description:
Assistant Manager \- Housing and Homelessness (Sanctuary Emergency Accommodation)
   

  

**Salary:** 
 £33,000 p.a.
   

  

**Full\-time (40 hours per week) with a 30min paid lunchbreak.**
 Monday 11:00am\-7:00pm
   

  

 Tuesday 10:00am\-6:00pm
   

  

 Wednesday 12:00pm\-8:00pm
   

  

 Thursday 12:00pm\-8:00pm
   

  

 Friday 1:00pm\-9:00pm
   

  

 You will also be rostered to work on bank holidays.
   

  

**Closing date:** 
 9am 5th October 2026
   

  

**Interview dates** 
 : tbc
   

  

 Employees are eligible for Medicash (a non\-contractual benefit), 33 days paid holiday, and a long service award (after five years).
   

  

 Our Emergency Accommodation offers short\-term accommodation (25 bedrooms), as well as support, meals and laundry facilities. Staff work with other services to provide a tailored package for each person while helping them towards moving into longer\-term accommodation.
   

  

 We are looking for a new assistant manager to support the Emergency Accommodation manager. The assistant manager will focus on the day\-to\-day operations of the service, supporting staff with service users and delegating responsibilities to the staff team. We are looking for a person who has a desire to help people who are experiencing homelessness. You may already have knowledge and understanding of homelessness, maybe through a previous job, as a volunteer, or through your own lived experience. You will be the sort of person who sees people experiencing rough sleeping or sofa surfing as a person, not just as ‘rough sleepers’ or ‘service users’.
   

  

 You will be self\-aware, compassionate, non\-judgmental, and have a strong degree of emotional intelligence. You will have excellent skills in communication, prioritisation, and administration. You will be able to inspire, motivate, and encourage others enabling them to grow and develop in their roles. You will be able to respond flexibly, confidently and professionally to any challenges which arise.

description:
**Description**
 Amazon is currently looking to hire an experienced Regional Manager \- Real Estate to join the team and play a critical role in supporting all property acquisition activity across Amazon's India Network . This role will be based in Kolkata. Regular Pan\- India travel will be required and this role reports to the Director\- Real Estate \& Operations Engineering in Bangalore.
   

  

 In this role you will support the India team to ensure the timely completion of new lease transactions including renewals, expansions, terminations, and reconfiguration of existing warehouse space. This encompasses the entire process from working with the local management team in defining the requirements, lease negotiations (business and legal terms), on\-site surveys, comparative financial analysis of lease transaction, and project management to affect the end result. Your primary objective in this role is to provide adequate, cost effective storage/operation space for Amazon on the continent given the market conditions working to challenging deadlines and budgetary requirements.
   

  

**Key Tasks/Responsibilities**
* Support the India team to fulfill the overall strategy for maintaining and developing space requirements of Amazon India Warehouse/storage strategy
* Develop and implement investment models together with market player to optimize investments
* Discuss with local stake holders and governmental bodies to ensure support for FC (Fulfillment Center) expansions
* Develop the annual India real estate business plan \& budget, and will be responsible for transactions to meet the business plan
* Developing regular communications to all business owners including local and central Finance managers, IT, legal, Operations, Facilities and Engineering functional representatives
* Landlord relations, negotiation and contractor management, including escalation of any issues beyond regular daily activity
* Alteration management and reducing Fix costs (all building related costs)


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of Reliability Program Manager or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree, or 2\+ years of Amazon experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Experience with computers, including MS Excel, Word and Office


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of team management, budget responsibilities, supplier management, problem solving, and client/ customer relations experience
* Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics \& robotics

**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month

title: Depot Troubleshooting Leader
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Depot Troubleshooting Leader in Sabarmati we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your technical and leadership expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside skilled, collaborative, and innovative teammates.
   

  

 You'll ensure the efficient operation of troubleshooting activities and provide essential technical and fault\-finding expertise to support service delivery, availability, and reliability of fleets and network equipment. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Core Team members, RAMS team, Project Engineering, Quality team), liaise with external stakeholders like customer representatives, and lead troubleshooting efforts while ensuring team readiness and compliance with EHS standards.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of coordinating the activities of Trouble Shooter Engineers, but also assist with pre\-work planning and skill development within autonomous teams.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Providing fault\-finding expertise and technical support for train repair activities and infrastructure maintenance
* Collating and analyzing data from system event downloads to identify failure modes and trends
* Reporting technical issues and liaising with Fleet Engineers, Safety Teams, and Engineering groups to resolve them
* Supporting the development of skills and knowledge transfer within teams
* Ensuring compliance with safety notices, rules, and local EHS standards
* Proactively escalating technical issues and supporting resolution efforts with Engineering teams


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Several years of technical experience in mechanical, electrical, or electronics fields (10\+ years for senior positions)
* Field experience (5\+ years for senior positions)
* Experience in project execution across technical, industrial, procurement, or supply chain functions
* Knowledge of general railway systems and safety standards
* Team management skills
* Familiarity with EHS standards and practices
* Desirable: RAM expertise, problem\-solving skills, and data analytics experience (e.g., Defect Management Systems)


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our dynamic and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards senior leadership roles or technical expert positions
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Chief of Cluster - Jharkhand
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The Agent / Chief of Cluster is responsible for the comprehensive management, strategic planning, and operational oversight of multiple mining sites within a designated cluster. This role ensures the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of all mining activities, aligning with the Coal Mines Regulation of 2017 and other relevant laws. The Agent / Chief of Cluster drives resource optimization, safety protocols, and stakeholder engagement, fostering continuous improvement, operational excellence, and sustainable practices across all sites.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Chief of Cluster \- Coal Mining**
**Strategic Leadership And Planning**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership for the operations of multiple mining sites within the cluster.
   

  

 Develop and implement long\-term operational plans and initiatives to enhance efficiency, productivity, and profitability.
   

  

 Align operational plans with the company’s goals, production targets, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Conduct feasibility studies and risk assessments for new projects and expansion initiatives.
   

  

 Monitor resource usage, production data, and performance metrics, making adjustments to meet changing operational needs and goals.
   

  

**Overall Mine Management**
 Supervise and coordinate all mining operations to ensure safe and efficient execution across the cluster.
   

  

 Develop and implement operational plans, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and production targets.
   

  

 Allocate resources, including manpower, equipment, and materials, to optimize mining operations and achieve production goals.
   

  

 Ensure all mining activities comply with the Coal Mines Regulation of 2017 and other relevant laws and regulations.
   

  

 Oversee daily mine operations to ensure alignment with safety standards and regulatory compliance.
   

  

**Safety And Compliance**
 Develop, enforce, and regularly update comprehensive safety protocols and procedures to maintain a safe working environment.

title: E-commerce Operations Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven Retail Operations Manager to lead and manage the end\-to\-end operations of Aavak's e\-commerce and marketplace business. The role will be responsible for driving operational excellence across seller onboarding, catalog management, order management, inventory, warehousing, fulfillment, logistics, returns, customer and seller support, and overall marketplace operations.

The candidate will own the operational performance of the Retail vertical, establish scalable processes and SOPs, monitor operational KPIs and SLAs, drive cross\-functional collaboration, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost\-effectiveness, service quality, and customer and seller experience. The role requires strong leadership, analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management capabilities, with the ability to build and scale processes within a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle of the Aavak Retail marketplace, covering seller activation, catalog readiness, order management, inventory, warehousing, fulfillment, last\-mile delivery, returns, cancellations, and post\-order support.
* Drive operational excellence by establishing standardized workflows, SOPs, process controls, SLAs, TATs, and quality benchmarks across retail operations.
* Manage and coordinate Retail Back Office, Retail Support, Warehouse, Fulfillment, and Delivery operations to ensure seamless execution and interdepartmental handoffs.
* Establish and monitor key operational metrics including Order Processing TAT, Order\-to\-Dispatch TAT, Fulfillment Rate, On\-Time Dispatch, On\-Time Delivery, Order Accuracy, Cancellation Rate, Return Rate, Inventory Accuracy, Seller Activation Rate, Issue Resolution TAT, and SLA adherence.
* Develop and maintain MIS dashboards and operational performance reports for daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual management reviews.
* Analyze operational data to identify process gaps, bottlenecks, failure points, cost leakages, and recurring operational issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for operational failures and develop appropriate Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans.
* Manage seller operational performance, including onboarding readiness, catalog quality, inventory availability, order fulfillment, dispatch compliance, and adherence to marketplace policies.
* Work closely with the Sales and Back Office teams to improve seller onboarding TAT, activation rates, catalog readiness, and seller adoption.
* Oversee coordination between Warehouse and Delivery teams to optimize inventory movement, order fulfillment, dispatch planning, route coordination, and last\-mile delivery performance.
* Monitor inventory accuracy and investigate stock variances, damages, shrinkage, returns, and reconciliation discrepancies in coordination with Warehouse and Accounts teams.
* Coordinate with Accounts on seller commissions, payouts, settlements, reimbursements, returns, and operational financial reconciliations.
* Work with IT and Platform teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve system defects, workflow issues, integration failures, dashboard discrepancies, and platform\-related operational bottlenecks.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to ensure campaign readiness, promotional execution, seller participation, inventory availability, and operational capacity planning.
* Establish appropriate escalation matrices and issue\-resolution workflows for customer, seller, warehouse, fulfillment, logistics, and platform\-related issues.
* Monitor customer and seller feedback, identify recurring pain points, and drive Customer Experience (CX) and Seller Experience (SX) improvements.
* Identify opportunities for process automation, workflow optimization, technology adoption, and cost rationalization across retail operations.
* Develop capacity planning and resource allocation processes to ensure operational readiness as order volumes, seller base, and geographic coverage increase.
* Monitor operational costs and identify opportunities to improve cost per order, fulfillment efficiency, logistics efficiency, and overall unit economics.
* Ensure operational teams adhere to company policies, SOPs, compliance requirements, safety standards, and defined service\-level benchmarks.
* Lead, mentor, and manage operational teams, establish performance expectations, allocate responsibilities, and drive KPI\-based performance management.
* Conduct periodic operational reviews and performance audits and present key findings, trends, risks, and improvement plans to senior management.
* Support senior management in developing the operating model, organizational structure, scalability framework, and expansion strategy for the Retail business.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Proven experience in e\-commerce operations, marketplace operations, retail operations, supply chain operations, or fulfillment management, preferably at a managerial level.
* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end e\-commerce order lifecycle, including seller onboarding, catalog management, inventory, order management, fulfillment, logistics, returns, cancellations, and customer support.
* Demonstrated experience in operations management, process design, SOP development, workflow optimization, and operational governance.
* Strong knowledge of KPI, SLA, TAT, MIS, dashboard, and performance\-management frameworks.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform RCA, CAPA, process mapping, gap analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing cross\-functional teams and multiple operational stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of warehouse, inventory, fulfillment, and last\-mile delivery operations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, MIS reporting, dashboards, and operational analytics; familiarity with ERP, WMS, OMS, CRM, or marketplace management systems preferred.
* Ability to interpret operational data and translate insights into actionable business and process improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, stakeholder\-management, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong understanding of cost optimization, operational efficiency, resource planning, and unit economics.
* Ability to operate independently, take ownership of business\-critical operational issues, and work under tight timelines.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup and multi\-brand environment.
* Prior experience in e\-commerce, marketplace, D2C, retail technology, logistics, or fulfillment operations preferred.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
The Finance Analyst will provide comprehensive financial and analytical support for a Facilities Management client account within JLL's Real Estate Management Services (REMS) division. This role focuses on day\-to\-day financial operations including transaction processing, MIS reporting, variance analysis, and client billing support. The Finance Analyst will work closely with client finance teams, JLL operations personnel, and the Finance Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting, timely invoicing, and effective financial controls for the account.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Reporting \& MIS**
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for the client account
* Generate Management Information System (MIS) reports, dashboards, and analytical summaries for internal and external stakeholders
* Maintain and update financial trackers, reconciliations, and supporting documentation
* Ensure timely and accurate financial close processes


**Variance Analysis \& Performance Tracking**
* Conduct detailed variance analysis comparing actuals against budgets and forecasts
* Identify trends, anomalies, and cost drivers impacting financial performance
* Prepare commentary and explanations for variances to support management review
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics relevant to the client account


**Budgeting \& Forecasting Support**
* Assist in the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts
* Gather inputs from operations teams and consolidate financial data for planning processes
* Update forecast models based on actual performance and business changes
* Support scenario analysis and what\-if modeling exercises


**Client Billing \& Invoicing**
* Coordinate client billing activities, ensuring accurate and timely invoice generation
* Review billing data for completeness and accuracy before client submission
* Liaise with client finance teams to resolve billing queries and disputes
* Track invoice status, payment collections, and accounts receivable aging


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Client Engagement**
* Serve as a finance point of contact for day\-to\-day client inquiries and requests
* Coordinate with external client finance teams on routine financial matters, data requests, and reporting schedules
* Work collaboratively with JLL operations teams to gather information and resolve financial issues
* Participate in client review meetings and present financial reports as needed


**Transaction Processing \& Data Management**
* Process financial transactions in ERP systems with accuracy and adherence to controls
* Maintain data integrity across financial systems and databases
* Perform account reconciliations and support month\-end close activities
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies and client\-specific requirements


**Process Improvement \& Automation**
* Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes and improve efficiency
* Support implementation of automation tools and system enhancements
* Maintain and update standard operating procedures and documentation


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or related field required


**Experience**
* 4–8 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial analysis roles
* Demonstrated experience in client\-facing or stakeholder engagement activities (coordinating with external client teams or business partners)
* Background in financial reporting, variance analysis, budgeting, and transactional finance
* Experience supporting billing or invoicing processes


**Industry Experience (Preferred)**
* Exposure to Facilities Management, Real Estate Services, Property Management, or related service industries is desirable but not mandatory


**Technical Proficiency**
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, complex formulas, data analysis, charting)
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as JDE (JD Edwards), SAP, or similar enterprise finance platforms
* Financial modeling and analytical capabilities
* Experience with data visualization and reporting tools is a plus


**Core Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Effective communication skills for engaging with clients, operations teams, and finance stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Proactive approach to identifying issues and proposing solutions
* Team player with ability to work collaboratively across functions
* Organized and detail\-oriented with commitment to accuracy and quality
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to evolving business requirements

title: Senior FinOps Analyst
description:
Sapiens is on the lookout for a Senior FinOps Analyst sits within the Cloud Services Office (CSO) – FinOps \& Demand Management function, reporting to the Director of FinOps. This is a critical, data\-driven role responsible for governing cloud financial performance, enabling demand transparency, and driving cost optimisation across the organisation. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of finance, technology, and business operations — ensuring cloud investments are aligned, accountable, and delivering measurable value.
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Working Model: Our flexible work arrangement combines both remote and in\-office work, optimizing flexibility and productivity.
   

  

 This position will be part of Sapiens CTO – Cloud Services division, for more information about it, click here: www.sapiens.com .
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**FinOps Governance \& Cloud Cost Management**
* Lead cloud financial governance — owning cost visibility, optimisation, forecasting, anomaly detection, and accountability for cloud spend across all business units.
* Maintain and enforce FinOps policies, standards, and controls to ensure financial discipline in cloud consumption.
* Proactively identify cost inefficiencies, overspend, and waste — and drive actionable remediation with engineering and operations teams.
* Target performance: ≤±5% variance from approved budget and ≥10–15% annual cost optimisation year\-over\-year.


 Demand Management \& Capacity Forecasting
   

  

* Define and lead the demand intake process — ensuring alignment between business priorities, resource requests, and cloud execution capacity.
* Assess and prioritise demand items within SLA (≤5–10 business days from intake to prioritisation decision), with ≥95% of items formally assessed and tracked.
* Collaborate with engineering and operations leads to align capacity planning with strategic demand signals.
* Provide data\-driven forecasting to inform resource allocation decisions and avoid under\- or over\-provisioning.


 Reporting \& Executive Insights
   

  

* Produce and maintain monthly FinOps reports — covering cloud spend, budget variance, forecast accuracy, and optimisation progress — for executive leadership and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Design and manage dashboards and reporting cadences that give real\-time visibility into financial and demand performance.
* Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, executive\-appropriate narratives and recommendations.
* Support the Head of CSO in quarterly transformation milestone reviews and board\-level reporting as required.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact between the CSO team and Finance (P\&L), engineering leads, and operations stakeholders on all matters of cloud cost and demand.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across all SCS internal teams, ensuring consumption decisions are financially sound and operationally viable.
* Facilitate regular demand reviews (weekly cadence) and FinOps governance meetings, ensuring actions are tracked and owners are accountable.
* Contribute to the broader transformation and continuous improvement agenda within the CSO team.


**Must Have Skills**
**What to Have for this position.**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation) preferred; cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP) are a strong advantage.


 Professional Experience
   

  

* 4–7 years of experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, or a related function within a technology or cloud\-native environment.
* Demonstrated track record of cloud cost optimisation, with measurable outcomes and a focus on budget adherence.
* Experience with demand management, resource planning, or operational governance in a cloud services context.
* Proven ability to produce executive\-level financial and operational reporting for senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with FinOps tooling (e.g. CloudHealth, Apptio, Cloudability, AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management).


**Skills \& Core Competencies**
**Personal \& Interpersonal Technical \& Delivery**
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail
* Cloud cost management \& optimisation
* Strong communicator — able to translate financial data into business language
* Demand and capacity forecasting
* Collaborative across engineering, finance, and operations teams
* Budget management \& variance analysis
* Proactive and self\-driven with high accountability
* FinOps governance and financial controls
* Resilient under pressure with ability to manage competing priorities
* Dashboard design and executive reporting
* Influencing without direct authority across stakeholder groups
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP cost tools
* Tooling: CloudHealth, Apptio, Cloudability, or similar


**Personal Attributes**
 The Ideal Candidate Is More Than An Analyst — They Are a Proactive Financial Steward And Demand Coordinator Who Can Be Counted On To Bring Rigour, Clarity, And Accountability To Cloud Operations. We Are Looking For Someone With
   

  

* A data\-first mindset — naturally drawn to numbers, trends, and root\-cause analysis, with the confidence to challenge spend decisions based on evidence.
* A bias for action — someone who surfaces issues early, escalates with clear recommendations, and does not wait to be told.
* Exceptional organisational discipline — able to manage multiple reporting cycles, stakeholder demands, and governance processes without dropping the ball.
* A collaborative, influential style — able to work across finance, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.
* Strong ownership mentality — takes personal responsibility for the accuracy, timeliness, and impact of their work.
* A calm, composed presence — able to handle ambiguity and pressure while maintaining the confidence of senior stakeholders.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within the first 6 months, the Senior FinOps Analyst will be expected to:
   

  

 1 Establish full visibility of cloud spend across all business units, with a baseline cost model and variance tracking in place.
   

  

 2 Deliver the first monthly FinOps report to executive leadership — clear, accurate, and decision\-ready.
   

  

 3 Implement a demand intake and prioritisation process that meets the ≤5–10 day SLA for assessment and decision.
   

  

 4 Identify and drive at least one meaningful cost optimisation initiative contributing to the annual 10–15% savings target.
   

  

 5 Be regarded as the go\-to person for cloud cost transparency, demand data, and FinOps governance within the CSO team.
   

  

**AI Expectations**
* Basic understanding of Generative AI and LLMs, including practical use cases for improving productivity and business operations.
* Experience using AI\-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to automate reporting, analyze data, summarize insights, and improve operational efficiency.
* Ability to leverage AI for FinOps activities, such as cloud cost analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, budget optimization, and executive reporting.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, and appropriate use of AI when handling enterprise financial and operational data.


**About Sapiens**
 Sapiens International Corporation (NASDAQ and TASE: SPNS) is a global leader in intelligent insurance software solutions. With Sapiens’ robust platform, customer\-driven partnerships, and rich ecosystem, insurers are empowered to future\-proof their organizations with operational excellence in a rapidly changing marketplace. We help insurers harness the power of AI and advanced automation to support core solutions for property and casualty, workers’ compensation, and life insurance, including reinsurance, financial \& compliance, data \& analytics, digital, and decision management. Sapiens boasts a longtime global presence, serving over 600 customers in more than 30 countries with its innovative SaaS offerings. Recognized by industry experts and selected for the Microsoft Top 100 Partner program, Sapiens is committed to partnering with our customers for their entire transformation journey and is continuously innovating to ensure their success. For More information visit us on www.sapiens.com .
   

  

 Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment that embraces individuals from diverse backgrounds.

Hence, beware of inauthentic and fraudulent job offers or recruitment drives from any individuals or websites purporting to represent Sapiens. Further, Sapiens does not charge any fee or other emoluments for any reason (including without limitation, visa fees) or seek compensation from educational institutions to participate in recruitment events. Accordingly, please check the authenticity of any such offers before acting on them and were acted upon, you do so at your own risk. Sapiens shall neither be responsible for honouring or making good the promises made by fraudulent third parties, nor for any monetary or any other loss incurred by the aggrieved individual or educational institution.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio\-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
 



  





 At our core, we are an AI\-powered entertainment company with a deeply human\-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
 



  





 Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250\+ million listeners, 300,000\+ creators, and 100,000\+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest\-growing media\-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast\-moving, and deeply owner\-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long\-term impact as we shape the future of audio\-first storytelling worldwide.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We’re looking for a business finance expert to drive business planning, performance analysis, and commercial decision\-making. You’ll work on financial strategy behind our biggest bets: expanding storytelling formats, optimizing global content launches, scaling AI\-powered production, and refining user acquisition economics. You’ll work directly with functional leaders, run point on key business cases, simplify complex trade\-offs, and ensure we’re compounding in the right direction,
 



  





 What will you do ?
 


* Create and evaluate business cases, investment proposals, and ROI models to support strategic decisions
* Work with business heads to drive financial strategy and execution across high\-impact initiatives
* Track key performance metrics, identify trends, and recommend actions to improve profitability
* Prepare and present MIS reports and dashboards for leadership, enabling data\-backed decisions
* Lead commercial negotiations, manage vendor contracts, and drive cost optimization across teams
* Leverage industry experience in digital media, consumer internet, or streaming to inform financial strategy



  





 What we’re looking for
 


* Chartered Accountant (CA) with a strong foundation in business finance and strategic thinking
* Sharp financial acumen with the ability to translate numbers into actionable insights
* 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in financial modelling , forecasting tools, and performance tracking frameworks
* A business\-first mindset — someone who can see finance as a lever for scale, not just control
* Bias for action — thrives in ambiguity and solves problems with a first\-principles approach
* Experience in high\-growth consumer\-tech, media\-tech, or streaming businesses is a strong advantage

title: Finance Lead - Client Business Partner
description:
**Role Summary**
 The Finance Lead will lead financial planning, analysis, and reporting for a Facilities Management client account within JLL's Real Estate Management Services (REMS) division. This role serves as the primary finance business partner to the client, providing strategic insights, driving budgeting and forecasting processes, and ensuring accurate financial reporting and billing operations. The Finance Manager will manage client stakeholder relationships, coordinate with external client finance teams, and lead a team of finance professionals supporting the account.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Financial Planning \& Business Partnership**
* Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with client objectives and service delivery goals
* Partner with client leadership and JLL operations teams to drive business decisions through financial insights and performance analysis
* Lead annual budgeting processes and quarterly forecasting cycles, incorporating business drivers and market trends
* Provide strategic recommendations on cost optimization, pricing strategies, and service delivery models
* Client Management \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Serve as the primary finance point of contact for external client finance teams and senior stakeholders
* Present financial performance reports, variance analyses, and business insights to client leadership
* Manage client expectations regarding financial deliverables, billing accuracy, and reporting timelines
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client finance departments to ensure seamless coordination


**Financial Reporting \& Analysis**
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting for the client account
* Conduct comprehensive variance analysis against budgets and forecasts, identifying trends and root causes
* Prepare executive\-level financial presentations and dashboards for internal and external stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, JLL policies, and client\-specific reporting requirements


**Billing, Invoicing \& Revenue Management**
* Oversee client billing processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of invoices
* Resolve billing disputes and coordinate with operations teams on pricing and contract terms
* Monitor revenue recognition and accounts receivable performance


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead and mentor finance analysts and other team members supporting the account
* Allocate responsibilities, set performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development within the finance team


**Systems \& Process Improvement**
* Drive automation and process enhancements to improve financial reporting efficiency
* Ensure effective utilization of ERP systems and financial tools to support account management


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), MBA in Finance, or equivalent professional qualification required


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of progressive finance experience, with at least 3–4 years in a managerial or business partnering role
* Demonstrated experience managing external client relationships and coordinating with client finance teams
* Proven track record in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Experience leading and developing finance teams


**Industry Experience (Preferred)**
* Background in Facilities Management, Real Estate Services, Property Management, or related service industries is highly desirable but not mandatory

Controllers also ensure that the firm's activities are conducted in compliance with the regulations governing transactions in the financial markets.

title: Senior Manager, Structured Credit Trading

title: Manager - Revenue Operations & Commercial Finance
description:
**About the role** 




 Mareana builds AI\-powered data platforms for life sciences and advanced manufacturing. We do complex, enterprise deals. These are high\-value long\-term contracts with a small number of strategically important customers. That means every deal matters individually, and the commercial machinery behind it has to be precise rather than high\-volume.
 



  





 This role owns that machinery. You will sit between Sales, Legal, Delivery and Finance, running the contracting workflow, the deal desk, commissions, and bookings reporting, and will use the same data to support revenue forecasting and management reporting.
 



  





 It is deliberately a hybrid role: part revenue operations, part commercial finance. You will be the single person who can answer both "what did we book?" and "what does that mean for revenue, margin and cash?" You will work directly with the Senior Director of Finance, with visibility to the CFO and the leadership team.
 



  





**What you will own** 




**Customer contracting** 



* Draft, review and negotiate MSAs, NDAs and SOWs alongside Legal and Sales
* Run the contract redlining and internal approval workflow, keeping cycle times predictable
* Manage the full contract lifecycle: renewals, amendments and terminations
* Prepare order forms and pricing schedules
* Maintain the contract repository and track contractual obligations, milestones and key dates



  





**Sales operations** 



* Design the annual sales commission plan with Finance and Sales leadership
* Run monthly commission calculation and administration
* Reconcile sales compensation and resolve disputes
* Provide deal desk support: pricing approvals, non\-standard terms and exception handling
* Perform deal\-level margin analysis, both pre\-signature and post\-delivery
* Track bookings (TCV / ACV) by rep, segment and product line
* Own quote\-to\-cash and order processing, working with Billing and Delivery
* Build and maintain sales reporting and dashboards — pipeline, KPIs, win/loss
* Administer the CRM and enforce data hygiene as the commercial system of record
* Track renewals and upsell / expansion opportunities



  





**Commercial Finance** 



* Support the rolling revenue forecast, including pipeline\-weighted and probability\-adjusted models
* Maintain Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and bookings reporting, and reconcile it to the P\&L
* Prepare commercial inputs for monthly management reporting and board materials
* Perform variance analysis on bookings, revenue and sales cost against plan
* Support revenue recognition for subscription and services contracts
* Model commission and pricing scenarios and their P\&L impact



  





**What we are looking for** 




**Must have** 



* 5\-7 years in revenue operations, sales operations, commercial finance or business finance, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS or a technology services business
* Hands\-on ownership of at least one full commission cycle and one bookings / ARR reporting cycle
* Working fluency in a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), not just a consumer of reports. The ability to build reports, fix data and design a workflow
* Strong commercial contract literacy. Experience with MSA or SOW, including understanding what drives revenue timing, margin and risk
* Genuine financial competence. Advanced Excel, comfort with revenue recognition principles, and the ability to build a forecast model from first principles
* Clear written and verbal communication and the confidence to say no to a poor deal structure



  





**Good to have** 



* Exposure to CPQ, contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools, or revenue intelligence platforms such as Clari or Gong.
* Experience in a business with long enterprise sales cycles and a small number of high\-value logos
* Familiarity with professional services delivery and time\-and\-materials or milestone\-based billing and profitability/resource utilization analysis.
* CA, MBA (Finance), CMA or equivalent — useful, but not required where the practical experience is there
* Exposure to US GAAP or ASC 606



  





**What will make you successful here** 



* Comfort operating as an individual contributor with wide scope. This is a build role, not a maintain role, as many of the processes are yet\-to\-be\-developed.
* Judgement over process adherence. With a small deal count, the right answer usually requires thought rather than a playbook
* Willingness to work across time zones with the US commercial team



  





**Why this role is worth taking** 



* Full\-stack commercial ownership. Most people in this space get either the CRM or the model. Here you get both, plus contracting.
* Direct access to the CFO, Senior Director of Finance, and senior Sales and Delivery leaders, with visibility into board\-level reporting
* Real influence on how the commercial function is built, at a stage where the decisions are still being made
* A clear path into a broader commercial finance or revenue operations leadership role as the business scales

title: Cost Engineering Manager
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world.  What You Can Expect
   

  

 The Cost Engineering Manager plays a critical role in estimating, budgeting, and developing cost insights into direct and indirect products and services. * Develop cost models and detailed cost break up for product, services with detailed insights into labor, materials, transportation and overhead cost buckets.

* Identify opportunities for cost improvement with external suppliers and service partners and develop broad road maps for product/service costs along with commercial and contractual terms including costs. Develop zero\-based costing or “Should Costing” for Zimmer Biomet products and services that can become reference costs for product launch, negotiations, and product pricing.
* Build dashboards and models to track Cost Model development and “Should Cost” progress.
* Develop market intelligence for competitive products, develop cost models from tear down, and re\-engineering for competition products.
* Develop Zimmer Biomet products benchmark costing for products and services based on competition and industry trends.
* Develop data analytics for commodity costs databases, trend trackers, labor markets costs data models for each region and freight, logistics costs models for Zimmer Biomet products, and services.
* Develop, deploy, and document cost management standards, procedures, and templates for using across organizations globally.
* Partner with Category Managers, Legal, and Finance to prepare for high\-impact negotiations.
* Collaborate with Finance for product costs roll ups and budgeting.
* Support automation and digital tools that enhance cost engineering efficiency and transparency.
* Ensure cost engineering practices align with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation and audit trails for strategic negotiations.
* Prepare reports, presentations, business communications, data summaries, and other documents of both a recurring and nonrecurring nature.
* Create reports to show financial impact of procurement projects and initiatives.
* Perform moderately complex analyses of data to draw inferences or conclusions to drive sound decisions.
* Collaborate actively with key stakeholders to ensure Procurement is actively engaged at the beginning of the process in core business initiatives and processes.


 What Makes You Stand Out
   

  

* “Should Costing” development for major cost driver products and services.

* The relationship between this role, Procurement senior leadership, Procurement team members, and cross\-functional stakeholders will be working well with no confusion regarding roles and responsibilities.

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical competence, work accurately and efficiently to tight month end deadlines, and take genuine ownership of their processes. The GL Accountant will play a key role in building a high performing GL function within the IDC.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**General Ledger Operations**
* Process and review journal entries in accordance with approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Maintain accurate and timely financial records across multiple entities and currencies (UK, Ireland and US)
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and maintain bank accounts including bank reconciliation
* Fixed assets accounting including registration, capitalisation, depreciation, and disposals
* Monitor the accuracy and appropriateness of allocations across cost centres
* Prepare and post journal entries with full supporting documentation
* Execute month end close activities including accruals, prepayments, and intercompany reconciliations
* Resolve reconciling items within agreed timelines
* Perform closing and consolidation activities including period end close, consolidation journal entries, and preparation of trial balance
* Perform closing department checks in accordance with the month end close timetable
* Preparation of financial inputs to monthly management accounts
* Support annual financial statements preparation and year end close activities
* Perform intercompany journal entries and intercompany balance reconciliations
* Apply all controls consistently and escalate any deviation, system issue, or exception immediately to the R2R Manager


**Process Compliance and Quality**
* Follow approved SOPs precisely at all times and support continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies and raising recommendations to the R2R Manager
* Maintain quality standards and turnaround times agreed between the IDC and the onshore Finance team
* Support the R2R Manager in monitoring process performance and flagging risks to the GPO Lead


**Knowledge Transfer and Collaboration**
* Actively participate in process walkthroughs, observation sessions, and supervised practice during the knowledge transfer period
* Build effective working relationships with Finance colleagues and stakeholders as directed by the R2R Manager, supporting seamless day\-to\-day operations


**Systems and Reporting**
* Prepare reports and reconciliation schedules as required by the R2R Manager and onshore Finance team
* Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules, providing documentation, and responding to queries


**Qualifications**
* Part\-qualified or newly qualified accountant — CA (ICAI), CMA (ICMAI), or ACCA preferred. The target profile is a CA finalist or newly qualified CA with 3 to 4 years of post\-articleship experience in a shared service or GL environment, within an overall experience range of 3 to 6 years
* Proven, independent ownership of month end close processes — journal preparation, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and intercompany accounting — executed to deadline without supervision
* Solid understanding of IFRS accounting standards
* Hands\-on experience with NetSuite ERP system or a comparable enterprise ERP (SAP, Oracle)
* Proficiency in MS Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and reconciliation tools
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English — essential for working with onshore Finance teams in the UK and Ireland
* Experience in a Shared Services Centre, Finance Operations team, or offshore delivery environment is required
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and ability to work to tight month end deadlines
* Proactive and results\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability


**Additional Information**
 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
   

  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


 And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.
   

  

 Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

title: Consultant, Proj Mgt Office
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Position Summary** 
  

  

 Provides governance, delivery management, financial oversight, and portfolio reporting support across the Market Change \& Modernization (MCM) portfolio. Serves as a key partner to Program Managers, Portfolio Leadership, Finance, and Governance stakeholders to ensure projects and programs comply with organizational governance standards. Coordinates portfolio\-level reporting, forecasting, audit readiness activities, health checks, risk management, gating processes, and executive governance materials while facilitating delivery transparency and operational effectiveness across multiple strategic initiatives.
   

  

  

  

**Major Duties** 
  

  

 Leads governance and delivery management activities across multiple programs and projects within the MCM portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and controls.
   

  

 Owns and facilitates portfolio reporting processes including Clarity status reporting, executive governance reporting, health checks, project metrics, and delivery transparency initiatives.
   

  

 Coordinates monthly and bi\-weekly forecasting, financial reporting, budget tracking, variance analysis, and project financial governance activities.
   

  

 Develops and maintains governance artifacts including PWG/PSG materials, project health checks, RAID reporting, decision logs, dependency tracking, and audit evidence repositories.
   

  

 Facilitates cross\-functional governance forums, stakeholder reviews, working groups, and status review sessions with program leadership, delivery teams, and senior management.
   

  

 Acts as a subject matter expert for Clarity PPM processes, governance reporting, forecasting, status reporting, project setup, portfolio hygiene, and reporting best practices.
   

  

 Supports audit remediation efforts by coordinating evidence collection, documentation reviews, process adherence, and governance control activities.
   

  

 Maintains portfolio RAID governance through review and tracking of risks, issues, actions, dependencies, decisions, and remediation activities across programs.
   

  

 Partners with Program Managers and project teams to improve reporting quality, project controls, project plan integrity, milestone management, and governance compliance.
   

  

 Develops reporting standards, process improvements, training materials, and operational guidance to improve portfolio effectiveness and consistency across teams.
   

  

 Provides onboarding, mentoring, and training to project managers, PMOs, and delivery teams on Clarity PPM, governance processes, and reporting requirements.
   

  

 Supports project and program lifecycle activities including ideation, project setup, budgeting support, governance readiness, gating preparation, and portfolio controls.
   

  

  

  

**Knowledge \& Skills** 
  

  

* Knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management practices.
* Strong understanding of enterprise governance frameworks, , portfolio governance, stage gating and audit control environments.
* Proficiency with Clarity PPM and project financial management processes.
* Experience managing executive reporting, governance forums, and stakeholder communications.
* Financial management skills including forecasting, budget tracking, variance analysis, and reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage risks, issues, dependencies, actions, and decision governance across large initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence outcomes and coordinate work across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong process improvement and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and deadlines.


  

  

**Experience** 
  

  

* For internal applications \- 24 months as Consultant
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Significant experience supporting project, program, PMO, governance, or portfolio management functions.
* Experience supporting complex regulatory, operational, technology, or business transformation initiatives.
* Experience with portfolio reporting, governance, audit management, financial controls, forecasting, and executive\-level communications.
* Experience working in large, matrixed financial services organizations preferred.


  

  

**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Staff Analyst
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an ambitious, highly analytical self\-starter to step into a high\-visibility role within our Agent (Partnerships) business. Partnerships is our high\-velocity business line that provides insurance agents with a digital\-first platform, automated underwriting infrastructure, insurance products, and specialized services to help them sell more life insurance, faster.
   

  

 Working as an elite individual contributor, you will sit squarely at the intersection of product mechanics, data science, and operational strategy. You will partner directly with our business leaders to solve unstructured data puzzles, proactively flag macro financial risks, and define the behavioral milestones that turn new agents into long\-term platform advocates. If you are a big\-picture thinker who loves digging into the data weeds to write the strategic story of enterprise growth, let's talk.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Strategic Partnerships Data Lead: Serve as an analytics thought partner and data expert for the Partnerships leadership team, spearheading strategic decisions around agent acquisition, growth, retention, persistency, and more.
* Core Product Analytics: Track, evaluate, and optimize the agent\-facing platform experience. Define precision usability metrics for new product features to ensure engineering sprint cycles drive positive user actions.
* Operational Risk \& Commission Debt Architecture: Build diagnostic data models to analyze, track, and mitigate backend financial exposure. Slice historical operational datasets to pinpoint risk concentration hotspots within external agencies and design targeted debt recovery frameworks.
* Strategic Input Modeling: Isolate critical growth levers across the agent journey to define the definitive onboarding metric (the "aha moment") that yields a positive snowball effect on platform retention and aggregate revenue generation.
* Funnel Optimization: Manage performance frameworks and monitor conversion steps for our emerging annuities business lines using a classic Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) funnel approach.
* Data Democratization \& Infrastructure: Collaborate with data engineers and broader analytics teams to maintain scalable business logic, deploy clean tracking dashboards, and enable self\-service analytics across the organization.
* Tooling Innovation: Actively build, test, and integrate advanced generative AI tools to automate internal analytics processes and maximize delivery speed.
* Team Mentorship: Provide ongoing guidance, peer code reviews, and tactical leadership training to distributed junior analytics resources across our global offices.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Experience Baseline: 5 to 8 years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, data science, or analytically intensive individual contributor roles at high\-growth tech startups or well\-established firms.
* Technical Mastery: Non\-negotiable expert knowledge of SQL. Strong foundational knowledge of statistics and predictive data modeling is highly desired. Familiarity with scripting languages (Python or R) is a major plus.
* AI\-Native Workflow Fluency: Proven history of actively leveraging modern Large Language Models (like ChatGPT or Claude) inside your day\-to\-day workflow to streamline writing, debug calculations, and automate personal efficiency. Must rank in the top 10% of AI\-fluent analysts.
* Analytics Stack Exposure: Experience utilizing advanced visualization, dashboarding, and AI\-enabled analytics environments (such as Hex, Tableau, Mode, or Excel).
* Unstructured Problem Solving: Exceptional talent for entering highly ambiguous situations, slicing past data records proactively to expose root causes, and organizing disparate facts into clear corporate narratives.
* Executive Presentation Agility: Superior written and verbal communication skills; comfortable defending high\-stakes analytical summaries to the corporate C\-suite and Board of Directors.
* Education: Advanced degree in a quantitative domain (Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math) or equivalent practical technical background.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Principal Consultant - Data Centres & Digital Infrastructure Advisory
description:
**Job Description**
 At WSP, we are driven by a shared purpose: to create positive, long\-lasting impacts on the world around us. As a global leader in strategic advisory services, we are proud to have been named
 **\#1 Advisor by Deal Value in 2024** 
 by Infranews. Our Investment and Transaction Advisory team is at the forefront of supporting digital infrastructure growth, providing technical and commercial insight across high\-value transactions in the data centre and digital infrastructure ecosystem.
   

  

 We are seeking an exceptional
 **Principal Consultant** 
 to join our growing advisory team, with a focus on technical due diligence in data centres and digital infrastructure.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to work on hyperscale and colocation data centre platforms, edge infrastructure, and supporting digital ecosystems (including power, cooling, connectivity and real estate), while also providing exposure to a broader range of infrastructure sectors, including energy, transport and social infrastructure, across high\-profile investment transactions and strategic advisory mandates.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Your Role Will Include:**
* Supporting the delivery of technical and commercial due diligence assignments for investors, lenders, and developers across the data centre sector (hyperscale, colocation, and edge facilities).
* Assessing design basis and operational performance of data centres, including:
* Power infrastructure (grid connection, redundancy, backup systems)
* Cooling systems (air/liquid cooling, energy efficiency)
* IT load capacity and scalability
* Uptime / resilience standards (Tier classification)
* Supporting investment cases and business plans, including capex benchmarking, lifecycle costs, and expansion strategies.
* Advising on operational performance, asset management practices, and risk identification across portfolios.
* Providing technical and commercial input into bids and pursuits, shaping competitive proposals through robust asset and demand insights to strengthen proposals.
* Working on cross\-sector digital infrastructure projects, including telecoms, fibre networks, and energy interface with DC assets.
* Engaging directly with clients, presenting findings that influence investment and financing decisions.
* Participating in site visits and international projects as required.


**OUR TEAM**
 The Investment and Transaction Advisory team has a strong track record of supporting clients at the early stage of projects such as feasibility plans, market forecasts as well as technical assessment of complex projects. As part of the GCC delivery team, the role supports opportunities and projects across Europe, Asia and North America. Our key clients cover a wide range of different organisations in the private and public sectors. Key clients include financial institutions (pension funds, investors and financiers), operators (utilities, ports, rail and mobility) and wider industry.
   

  

 We are expanding from a strong transport base into new sectors, including industrial clients, major government programmes (e.g. Port Infrastructure Fund, UK Freeports), mobility, and energy infrastructure \[RC3] . \[RC4] \[SG5] WSP has a global network of over 10,500 advisory professionals and 80,000 employees across technical, sustainability and advisory disciplines, enabling our front\-end consultancy to draw on deep expertise across transaction advisory (including PPP), investment advisory, market studies, demand forecasting, feasibility studies, and management consultancy.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE**
* Proven experience in data centres or digital infrastructure, ideally within:
* Engineering consultancy
* Advisory / due diligence
* Owner/operator or developer environment
* Strong understanding of:
* Data centre design and operations (power, cooling, redundancy)
* Capacity planning, utilisation, and scalability
* Asset lifecycle management and reliability
* Experience in technical due diligence or investment advisory for infrastructure assets.
* Ability to work on complex assignments and engage with senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing workstreams and delivering under tight deadlines.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset across multidisciplinary teams.
* Interest in the growth of digital infrastructure and its role in enabling global connectivity and AI/data\-driven economies.


 BGV:
   

  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.


**About Us**
 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 With approximately
 **4,000 talented people** 
 across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru \& Mumbai offices) in India and more than
 **73,000 globally** 
 , in 550
 **offices across 40 countries** 
 , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**
* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Working Module**
 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.


**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
 Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. title: Analyst - Financial Analysis
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.


As a **Financial Analyst** within the Consumer Banking team in Bengaluru, you will support reporting and analytics for **Branch Network Transformation initiatives**—specifically **New Builds, Branch Consolidations, and Branch Relocations**. This role goes beyond traditional MIS reporting: you will directly **extract data from the data warehouse using SQL**, reconcile across sources, and translate operational and financial signals into **decision\-ready insights** for Finance and senior stakeholders. You will partner with Finance and Program teams to standardize definitions, improve data integrity, and enable consistent governance reporting across the transformation portfolio.


Job responsibilities

* **Build and own reporting for New Builds, Consolidations, and Relocations** by first understanding underlying data structures and source tables, extracting required data (SQL/Databricks), defining key cuts/segmentations, and developing meaningful KPIs and insights for governance and finance reporting.
* Develop and maintain **SQL queries** and **Python\-based workflows** to support recurring reporting, ad\-hoc analysis, and automated validation/reconciliation routines.
* Define, calculate, and maintain standardized performance and execution metrics (e.g., plan vs actual milestone attainment, cycle\-time/aging, slippage indicators, exception flags) to support governance and forecast discussions.
* Perform reconciliations across systems (program tools vs finance/warehouse datasets); investigate and explain variances, identify root causes, and track issues through resolution with partner teams.
* Support Finance partners by translating business questions into clear analytical requirements and producing accurate, explainable outputs aligned to finance definitions and controls.
* Provide insight\-led commentary for leadership forums: highlight key movements, risks, bottlenecks, and **actions needed**, supported by data.
* Contribute to dashboards and visualization deliverables where needed (e.g., ThoughtSpot/Power BI/Tableau) and drive process improvements to reduce manual effort and improve refresh reliability.
* Apply data controls and governance standards, including documentation, validation checks, lineage clarity, and change traceability.


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* \~2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or an analytical finance support role.
* Strong proficiency in **SQL** (complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions) with ability to extract directly from data warehouse/Databricks environments.
* Working proficiency in **Python** for data transformation, reconciliation, and analytical workflows.
* Demonstrated experience working with complex datasets across multiple systems and resolving inconsistencies in definitions and outputs.
* Ability to structure and communicate analysis clearly to finance and non\-technical stakeholders (clear narrative, drivers, and implications).
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills for analysis and validation.
* Experience with one or more Intelligent Automation tools (preferred).
* Exposure to finance concepts such as P\&L, cost drivers, allocations, cost center structures, and reporting hierarchies; experience supporting governance routines is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.
