 accurate and is responsible for monitoring and follow up on the effectiveness of the operations, the
   

  

 quality, environmental issues. The Factory Controller is responsible to point out areas where
   

  

 potential costs reductions can be achieved to the management.
   

  

* Cost savings – the Factory Controller is responsible to provide a detailed follow up for the


 management on VPC and LES related costs savings, investment related cost savings
   

  

* Investments – the Factory Controller is responsible for making sure that the investments are


 done according to the Rockwool group principles, including helping compile the required
   

  

 information, and reporting it accordingly
   

  

* Costing/BOM – the Factory Controller is responsible for maintaining an accurate BOM (Bill of


 Material), and helping the operations department
   

  

* eNA – the Factory Controller is responsible for creating SKUs based on the inputs from


 production and sales and keeping upto SKUs with respect to cost and measures
   

  

* Variance analysis – the Factory Controller is responsible reporting monthly variance actual vs


 budget vs TYCE for VPC, PKF, cost saving.
   

  

* Ad\-hoc tasks – ad\-hoc tasks should take up 20\-30% of the Factory Controllers time – these


 should include all ad\-hoc projects requested by operations, as well as own initiatives to increase
   

  

 efficiency, or reduce costs.
   

  

* Standardization and benchmarking – the Factory Controller is responsible for pro\-actively


 benchmarking across OPCOs, and working closely together with the operations department to
   

  

 achieve “best in class” performance. Furthermore, the controller should actively participate in
   

  

 improving the control environment in Rockwool Asia.

 standard format and within strict timeline

 Factory operations, capex and opex.

description:
**HIRING: Senior Executive – Finance \& Accounts** 

  
 




**About the Role** 

  
 




 We are looking for an experienced, high\-ownership Senior Executive – Finance \& Accounts to manage end\-to\-end accounting, plant costing, statutory compliance, and corporate reporting for our manufacturing unit in Chennai. Working directly with the Finance HOD, you will serve as the operational core of our finance department, handling everything from day\-to\-day transactions to audit management and banking operations.
 
  
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 

  
 




  





**1\. Financial Accounting, AP/AR \& MIS** 

  
 



* Manage end\-to\-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) for domestic and import/export transactions.
* Perform periodic vendor and customer reconciliations and obtain balance confirmations.
* Assist the Finance HOD in preparing monthly MIS reports, including P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash/Fund Flow statements, monthly accruals, and Budget vs. Actual analyses.
* Maintain the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), calculate depreciation, tag assets via ERP system codes, and conduct periodic physical verifications.



  





**2\. Banking \& Treasury** 

  
 



* Oversee day\-to\-day banking operations, corporate bank account maintenance, and trade finance (Letters of Credit (LC), import/export payments).
* Working knowledge of the dividend payment process is preferred.



  





**3\. Statutory Compliance** 

  
 



* Manage monthly calculation, payment, and return filings for TDS/TCS and GST, including vendor GST reconciliations.
* Assist the Finance HOD in calculating advance tax payments, issuing employee and vendor tax certificates, and supporting Corporate Income Tax return filings and responses to Income Tax notices.
* Assist the Finance HOD and coordinate with the Company Secretary (CS) on ROC/Board/AGM compliances, annual regulatory filings, and secretarial updates.
* Coordinate with the insurance broking company to track and update company insurance policies (Marine, Employee Medical, Burglary, and Property Risk).



  





**4\. Audits \& Corporate Governance** 

  
 



* Coordinate with Statutory Auditors (top\-tier audit firms) and Tax Auditors.
* Coordinate with auditors on Transfer Pricing (TP) documentation, group company reconciliations, and related tax filings.



**5\. Plant Costing \& Operations** 

  
 



* Basic knowledge of costing and Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP Business One (SAP B1\).
* Working knowledge of updating landed cost in SAP B1\.



  





**Key Requirements** 

  
 



* **Education:** 
 B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) / CMA Inter / CA Inter
* **Experience:** 
 4 to 7 years of core accounting experience, preferably within a manufacturing environment
* **ERP Skill:** 
 Hands\-on experience with SAP Business One (SAP B1\) is mandatory



  





**What We Offer** 

  
 



* **Salary Range:** 
 Upto ₹9\.0 LPA (Based on experience and skill set)
* **Growth:** 
 High\-visibility role working directly with senior leadership in a structured, fast\-paced environment



  





**How to Apply** 

  
 




 Interested candidates can send their updated Resume/CV to
 **amritha.manikandavijayan@rosscontrols.com** 
 with the subject line "Application for Executive /Senior Executive – Finance \& Accounts – Chennai".

title: US Accountant
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **US Accountant / Finance Operations professional based in India** 
 to manage accounting, US tax coordination, payments, collections, and day\-to\-day financial operations for our US\-based businesses.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who is comfortable owning the finance function rather than only doing bookkeeping.
   




 Responsibilities
 
  




* Manage day\-to\-day accounting and bookkeeping for US entities
* Maintain accurate P\&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and general ledger records
* Support and coordinate US federal and state tax filings, including working with external CPAs when needed
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
* Own collections and follow\-up on outstanding invoices
* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and financial platforms
* Handle Stripe disputes, chargebacks, evidence submissions, and dispute tracking
* Monitor incoming payments and investigate failed, delayed, or unmatched transactions
* Manage vendor payments, employee expenses, reimbursements, and corporate cards
* Assist with month\-end and year\-end close
* Maintain supporting documentation for transactions and financial records
* Prepare financial reports and management dashboards
* Help improve accounting controls, reconciliation processes, and finance workflows
* Coordinate with leadership, CPAs, vendors, customers, banks, and payment processors as needed



  




 Requirements
 
  




* Based in India
* 3\+ years of accounting or finance operations experience
* Strong experience handling accounting for US\-based companies
* Working knowledge of US accounting and tax requirements
* Experience with US tax preparation or directly supporting US CPA/tax filings
* Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, AP, AR, and financial reporting
* Experience with several of the following platforms is strongly preferred:
* Rho, Mercury, Brex, Ramp, Zoho, Zen Payments, Stripe
* Experience handling Stripe disputes and chargebacks
* Experience with collections / accounts receivable follow\-up
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* High attention to detail and ability to independently investigate discrepancies
* Comfortable working with US\-based teams and overlapping with US business hours when required
* Excellent written and spoken English



  




 Nice to Have
 
  




* CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or similar accounting qualification
* Experience working with startups or fast\-growing US companies
* Experience managing multiple US entities
* Experience with QuickBooks Online or Zoho Books
* Experience with payroll, 1099s, W\-2 coordination, sales tax, and state filings
* Experience improving or automating finance workflows



  




 What We’re Looking For
 
  





 We want someone who is
 **proactive and operational** 
 . You should be comfortable noticing that an invoice is overdue, a Stripe dispute needs a response, a transaction does not reconcile, or a tax deadline is coming up — and taking ownership of getting it resolved.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role with significant responsibility across the company's accounting and finance operations.

* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.
* Support in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Development and maintenance of a robust system of internal controls to safeguard assets, ensure that there is no fraudulent misreporting, and ensure the accuracy of financial data, including regular assessment of the effectiveness of internal controls addressing any weaknesses or gaps. .
* Development and implementation of up\-to\-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.

* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.

* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. To support this quickly growing business, you must be highly analytical and possess a strong passion for analytics and accountability, setting high standards, and razor\-sharp accuracy. We take working hard, having fun, and making history seriously and you should too! We provide end\-to\-end financial support driving AWS to be the low\-cost provider in Cloud computing and leader in customer experience. This includes supporting business owners in designing, building, operating and innovating our data centers. We support operations, business development, construction and carbon free energy. We partner closely with business leaders to provide strategic financial guidance that shapes directly impacts AWS growth in the region. title: Financial Analyst
description:
We are looking for a
 **highly analytical and commercially minded Real Estate Acquisition Analyst** 
 to join our acquisitions team. The role will involve evaluating commercial real estate investment opportunities from
 **initial opportunity identification through underwriting, due diligence, transaction execution and post\-acquisition monitoring** 
 .
   

  

 You will work closely with senior leadership and internal and external stakeholders to assess investment opportunities against hBits’ investment criteria. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with
 **financial models, market research, property\-level information and investment analysis** 
 , while having a strong curiosity about the underlying real estate business.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work on
 **live commercial real estate transactions** 
 and develop an end\-to\-end understanding of real estate investing.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 
+ Investment \& Acquisition Analysis: Identify, screen and evaluate potential commercial real estate opportunities; assess location, asset quality, tenant profile, lease structure, rental economics, occupancy, growth potential and key investment risks to support acquisition decisions.
+ Financial Modelling \& Valuation: Build and maintain financial models to analyse property\-level cash flows, rental income, operating expenses, capex and financing requirements; perform valuation and return analysis including IRR, equity returns, yields, cash\-on\-cash returns and sensitivity analysis.
+ Due Diligence: Participate in and coordinate commercial, financial, tax, legal and technical due diligence; review leases, tenant information, financial statements and other asset documentation, while working with external consultants and identifying key risks, gaps and red flags.
+ Market \& Asset Research: Conduct research across commercial real estate markets, micro\-markets and asset classes; analyse rental trends, comparable properties, transaction activity, vacancy, absorption, supply\-demand dynamics and other factors influencing asset valuations and investment returns.
+ Site Visits \& Asset Evaluation: Participate in property site visits and evaluate the physical and commercial aspects of assets, including location, accessibility, building quality, tenant profile, surrounding infrastructure and competitive positioning.
+ Transaction Execution: Support the acquisition process through underwriting, diligence, negotiation and closing; coordinate with internal teams, asset owners and external advisors to ensure transaction milestones and critical diligence items are completed within timelines.
+ Investment Reporting: Prepare investment memos, deal notes, financial analysis and management presentations clearly articulating the investment thesis, key assumptions, expected returns, risks and downside scenarios for senior management and investment stakeholders.
+ Post\-Acquisition Monitoring: Monitor acquired assets against underwriting assumptions, including rental collections, occupancy, lease expiries, tenant developments and asset\-level financial performance, and highlight material deviations, risks or value\-creation opportunities.


**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who combines
 **strong financial aptitude with a genuine interest in real estate and investments** 
 .
   

  

**Essential Qualifications**
* 
+ Bachelor’s degree in finance, Commerce, Economics, Real Estate, Business or a related discipline.
+ 1–4 years of relevant experience in investment analysis, real estate, investment banking, transaction advisory, corporate finance, credit, equity research, valuation or related fields.
+ Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modelling.
+ Strong understanding of financial statements and financial analysis.
+ Excellent analytical and quantitative abilities with strong attention to detail.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 
+ CFA / CA / FRM / MBA Finance / CIMA or equivalent qualification.
+ Experience in commercial real estate, real estate finance, private equity, credit, investment banking or transaction advisory.
+ Experience in financial modelling, valuation and/or real estate transactions.


**Ideal Candidate**
**The Ideal Candidate Is Someone Who Enjoys Asking**
**“Is this a good investment, and why?”**
 You should be comfortable moving from a
 **spreadsheet to a property site visit, from a lease agreement to a financial model, and from market research to an investment recommendation** 
 .
   

  

 If you are
 **analytical, curious, commercially minded and passionate about investments and real estate** 
 , we would like to hear from you.

**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an accomplished and strategic
 **Chief Financial Officer (CFO)** 
 to lead the company’s finance function and play a pivotal role in its next phase of growth, including
 **IPO preparation and execution** 
 .
 



 The CFO will be responsible for driving financial strategy, strengthening governance and controls, optimizing capital structure, and ensuring the organization is fully prepared for the demands of a public listing. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in
 **IPO management, investor relations, corporate finance, financial planning, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder management** 
 , along with the ability to partner closely with the CEO, Board, investors, auditors, legal advisors, and investment bankers.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. IPO Strategy \& Execution
 


* Lead the
 **end\-to\-end IPO process** 
 , from readiness assessment and planning through listing and post\-IPO compliance.
* Develop and execute the company’s
 **IPO roadmap** 
 , timelines, milestones, and readiness plan.
* Coordinate with investment banks, legal counsel, auditors, merchant bankers, regulators, and other external advisors.
* Drive preparation of IPO\-related financial information, disclosures, due diligence materials, prospectus/offer documents, and management representations.
* Ensure financial statements, accounting policies, internal controls, governance frameworks, and reporting processes meet
 **public\-company standards** 
 .
* Lead IPO due diligence, financial diligence, regulatory queries, and resolution of audit or accounting matters.
* Manage IPO\-related investor communications, roadshows, analyst interactions, and management presentations in partnership with the CEO and investor\-relations team.
* Ensure successful transition from a private to a publicly listed company, including post\-listing reporting and governance requirements.



 2\. Financial Strategy \& Business Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the company’s overall financial strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning, and financial performance management.
* Provide strategic insights to the CEO and Board on growth, profitability, cash flow, investments, and capital allocation.
* Establish appropriate financial KPIs and drive accountability across the organization.
* Evaluate strategic initiatives, acquisitions, investments, partnerships, and other major business decisions from a financial perspective.



 3\. Financial Reporting, Controls \& Governance
 


* Oversee accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Strengthen accounting, financial controls, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, securities regulations, and corporate laws.
* Lead relationships with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax advisors, and other professional advisors.
* Build robust
 **internal controls and corporate governance mechanisms** 
 appropriate for a listed company.



 4\. Capital Management \& Investor Relations
 


* Manage the company’s capital structure, liquidity, treasury, and working capital.
* Develop relationships with institutional investors, private equity/venture capital investors, lenders, analysts, and other financial stakeholders.
* Lead investor reporting and support the development of a strong
 **equity story and investor narrative** 
 .
* Optimize capital allocation and evaluate opportunities for debt, equity, strategic investments, and other financing structures.



 5\. Team \& Organizational Leadership
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing finance organization.
* Establish scalable finance processes, systems, and reporting infrastructure.
* Develop finance talent capable of supporting the organization through IPO and subsequent public\-company growth.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, compliance, and commercial thinking.



 Key Success Measures
 


* Successful and timely
 **IPO readiness and execution** 
 .
* Strong financial controls, governance, and audit outcomes.
* High\-quality and timely financial reporting.
* Improved profitability, cash flow, and capital efficiency.
* Effective investor, Board, auditor, and regulatory relationships.
* Successful transition to public\-company reporting and compliance standards.



 Candidate Profile
 


* **15\+ years** 
 of progressive finance experience, preferably with experience as a CFO / Finance Director / senior finance leader.
* Demonstrated
 **hands\-on experience managing an IPO** 
 , preferably from preparation through listing.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, financial reporting, corporate governance, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience working with investment banks, auditors, legal advisors, regulators, and institutional investors.
* Strong knowledge of financial planning, treasury, taxation, risk management, and internal controls.
* Experience in a high\-growth, complex, or professionally managed organization preferred.
* Excellent strategic, analytical, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively with the
 **Board, CEO, senior leadership team, investors, and external advisors** 
 .



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* CA / CPA / CMA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent professional qualification.
* Prior experience taking a company public or managing a significant public\-market transaction.
* Experience in \[Industry/Sector] preferred.
* Exposure to M\&A, fundraising, private equity/venture capital, and investor relations will be an advantage.

* **Strategic and commercially oriented**

* An effective communicator with investors and the Board

In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. title: Financial Analyst
description:

Mumbai

We are looking for a **highly analytical and commercially minded Real Estate Acquisition Analyst** to join our acquisitions team. The role will involve evaluating commercial real estate investment opportunities from **initial opportunity identification through underwriting, due diligence, transaction execution and post\-acquisition monitoring**.  

  

You will work closely with senior leadership and internal and external stakeholders to assess investment opportunities against hBits’ investment criteria. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with **financial models, market research, property\-level information and investment analysis**, while having a strong curiosity about the underlying real estate business.
This is an opportunity to work on **live commercial real estate transactions** and develop an end\-to\-end understanding of real estate investing.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* + **Investment \& Acquisition Analysis:** Identify, screen and evaluate potential commercial real estate opportunities; assess location, asset quality, tenant profile, lease structure, rental economics, occupancy, growth potential and key investment risks to support acquisition decisions.
	+ **Financial Modelling \& Valuation:** Build and maintain financial models to analyse property\-level cash flows, rental income, operating expenses, capex and financing requirements; perform valuation and return analysis including **IRR, equity returns, yields, cash\-on\-cash returns and sensitivity analysis**.
	+ **Due Diligence:** Participate in and coordinate commercial, financial, tax, legal and technical due diligence; review leases, tenant information, financial statements and other asset documentation, while working with external consultants and identifying key risks, gaps and red flags.
	+ **Market \& Asset Research:** Conduct research across commercial real estate markets, micro\-markets and asset classes; analyse rental trends, comparable properties, transaction activity, vacancy, absorption, supply\-demand dynamics and other factors influencing asset valuations and investment returns.
	+ **Site Visits \& Asset Evaluation:** Participate in property site visits and evaluate the physical and commercial aspects of assets, including location, accessibility, building quality, tenant profile, surrounding infrastructure and competitive positioning.
	+ **Transaction Execution:** Support the acquisition process through **underwriting, diligence, negotiation and closing**; coordinate with internal teams, asset owners and external advisors to ensure transaction milestones and critical diligence items are completed within timelines.
	+ **Investment Reporting:** Prepare **investment memos, deal notes, financial analysis and management presentations** clearly articulating the investment thesis, key assumptions, expected returns, risks and downside scenarios for senior management and investment stakeholders.
	+ **Post\-Acquisition Monitoring:** Monitor acquired assets against underwriting assumptions, including rental collections, occupancy, lease expiries, tenant developments and asset\-level financial performance, and highlight material deviations, risks or value\-creation opportunities.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for someone who combines **strong financial aptitude with a genuine interest in real estate and investments**.
**Essential Qualifications**
* + Bachelor’s degree in **finance, Commerce, Economics, Real Estate, Business or a related discipline**.
	+ **1–4 years of relevant experience** in investment analysis, real estate, investment banking, transaction advisory, corporate finance, credit, equity research, valuation or related fields.
	+ Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Excel and financial modelling**.
	+ Strong understanding of financial statements and financial analysis.
	+ Excellent analytical and quantitative abilities with strong attention to detail.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* + CFA / CA / FRM / MBA Finance / CIMA or equivalent qualification.
	+ Experience in **commercial real estate, real estate finance, private equity, credit, investment banking or transaction advisory**.
	+ Experience in financial modelling, valuation and/or real estate transactions.

  

**Ideal Candidate**
The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys asking:
**“Is this a good investment, and why?”**
You should be comfortable moving from a **spreadsheet to a property site visit, from a lease agreement to a financial model, and from market research to an investment recommendation**.
If you are **analytical, curious, commercially minded and passionate about investments and real estate**, we would like to hear from you.

description:

description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around.  As an Accounting Operations Senior Associate, you will support key transactional accounting functions with a primary focus on Travel \& Expense (T\&E) and broader procure\-to\-pay (P2P) operations. * Strong analytical skills and ability to consider wider objectives
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (Pro)

* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to synthesize large amounts of data
* Be ready to take initiatives and multitask independently

 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. title: Senior Analyst - Lease Accounting
description:
**Job Description** **Role Summary**


The R2R Senior Analyst – Lease is accountable for technical judgement and policy guidance across lease accounting under IFRS 16 / ASC 842, acting as a quality checkpoint between lease preparation and tower\-level close governance.


This role ensures that:

* Lease master data, ROU asset \& lease liability accounting, remeasurements/modifications, and tool\-to\-GL reconciliations are
* Complete
* Accurate
* Independently supported
* SOX / IPE compliant


The role owns resolution of non\-standard and complex lease cases, ensures consistent interpretation of SOP 10\.3\.x, and drives disciplined ageing closure, evidence sufficiency, and exception resolution.

**Role Purpose**


To ensure accurate, compliant, and defensible lease accounting outcomes by:

* Acting as the technical SME for lease accounting and policy interpretation
* Resolving complex lease scenarios and judgement\-heavy cases
* Driving cross\-tower alignment and audit readiness
* Strengthening controls, governance, and consistency across entities

**Key Responsibilities**


1\. Technical Accounting \& Policy Interpretation

* Own interpretation and application of IFRS 16 / ASC 842 standards
* Provide guidance on:
* Lease classification and recognition
* ROU asset and lease liability accounting
* Discount rates and assumptions
* Ensure consistent application of lease accounting policies across entities


2\. Complex Case Resolution \& Judgement

* Resolve non\-standard and complex lease accounting scenarios, including:
* Lease modifications and remeasurements
* Contract interpretation issues
* System or accounting discrepancies
* Provide defensible accounting conclusions with documented rationale and evidence


3\. Certification \& Control Gatekeeping

* Certify lease accounting outputs, including:
* ROU asset and liability balances
* Amortization and interest postings
* Lease tool\-to\-GL reconciliations
* Ensure:
* Compliance with SOX / IPE standards
* Adherence to maker\-checker discipline
* Audit\-ready documentation prior to close


4\. Exception Handling \& Close Governance

* Drive exception resolution and break management
* Perform and enforce:
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Ageing closure discipline
* Ensure timely escalation of:
* High\-risk items
* Systemic issues
* Support close governance and risk management


5\. Cross\-Tower Alignment \& Integration

* Collaborate with:
* Fixed Assets (FA)
* IDSW
* Intercompany (IC)
* Ensure consistency in:
* Accounting treatment
* Data flows and integration
* Resolve cross\-functional dependencies impacting lease accounting


6\. Controls, Compliance \& Audit Readiness

* Ensure compliance with:
* SOX / ICFR controls
* IPE evidence standards
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approvals, and evidence trails
* Support internal and external audits, including:
* Lease accounting validation
* Policy interpretation discussions


7\. Documentation \& Technical Positioning

* Prepare technical accounting memos and judgement documentation
* Ensure traceability of:
* Accounting decisions
* Approvals
* Supporting evidence
* Maintain consistency across:
* Regions
* Entities
* Reporting outputs


8\. Continuous Improvement \& Standardization

* Reduce repeat issues through:
* Standardized policy interpretations
* Preventive guidance
* Clear escalation frameworks
* Improve:
* Documentation quality
* Process consistency
* Control effectiveness


9\. Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with:
* Lease Tower Lead / Reviewer
* Controllers / Regional Finance teams
* Real Estate / Contract owners
* Compliance \& Controls teams
* Fin\-Tech / Systems teams
* Cross\-tower SMEs (FA, IDSW, IC)
* Provide technical guidance and resolution support


Top Skills for Success

* Lease accounting expertise (IFRS 16 / ASC 842\)
* Technical accounting judgement and policy interpretation
* Remeasurements and modification accounting
* Controls, Compliance \& Audit (SOX / ICFR / IPE)
* Problem solving (RCA / CAPA)
* Reconciliation quality and exception handling
* ERP and lease systems (SAP, lease tools, OneStream)
* Cross\-functional collaboration


Key Outcomes / Success Measures

* Audit\-ready lease controls with certified reconciliations and traceable evidence
* Predictable lease close with:
* Disciplined ageing
* Clear resolution tracking
* Reduced repeat exceptions
* Consistent technical judgement aligned to IFRS 16 / ASC 842 standards
* Faster resolution of complex cases with:
* Documented rationale
* Cross\-tower alignment


Tools \& Systems

* Lease Accounting Tool (ROU / liability calculations, remeasurements) — High
* SAP GL (postings, extracts, reporting) — High
* OneStream (reconciliation submission / certification, if applicable) — Medium–High
* Microsoft Excel (amortization schedules, remeasurement models, tie\-outs) — High
* Contract repositories / master data systems — Medium–High

 **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
* CA / CPA / ACCA (preferred or in progress)
* 5–8 years of experience in R2R / Lease Accounting / Financial Accounting
* Strong expertise in:
* Lease accounting standards (IFRS 16 / ASC 842\)
* Complex accounting scenarios and policy interpretation
* Experience with:
* ERP systems (SAP)
* Lease accounting tools (preferred)
* Strong analytical and technical accounting skills

 **Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

title: Senior Associate, Financial Modeling Services - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. **The Team**

Our culture is characterized by openness and entrepreneurial thinking, with a foundation of mutual respect and high\-quality standards for our work. We strive to remove bureaucracy in favor of recognizing effort and results through advancement opportunities and a motivating performance\-based reward structure. * Conduct feasibility studies, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis to assess the financial viability of projects
* Collaborate with project developers, engineers, and external stakeholders to gather data and assumptions for financial models
* Support the structuring and negotiation of project financing, including debt and equity arrangements
* Analyze market trends, regulatory frameworks, and industry developments to inform investment strategies
* Ability to perform comprehensive reviews of financial models prepared by internal teams, IBs/ PE firms
* Prepare and present detailed financial reports, investment memorandums, and presentations to senior management, investors, and other stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices in financial modeling and project finance
* Provide insights and recommendations to optimize project returns and mitigate risks
* Foster and maintain strong client relationships, providing consistent and clear communication throughout project execution
* Collaborate with the engagement team to ensure the effective, timely, and efficient delivery of all modeling related projects
* Manage and/or work on multiple projects at a time
* Lead and mentor junior team members


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 3\-5 years in financial modeling, financial planning, financial analysis, financial due diligence, valuation, corporate/project finance or M\&A
* Chartered Accountant (CA) / Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) / MBA (Finance) with a strong academic record; any certification in financial modeling is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of project finance structures, including debt financing, tax equity, and public\-private partnerships (PPPs)
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling software; knowledge of VBA or Python is a plus
* Experience with developing presentations and reports using PowerPoint
* Excellent communication skills to present complex financial data to non\-finance stakeholders
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with attention to detail
* Effective project management and organizational skills
* Ambitious, results driven, self\-starter with a desire to thrive in an entrepreneurial culture


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Lead Analyst - Credit Research
description:
**Job Summary** 




 Evalueserve is looking for high\-potential finance professionals who are passionate about equity research, financial analysis, and investment decision\-making. This role offers an opportunity to work with leading global asset managers, hedge funds and financial institutions, supporting critical investment research and valuation initiatives. The role offers hands\-on exposure to company and industry analysis, financial modeling, valuation, and investment writing. Analysts will also leverage AI\-enabled research and productivity tools to improve research efficiency and accelerate information synthesis, while applying sound financial judgment and independent thinking to generate actionable insights. This is an ideal opportunity for candidates seeking a challenging and rewarding career in investment research within a fast\-paced, global environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Responsible for credit analysis using credit metrics (liquidity, coverage, solvency etc.)
* Creating and maintaining excel based financial models with forecasts and benchmarking companies on financial and operating metrics
* Responsible for building detailed financial models that include industry research, capital structure analysis, peers’ comparison, and recovery analysis
* Incorporate acquisition/merger announcements (merger models) or long\-term business plan projections in the existing model of the portfolio companies
* Reviewing credit agreements and bond indentures for the covenant package and incorporating them in models for covenant testing
* Publishing quarterly and annual write\-ups on portfolio companies that include investment recommendations based on past trends and financial model projections
* Explaining the rationale to clients/onshore team behind industry drivers, company KPIs, business strategy, model assumptions, and investment recommendations
* Extensive company valuation involves approaches such as DCF, DDM, Trading and transaction multiples, etc.
* Listening to and summarizing earnings conference calls on a quarterly basis
* Responsible for writing credit reviews, including \- Credit Ratios Analysis, Covenant Analysis, Capital Structure Analysis.
* Credit Comparable to Impact of Macro factors (Economy, Industry) and qualitative factors including Business/Asset Quality, Management etc. on the creditworthiness of a company
* Identifying credit strengths and weaknesses
* Preparation of financial models using financial statements, debt schedule, and financial forecast
* Extraction of debt related information, e.g. price, maturity, Yield, Z\-spread, CDS etc. from database.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Relevant experience of 5\-8 Years with graduate/ master’s degree.
* CA / MBA (Finance); CFA (added advantage)
* Strong accounting and financial skills
* Good analytical skills
* Excellent understanding of credit research concepts
* Ability to meet tight deadlines and ensure timely completion of tasks
* Good listening skills
* Ability to implement new working styles
* Ability to identify proactive ways of contributing to the company’s goals and mission

title: Lead - Mid Office
description:
**Role Overview** 




 The Lead — Treasury Mid Office will own end\-to\-end liquidity and interest\-rate risk management for Hero FinCorp, set and maintain the Fund Transfer Pricing (FTP) framework, drive capital adequacy and cost\-of\-funds optimization, and partner closely with the Front Office, Back Office, regulators, auditors, rating agencies and investors. The role is a critical control and analytics function bridging strategy, risk and operations within Treasury.
 



  





**Location\-** 
 Corporate Office, DLF Downtown
 



**Team Size\-** 
 Manages a small mid\-office pod of 3\-4 members
 



  





**Detailed Responsibilities** 




**M1 — Liquidity \& Interest Rate Risk Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end liquidity risk and interest\-rate risk management for the company.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, drawdown planning, monitoring of approvals and daily liquidity positioning.
* Ensure compliance with Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Stress Testing, Contingency Funding Plan (CFP) and other key ALM parameters.
* Create, track and monitor market\-risk benchmarks for investments and treasury exposures.



**M2 — FTP, Cost of Funds \& Capital Adequacy** 



* Establish and maintain the Fund Transfer Pricing (FTP) mechanism across Lines of Business.
* Partner with business teams to work out a suitable cost of funds for each Line of Business.
* Manage the various levers of Capital Adequacy to drive efficient capital utilization.
* Finalize monthly / quarterly / yearly Cost of Borrowing and other associated treasury costs.
* Conduct competitor analysis on borrowings and cost of funds to benchmark Hero FinCorp's position.



**M3 — Regulatory Reporting, Compliance \& Audit** 



* Submit RBI regulatory returns relating to Treasury and provide data inputs for other returns, including ad\-hoc requirements.
* Monitor accounting closures, ECB borrowing workings and annual disclosures.
* Handle statutory, RBI, tax and bank auditors on all Treasury\-related matters.
* Track economic and regulatory changes and present detailed financial\-impact assessments to management.



**M4 — ALCO, Stress Testing \& Contingency Funding** 



* Ensure timely preparation of ALCO presentations, closing minutes of meeting and related compliance.
* Run periodic stress tests and maintain the Contingency Funding Plan.
* Provide analytical support for ALCO decisions on liability mix, hedging strategy and liquidity buffer.



**M5 — Investor, Rating Agency \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Handle queries from investors, rating agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Own investor decks, CMA, QIS and portfolio cuts shared with rating agencies.
* Continuously update the Information Memorandum, treasury policies and other standardized documents.
* Manage relationships and fee negotiations with Credit Rating Agencies (CRAs), investment and valuation consultants.



**M6 — Research, Strategy \& Management Reporting** 



* Conduct continuous research on the economy, debt markets, insurance companies and corporates to support informed funding decisions.
* Drive the Annual Operating Plan — working files, presentations, manpower planning and strategy decks.
* Publish updates on key macro\-economic indicators to senior management.



**M7 — Front \& Back Office Support / Mid\-Office Operations** 



* Support the Front Office in liaising with lenders (including family\-office deals) — provide clarity on policies and procedures to resolve lender queries.
* Liaise with the Front Office and other stakeholders on Direct Assignment (DA) and Loans\-against\-Eligible\-Receivables (LER) transactions.
* Support the Back Office in security management, limit monitoring and other operational tasks.
* Perform the checker role in debt servicing (interest calculation), DA payouts and ECB payouts.
* Ensure maintenance of Treasury systems and implementation of all treasury\-related processes.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA preferred.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in NBFC / Bank Treasury Mid Office or ALM function.
* Prior experience in ALCO support, FTP design, regulatory reporting and rating\-agency interactions strongly preferred.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* ALM, LCR, Stress Testing \& Contingency Funding Plan frameworks.
* RBI Master Directions for NBFCs (Scale\-Based Regulation), FEMA / ECB framework.
* Fund Transfer Pricing (FTP) design and capital\-adequacy management.
* Ind AS 109 — financial instruments, hedge accounting and impairment.
* Rating\-agency frameworks (CRISIL / ICRA / CARE / India Ratings) and investor disclosure standards.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, Power BI, Treasury / ALM systems; working knowledge of Python and automation tools.



  





**Behavioural Competencies** 



* Strong control mindset balanced with commercial / business partnering.
* Executive communication — board, ALCO, CFO, rating agencies and investors.
* Ability to manage a mid\-office pod and groom talent.
* High ownership, accuracy and audit\-readiness.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, especially around regulatory change.

description:
**The Role**




  





 The Director of FP\&A Centre of Excellence (CoE) is responsible for leading the British Council’s global finance capability to deliver standardised, technology\-enabled financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and insight generation across Regions, Strategic Business Units (SBUs), and Central Functions. The role oversees three core pillars: Process Excellence (standardisation, governance, and continuous improvement of FP\&A processes), Product \& Technology Enablement (leadership of the Anaplan platform, analytics, automation, and AI/ML forecasting capabilities), and Core Delivery \& Service Operations (management of central FP\&A teams supporting English \& Exams, Cultural Engagement, Central Services, and Staff Costs). The position also drives adoption of a globally consistent FP\&A Target Operating Model, ensuring scalable, accurate, and insight\-driven financial decision support.
 



 Operating within the FP\&A Centre of Excellence, the role requires a strategic, forward\-looking finance leader with experience delivering global FP\&A services in a complex international organisation. The Director partners closely with the Global Finance Director, Director of FP\&A, Group FP\&A, regional finance teams, and Business Decision Support (BDS) leaders to strengthen financial performance, embed data\-driven decision\-making, improve forecasting accuracy, and support organisational priorities. The role combines leadership of finance transformation, technology adoption, service excellence, and capability building to enhance the British Council’s commercial and operational decision\-making worldwide.
 



  





**Main responsibilities**









 The role provides end\-to\-end leadership of the FP\&A Centre of Excellence (CoE), acting as the global owner of planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics frameworks. It is responsible for managing centralised FP\&A delivery teams across English \& Exams, Cultural Engagement, Central Services, and Staff Costs, ensuring consistent, high\-quality management information, financial models, planning tools, and decision\-support services through defined KPIs, SLAs, and governance standards.
 



 The position also leads process standardisation, continuous improvement, automation, and governance of planning assumptions and analytics quality, while serving as the product owner for the Anaplan platform and related digital FP\&A capabilities, including predictive analytics and scenario modelling. In addition, it builds strong partnerships across Finance, Data, Compliance, and Business Decision Support (BDS) leadership, acts as the escalation point for CoE service issues, and develops a high\-performing, multi\-disciplinary global team with strong digital FP\&A, systems, and analytics capabilities.

* Building relationships at all levels of the organisation
* Excellent analytical and data skills along with strong planning and organisational skills are required.

* Ability to operate effectively and prioritise in a busy global facing role

title: Banking Treasury Manager, Gurgaon
description:
**Manager – Finance \& Accounts**
**Location: Sector 58, Gurugram**
**Job Description – Manager – Finance \& Accounts**
**Job Title:** 
 Manager – Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurugram
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–10 Years
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Head of Finance
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented
 **Manager – Finance \& Accounts** 
 to lead and manage key finance, accounting, treasury, banking, working capital, financial closure, audit, and compliance activities.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for ensuring strong financial controls, effective fund management, timely financial reporting, accurate accounting, optimized working capital, and smooth coordination with banks, auditors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on exposure to
 **Treasury, Banking, Fund Planning, Working Capital Management, Accounting, Financial Closing, Audit, P\&L, Balance Sheet Finalization, and Compliance** 
 , along with the ability to independently manage finance operations and provide meaningful financial insights to senior management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supplier Payments \& Accounts Payable
* Manage and oversee the complete supplier payment process, ensuring timely and accurate payments.
* Review payment proposals, vendor balances, outstanding payables, and payment schedules.
* Ensure appropriate approval and documentation before processing payments.
* Monitor vendor ageing and optimize payment cycles in line with cash\-flow requirements.
* Resolve supplier payment\-related queries and discrepancies.
* Banking \& Bank Account Management
* Manage day\-to\-day banking operations, including fund transfers, bank reconciliation, payment processing, and banking documentation.
* Handle Current Accounts and Fixed Deposits (FDs), including opening, renewal, maturity, and utilization.
* Maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions.
* Monitor bank charges, interest rates, facilities, and other banking arrangements.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Borrowings \& Debt Management
* Manage the organization's borrowings and debt portfolio, including short\-term and long\-term financing.
* Monitor loan schedules, interest payments, principal repayments, and financial covenants.
* Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for financing requirements, renewals, and documentation.
* Evaluate borrowing requirements based on business cash\-flow needs.
* Overdraft \& Working Capital Loan Management
* Manage Overdraft (OD), Cash Credit (CC), and Working Capital Loan facilities.
* Monitor utilization of working capital limits and ensure optimum utilization of available facilities.
* Coordinate with banks for renewal/enhancement of working capital limits.
* Prepare and submit required financial information and documents to banks.
* Monitor interest costs and identify opportunities for financing\-cost optimization.
* Fund Planning \& Treasury Management
* Prepare and manage daily, weekly, and monthly fund\-flow plans.
* Ensure availability of funds for critical business requirements, supplier payments, statutory payments, salaries, and other obligations.
* Monitor cash positions across bank accounts and optimize fund utilization.
* Develop effective fund planning and treasury management strategies.
* Identify potential cash\-flow gaps and arrange funds proactively.
* Cash Flow Management
* Prepare and monitor cash\-flow forecasts and projections.
* Analyze actual versus projected cash flows and identify variances.
* Manage working capital effectively by monitoring receivables, payables, inventory, and other cash\-flow drivers.
* Ensure adequate liquidity while minimizing idle funds and financing costs.
* Provide regular cash\-flow and liquidity updates to senior management.
* Accounts Closing \& GL Accounting
* Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounts closing process.
* Ensure accurate and timely posting and review of General Ledger (GL) accounting entries.
* Review journal entries, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses, depreciation, and other accounting adjustments.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of GL accounts, sub\-ledgers, bank accounts, vendor/customer balances, and inter\-company accounts.
* Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies and ensure accuracy of financial records.
* Balance Sheet Finalization
* Take ownership of Balance Sheet finalization and ensure accuracy of all balance sheet schedules.
* Review provisions, accruals, fixed assets, loans, advances, receivables, payables, and other balance sheet items.
* Ensure proper accounting treatment and supporting documentation.
* Prepare balance sheet schedules and management reports for review by senior management and auditors.
* Audit \& Financial Reporting
* Manage and coordinate statutory, internal, tax, and financial audits.
* Coordinate with auditors and provide required schedules, documents, reconciliations, and explanations.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.
* Support preparation and review of financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* P\&L Management
* Monitor and review the Profit \& Loss (P\&L) on a monthly basis.
* Analyze revenue, expenses, margins, operating costs, and major variances.
* Prepare variance analysis and provide actionable insights to management.
* Work with business teams to identify cost\-control and profitability improvement opportunities.
* Ensure accurate classification and accounting of revenue and expenses.
* Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure timely and accurate financial and statutory compliances applicable to the organization.
* Coordinate with internal and external consultants for tax, statutory, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure timely filing of required returns, payments, and submissions.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for compliance and audit purposes.
* Keep track of changes in applicable financial, taxation, and regulatory requirements.
* Internal Controls \& Process Improvement
* Establish and strengthen financial controls, SOPs, and accounting processes.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure adherence to delegation of authority and approval mechanisms.
* Drive automation and process improvements across finance and accounting operations.
* Ensure proper segregation of duties and minimize financial and operational risks.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Timely completion of monthly/annual financial closing
* Accuracy of GL and financial statements
* Timely supplier payment processing
* Cash\-flow forecast accuracy
* Effective working capital management
* Optimum utilization of OD/CC/working capital facilities
* Reduction in financing and interest costs
* Timely bank reconciliation and closure of outstanding items
* Timely audit completion and closure of audit observations
* Compliance adherence and zero/low compliance deviations
* Accuracy of P\&L and Balance Sheet finalization
* Improvement in cash conversion cycle
* Effectiveness of internal financial controls


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in Finance \& Accounts, Treasury, Banking, and Working Capital Management.
* Strong hands\-on experience in GL accounting, financial closing, Balance Sheet finalization, P\&L management, and audits.
* Strong knowledge of banking operations, OD/CC limits, working capital loans, borrowings, and fund management.
* Excellent understanding of cash\-flow management and working capital cycles.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and financial management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP/accounting systems.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced business environment.

title: Accounting Controller – US GAAP
description:
**About the Company:** 




 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Controller \- Accounting Operations, Inventory and Controls will be responsible for the reliability of the Company's underlying accounting processes, subledgers, reconciliations, and transactional accounting. This role will oversee the accounting activities supporting accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, inventory, cash, fixed assets, leases, prepaid expenses, accruals, and intercompany transactions. The successful candidate must be willing to work directly in the accounting records, investigate discrepancies, correct process failures, and establish repeatable, well\-controlled procedures. This is a hands\-on role and not solely a supervisory position.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**General Ledger and Close Support** 




 • Maintain assigned general\-ledger accounts and supporting schedules.
 



 • Ensure subledgers reconcile to the general ledger each reporting period.
 



 • Prepare and review account reconciliations using standardized Company templates.
 



 • Investigate and resolve reconciling items, stale balances, unsupported amounts, duplicate entries, and classification errors.
 



 • Prepare routine and non\-routine journal entries with complete supporting documentation.
 



 • Ensure transactions are recorded in the correct legal entity, account, department, location, and accounting period.
 



 • Support the Lead Controller in completing the monthly, quarterly, and annual close.
 



  





**Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Payroll Accounting** 




 • Oversee accounts payable accounting, including vendor invoices, credits, payments, accruals, statement reconciliations, and purchase\-related transactions.
 



 • Monitor aged payables, unmatched receipts, outstanding checks, duplicate payments, and unapplied credits.
 



 • Oversee accounts receivable accounting, billing support, cash application, customer deductions, credits, and account reconciliations.
 



 • Resolve unapplied cash, short payments, disputed deductions, credit balances, and recurring billing issues.
 



 • Support accounts\-receivable aging analysis and allowance or reserve calculations.
 



 • Oversee payroll accounting and reconcile payroll registers, tax liabilities, benefit deductions, and payroll\-related general\-ledger accounts.
 



 • Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and supporting documentation across transactional accounting processes.
 



  





**Inventory and Cost Accounting** 




 • Own accounting processes supporting inventory, cost of goods sold, purchasing accruals, freight, inventory adjustments, and inventory reserves.
 



 • Reconcile inventory subledgers and operating reports to the general ledger.
 



 • Investigate inventory quantity, valuation, costing, and gross\-margin discrepancies.
 



 • Review inventory adjustments, write\-offs, transfers, reserve calculations, and related journal entries.
 



 • Support physical inventory counts and cycle\-count procedures.
 



 • Reconcile inventory held across Company facilities, third\-party locations, and other relevant channels.
 



 • Review purchase\-price variances, freight allocations, landed costs, and other cost components.
 



 • Coordinate with operations and information technology personnel to resolve inventory\-system and data issues.
 



  





**Cash, Fixed Assets, Leases and Intercompany Accounting** 




 • Prepare and review bank reconciliations for all assigned Company bank accounts.
 



 • Investigate outstanding checks, unidentified receipts, returned payments, bank fees, and other reconciling items.
 



 • Maintain fixed\-asset records, depreciation schedules, lease\-accounting schedules, prepaid\-expense schedules, and recurring\-accrual support.
 



 • Record and reconcile intercompany transactions among legal entities and resolve differences before consolidation.
 



 • Maintain intercompany schedules and ensure charges are recorded consistently in both the originating and receiving entities.
 



 • Provide complete intercompany support to the Lead Controller for consolidation and elimination entries.
 



  





**Process Improvement, Controls and Team Leadership** 




 • Evaluate accounting processes for control gaps, unnecessary manual work, duplication, and inconsistent practices.
 



 • Document accounting workflows, responsibilities, approval points, system dependencies, and recurring procedures.
 



 • Standardize accounting templates, reconciliations, schedules, journal\-entry support, and review procedures.
 



 • Identify opportunities for automation and improved use of ERP and accounting systems.
 



 • Own execution and documentation of assigned process\-level internal controls and immediately report control failures.
 



 • Support remediation of audit observations and internal\-control deficiencies.
 



 • Supervise assigned accounting personnel, review work product, provide corrections and coaching, and establish backup coverage for critical processes.
 



 • Escalate staffing, performance, system, control, or capacity issues to the Lead Controller and Chief Financial Officer.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a closely related field.
 



 • Minimum 7\+ years of progressive full\-cycle accounting experience.
 



 • Minimum 2\+ years in accounting\-management, supervisory, or formal work\-review experience.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of the general ledger and monthly close process.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in account reconciliations, root\-cause analysis, and discrepancy resolution.
 



 • Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, cash, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, accruals, and intercompany accounting.
 



 • Meaningful inventory and cost\-accounting experience.
 



 • Experience supporting a multi\-entity or multi\-location business.
 



 • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP as applied to transactional and operational accounting.
 



 • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with ERP and accounting systems.
 



 • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
 



 • Ability to prepare audit\-quality accounting support and maintain complete process documentation.
 



 • Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and supervise accounting personnel in a remote environment.
 



 • Ability to provide recurring work\-hour overlap with U.S. Central Time, with expanded availability during close and reporting periods.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or comparable professional accounting designation.
 



 • Experience in food distribution, foodservice, wholesale distribution, retail, e\-commerce, logistics, or another inventory\-intensive industry.
 



 • Experience supporting a U.S. publicly traded company or working within a public\-company control environment.
 



 • Experience supporting external audits and preparing auditor\-ready schedules and documentation.
 



 • Experience improving accounting processes or implementing accounting\-system enhancements.
 



 • Experience with physical inventory, cycle counting, inventory reserves, freight accounting, purchase\-price variances, and gross\-margin analysis.
 



 • Experience supervising an offshore or distributed accounting team
 



  





**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨** 




 🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients
 



 🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment
 



 ⚖️ Excellent work\-life balance – 5\-day workweek
 



 🩺 Comprehensive health \& accident insurancef
 



 🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays
 



 🍽️ Complimentary lunches \& dinners
 



 🏆 Quarterly, Semi\-Annual \& Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways
 



 📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more
 



 🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month\-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations
 



 🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

title: Finance Manager (CA Qualified)
description:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Finance Manager will be responsible for managing the complete Finance \& Accounts function of the company, ensuring accurate financial reporting, strong financial controls, statutory compliance, taxation, cash\-flow management, budgeting, audits, and timely management reporting. The role will work closely with senior management to provide financial insights, control costs, improve profitability, manage working capital, and support business decision\-making.
 



  
 







**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Financial Accounting \& Reporting** 



* Manage the complete day\-to\-day Finance \& Accounts operations.
* Ensure accurate and timely accounting of all sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, payments, assets, liabilities and other financial transactions.
* Review General Ledger, Trial Balance, Profit \& Loss Account and Balance Sheet.
* Lead monthly, quarterly and annual book closure.
* Ensure proper accounting provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses, depreciation and other year\-end adjustments.
* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards / Ind AS and accounting policies.
* Maintain accurate and audit\-ready books of accounts.
* Review and reconcile bank, vendor, customer, inter\-company and statutory balances.



  





  
 **Management Reporting \& MIS** 



* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports to management.
* Prepare:


1. Profit \& Loss Statement
2. Balance Sheet
3. Cash Flow Statement
4. Working Capital Report
5. Receivables \& Payables Ageing
6. Budget vs. Actual Analysis
7. Sales \& Gross Margin Analysis
8. Expense Analysis
9. Branch / Business Unit profitability


* Provide financial analysis and recommendations to management.
* Identify financial trends, variances and potential risks.
* Develop dashboards and reports to support business decisions.



  





**Budgeting \& Financial Planning** 



* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
* Coordinate with various departments for preparation of budgets.
* Monitor actual performance against approved budgets.
* Conduct monthly variance analysis and identify corrective actions.
* Prepare financial projections and business forecasts.
* Support management in evaluating new business initiatives and investments.



  





**Cash Flow \& Treasury Management** 



* Monitor daily cash position and overall liquidity.
* Prepare and maintain short\-term and long\-term cash\-flow forecasts.
* Ensure adequate funds are available for operational requirements.
* Monitor collections and payment schedules.
* Review and control vendor payments.
* Manage banking relationships and coordinate with banks for finance\-related matters.
* Monitor working capital and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliations and resolution of outstanding items.



  





**Accounts Receivable \& Payable** 



* Oversee customer receivables and collection processes.
* Monitor ageing of customer balances and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Review credit customer limits and outstanding balances.
* Oversee vendor payments and payable ageing.
* Ensure proper vendor reconciliation before payment.
* Review customer, supplier and inter\-company reconciliations.
* Identify and reduce overdue receivables and unnecessary working\-capital blockage.



  
 



**GST \& Tax Compliance** 



* Ensure complete and timely compliance with applicable GST, TDS and Income Tax requirements.
* Review GST returns, reconciliations and tax payments.
* Ensure proper GST input tax credit reconciliation.
* Review TDS deductions, payments, returns and certificates.
* Coordinate for Income Tax return preparation and tax assessments.
* Monitor advance tax and other direct\-tax obligations.
* Coordinate with external tax consultants and advisors.
* Review tax notices and ensure timely responses.
* Keep management updated on major changes in tax and financial regulations.



  





**Audit Management** 



* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors.
* Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents and reconciliations.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory and internal audits.
* Review audit observations and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of audit trails.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants and management for resolution of audit queries.



  





**Internal Controls \& Process Improvement** 



* Develop, implement and monitor strong financial controls.
* Establish finance policies, procedures and SOPs.
* Review authorization and approval processes for purchases, expenses and payments.
* Identify financial risks, control weaknesses and potential leakages.
* Implement processes to reduce errors, fraud risks and financial losses.
* Continuously improve accounting and finance processes through automation and technology.
* Ensure proper segregation of duties within the Finance function.



  





**Cost Control \& Profitability** 



* Monitor operational and administrative expenses.
* Analyse product, department, branch and business\-unit profitability.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Monitor wastage, overheads and other controllable costs.
* Support management in pricing and margin\-related decisions.
* Analyse gross margin and contribution margins.
* Recommend corrective actions where profitability is below target.



  





**Inventory \& Stock Accounting** 



* Monitor inventory accounting and valuation.
* Coordinate with Operations / Production / Stores teams for stock reconciliation.
* Review stock adjustments, wastage, damages and variances.
* Support periodic physical stock verification.
* Investigate significant stock variances.
* Ensure proper accounting of inventory movements.



  





   
 **Payroll \& Statutory Payments** 



* Review payroll accounting and salary\-related entries.
* Ensure correct accounting of employee benefits and statutory deductions.
* Coordinate with HR for payroll\-related finance matters.
* Monitor applicable PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and other statutory obligations.
* Ensure timely payment and reconciliation of statutory liabilities.



  





   
 **Team Management** 



* Lead and supervise the Finance \& Accounts team.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor deliverables.
* Review the team's accounting and reconciliation work.
* Train and develop team members.
* Establish clear deadlines and performance standards.
* Ensure timely completion of monthly closing, MIS and statutory requirements.
* Promote accuracy, accountability and process discipline within the team.



  





**Experience requirement:** 



* 8\-10 years of experience in  of post\-qualification experience in Finance \& Accounts.
* Experience in the FMCG, Food \& Beverage, Bakery, Hospitality, or Retail industry is preferred.
* Strong practical experience in accounting, taxation, financial reporting and audit.
* Strong knowledge of Indian taxation and statutory compliance.
* Experience in managing a Finance \& Accounts team.
* Strong analytical, leadership, problem\-solving, communication, and decision\-making skills
* Proficiency in both verbal and written English



  
 



**Qualification and Licenses requirement:** 



* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
* Strong knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), GST, TDS, Income Tax, statutory compliance, audit, budgeting, and financial reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software such as Tally, SAP, Oracle, Zoho Books, or similar systems.
* Proven experience in financial analysis, cash\-flow management, working capital, cost control, and team management.
* Strong analytical, leadership, problem\-solving, communication, and decision\-making skills..

title: Senior Associate-RMS Digital RM-Data Analytics
description:

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network.  This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. * Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.
