title: Senior Legal Counsel - Contract & Review Management [T500-29288]
description:
**About ADM:** 




 We are one of the world’s largest nutrition companies and a global leader in human and animal nutrition. We unlock the power of nature to provide nourishing quality of life by transforming crops into ingredients and solutions for foods, beverages, supplements, livestock, aquaculture, and pets.
 



  





**About ADM India Hub:** 




 At ADM, we have long recognized the strength and potential of India’s talent pool, which is why we have maintained a presence in the country for more than 25 years. Building on this foundation, we have now established ADM India Hub, our first GCC in India.
 



 At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.
 



  





**Legal Counsel – Contract Review \& Management** 




**Level:** 
 Mid\-level (9–12 years post\-qualification)
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




**First\-pass (L1\) contract review:** 



* Perform first\-pass review and redlining of various types agreements including commercial and related agreements (e.g., NDAs, MTAs, and other high\-volume contract types) using ADM’s playbooks.
* Prepare a structured review record for each agreement — what changed, the basis for the position, per\-clause and overall risk rating, and open items — so onshore senior counsel can adjudicate and sign off efficiently.
* Apply ADM’s standard positions and pre\-approved fallback language consistently; identify out\-of\-playbook terms and escalate to onshore counsel (L2\) with a clear summary of the issue and options.
* Meet agreed service levels for initial response and review turnaround, and keep matters moving toward execution.



  





**NDA process management:** 



* Manage the NDA process end to end — intake through Onit, completeness checks, redlining, negotiation support, and tracking — as the primary point of contact for routine NDA requests.
* Handle incomplete requests, requested changes, and third\-party (other\-party) paper; resolve standard issues independently and escalate substantive changes to onshore attorneys.
* Maintain a complete, accurate repository (Onit) of executed NDAs and related records to support auditability and reuse.
* Support the phased expansion of the NDA model beyond the U.S. (EMEA and APAC) as scope and volume are defined.



  





**Workflow, quality \& continuous improvement:** 



* Use the legal workflow system (Onit) to receive, route, track, and report on matters; help triage and assign work as volume grows.
* Monitor quality and the L2 override rate; use feedback to refine playbooks and reduce rework over time.
* Partner with onshore attorneys and legal operations to review, validate, and tighten playbook positions before they go live.
* Contribute to a shared, governed Skills library that drives standardization and consistency across the team.
* Identify additional high\-volume or lower complexity work suitable for the ACC \+ AI model and support onboarding of new contract types.
* Champion human\-in\-the\-loop discipline — every AI\-suggested edit is reviewed, accepted, or rejected by a qualified reviewer.



  





**Required qualifications:** 



* Law degree (LLB/JD or equivalent) and qualification/admission to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.
* 5\+ years of post\-qualification experience reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts and NDAs, ideally in\-house or in a corporate/commercial practice.
* Strong working knowledge of common commercial clauses, risk, and standard fallback positions; sound judgment on when to escalate.
* Excellent written English, attention to detail, and the ability to produce clear, well\-documented review records.
* Comfort working with technology and AI\-assisted tools; proficiency with Microsoft Word (tracked changes) and legal workflow/CLM systems.
* Ability to manage a high\-volume queue independently, prioritize, and meet service\-level turnaround targets.



  





**Preferred qualifications:** 



* Experience supporting a captive/shared\-services or capability\-center legal function, or a legal operations environment.
* Familiarity with contract lifecycle tools (e.g., Onit) and e\-signature (e.g., DocuSign).
* Exposure to legal AI, prompt\-based tools, or building templates/playbooks/knowledge assets.
* Experience across multiple regions (U.S., EMEA, APAC) or with cross\-border agreements.



  





**Competencies:** 



* Judgment and risk awareness — knows what to standardize and what to escalate.
* Consistency and rigor — applies playbook standards uniformly and documents clearly.
* Collaboration — works effectively with onshore counsel, legal ops, and business stakeholders.
* Ownership — manages a process end to end and drives it to closure.
* Continuous improvement — turns feedback and data into better playbooks and faster cycles.



  





**Working conditions:** 




 Based at the ADM Capability Center in India. Some overlap with U.S. business hours is expected to coordinate with onshore counsel and stakeholders. ADM is an equal opportunity employer. Confidential – for internal recruiting use.

title: Litigation Counsel – Collections & Recovery
description:
**Please Read How To Apply Section Carefully**
**ROLE**
**Litigation Counsel — Collections \& Recovery**
 In\-house seat to lead recovery litigation across group NBFC entities. The job is maximum rupees collected from defaulting and fraudulent counterparties — not maximum notices served, and not endless legal loops.
   

  

**WHERE**
 Mumbai. Hearings across NCLT, High Court, tribunals, magistrate / EOW, outstation courts.
   

  

**REPORTS TO**
 Business leadership. You own the recovery docket. External counsel reports to you.
   

  

**BOOK**
 \~35 live offensive matters \+ a small defensive criminal / notice book. Multi\-entity, multi\-forum.
   

  

**SUCCESS**
 Cash in. Encashable security. Accounts frozen. Assets attached. Days\-to\-control. Filings are inputs.
   

  

**THE WORK**
 You will design and run multi\-forum campaigns on each cluster of defaults: Section 9 interim relief (freeze, disclosure, attachment), Section 11 / 17 arbitration, NCLT admission and CoC strategy, police and EOW complaints, newspaper publication and service, asset tracing, and settlements that only close against security that can be encashed. You will also protect directors on the defensive docket with the same urgency.
   

  

 You will not be hired to issue legal notices and wait for the next listed date. You create the next event — mention, publication receipt, additional affidavit, Form D, police follow\-up, asset\-search sprint — and you stand up and argue the hearings that matter.
   

  

**What You Have Done**
* 5–10 years of dispute work with a recovery bias. You have personally argued in more than one of: NCLT, High Court (Sec 9 / 11\), arbitral tribunal, magistrate or EOW.
* At least one matter where your sequence of moves produced cash in the client’s account or attached / encashable security — not merely an award or an admission order.
* Comfort with the unglamorous work that wins orders: affidavits of service, newspaper originals, vakalatnamas, bank\-freeze follow\-through, IO visits.
* Judgement on when to settle (only with security) and when settlement is the other side’s delay tactic.
* Ability to run a panel of external counsel to your written brief, and to replace counsel who miss dates or go silent.
* Clear bright line between lawful pressure (court\-ordered publication, notices to authorities, asset disclosure) and anything that is defamation, intimidation, or a reckless counter\-FIR risk.


**What This Is Not**
 A notice factory. A research seat. A coordinator who outsources thinking to senior counsel and reports dates. A role for someone whose default move is ‘issue a legal notice and file a case.’ If you want a quiet drafting practice, do not apply.
   

  

**How We Work With You**
* Authority to brief and replace external counsel within budget; investigator and publication budget from week 1\.
* Settlement mandate below a stated threshold; above that, you bring the recommendation, not the paperwork after the deal is done.
* Vakalatnamas and affidavits signed by the company inside 48 hours. One source\-of\-truth tracker. Weekly 2 hours recovery stand\-up.
* Compensation: in\-house base plus variable tied to cash collected and enforceable security on named clusters — not to number of filings.


**How To Apply**
**Send (1\) CV and (2\) an 8\-line note on one matter you ran that produced cash or attached security. Name the forums, the non\-obvious move, and the result. Do not send a generic ‘I have handled IBC and arbitration matters’ paragraph. Shortlisted candidates will get a two\-page redacted case study before the second conversation.**

title: Legal Counsel & Company Secretary
description:
**THIS ROLE WILL REQUIRE YOU TO RELOCATE TO DUBAI** 




  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel \& Company Secretary to join a fast\-paced telecommunications business with operations across multiple international markets.
 



 The role will provide legal, corporate governance and company secretarial support across the Group, working closely with senior management, Board members, finance, regulatory, commercial and operational teams.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strong commercial legal capability with practical experience managing the governance and statutory requirements of a complex, multi\-entity international organisation. Experience within telecommunications, technology, digital services or another highly regulated international sector is strongly preferred.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Legal \& Commercial
 


* Provide practical legal advice to the Group and its international operating companies.
* Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including:
* Telecom and technology agreements
* Supplier and vendor contracts
* Distribution and channel agreements
* Customer and enterprise agreements
* IT, software, SaaS and technology agreements
* Outsourcing and managed\-service agreements
* NDAs, consultancy and professional\-services agreements
* Advise business teams on contractual risk, liability, indemnities, termination rights and commercial obligations.
* Support negotiations with major suppliers, partners, operators and other third parties.
* Work with regulatory and compliance teams on matters affecting telecommunications operations across different jurisdictions.
* Support the management of disputes, litigation and external legal advisers where required.
* Provide legal input into new market entry, corporate projects, restructurings, acquisitions and other strategic initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate legal controls, policies and contracting processes are maintained across the Group.



 Company Secretarial \& Corporate Governance
 


* Act as a key point of contact for company secretarial and corporate governance matters across the Group.
* Maintain oversight of the Group's legal entity structure across multiple jurisdictions.
* Manage statutory registers, corporate records and governance documentation.
* Coordinate Board and shareholder meetings, including:
* Preparing agendas
* Collating and distributing Board papers
* Drafting Board and shareholder resolutions
* Preparing and maintaining accurate meeting minutes
* Tracking actions and decisions
* Ensure required statutory filings and corporate submissions are completed accurately and within relevant deadlines.
* Manage director appointments, resignations, changes of officers, registered offices and other corporate changes.
* Coordinate incorporations, dissolutions, restructurings and changes to Group entities.
* Maintain appropriate delegated authorities, powers of attorney and authorised signatory records.
* Support annual corporate compliance requirements across international subsidiaries.
* Liaise with local counsel, company secretarial providers, corporate service providers and government authorities internationally.
* Ensure subsidiaries comply with applicable corporate governance requirements and Group policies.



 Board \& Senior Management Support
 


* Provide governance advice to the Board, Chairman, CEO and senior management as required.
* Ensure Board decisions and corporate approvals are appropriately documented and implemented.
* Advise management on corporate authority, governance processes and director responsibilities.
* Support the development and implementation of Group governance frameworks, policies and procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive Board, shareholder and corporate information.



 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate should ideally have:
 


* Qualified lawyer status in a recognised jurisdiction.
* Approximately 8–15\+ years' relevant legal experience, although exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.
* Strong commercial legal and contract negotiation experience.
* Demonstrable company secretarial and corporate governance experience.
* Experience supporting Boards and senior executives.
* Experience managing multiple legal entities across several countries.
* Strong understanding of corporate structures, statutory filings, Board governance and subsidiary management.
* Experience within telecommunications, MNO, MVNO, technology, digital or another regulated international business is highly desirable.
* Exposure to international regulatory and compliance environments.
* Ability to coordinate multiple external legal and corporate service providers across jurisdictions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
* Commercially minded, pragmatic and comfortable operating in a fast\-moving international environment.



 Preferred Experience
 



 Particular interest will be given to candidates with experience in:
 


* Multi\-country corporate structures
* International subsidiary governance
* Board and shareholder governance
* Commercial telecom and technology contracts
* Corporate restructuring and entity rationalisation
* Regulatory and compliance matters
* International expansion and new\-market entry
* Working directly with CEOs, CFOs, General Counsel and Boards



 Key Success Measures
 



 Success in the role will be measured through:
 


* Effective governance of the Group's international legal entities.
* Accurate and timely completion of statutory and corporate requirements.
* High\-quality Board and shareholder governance.
* Commercially effective legal advice and contract negotiation.
* Reduction of legal, contractual and governance risk.
* Strong visibility and control of corporate obligations across all jurisdictions.
* Effective management of external legal and company secretarial providers.



 The Opportunity
 



 This is an opportunity to take a significant legal and governance role within a global telecommunications organisation, providing exposure to multiple jurisdictions, Boards, senior leadership and complex international commercial and corporate matters.
 



 The position would suit a commercially minded lawyer who combines strong legal capability with hands\-on company secretarial and corporate governance expertise and is comfortable operating across a diverse international business.

title: Companies Secretary
description:
**About the job** 




**Job Title: Companies Secretary (CS)** 




**Location:** 
 Green Park, Delhi
 



**Company:** 
 Sangal \& Associates
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 qualified CS (freshers welcome) as well as candidates with prior experience may apply.
 



**Salary:** 

 50,000 to 1,00,000 (depending on experience)
 




  





**About Us** 




 Sangal \& Associates is a Chartered Accountancy firm based in Delhi NCR, advising companies, alternative investment funds, start\-ups and promoter groups in India and overseas.
 



 Our practice spans statutory, internal and tax audits; direct and indirect taxation; transfer pricing and international taxation; business and securities valuations; corporate structuring and restructuring; FEMA and RBI compliances; secretarial and ROC compliance; due diligence and transaction advisory; and litigation and representation before tax and regulatory authorities.
 



 Working with us means exposure to cross\-border assignments, funds and fast\-growing businesses, close working contact with the partners, and the breadth that comes from a practice that is not confined to a single vertical.
 



  





 We are looking for a Company Secretary to join our team on a full\-time, onsite basis.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Handle end\-to\-end secretarial compliance under the Companies Act, 2013 — incorporations, ROC/MCA filings, maintenance of statutory registers and records.
* Convene and document Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, AGMs and EGMs — drafting notices, agendas, resolutions and minutes.
* Conduct and support Secretarial Audits, due diligence and compliance health checks for clients.
* Manage FEMA/RBI compliances and filings, including FC\-GPR, FC\-TRS, Form InVi, FLA Return and ODI/FDI reporting.
* Support valuation and transaction advisory assignments — share allotments, transfers, buy\-backs, restructuring, ESOP schemes and related documentation.
* Draft and vet agreements, undertakings, declarations, board resolutions and other legal/secretarial documentation.
* Liaise with clients, ROC, RBI, authorised dealer banks and other regulatory authorities.
* Track regulatory amendments and advise clients and internal teams on their impact.
* Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely closure of all statutory due dates.



**Requirements** 



* Qualified Company Secretary (Member of ICSI); candidates who have completed CS Executive with relevant experience may also be considered.
* Working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, FEMA and allied corporate laws.
* Sound drafting skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in MS Office and MCA/RBI online filing portals.
* Ability to manage multiple client assignments and deadlines independently.
* LLB or additional qualification will be an added advantage.

 **India, France, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Australia, Singapore, Canada, and Israel** 
 , the Group operates across multiple legal, regulatory, and commercial environments.

 **General Counsel/VP – Legal \& Compliance** 
 to establish and lead the Group's global Legal \& Compliance function.
 



 This is a unique opportunity to join the executive leadership team and
 **build the legal function from the ground up** 
 —shaping the organization's approach to commercial contracting, corporate governance, privacy, compliance, intellectual property, risk management, and strategic transactions.
 



 The ideal candidate will be both
 **strategic and hands\-on** 
 : someone who can advise the CEO and Board on complex matters while also building scalable processes, frameworks, and a high\-performing legal organization.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 As the Group's senior\-most legal leader, you will be responsible for providing legal and strategic guidance across the business while building a scalable global legal infrastructure.
 



 You will partner closely with the
 **CEO, CFO, Board, and senior leadership team** 
 , as well as Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, HR, Security, and other functions.
 



  





**Your key areas of ownership will include:** 




**Commercial \& Technology Law** 



* Lead the drafting, negotiation, and execution of enterprise SaaS and technology agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, licensing agreements, partnership and reseller agreements, and vendor contracts.
* Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, and other teams to provide practical, commercially focused legal guidance.
* Build scalable contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval frameworks, and legal workflows.
* Establish processes that enable faster business execution while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.
* Manage external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions and optimize legal spend.
* Oversee disputes, claims, demand notices, and litigation, working toward commercially balanced outcomes.



**Corporate Governance \& Secretarial** 



* Lead corporate governance and company secretarial matters across the Group's global entities.
* Oversee board meetings, resolutions, statutory registers, regulatory filings, and governance documentation.
* Advise on corporate structuring, investments, reorganizations, and strategic transactions.
* Support M\&A activities, including due diligence, transaction documentation, and post\-transaction integration.
* Coordinate with local legal and corporate secretarial advisors across jurisdictions.

**Privacy, Compliance \& Regulatory Affairs** 



* Own and continuously strengthen the Group's global privacy and compliance framework.

 **GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act** 
 , and other applicable regulations.

title: Litigation Manager (4-5 years)
description:
Position Overview
 



 Delhivery is looking for a law graduate with 4–5 years of relevant litigation experience to join its Litigation team in Gurugram. The role involves independently managing litigation filed by or against Delhivery across India — commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters — including reviewing notices received, drafting and vetting replies, notices, written statements and evidence, and formulating and recommending strategy on the way forward for current and existing matters. The candidate will monitor all pending litigation; coordinate with internal business and ground teams to gather evidence and inputs for replies, notices, written statements and other court/tribunal filings; and manage and coordinate with external counsel, including assigning new matters and overseeing how they are handled. The ideal candidate will have sharp legal acumen and the ability to strategise, and will be resourceful, organised and people\- oriented, with strong follow\-up skills and the ability to manage cases independently with minimal supervision.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Litigation Management \& Drafting
 



 • Independently manage and respond to commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters across India; review notices received and draft, vet and finalize replies, notices, written statements, pleadings and evidence before filing.
 



 • Take the call on assigning matters to external counsel, driving litigation strategy, filings and hearings, and proactively flag risks and escalations to management.
 



 • Track litigation timelines, monitor court proceedings, maintain accurate, up\-to\-date trackers and ensure timely resolution of issues such as AR attendance, document filing and orders with external counsel.
 



 2\. Evidence \& Internal Coordination
 



 • Coordinate with internal departments (HR, Security, Finance, Revenue Assurance) and business/ground teams to obtain accurate data and factual inputs; manage, protect and collate evidence for use in replies and pleadings.
 



 • Draft responses independently or route them to counsel, and review counsel\&\#39;s drafts for accuracy and alignment with the company\&\#39;s position before filing.
 



 • Act as the primary liaison between the Litigation team, internal stakeholders and external counsel; drive timely documentation, appearances and compliance across functions.
 



 3\. Counsel \& Court Coordination
 



 • Coordinate with external counsel for hearings, filings, conferences and documentation, representing the Litigation team\&\#39;s interests throughout.
 



 • Facilitate execution of affidavits, vakalatnamas and authorisations, and coordinate attendance of company representatives and witnesses before courts and authorities, ensuring adequate preparation.
 



 4\. Strategy, Team \& Operations
 



 • Strategise and advise business teams on legal escalations and potential litigation, recommending a course of action based on risk assessment; identify recurring issues and recommend process or policy changes.
 



 • Own day\-to\-day litigation operations, calendars, document repositories, litigation reports, counsel invoices and court\- fee approvals and drive improvements in tracking and document management.
 



 Qualifications ; Experience
 



 • LL.B. from a recognised university or institution.
 



 • 4–5 years of relevant litigation or litigation\- management experience (in\-house or law firm) across commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil or criminal matters.
 



 • Demonstrated experience independently managing litigation end\-to\-end, with minimal supervision.
 



 • Familiarity with court procedures, particularly in Delhi/NCR.
 



 • Proven experience coordinating with external counsel and internal stakeholders on case strategy.
 



 • Ability to independently navigate court and tribunal
 



  





 Key Skills Attributes
 



 • Sharp legal acumen with strong drafting and reviewing skills across notices, pleadings and
 



 evidence.
 



 • Resourceful, proactive and solution\-oriented, with the confidence to own matters and a small team independently.
 



 • Strong analytical ability and sound judgment in assessing litigation risk and strategy.
 



 • Excellent follow\-up skills and the ability to drive closure of action items across stakeholders.
 



 • Clear, confident communication skills, both written and verbal
 



 • Bar Council enrolment preferred.
 



 • High level of organization, attention to detail and ownership.
 



 • Ability to manage multiple matters, a small team and competing priorities under pressure.
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and litigation trackers; high integrity and professionalism.

title: Global Financial Crimes Compliance Risk Assessment Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The American Express Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) function provides second\-line policy, framework, oversight and control solutions to meet the Company’s legal, regulatory and risk management mandates in connection with Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter Terrorism Financing (CTF), Sanctions, and Anti\-Bribery and Corruption. The GFCC portfolio comprises all aspects of the Company’s first and second\-line financial crime risk management (FCRM) activities, including all lines of businesses in the United States and both proprietary and non\-proprietary global markets.
   

  

 Reporting to the Vice President of Financial Crime Risk Assessment, Reporting \& Controls Oversight, this Manager role is responsible for supporting the Financial Crime Risk Assessment (FCRA) framework, including risk assessment delivery, reporting, and fundamental assessments. Specifically, this role will support each of the FCRA processes with pre\-planning and execution activities focused on data requirements, collection, analysis and tracking, implementing and maintaining data quality controls, and developing action plans to address data issues. The FCRAs play a critical role in delivering transparent, data\-driven insights into inherent and residual risks, strengthening the control environment, and supporting effective governance and decision\-making across the enterprise. Through close partnership with stakeholders across lines of defense, technology, product, and business teams, this role enhances a foundational component of the risk assessment process, improving the accuracy of results and risk visibility in alignment with evolving regulatory expectations and ongoing transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Build governance structure and oversee the end\-to\-end process of data collection, tracking, analysis, documentation, issues, and quality controls used in the production of enterprise, market, legal entity, and line\-of\-business FCRAs.
* Develop and implement data quality controls and associated documentation of enhanced processes and procedures in FCRA processes.
* Manage engagement with key stakeholders across Business Units, GFCC, Market Compliance, Technology and Product teams to obtain requisite data.
* Develop and maintain documented data and input requirements, including data owners, data sources, extraction scripts, report names, and other details required to develop a consolidated data inventory of risk assessment inputs.
* Define and implement data attestation process, data tracker and issues log to enable effective and accurate data collection, including documentation of known limitations, anomalies, data manipulations, and data issues that may impact the quality or accuracy of data.
* Analyze FCRA data and results to identify emerging risks, issues, trends, and year\-over\-year changes; translate insights into actionable recommendations and methodology enhancements.
* Support outcomes of risk assessments and development of risk assessment action plan based on data issues.
* Support senior management, audit, and regulatory engagements through high\-quality, defensible analysis and documentation.
* Partner with GFCC Enablement, Technology and Product teams to support delivery of enhancements to risk assessment platforms and data infrastructure. Perform assessments to evaluate and mitigate impacts to existing reports stemming from platform modernization, technology and process changes.
* Provide subject matter expertise on financial crime risk assessment, reporting, and controls, strengthening governance and risk management practices.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 5\+ years of work experience in data management, analytics and/or reporting within Financial Crimes Compliance, Risk Management, or general Compliance.
* Demonstrated expertise in data management, including data collection, organization, validation, and maintenance to ensure accuracy, consistency, and accessibility across systems and platforms.
* Demonstrated experience in AML/CTF programs, or broader financial crimes risk management, including execution of enterprise risk assessments.
* Expert MS Excel skills (e.g., Pivot tables, Macros, Power Query) and/or demonstrated experience using data visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or MicroStrategy is required. Proficiency in SQL and/or other data querying languages is preferred, with the ability to design, review, and optimize complex queries to extract, analyze, and validate large datasets.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly articulate complex risk and control concepts to a range of audiences and translate findings into impactful reports, communications and presentations to senior management, committees, regulators, etc.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Decisive self\-starter with a high degree of accountability, solution\-focused and able to successfully balance multiple priorities over both the short and long term in a deadline\-intensive environment.
* Ability to initiate and drive projects to completion, navigate ambiguity and proactively anticipate and address challenges.
* Strong management, collaboration, organizational, and interpersonal skills with ability to motivate and engage team\-members and stakeholders to ensure effective delivery of initiatives.
* Experience supporting regulatory exams, audits, or internal reviews, including preparation of defensible documentation and responses.
* Experience working across global, matrixed organizations and partnering effectively with Compliance, Risk, Audit, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Proven to have a global mindset; able to work well across time zones and work cultures.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

**Description**
 Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The right candidate will possess a strong program management background, has experience leading large projects, and has a well\-rounded technical background in current technologies. As a Sr. Technical Program Manager, you will be Single Threaded Owner (STO) to lead and develop scalable solutions across multiple engineering teams, driving project schedules from design to release, stakeholder management and managing the production launch for large cross org programs. You will work directly with customers, disambiguate the requirements, anticipate bottlenecks and risks, make trade\-offs, provide escalation management and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, destroy limits to scale, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are able to develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives while rolling up your sleeves to get the job done. This role will require high judgement on how we can deliver for customers in both the short\- and long\-term.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 TFS has over 150\+ engineers, and 15\+ product \& program managers. Each TPM is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with clients and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation \& management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with \~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Maintain confidentiality of employee and candidate information. 5. General HR Support Coordinate with employees, candidates, and internal departments as required. Support the HR team in implementing HR processes and initiatives. Assist with other HR-related activities assigned by the reporting manager. Required Skills Good verbal and written communication skills . Basic understanding of HR and recruitment concepts. Good interpersonal and coordination skills. Strong follow-up skills. We are seeking an Accounting Systems Analyst to join our Accounting Service Center Systems team. This role sits at the intersection of finance and technology, supporting the development, automation, and optimization of accounting and finance processes. You will work closely with Finance and Systems teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and deliver technology-driven solutions that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control across financial operations. 
 Role & responsibilities Identify manual and repetitive finance processes and design automation solutions to improve efficiency and accuracy. Build and maintain automation workflows using Python, VBA/Excel Macros, Power Automate, Alteryx, or similar tools. Support integrations between ERP, accounting, and finance systems through APIs and direct data connections. Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze financial data. Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions. Test, monitor, and document automated processes to ensure reliability, compliance, and audit readiness. Troubleshoot, existing automations and continuously improve process performance and scalability. Maintain documentation of automated workflows, system dependencies, and process logic. 

 Preferred candidate profile Bachelors degree in computer applications (BCA), Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Candidates with strong practical automation experience from other educational backgrounds will also be considered. 1-2 years of experience in automation, systems support, or related technical roles. Hands-on experience with Python and/or VBA scripting and automation. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Exposure to workflow automation or RPA tools such as Alteryx or Power Automate. Understanding of finance and accounting processes, including reconciliations, journal entries, accounts payable/receivable, and month-end close activities. Familiarity with ERP or accounting systems, preferably SAP. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Certification in automation or RPA tools such as Alteryx, Power Automate, or similar platforms is a plus. Previous experience working directly with Finance or Accounting teams is preferred. Experience with API integrations and system-to-system data flows would be advantageous. Exposure to Power BI, Alteryx, or similar reporting and dashboarding tools is desirable. Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and implement automation solutions that drive efficiency. 

 Eligibility criteria for the walk-in drive for the Accounting Systems Analyst role: Candidates should have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Applications (BCA), Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Candidates should have 1+ years of experience in automation, systems support, process improvement, or related technical roles. Candidates must have hands-on experience with Python and/or VBA scripting and automation. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases is mandatory. Exposure to Power Automate, Alteryx, RPA tools, or similar workflow automation platforms is preferred. Candidates who have interviewed with Wiley within the last six months will not be considered. Candidates should be currently based in the Delhi NCR region. Notice period should not be more than 60 days.

title: Government Tender & Business Development Executive / Manager
description:
Position : Government Tender & Business Development Executive / Manager Department: Business Development / Government Projects Industry: Education & IT Training Location: Pune Employment Type: Full-Time 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced and proactive Government Tender & Business Development Executive/Manager to identify, manage, and secure government tenders and projects related to Education, Skill Development, IT Training, Corporate Training, Digital Skills, and Workforce Development. The candidate will be responsible for the complete tender lifecycle, including identifying relevant opportunities, reviewing eligibility criteria, preparing documentation, coordinating with internal teams, submitting bids, and supporting the organisation through the tender and project execution process. 
 Key ResponsibilitiesTender Identification & Research 
 Search and identify relevant Government Tenders and RFP opportunities related to Education, Skill Development, IT Training, and Technology Training. Regularly monitor government tender portals and procurement platforms. Identify opportunities from Central Government, State Government, Universities, Government Institutions, Skill Development Bodies, and other public organisations. Analyse tender requirements, eligibility criteria, scope of work, and project requirements. 
 Tender Management 
 Manage the complete tendering and bidding process. Prepare and coordinate tender documents, technical proposals, commercial proposals, and supporting documentation. Ensure all tender submissions are completed within the required deadlines. Maintain proper records of submitted, ongoing, won, and lost tenders. Coordinate with internal departments for required documents and information. 
 Documentation & Compliance 
 Prepare and manage documents required for tender submissions. Ensure compliance with eligibility criteria and tender requirements. Coordinate for company documents, financial documents, technical documents, certificates, declarations, and other required information. Maintain an updated database of company credentials and documents required for government tenders. 
 Government & Business Development 
 Build relationships with relevant government departments, educational institutions, universities, and skill development organisations. Identify new government training and education business opportunities. Participate in pre-bid meetings and tender-related discussions when required. Coordinate with management and internal teams for proposal strategy and project planning. 
 Reporting 
 Maintain a regular pipeline of upcoming and active tender opportunities. Share regular reports on: New Tender Opportunities Submitted Tenders Upcoming Deadlines Tender Status Won and Lost Opportunities Potential Revenue 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Experience in Government Tender Management / Tendering / Government Business Development. Knowledge of government procurement processes and tender documentation. Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals. Strong documentation and proposal-writing skills. Good understanding of the Education, Training, Skill Development, or IT sector. Ability to understand RFPs, RFQs, eligibility criteria, and scope of work. Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and documentation. Ability to manage multiple tender deadlines. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred: Government Education Projects Skill Development Projects IT Training Projects Government Training Programs University Training Projects Digital Skill Development Corporate and Institutional Training 
 Experience 
 2-6+ years of relevant experience Candidates with proven experience in successfully managing and winning government tenders will be preferred. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Number of relevant tender opportunities identified Number of tenders submitted Tender submission accuracy and compliance Number and value of tenders won Revenue generated through government projects Development of new government and institutional partnerships Tender conversion ratio 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in government tendering and business development, with the ability to identify opportunities and manage the complete tender process. 
 The candidate should also understand the Education and Training ecosystem and be capable of helping the organisation expand into Government, Skill Development, Institutional, and Public Sector training projects. If you have experience in Government Tenders and are passionate about building large-scale Education and Training opportunities, we would like to hear from you.

title: Servicer Sales Executive
description:
Services Sales Executive - India Software Development & Managed Engineering 12th Wonder Pune 12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven - 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews. What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India. The Role This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them. You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers - identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan. You own your territory and your number. You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity - but the deal is yours to win or lose. Your buyer: India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments - automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~ 20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan-Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a mornings drive. What you're selling Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models: Custom software development. Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients - web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships. Managed engineering teams. Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the clients product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure. Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a 15-25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3-5x the initial contract value. What you'll have behind you You're not selling a pitch deck. You're selling a delivery capability that already works. 70-person engineering team across full-stack development, managed teams, and R&D services 100+ existing customers - referenceable proof that the delivery model works Pre-sales engineering support on every qualified opportunity Pune delivery centre operational since 2019, inside the automotive supplier belt CRM, data tools, and an events budget from day one Direct reporting line to the COO, with weekly leadership access Responsibilities Hunt new logos. Identify and qualify enterprise accounts within your territory. Build your own outbound pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, events, LinkedIn, and partnerships. No inbound engine exists - you create the conversations. Run the full sales cycle. From first meeting through discovery, solution shaping, proposal, negotiation, and close. You'll work with pre-sales engineers to scope engagements and with delivery leadership to confirm capacity and timelines. Grow accounts after landing. The land-and-expand model is central. A 20 lakh project win should become a 60-80 lakh managed team engagement within 12 months. You own the relationship end-to-end. Maintain pipeline discipline. Keep CRM current. Forecast accurately. Maintain pipeline coverage at 3x the forward quarter. Report weekly on stage progression, win/loss, and coverage gaps. Milestones Exhibit 1: Year-one delivery cadence First 30 days - Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live. First 60 days - Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker. First 90 days - Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation. First 180 days - First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts. End of year one - 75 lakh in closed revenue - roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team. Requirements 3-6 years in B2B sales of software development, IT services, or engineering services to Indian enterprises Has built pipeline through outbound - not just worked marketing-generated leads Comfortable selling to CXOs, CTOs, engineering heads, and procurement Can articulate a delivery model and defend a rate card in a pricing conversation Thinks in pipeline coverage, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy Wants a role where commission is uncapped and effort directly drives income Nice to have: An existing network in the Pune-Chakan-Talegaon automotive belt or the TIC/testing sector; experience closing services deals in the 15-30 lakh range; exposure to staff augmentation or managed-team delivery models.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Travel Sales Executive to join our Sales & Business Development team. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a strong customer-focused approach, and a passion for the travel industry. The candidate will be responsible for generating leads, understanding customer requirements, recommending suitable travel solutions, converting inquiries into bookings, and achieving monthly sales targets. 
 Key Responsibilities: Generate leads through calls, referrals, digital platforms, online inquiries, and other sales channels. Understand customers' travel requirements, preferences, and budgets. Recommend and sell suitable domestic and international holiday packages. Promote and sell holiday packages, flight tickets, hotel bookings, visa assistance, travel insurance, and other travel-related services. Prepare customized travel itineraries and quotations based on customer requirements. Follow up regularly on leads, inquiries, quotations, and pending bookings. Convert inquiries and leads into confirmed bookings while achieving monthly sales targets. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with individual and corporate clients. Handle customer queries and provide timely solutions throughout the booking process. Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, quotations, and bookings. Stay updated on travel destinations, packages, pricing, and industry trends. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in any discipline. 1-3 years of experience in travel sales, tourism, or a related industry. Experience in holiday package sales will be an added advantage. Required Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong sales, negotiation, and persuasion abilities. Customer-centric approach with excellent problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of domestic and international travel destinations. Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable travel solutions. Good computer knowledge and proficiency in basic office applications. Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet sales targets. Positive attitude, confidence, and willingness to learn.

Key Skills: Travel Agent Activities,Holiday Packages,Lead Generation,Travel Sales,Travel Booking,visa services,Corporate Travel Management,Quotation

Our software portfolio covers Capital Markets, CRM, ERP, Service Management, Project Management, Workflow & Business Process Automation, Financial Accounting and AI-enabled Business Applications .

title: Territory Sales Executive
description:
TERRITORY SALES EXECUTIVE - GENERAL TRADE 
 Industry: Imported Glassware / Tableware / Houseware 
 Department: General Trade Sales 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Field Sales 
 Working Days: 6 Days per Week 
 Salary: 26,000 - 45,000 per month + applicable TA/DA/Conveyance at Actuals/ 
 Mobile Allowance. 
 OPEN POSITIONS 
 Delhi / NCR - 2 Positions 
 Territory 1: North Delhi + West Delhi + GT Road Belt up to Ambala 
 Territory 2: South Delhi + East Delhi + Gurgaon + Faridabad 
 Kolkata / West Bengal - 1 Position 
 Territory: Kolkata + Entire West Bengal 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for energetic, street-smart and result-oriented Territory Sales Executives - General Trade to develop the market for a leading Imported Glassware Brand . 
This is a pure General Trade Field-sales role , focused on independent retail outlets such as: 
 Glassware and crockery shops 
 Kitchenware and cookware shops 
 Houseware and plastic household-product stores 
 Gift shops 
 Departmental stores 
 Independent neighborhood / mom-and-pop retailers 
 The sales channel is primarily: 
 Company to Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 The role will focus strongly on four areas: 
 DISTRIBUTOR STRENGTHENING 
 OUTLET COVERAGE 
 SECONDARY SALES 
 PRODUCT VISIBILITY 
 This is not a HORECA or Institutional Sales position. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Drive Secondary Sales 
Generate and grow secondary sales from distributors to General Trade retailers. Regularly visit retailers, present products, book orders, introduce new products and generate repeat business. 
The objective is to ensure continuous movement of products from: 
 Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 2. Increase Outlet Coverage 
 Continuously identify and develop new retail outlets in the assigned territory. Focus on increasing the number of productive outlets that actively stock, sell and reorder the Imported Glassware Brand. 
 Develop both: 
 New retailers 
 Existing retailers with additional sales potential 
 Approximately 70% focus on new business development and 30% focus on existing business development , depending on territory maturity. 
 3. Strengthen Distributors 
 Work closely with existing distributors to improve: 
 Market coverage 
 Retailer servicing 
 Product availability 
 Secondary sales 
 Stock movement 
 New-product distribution 
 Market penetration 
 Identify areas where distribution is weak or additional distributors may be required. Support the company in identifying suitable new distributor opportunities. 
 4. Improve Product Visibility 
Ensure good visibility and presentation of products at important retail outlets. 
Look for opportunities to improve: 
Shelf placement 
Counter displays 
Product presentation 
New-product visibility 
Range display 
Promotional material 
The objective is to make the products visible and easy for retailers to recommend to customers. 
 5. Increase Product Range Per Outlet 
 Encourage retailers to stock a wider range of products instead of only a few fast-moving items. 
 Focus on: 
 Increasing number of SKUs per outlet 
 Introducing new products 
 Expanding product categories 
 Improving repeat ordering 
 Developing higher-value retailers 
 6. Territory & Beat Management 
 Plan and cover the assigned territory systematically. 
 Develop: 
 Markets - Beats - Retailers - Visit Frequency 
 Maintain disciplined market coverage and regularly identify: 
 New outlets 
 Underdeveloped markets 
 Inactive retailers 
 Distribution gaps 
 Competitor activity 
 New sales opportunities 
 7. Year-on-Year Sales Growth 
 Take ownership of sales growth in the assigned territory. 
 Sales targets will be planned considering: 
 Previous-year sales 
 Existing business 
 Territory potential 
 Outlet opportunities 
 Distributor strength 
 New product opportunities 
 Performance will be strongly evaluated on Year-on-Year sales growth . 
 8. New Product Introduction 
 Actively present and introduce new products to distributors and retailers. 
 The salesperson should be comfortable explaining: 
 Product features 
 Design and usage 
 MRP 
 Retail potential 
 Product dierentiation 
 Consumer appeal 
 9. Market Intelligence 
 Regularly provide feedback on: 
 Competitor brands 
 Competitor pricing 
 New launches 
 Retailer feedback 
 Product trends 
 Retail margins 
 Market opportunities 
 Fast- and slow-moving products 
 Distributor and retailer activity 
 COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY 
 The Territory Sales Executive will be responsible only for Sales and Market Development . 
 Retailer payment collection will be handled by the respective distributor. 
 IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 
 Experience 
 2 to 5 years of relevant General Trade Field-sales experience preferred. 
 Candidates may come from: 
 Glassware 
 Crockery 
 Tableware 
 Kitchenware 
 Cookware 
 Plasticware / Plastic Household Products 
 Houseware / Homeware 
 Giftware 
 Utensils 
 Small Home Appliances 
 FMCG / Consumer Goods with strong General Trade experience 
 Direct glassware experience is preferred but not mandatory. 
 Strong candidates from Cookware, Kitchenware, Plastic Household Products, Crockery or Houseware are highly relevant. 
 Candidates primarily experienced in HORECA, Hotels, Restaurants or Institutional Sales without meaningful General Trade experience will not be suitable. 
 SKILLS & PERSONAL QUALITIES 
The ideal candidate should be: 
 Strong in General Trade sales 
 Street-smart and energetic 
 Comfortable working extensively in the market 
 Good at retailer relationship building 
 Strong in new outlet opening 
 Experienced in secondary sales 
 Good at distributor coordination 
 Target-oriented 
 Self-driven and disciplined 
 Strong in follow-up 
 Comfortable working independently 
 Commercially aware 
 Willing to travel regularly 
 
 Knowledge of MS Word or Excel is beneficial 
 VEHICLE & TRAVEL 
 Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred / required depending on the territory. 
 The candidate should be comfortable with extensive local travel and outstation travel wherever required. 
 WORKING DAYS 
 This is a 6-day Field-sales position . 
 Weekly off will normally be: Sunday OR the weekly closure day of the principal market being covered. 
 TERRITORY DETAILS 
 NORTH & WEST DELHI / GT ROAD BELT 
 North Delhi, West Delhi and markets along the GT Road belt up to Ambala. Candidates already familiar with retailers and distributors in these markets will be preferred. 
 SOUTH & EAST DELHI / NCR 
 South Delhi, East Delhi, Gurgaon and Faridabad. 
 Existing General Trade market knowledge will be preferred. 
 KOLKATA / WEST BENGAL 
 Based in Kolkata with responsibility for the entire West Bengal market . 
 Regular outstation travel across West Bengal will be required. 
 Knowledge of the West Bengal General Trade market and ability to communicate in Bengali and Hindi will be preferred. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS 
 Performance will primarily be evaluated on: 
 
 Distributor Strengthening 
 Distributor productivity 
 Market coverage 
 Product availability 
 New distributor opportunities 
 Outlet Coverage 
 New outlets opened 
 Productive outlets developed 
 Existing outlet growth 
 New market penetration 
 Secondary Sales 
 Secondary sales growth 
 Year-on-Year sales growth 
 Repeat orders 
 New-product sales 
 Product Visibility 
 Product placement 
 Range visibility 
 New-product displays 
 Retail presence 
 WHO SHOULD APPLY? 
 Apply if you can confidently say: 
 I know General Trade. I can strengthen distributors, increase outlet coverage, drive secondary sales, improve product visibility and grow my territory year after year. 
We are looking for a strong market developer and salesperson , not merely an order taker.

title: Senior Consultant ALM
description:
The Senior Consultant ALM will lead the design, configuration, and governance of SAP Cloud ALM for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations. The role focuses on establishing end-to-end ALM practices across requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. The consultant will define ALM governance frameworks including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and KPIs, while ensuring performance tuning and Basis-level support. Acting as the ALM workstream lead, the role involves stakeholder engagement, solution architecture advisory, and transition into operations. Must Have 8+ years experience working in Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) roles across at least 3 enterprise SAP implementations. Handson experience designing, configuring, and operating modern ALM toolsets in SAP landscapes, with recent practical experience using SAP Cloud ALM in a Public Cloud implementation. Proven ability to apply ALM practices across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. Experience leading the ALM workstream on SAP programmes, with a proven ability to define and enforce ALM governance including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and reporting Proficiency in performance monitoring, tuning, and Basis-level tasks. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting other. Nice to Have Handson experience with Codebeamer, Windchill RV&S, or similar enterprise ALM platforms. Experience managing coexistence or transition between Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM. Experience integrating ALM with CI/CD or DevOps pipelines. Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Day-To-Day: SAP Cloud ALM workstream leadership and planning Configure and run SAP Cloud ALM for requirements, testing, defects, releases, and operations readiness. Support consulting and implementation projects for Application Lifecycle Management (ALM). Support the definition of client specific solution architectures for ALM & PLM; with focus on Application Architecture or Technical Architecture as required. Analyse requirements, design solutions, and successfully implement solutions with the help of cross-functional teams. Ensure quality through appropriate methods and software engineering processes. Roles & Responsibilities Develop organisational strategies, runbooks and roadmaps for SAP Cloud ALM. Establish SAP Cloud ALM governance: templates, standards, naming conventions, traceability rules, release gates, and quality KPIs. Configure SAP Cloud ALM scenarios based on client requirements and following SAP best practices. Drive and deliver system upgrades, performance tuning, and test automation. Provide technical support for ALM-related issues to implementation teams and clients. Engage with internal and client stakeholders around Cloud ALM processes, including workshops and advisory/SME sessions. Stay current with the latest SAP ALM tools and best practices and delivery though-leadership pieces, like blogs, whitepaper etc.

Key Skills: SAP Cloud ALM,SAP Solution Manager,SAP implementations,Application Lifecycle Management,SAP S/4HANA,Application Architecture,SAP landscapes,ALM practices

Proven ability to apply ALM practices across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. Experience leading the ALM workstream on SAP programmes, with a proven ability to define and enforce ALM governance including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and reporting Proficiency in performance monitoring, tuning, and Basis-level tasks. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting other. Nice to Have Handson experience with Codebeamer, Windchill RV&S, or similar enterprise ALM platforms. Experience managing coexistence or transition between Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM. Experience integrating ALM with CI/CD or DevOps pipelines. Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Day-To-Day: SAP Cloud ALM workstream leadership and planning Configure and run SAP Cloud ALM for requirements, testing, defects, releases, and operations readiness. title: AI/ML Solution Architect
description:
About the Role 
 Bacancy is looking for an experienced AI/ML Solution Architect to lead the design and architecture of scalable, secure, and production-ready AI/ML solutions for enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will have 12+ years of experience in software engineering and architecture, with significant expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, cloud platforms, and enterprise solution architecture . 
 This role will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, engineering teams, and technology leadership to translate business challenges into innovative AI-powered solutions and drive them from concept through production. 
 Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end AI/ML solution architectures aligned with business objectives, scalability, security, and performance requirements. Architect solutions leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and AI Agents . Define architecture for LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, vector databases, embeddings, model fine-tuning, and inference systems . Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML models, frameworks, platforms, tools, and cloud services. Design and implement MLOps/LLMOps strategies covering model development, deployment, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and governance. Architect AI solutions across major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud . Develop scalable data architectures and pipelines required for AI/ML workloads. Establish best practices around AI security, data privacy, responsible AI, model governance, and compliance . Conduct technical discovery sessions and translate complex business requirements into practical AI/ML solutions. Create solution architecture documents, technical proposals, HLDs, LLDs, architecture diagrams, POCs, and technology roadmaps . Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure successful implementation of the proposed architecture. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects, developers, data scientists, and ML engineers. Participate in client presentations, technical discussions, workshops, solution demonstrations, and pre-sales activities . Stay current with emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability to enterprise use cases. Drive architectural decisions, technology evaluations, and proof-of-concepts for emerging AI capabilities. 
 Required Technical Skills 
 12+ years of experience in software engineering, technology architecture, or solution architecture. Strong hands-on and architectural experience in AI/ML technologies . Excellent understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) . Experience with frameworks and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face , or equivalent. Strong knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, fine-tuning, and AI agents . Experience with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks. Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, and predictive analytics . Experience designing production-grade ML/AI systems . Strong understanding of MLOps/LLMOps , CI/CD, model lifecycle management, monitoring, and observability. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform . Knowledge of databases, data platforms, APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, APIs, Git, CI/CD , and modern DevOps practices. Strong understanding of AI/ML security, data governance, privacy, and responsible AI principles. 
 Solution Architecture & Client Responsibilities 
 Lead technical discussions with enterprise clients and C-level/technology stakeholders. Understand business problems and identify opportunities where AI/ML can deliver measurable value. Prepare AI/ML solution proposals, architecture blueprints, technical estimations, and implementation roadmaps . Support the sales and pre-sales team in technical discovery and proposal development. Present complex AI/ML concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Conduct architecture reviews and provide recommendations on technology selection and solution design. Identify technical risks, dependencies, scalability concerns, and mitigation strategies. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field . Experience working with enterprise clients or digital transformation programs. Experience leading large-scale AI/ML transformation initiatives. Experience with Agentic AI and multi-agent architectures . Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, and enterprise AI adoption. Relevant cloud/AI certifications such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or AI/ML certifications are an advantage.

Key Skills: Enterprise Architecture,Solution Architecting,Technical Architecture,Architecting,Architecture,Artificial Intelligence,Technical,Ml

title: Senior Consultant ALM
description:
The Senior Consultant ALM will lead the design, configuration, and governance of SAP Cloud ALM for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations. The role focuses on establishing end-to-end ALM practices across requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. The consultant will define ALM governance frameworks including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and KPIs, while ensuring performance tuning and Basis-level support. Acting as the ALM workstream lead, the role involves stakeholder engagement, solution architecture advisory, and transition into operations. Must Have 8+ years experience working in Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) roles across at least 3 enterprise SAP implementations. Handson experience designing, configuring, and operating modern ALM toolsets in SAP landscapes, with recent practical experience using SAP Cloud ALM in a Public Cloud implementation. Proven ability to apply ALM practices across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. Experience leading the ALM workstream on SAP programmes, with a proven ability to define and enforce ALM governance including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and reporting Proficiency in performance monitoring, tuning, and Basis-level tasks. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting other. Nice to Have Handson experience with Codebeamer, Windchill RV&S, or similar enterprise ALM platforms. Experience managing coexistence or transition between Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM. Experience integrating ALM with CI/CD or DevOps pipelines. Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Day-To-Day: SAP Cloud ALM workstream leadership and planning Configure and run SAP Cloud ALM for requirements, testing, defects, releases, and operations readiness. Support consulting and implementation projects for Application Lifecycle Management (ALM). Support the definition of client specific solution architectures for ALM & PLM; with focus on Application Architecture or Technical Architecture as required. Analyse requirements, design solutions, and successfully implement solutions with the help of cross-functional teams. Ensure quality through appropriate methods and software engineering processes. Roles & Responsibilities Develop organisational strategies, runbooks and roadmaps for SAP Cloud ALM. Establish SAP Cloud ALM governance: templates, standards, naming conventions, traceability rules, release gates, and quality KPIs. Configure SAP Cloud ALM scenarios based on client requirements and following SAP best practices. Drive and deliver system upgrades, performance tuning, and test automation. Provide technical support for ALM-related issues to implementation teams and clients. Engage with internal and client stakeholders around Cloud ALM processes, including workshops and advisory/SME sessions. Stay current with the latest SAP ALM tools and best practices and delivery though-leadership pieces, like blogs, whitepaper etc.

Key Skills: SAP Cloud ALM,SAP Solution Manager,SAP implementations,Application Lifecycle Management,SAP S/4HANA,Application Architecture,SAP landscapes,ALM practices

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the worlds toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. DESCRIPTION Position Summary: The Senior Electrical Engineering Manager will provide technical and people leadership for the PCBA Center of Excellence in Hyderabad. This role requires strong hands-on experience in electrical and PCBA product development, ideally in complex or regulated products such as scientific instruments, diagnostics, or medical devices. The Senior Manager will lead the technical evaluation and implementation of design improvements, cost-optimization opportunities, and product lifecycle changes while ensuring that performance, quality, reliability, compliance, and manufacturability requirements are met. The role will also strengthen the CoEs technical capabilities, engineering governance, and ability to partner effectively with R&D, site engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. What you will do: Technical Leadership Provide technical leadership and deep expertise in electrical and embedded systems design, including power electronics, motor control, precision analog, RF, and embedded systems, to review, challenge, and validate PCBA design and VAVE opportunities. Review and guide system- and board-level architectures, design changes, and component selection. Apply end-to-end electrical and PCBA product-development experience to assess product architecture, technical risk, design changes, and verification and validation requirements. Lead technical trade-off analyses across performance, cost, risk, reliability, and manufacturability. Partner with R&D and site engineering teams to convert technical concepts into robust, validated, and executable design solutions. Ensure disciplined engineering practices, including simulation, analysis, structured design reviews, and appropriate technical documentation. Value Engineering and Cost Productivity Lead the identification, evaluation, and execution of PCBA value-engineering opportunities. Build and manage a pipeline of cost and design-improvement initiatives across sites and suppliers. Review and challenge internal and external proposals to ensure technical and business viability. Drive alternate-component and alternate-design assessments for cost reduction, supply continuity, and lifecycle improvement. Ensure VAVE opportunities are supported by appropriate technical analysis, risk assessment, verification, validation, and implementation planning. Ensure that proposed changes meet performance, quality, regulatory, reliability, and manufacturability requirements. Governance and Operational Excellence Establish technical governance, standardized workflows, review criteria, decision points, ownership, and documentation requirements for evaluating, approving, validating, and implementing PCBA design and VAVE opportunities. Improve productivity and execution by clarifying expectations, reducing rework, and driving consistent engineering practices across the CoE. Cross-Functional Collaboration Act as a key interface among the PCBA CoE, R&D, site engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. Align stakeholders on product architecture, technical requirements, risks, validation needs, and implementation plans. Influence technical and business decisions within a global matrix environment. Support regional manufacturing and value-engineering programs. People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop engineering team members. Build technical capability within the CoE through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and structured technical development. Upskill the team in electrical and PCBA product development, technical risk assessment, validation planning, and VAVE execution. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical rigor, and continuous improvement. Support succession planning, talent development, and organizational capability building. Benefits: Thermo Fisher Scientific offers competitive remuneration, an annual incentive plan, healthcare benefits, and a broad range of employee benefits. Employees have access to meaningful career and development opportunities within an innovative, forward-looking organization. Our culture is built on our values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement. REQUIREMENTS How you will get here: Minimum Qualifications Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. 15 or more years of relevant experience in electrical, electronics, embedded systems, PCBA, or complex product development. Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams in a global, cross-functional environment. Strong technical background in electrical hardware design, product development, testing, and validation. Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Masters degree in a related engineering discipline. Experience in scientific instrumentation, diagnostics, medical devices, or other regulated products. Knowledge of PCBA VAVE, DFx, EMC/EMI, electrical safety, and product-certification requirements. Experience working with global manufacturing sites, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
