title: Company Secretary
description:
Company Secretary Experience: 8-12 Years 
 Salary: 12-15 LPA 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Location: Kolkata 
 Department: Legal & Secretarial / Corporate Governance Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and qualified Company Secretary with 8-12 years of relevant experience in corporate secretarial functions, statutory compliance, and corporate governance. The ideal candidate must have actual hands-on experience in planning, coordinating, conducting, and documenting statutory and corporate meetings , rather than only providing administrative support. The candidate should have strong knowledge of the Companies Act, SEBI regulations (where applicable), MCA compliances, corporate governance, and statutory filings. Key Responsibilities 1. Corporate Secretarial & Compliance Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 , applicable rules, regulations, and secretarial standards. Handle end-to-end corporate secretarial activities and statutory compliances. Prepare and maintain statutory registers, records, minutes, resolutions, notices, and other corporate documents. Manage and coordinate filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Monitor statutory compliance calendars and ensure timely completion of all filings and disclosures. 2. Board & Statutory Meetings - Mandatory Plan, coordinate, and conduct actual Board Meetings, Annual General Meetings (AGMs), Extraordinary General Meetings (EGMs), and other statutory/corporate meetings. Prepare meeting notices, agendas, explanatory statements, resolutions, and supporting documents. Coordinate with Directors, senior management, auditors, legal advisors, and other stakeholders for meetings. Ensure proper compliance with notice periods, quorum requirements, agenda items, voting procedures, and applicable statutory requirements. Attend meetings and independently handle the complete meeting process from preparation through closure . Prepare and finalize accurate minutes of Board and General Meetings. Track and ensure implementation of decisions/resolutions passed during meetings. 3. MCA & Regulatory Compliance Handle applicable MCA/ROC filings , including annual returns, financial statement filings, director-related filings, and event-based compliances. Maintain updated knowledge of changes in corporate laws, regulations, and compliance requirements. Ensure timely submission of statutory returns, forms, disclosures, and other regulatory documents. Coordinate with external professionals and regulatory authorities whenever required. 4. Corporate Governance Advise the management and Board on corporate governance and secretarial compliance matters. Ensure adherence to Secretarial Standards (SS-1 and SS-2) and applicable corporate governance requirements. Support the Board and management in implementing legally compliant corporate processes. Identify potential compliance gaps and recommend corrective/preventive actions. 5. Statutory Records & Documentation Maintain statutory registers and corporate records in accordance with applicable laws. Maintain proper documentation of resolutions, minutes, notices, disclosures, and regulatory filings. Ensure all corporate records are accurate, updated, confidential, and readily available for audits/inspections. 6. Stakeholder & Advisory Responsibilities Coordinate with Directors, senior management, auditors, legal counsel, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Provide timely advice on corporate secretarial and compliance matters. Assist in due diligence, corporate restructuring, changes in shareholding/directorship, and other corporate actions when required. Required Qualifications Qualified Company Secretary (CS) from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). Bachelor s degree in Commerce, Law, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. 8-12 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Company Secretarial / Corporate Compliance functions. Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013 , MCA/ROC compliance, Secretarial Standards, and corporate governance. Experience in handling actual Board Meetings, AGM, EGM, and other statutory meetings is mandatory . Key Skills Corporate Secretarial & Statutory Compliance Board Meeting & General Meeting Management Companies Act, 2013 & MCA/ROC Compliance Corporate Governance & Secretarial Standards Minutes, Resolutions & Statutory Documentation Regulatory Filing & Compliance Management Preferred Candidate Profile Strong hands-on experience rather than purely documentation-based exposure. Demonstrated experience in independently managing end-to-end Board/General Meetings . Strong drafting and documentation skills. Excellent understanding of corporate laws and regulatory requirements. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple statutory deadlines. Ability to work independently and advise senior management on compliance matters.

description:
About the Role We are looking for a highly organized, professional, and customer-focused Front Office Executive cum Admin Coordinator & Travel Desk to manage the front office operations while supporting day-to-day administrative activities and employee travel requirements. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for visitors, employees, and external stakeholders. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong coordination abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Front Office & Reception Management Manage the front desk and ensure a professional and welcoming experience for all visitors and employees. Greet visitors, candidates, clients, and other stakeholders and direct them to the appropriate person or department. Handle incoming calls, emails, and general enquiries professionally. Maintain visitor records and ensure adherence to company security and visitor management procedures. Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure meeting rooms are well maintained and ready for use. Manage incoming and outgoing couriers, parcels, and official correspondence. Maintain the reception and front office area in a professional and presentable manner. Support employee and candidate coordination whenever required. 
 2. Administration Coordination Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities across the office. Work closely with internal teams and external vendors for various administrative requirements. Coordinate with vendors for office supplies, housekeeping, security, maintenance, transport, and other facility-related services. Maintain records of office assets, consumables, and administrative inventory. Ensure timely availability of office stationery and other required supplies. Support invoice collection, vendor documentation, and coordination with the Finance team for payments. Track and follow up on administrative requests and ensure timely resolution. Assist in organizing internal meetings, employee engagement activities, and company events. Support onboarding arrangements for new employees, including workstation and administrative requirements. Maintain relevant administrative reports, trackers, and documentation. 
 3. Travel Desk Management Manage end-to-end travel arrangements for employees and business visitors. Coordinate domestic and international travel requirements, including: Flight bookings Hotel reservations Airport transfers Local transportation Other travel-related arrangements Coordinate with approved travel agencies and vendors. Ensure travel bookings are made in line with company policies and approved budgets. Maintain proper travel records, booking confirmations, and expense-related documentation. Handle travel changes, cancellations, and emergency travel requirements efficiently. Coordinate travel itineraries and share complete travel details with employees. Maintain a travel tracker and prepare periodic reports on travel requirements and expenses. Ensure smooth coordination between employees, travel vendors, Finance, and Administration teams. 
 4. Vendor & Facility Coordination Act as a point of contact for administrative and facility-related vendors. Coordinate with vendors for timely delivery of services. Maintain vendor contact details, agreements, and service-related documentation. Follow up on maintenance issues and ensure timely resolution. Assist in monitoring service quality and escalating concerns when required. Support cost optimization initiatives related to administration and travel. 
 Skills & Competencies Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Professional personality and presentation. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. Good coordination and follow-up skills. Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook . Experience in travel coordination and vendor management will be an advantage. 
 Experience Required 14 years of relevant experience in: Front Office / Reception Administration Coordination Travel Desk Executive Assistance or Office Coordination Candidates with experience in a corporate environment will be preferred. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is: Professional and presentable. Highly organized and proactive. Comfortable interacting with employees, senior management, clients, and visitors. Able to manage front office responsibilities along with administrative coordination. Experienced in handling travel bookings and vendor coordination. Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks simultaneously. 
 Why Join Us? This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure across Front Office Operations, Administration, Vendor Management, Employee Coordination, and Corporate Travel Management while working in a dynamic and growing organization. Join us and become an important part of creating a smooth, professional, and welcoming workplace experience for everyone.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview 
 As a Principal Software Engineer for the Fluence OS platform, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, development, integration, deployment and evolution of reliable edge-platform software used in industrial energy systems. You will combine deep Linux and container expertise with strong C/C++ engineering and practical knowledge of Industrial IoT communication protocols. The role is expected to solve complex cross-component problems, establish engineering direction and raise the technical capability of teams working across a globally distributed organization. 
 What You Will Do 
 Technical ownership and architecture: Own the technical design and evolution of major Fluence OS platform capabilities. Translate product and system requirements into scalable, maintainable software architecture and clear implementation plans. Hands-on platform engineering: Design, develop, integrate and troubleshoot production-grade software running on Ubuntu Linux, with a strong focus on C/C++, system services, resource efficiency, reliability and long-term maintainability. Containerized application delivery: Define and implement Docker-based packaging and runtime practices, including Dockerfiles, image construction, Docker Compose configurations, upgrades, observability and troubleshooting across deployed environments. Industrial communication: Lead the design and implementation of robust integrations using protocols such as MQTT, Modbus, BACnet and OPC UA. Address interoperability, data quality, performance, fault handling and recovery across heterogeneous industrial devices and systems. Gateway and industrial edge development: Design and develop software gateways and edge services that connect industrial devices, normalize and route data, perform protocol conversion, and operate reliably on embedded and industrial computing platforms. System integration and reliability: Diagnose complex issues spanning applications, operating systems, containers, networks, protocols and third-party open-source components. Drive root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions rather than short-term fixes. Engineering excellence: Set standards for code quality, code reviews, automated testing, secure development, performance analysis, observability, release readiness and technical documentation. CI/CD and automation: Guide improvements to build, test, package and deployment pipelines. Use scripting and automation to improve repeatability, traceability and engineering productivity. Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, challenge assumptions constructively, make well-reasoned technical decisions and mentor engineers. Provide clear direction while remaining deeply involved in implementation and problem solving. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with product managers, architects, subject-matter experts, quality teams, site teams and other engineering groups to deliver platform outcomes in an agile, globally distributed environment. Documentation and knowledge sharing: Create architecture decisions, interface specifications, development standards, troubleshooting guidance and customer-facing technical documentation that are precise and usable. 
 Required Qualifications 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant ownership of complex production software or platform components. Deep hands-on expertise with Ubuntu Linux, including services, processes, filesystems, permissions, package management, logging, networking and performance troubleshooting. Strong hands-on C/C++ programming skills, with experience designing, debugging and maintaining production-grade software. Advanced practical experience with Docker containers, including Dockerfiles, image creation, Docker Compose, networking, storage, upgrades and runtime troubleshooting. Strong working knowledge of Industrial IoT and industrial communication protocols, including several of MQTT, Modbus TCP/RTU, BACnet and OPC UA. Experience integrating software with industrial devices, gateways, controllers or other edge systems, with an understanding of unreliable networks and distributed-system failure modes. Experience with software architecture, interface design, design patterns, multithreading/concurrency, memory and resource management, and performance optimization. Experience with source control, code review, build systems, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Demonstrated ability to lead technical investigations, make architecture decisions and guide delivery across multiple engineers or teams. Excellent English communication skills, including concise technical writing and the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Hands-on experience developing industrial gateways, protocol converters or edge communication services that bridge field devices and higher-level platform applications. Experience developing, integrating and troubleshooting software on embedded Linux and industrial computing devices, including Advantech or comparable industrial PCs, controllers and gateways. Understanding of hardware-constrained and field-deployed environments, including device interfaces, serial and Ethernet communication, resource limitations, remote diagnostics and operational reliability. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Python and Bash scripting for automation, tooling, testing and diagnostics. Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for C/C++ and containerized applications. Knowledge of IP networking, routing, DNS, TLS, certificates, firewalls and troubleshooting of field-network communication. Experience with observability and open-source platform components such as Grafana, time-series data systems, message brokers or monitoring tools. Experience with test automation, protocol simulators, hardware-in-the-loop testing or integration laboratories. Experience with cloud or hybrid edge environments, including AWS services such as EC2. Familiarity with Node.js/TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL or related platform technologies. Experience in energy storage, SCADA, industrial automation, controls or another operational-technology domain. Familiarity with common embedded and industrial interfaces such as RS-232/RS-485, CAN, GPIO or other device-level communication interfaces. 
 Leadership Expectations 
 Operate as a senior technical authority who remains hands-on and accountable for engineering outcomes. Create clarity in ambiguous problem spaces and balance immediate delivery needs with platform sustainability. Mentor engineers through design feedback, code reviews, debugging support and practical knowledge sharing. Influence architecture and engineering practices across team boundaries through facts, prototypes and clear trade-off analysis. Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement. 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 12 years of related experience, or a Master's degree and 8 years of related experience, or a PhD and 5 years, or the equivalent

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
SUMMARY 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a technically strong Senior Technical Project Manager to drive delivery of complex, technology-heavy projects for our retail-focused client portfolio. This role is weighted toward technical ownership and hands-on execution the ideal candidate is someone who can dig into code, architecture, and infrastructure decisions directly, not just track status. Deep working knowledge of Python, .NET, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) is essential, along with practical experience implementing modern deployment strategies (CI/CD, blue-green, canary releases) and a solid understanding of retail industry systems such as omnichannel commerce, POS, supply chain, and customer engagement platforms. 
 The Senior Technical Project Manager will be hands-on in reviewing architecture and code-level decisions, troubleshooting technical blockers, validating deployment pipelines, and ensuring solutions are technically sound using project management skills as a means to keep technical delivery on track, rather than as the core focus of the role. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the technical delivery of projects end-to-end from solution design review through deployment for retail client engagements. 
 Get hands-on with Python and .NET codebases where needed: reviewing code quality, debugging issues, validating designs, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. 
 Evaluate and make recommendations on cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP compute, storage, networking, managed services, and cost optimization. 
 Design, implement, and troubleshoot deployment strategies and pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), blue-green/canary releases, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM). 
 Perform technical risk assessments and gap analyses on architecture, integrations, and non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, security). 
 Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs. 
 Set up and maintain project-level technical tracking (sprint boards, technical backlogs) using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with a focus on technical accuracy over administrative reporting.

Strong communication and coordination skills. title: Senior Civil Engineer
description:
Only Male Candidates from Pune, PCMC will be considered. Apllicants other than Pune (out of Pune city) will not be considered. 
 
 Position Senior Civil Engineer Department Projects / Construction Reporting To Site In-Charge / Project Manager Location PCMC & Nearby Areas, Pune Employment Type Full-Time 


 Preferred candidate locations - Ravet/Pimple Gurav/Bhosari/Chakan/Punawale/Moshi/Alandi/Charholi/PCMC and nearby areas only. 
 1. Job Purpose The Senior Civil Engineer will be responsible for assisting in the planning, execution, supervision, and monitoring of civil construction activities at project sites. The role requires strong knowledge of civil engineering principles, practical site execution skills, quality awareness, and the ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and internal teams. 
 The candidate will ensure that construction work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, project schedules, and company requirements. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Site Supervision & Execution Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at the assigned project site. Monitor construction activities including excavation, PCC, RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, tiling, painting, and other finishing works. Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and instructions from senior engineers. Check the availability and proper utilization of manpower, materials, tools, machinery, and equipment. Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors to ensure timely completion of assigned activities. Monitor the progress of work and report delays, site issues, and constraints to the reporting manager. Ensure proper sequencing of construction activities to avoid unnecessary delays and rework. B. Drawing & Technical Understanding Read and understand structural, architectural, civil, and service-related drawings. Verify dimensions, levels, alignments, locations, and other details before execution. Coordinate with senior engineers and consultants in case of discrepancies or missing information in drawings. Ensure that construction is carried out according to the latest approved drawings. Maintain proper records of drawings, revisions, instructions, and site-related documents. Assist in preparing basic quantity calculations and measurements from drawings. C. Quality Control Ensure that construction work complies with approved specifications and required quality standards. Check reinforcement, shuttering, concrete, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing work before proceeding to the next stage. Assist in checking the quality of incoming construction materials. Coordinate with the quality-control team for inspections and testing. Ensure proper curing of concrete and masonry work. Identify defective or substandard work and immediately report it to the concerned senior. Monitor rectification and ensure that rejected or defective work is corrected properly. Minimize material wastage and prevent unnecessary rework. D. Quantity & Measurement Assist in taking measurements of completed work executed by contractors. Prepare and maintain measurement records for civil works. Assist in checking contractor bills against actual site measurements. Verify quantities of materials consumed at the site. Assist in preparing basic BOQ quantities and material requirements. Maintain records of concrete, steel, cement, sand, blocks, tiles, and other construction materials. Monitor material consumption against approved quantities and identify unusual wastage. E. Material Management Coordinate with the stores and purchase departments regarding material requirements. Check materials received at site for quantity and basic quality requirements. Ensure materials are used appropriately and wastage is controlled. Inform the senior engineer about upcoming material requirements to avoid work stoppage. F. Contractor & Labour Coordination Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, supervisors, and skilled/unskilled workers. Allocate daily work activities as instructed by senior engineers. Monitor labour productivity and work progress. Maintain discipline and proper coordination among site workers. Report manpower shortages and productivity issues to the reporting manager. Ensure workers understand the required quality and execution standards. Coordinate with contractors for timely completion of assigned targets. 
 G. Safety Compliance Follow and promote all safety rules and procedures at the construction site. Ensure workers use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Immediately report unsafe working conditions, accidents, near misses, and hazards. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe movement of workers and materials. Coordinate with the safety team to address site safety observations. Never compromise safety for speed or project deadlines. H. Daily Reporting & Documentation Prepare daily progress reports as required by the reporting manager. Record manpower deployment, material consumption, work progress, and major site activities. Maintain site photographs and progress documentation. Report any technical, manpower, material, quality, or coordination issues promptly. Maintain proper records of inspections, measurements, checklists, and site instructions. Assist senior engineers in preparing weekly and monthly project progress reports. 3. Coordination Responsibilities The Senior Civil Engineer will regularly coordinate with: Senior Civil Engineers Site In-Charge / Project Manager Architects Structural Consultants MEP Teams Quality Control Team Safety Team Purchase Department Stores Department Contractors & Subcontractors Vendors and Suppliers The candidate must maintain professional communication and ensure that instructions received from senior management are properly implemented at site. 
 4. Required Qualifications Education: B.E. / B.Tech./Diploma in Civil Engineering. Candidates with relevant site experience will be preferred. 
 Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience in residential and commercial construction is preferred. 5. Required Technical Skills The candidate should have knowledge of: Civil construction practices RCC and structural work Reinforcement and shuttering Masonry and plastering Waterproofing Flooring and finishing works Quantity estimation and measurement Reading architectural and structural drawings Basic knowledge of AutoCAD MS Excel and MS Office Basic understanding of construction materials Quality control procedures Site safety practices
 
 6. Key Skills & Competencies Strong site supervision skills Good communication and coordination abilities Basic technical and problem-solving skills Ability to read and understand drawings Good numerical and measurement skills Attention to detail Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously Teamwork and coordination Time management Willingness to work at construction sites Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Timely completion of assigned work Quality of executed work Reduction in rework and material wastage Accuracy of measurements and documentation Contractor and labour coordination Compliance with drawings and specifications Safety compliance Daily/weekly reporting accuracy Productivity and utilization of resources Adherence to project schedules 8. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a technically sound, hardworking, responsible, and career-oriented Civil Engineer who is willing to work at construction sites and learn practical aspects of project execution. The candidate must have a hands-on approach, good observation skills, and the ability to identify site-level problems and escalate them appropriately. Strong discipline, punctuality, professional conduct, and willingness to take responsibility will be highly valued. 9. Working Conditions The position is primarily site-based. The candidate may be required to travel to project locations within PCMC and nearby areas. The role involves regular interaction with contractors, labourers, vendors, consultants, and project teams. Working hours may vary depending on project requirements and critical construction activities. 10. Overall Responsibility The Senior Civil Engineer will play an important role in ensuring that assigned construction activities are completed on time, within required quality standards, with minimum wastage, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety requirements, and company policies. The position offers an opportunity to develop strong practical knowledge in construction execution, project coordination, quantity management, quality control, and overall site management while working under experienced senior engineering and project-management professionals .

Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, frameworks, and tooling that can be adopted across teams. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities and enable AI agents to independently execute well-defined engineering workflows. Establish reusable patterns for AI reliability, security, observability, evaluation, scalability, latency, and cost management. Partner with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve product capabilities or engineering workflows. Lead initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, and technical dependencies. Consistently deliver deadline-sensitive work that is interdependent with other engineering teams. Communicate complex engineering and architectural concepts clearly and concisely to engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and demonstrated outcomes. Continuous Improvement & Engineering Excellence Challenge the status quo and continuously improve the platform, architecture, processes, and engineering practices. title: Lead Engineer - Backend (Data Platform)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Backend / Data Platform to provide technical leadership for backend and data-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify AB Tasty. This is a hands-on technical leadership role , not an engineering management position. You will continue to design systems and write production code , while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams. You will work across Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP , solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low-latency serving, and reporting. A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers. 
The Engineering Landscape Our production data platform includes: ClickHouse - self-hosted and ClickHouse Cloud for high-volume analytics and SaaS reporting BigQuery - large-scale analytics and data processing Bigtable - low-latency NoSQL serving Redis - caching, queues, and distributed coordination Kafka - high-volume real-time event streaming GCP - GCS, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, IAM, Secret Manager, GKE and VMs Java - Spring Boot and JVM-based backend services Apache Beam / Dataflow - distributed event and batch processing Go - adjacent SQL and reporting services Alongside the existing platform, we are building capabilities around: Warehouse-native experiment computation in customer Snowflake/BigQuery environments Cross-platform visitor profiles and identity First-party cohorts and saved audiences Unified metrics across internal and customer warehouses Converging Wingify and AB Tasty analytics onto a common data foundation 
What Youll Do Architecture System Design Own the technical architecture and design of significant backend/data-platform workstreams. Design distributed systems for high-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low-latency serving . Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost . Evaluate trade-offs across ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and other technologies based on workload characteristics. Drive designs that can evolve as the Wingify and AB Tasty platforms converge. Hands-on Engineering Remain hands-on with Java and production backend code . Build and evolve backend services, query engines, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems. Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks. Solve difficult production problems involving slow queries, data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure . Work with Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, GCS, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, and Redis at production scale. Own critical systems through design, implementation, deployment, observability, and operation . Technical Leadership Set technical direction for a platform area or major engineering workstream . Break ambiguous product and platform requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans. Review architecture and designs from other engineers and challenge assumptions constructively. Establish engineering practices around reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and maintainability . Mentor SSE-1/SSE-2 engineers and help them grow their system-design and production-engineering capabilities. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams. Influence architecture beyond your immediate projects without requiring formal people-management authority. 
What Were Looking For 6+ years of hands-on backend/software engineering experience , with substantial experience building distributed or data-intensive systems. Demonstrated ownership of architecture and system design for production systems at meaningful scale. Strong hands-on Java experience, including modern Java and JVM backend systems. Strong experience designing systems around analytical databases, data warehouses, and/or large-scale non-relational stores . Deep understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, query execution, caching, concurrency, and performance optimisation . Strong SQL and analytical-querying experience. Experience designing and operating streaming/event-driven architectures , ideally using Kafka or equivalent technologies. Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale. Strong cloud engineering experience; GCP is preferred. Experience operating production systems with clear SLOs, observability, failure handling, and performance requirements . Strong debugging ability across applications, distributed systems, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure. Experience mentoring senior engineers, reviewing technical designs, and influencing architecture . Ability to balance long-term platform architecture with pragmatic delivery. 
Nice to Have Deep production experience with ClickHouse , including schema design, MergeTree engines, partitioning, sorting keys, query optimisation, replication, and performance tuning. BigQuery and Bigtable at significant production scale. Apache Beam / Dataflow . Snowflake or warehouse-native compute architectures. Go , Vert.x, or other high-performance backend technologies. Experience handling billions of events and/or TB-PB scale analytical datasets . Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity resolution, cohorts, or behavioural analytics. Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring.

title: Senior Manager – Founder’s Office (HR)
description:
**About Ditto** 




 Ditto’s mission is to help people make well\-informed insurance decisions — from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry\-first “No\-spam” policy, and over the past three years, we’ve assisted over 700,000 users with personalised advice on health and term insurance. We carry a 4\.9 rating with 14,000\+ reviews on Google.
 



 Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K\+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We won LinkedIn’s Top Startup award in both 2022 and 2023\.
 



  





**The Context** 




 In 2024, Ditto was a team of 350\. By 2025, we were 700\. Today, we’re at 1,400 — and we’ll cross 2,000 by the start of 2027\.
 



 Ditto is a service company. Our people are our product — the quality of advice we give customers is only as good as the people giving it. How well we hire, how well we retain good talent, and how well we develop them directly determines how well the company grows. At our scale, getting this wrong isn’t a minor inefficiency — it’s an existential risk.
 



 Growth at this pace breaks things. Hiring processes that worked at 350 don’t hold at 1,400\. Retention strategies that were informal now need structure. Performance systems that were manager\-dependent now need to be organisation\-wide. This role exists to fix what’s breaking and to build what doesn’t exist yet.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will report to the HR Lead and work closely with the co\-founders on two critical problem areas. Depending on your experience and expertise, you’ll own one of these:
 



  





**Problem Area 1: Hiring at Speed Without Dropping the Bar** 




 We need to close roles faster while ensuring quality doesn’t slip. This means:
 


* Redesigning hiring workflows to reduce time\-to\-close across roles
* Building reliable, sustainable sourcing channels that don’t depend on a single pipeline
* Identifying bottlenecks in the current process and implementing fixes that hold at scale



  





**Problem Area 2: Talent Management \& Retention for a 2,500\-Person Organisation** 




 Our current people systems were built for a much smaller team. This means:
 


* Revamping talent management frameworks — performance cycles, career progression, development paths
* Rethinking employee retention policies so they work at 2,500 people, not just 700
* Ensuring our systems are robust enough to run smoothly as the organisation continues to scale



  





**How This Role Evolves** 




 The first six months will be about understanding how our current systems operate, identifying what needs to change, and designing better ones — but not just on paper. We expect you to start executing early. You’ll work closely with the co\-founders and HR team to get the foundations right, but you’ll also be measured on what you ship, not just what you propose.
 



 After six months, based on how things shape up, this role could go one of two ways: you take ownership of the entire function you’ve built, or you move to the next 0\-to\-1 problem. The same applies to team structure — whether this becomes a team\-lead role or stays as a high\-impact IC will depend on the work and your trajectory.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4\+ years of experience in HR business partnering, people operations, org consulting, or a generalist Founder’s Office role with strong HR exposure
* Experience in a startup that went through a significant scaling phase, or at an established company with a large, complex team — you’ve seen what happens when organisations grow fast
* Deep understanding of HR systems and people processes — not just theory, but how things actually work on the ground
* Strong analytical ability with comfort working with people data and dashboards
* Clear, structured communicator who can influence both leadership and cross\-functional teams
* High ownership mindset — you operate independently and drive outcomes without waiting for direction
* Ability to build relationships, earn trust quickly, and navigate ambiguity with confidence



  





**A note on what this role is not:** 
 We’re not looking for someone who advises from the sidelines. This role requires you to get your hands dirty — to design systems, yes, but also to execute projects on your own when needed. If you’re looking for a pure advisory or consulting role, this isn’t the right fit.
 



  





**Why Join Ditto** 



* Work on high\-priority problems with direct business impact — not maintenance work
* A front\-row seat to how a fast\-growing startup scales its people function
* Exposure to multiple verticals and a real path to leadership roles
* Direct access to co\-founders and the opportunity to shape how the organisation operates



  





**Perks** 



* Comprehensive health and term insurance
* ESOPs
* Compensation as per industry standards



  





**Our Interview Process** 




 We respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 2 weeks.
 


1. Introductory call with HR
2. Task submission
3. Task presentation \+ Managerial round
4. Founders round



  





**This is an in\-office role (with flexibility for remote working). Our address is:** 
 Fortuna\-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd Phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore, Bangalore South – 560078, Karnataka, India.
 



  





***Please Note:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees for the hiring process. We’ve seen fraudulent hiring messages impersonating Ditto. Please verify any communication through our official channels.*

title: Senior Cyber Security IAM Analyst
description:
At OneAdvanced, we develop and host multiple software products and manage a large technical infrastructure spanning Public Cloud, Private Cloud, and on\-premise data centres. We are building an AI\-first business, and we invest heavily in security and engineering to build, run, and protect our products and customer data with confidence.
 



  





 This role sits within our Identity and Access Management (IAM) function and reports to the Director of IAM. It is central to a major investment for us: the design, build, and deployment of our next\-generation Privileged Access Management (PAM) capability. Working closely with technical stakeholders across the CTO organisation, you will help select and implement a new PAM tool and the processes and controls that surround it — including how we secure privileged access for the non\-human and agentic AI identities that increasingly run in our environment. As the capability matures, you will grow into the subject\-matter expert who supports and governs privileged access across the company.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Privileged Access Management (primary focus) :** 



* Help design, build out, and deploy our next\-generation PAM capability, from tool selection through to production rollout.
* Partner with technical stakeholders across the CTO organisation to implement the new PAM tool and the supporting processes, standards, and controls.
* Extend privileged access controls to non\-human and agentic AI identities, securing the credentials, secrets, and just\-in\-time access these workloads depend on.
* Execute and progressively automate core PAM operations, including credential rotation, privileged session monitoring, and vault hygiene.
* Grow into the subject\-matter expert for PAM, helping to govern privileged access policy and standards and advising teams across the business.








  





**Identity and Access Management Operations :** 



* Implement and manage identity and access control systems across key strategic platforms, including Active Directory, LDAP, and Entra.
* Manage user accounts, groups, and permissions across the IAM system.
* Grant or deny day\-to\-day access requests based on user role and privilege, ensuring the right people have access to the right resources.
* Work with internal customers, business analysts, and application teams to understand and implement access requirements.
* Configure and enforce access policies and procedures.
* Monitor user activity across the IAM system and investigate anomalies.
* Collaborate with internal teams to deliver access control initiatives aligned with corporate security policy and compliance standards.
* Troubleshoot IAM\-related issues and design effective solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on IAM tools, technologies, and best practice.
* Integrate IAM solutions seamlessly into the broader IT infrastructure.
* Support the operational lifecycle of non\-human and agentic identities, including authentication, authorisation, monitoring, and de\-provisioning.
* Support evaluation and adoption of IAM tooling and automation to reduce manual administration.
* Support IAM risk and control activities, including evidence gathering for internal and external audits (e.g. ISO 27001\).
* Document IAM processes and procedures.








  





**Identity Governance and Administration Support :** 



* Run access certification campaigns, process joiner\-mover\-leaver requests, and remediate dormant or orphaned accounts.
* Maintain the entitlement catalogue and flag gaps or anomalies to IAM leadership .



  





**Reporting and Continuous Improvement :** 



* Develop, monitor, and report on IAM, PAM, and IGA metrics and KPIs, and prepare clear, concise status reports for management.
* Deliver IAM training and awareness sessions for technical and non\-technical staff.
* Track emerging IAM tools and industry developments and raise relevant options with IAM leadership.
* Support identity\-related projects end\-to\-end, working alongside the Director of IAM on strategic delivery.



  





**Required Experience and Qualifications :** 



* Minimum 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Identity and Access Management, with strong, demonstrable Privileged Access Management (PAM) experience at its core.
* Deep, hands\-on Privileged Access Management experience is essential — including vault administration, credential rotation, and privileged session management — ideally gained in modern cloud and agentic AI environments.
* Experience implementing or building out a PAM capability (tool selection, deployment, and process design) is highly advantageous, as is practical exposure to Identity Governance and Administration operations such as access certification campaigns .
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in Windows (Azure, Active Directory) and/or AWS are highly desirable.



  





**Non\-Technical Skills:** 



* Strong understanding and ability to articulate the organisation's IAM strategy.
* Knowledge of IAM tools and the ability to recommend suitable operational approaches.
* Strong understanding of security concepts and how they apply to IAM.
* Excellent organisational skills with attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and project administration abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
* Capability to develop and deliver training to diverse audiences.



  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Experience with directory services such as LDAP, Active Directory, and Entra.
* Knowledge of security protocols including SSH and TLS.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Ruby.
* Hands\-on experience administering PAM tooling (e.g. CyberArk), including vaulting, credential rotation, and session monitoring; familiarity with secrets management for machine, service, and agentic AI identities is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with IGA tooling (e.g. SailPoint), including access certification campaigns and joiner\-mover\-leaver workflows.
* Familiarity with other IAM tools (e.g. Secret Server, Okta, Ping Identity).
* Familiarity with database concepts and relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server.
* Comfortable working across multiple operating systems including Azure, Windows, Unix/Linux.



  





**What We Do For You:** 



* Wellbeing focused – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* Annual Leave – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* Employee Assistance Programme – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7\.
* Personal Growth \- Regardless of where you are at in your career, we’re committed to enabling your growth personally and professionally
* Development Programmes – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
* Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub! \- Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* Life Insurance \- 3x annual salary
* Personal Accident Insurance \- providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* Performance Bonus – Our Group\-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success



  





**Who We Are** 




 At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.
 



 We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.
 



 OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.
 



 Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.
 



 We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.
 



 Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.
 



 Learn more at
 **www.oneadvanced.com**

title: Training Manager - ERS
description:
**Program Training Manager**
**Position Summary**
 The GCC Emergency Roadside Service (ERS) Call Center Program Training Manager is responsible for supporting and enabling growth for Customer Operations primarily related to Roadside Assistance. This role is business facing and will be responsible for designing, delivering and maintaining all training programs that support the performance, quality and readiness of ERS call center agents, shift leads and Supervisory roles. This role oversees onboarding, upskilling, quality assurance alignment, knowledge management, and certification programs to ensure agents can rapidly assess emergencies, prioritize safety, dispatch appropriate services, and deliver an exceptional customer experience under time‑sensitive conditions.
   

  

 The Training Manager partners closely with Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, and Technology teams to ensure staff are equipped with the skills, tools, and information required to meet service‑level expectations (ETAs, speed to dispatch, accuracy, customer reassurance) in a fast\-paced 24/7 environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Training Program Design \& Delivery**
* 
+ Develop, implement, and maintain training curricula for new hires, cross‑training, and ongoing employee development.
+ Deliver training using multiple modalities (live classroom, virtual instructor‑led training, e‑learning modules, simulations, call calibrations, and scenario\-based workshops).
+ Create job aids, scripts, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and workflow documentation tailored to emergency roadside service operations.
+ Conduct skills assessments, certification tests, and post\-training evaluations.


**Quality \& Performance Alignment**
* 
+ Partner with Quality Assurance to identify skill gaps, design corrective coaching programs, and align training to QA scoring criteria.
+ Review call trends, failure modes, dispatch errors, and customer feedback to proactively address recurring issues.
+ Ensure training content reflects current safety protocols, dispatch procedures, system updates, and partner/contractor networks.


**ERS Operational Readiness**
* 
+ Maintain training standards that support critical ERS KPIs such as:
+ Speed to answer
+ Accurate problem identification
+ Safety assessment and risk mitigation
+ Accurate provider selection and dispatch
+ ETA communication and customer reassurance
+ Train agents on emergency protocols, incident escalation pathways, tow and repair partner requirements, and equipment types (e.g., light/medium/heavy\-duty tow, tire service, lockout, fuel, battery).


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* 
+ Lead a team of trainers and instructional designers (if applicable), ensuring consistent delivery and documentation.
+ Work directly with ERS Operations Managers, supervisors, and shift leads to coordinate training schedules and staffing needs.
+ Serve as the subject\-matter expert on call handling protocols, escalation procedures, and customer experience standards.
+ Support onboarding of seasonal or surge staff during high\-volume periods.


**Technology \& Systems Support**
* 
+ Develop training for call center platforms including CRM, dispatch systems, mapping/locator tools, telematics integrations, and AI‑assisted workflows.
+ Partner with IT/Product to validate system changes and update training materials prior to deployment.
+ Manage learning management system (LMS) content, reporting, and compliance tracking.


**Compliance, Safety \& Risk Mitigation**
* 
+ Ensure all training meets industry, legal, and company standards regarding customer safety, privacy, and incident documentation.
+ Reinforce safety\-first protocols for assessing emergency scenarios involving unsafe locations, breakdown hazards, weather conditions, and vehicle risks.
+ Maintain updated training on third‑party service provider safety requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* 
+ 5\+ years of experience in call center training, quality, or operations; 2\+ years in a supervisory or training leadership role.
+ Experience in emergency roadside assistance, automotive services, dispatch, or a related safety‑critical environment.
+ Strong instructional design skills and familiarity with adult learning methodologies.
+ Experience with call center technology platforms (CRM, IVR, ACD, dispatch systems).
+ Excellent communication, coaching, and facilitation skills.
+ Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate data into actionable training strategies.


**Preferred**
* 
+ Prior experience managing high‑volume 24/7 operations.
+ Knowledge of vehicle systems, towing equipment types, and roadside service workflows.
+ LMS administration experience.
+ Certification in training or design (e.g., ATD, CPTM, APTD, or equivalent).
+ Experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).


**Key Competencies**
* 
+ Calm under pressure \& crisis communication skills
+ Operational awareness of ERS workflows
+ Continuous improvement mindset
+ Analytical thinking \& data\-driven decision making
+ Strong coaching \& interpersonal skills
+ Adaptability in dynamic environments
+ Cross\-functional collaboration


**Success Measures**
* 
+ Reduced average handle time (AHT) without sacrificing safety or empathy
+ Improved first\-call resolution and dispatch accuracy
+ Higher QA performance scores across the agent population
+ Reduced onboarding time\-to\-proficiency
+ Improved customer satisfaction (NPS/CSAT) for ERS calls
+ Reduced safety\-related incidents and dispatch errors
+ Effective change adoption during system updates or workflow changes

title: SPE-Policy Servicing
description:
**Job Summary**
 This role focuses on delivering high quality policy servicing support for property and casualty insurance operations in a multinational environment. The specialist will manage policy documentation updates and customer support with strong spoken English and MS Office proficiency working from office in night shifts to ensure seamless service continuity and accurate record maintenance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage end to end policy servicing activities including policy creation endorsement processing and renewal updates to ensure accurate and timely maintenance of insurance records in line with company standards and regulatory requirements.
* Handle customer and internal stakeholder inquiries on policy coverage documentation status and servicing requests by providing clear professional and well structured verbal communication in English that supports high satisfaction and trust.
* Utilize MS Office tools to prepare review and update policy related documents spreadsheets and reports with consistent formatting robust data validation and organized storage that supports efficient operational review.
* Monitor assigned work queues service requests and case tickets during night shifts to ensure that all policy servicing activities are completed within agreed turnaround times while maintaining attention to detail and high accuracy.
* Collaborate with underwriting claims and operations teams by sharing clear policy information and status updates that support effective risk evaluation claim adjudication and workflow coordination across the organization.
* Review source documents emails and system inputs for policy servicing tasks by identifying discrepancies missing information and potential errors and promptly initiating corrective actions to maintain data integrity.
* Document all servicing actions changes and communications in the designated policy administration systems and MS Office trackers to create an auditable trail that supports compliance and performance monitoring.
* Apply foundational knowledge of property and casualty insurance concepts when available to interpret coverage terms limits and conditions so that servicing decisions align with business rules and customer commitments.
* Support continuous improvement of servicing processes by sharing observations from night shift operations suggesting practical enhancements and participating in pilots that aim to reduce rework and improve turnaround time.
* Adhere to company policies information security guidelines and regulatory requirements during all servicing activities to protect customer data uphold ethical standards and mitigate operational risk.
* Coordinate workload and handover notes across shifts through structured MS Office based reports so that colleagues have clear visibility into pending tasks priorities and special handling instructions.
* Provide concise and accurate status updates to supervisors and stakeholders regarding volumes completion rates and policy servicing challenges so that resource planning and decision making are well informed.
* Support training and knowledge sharing within the team by documenting frequently asked questions standard responses and process clarifications in easy to use MS Office formats that help new team members become productive quickly.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong spoken English communication skills that enable clear conversation with stakeholders effective explanation of policy details and confident handling of complex queries during night shifts.
* Show solid proficiency in MS Office applications including word processing spreadsheets and presentations to prepare servicing documents maintain policy logs and compile operational reports with accuracy.
* Bring practical experience of two to six years in policy servicing insurance operations or similar back office environments with focus on data accuracy process adherence and customer oriented outcomes.
* Apply any prior exposure to property and casualty insurance concepts to better understand coverage structures endorsements and renewal practices thereby enhancing the quality and speed of servicing decisions.
* Maintain consistent ability to work from office in night shifts with reliable attendance and disciplined time management that supports service level commitments and global business continuity.
* Exhibit strong analytical and problem solving skills in reviewing policy data identifying servicing issues and recommending clear corrective steps that reduce recurring errors and improve operational reliability.
* Display high standards of professionalism integrity and collaboration when interacting with colleagues and stakeholders contributing to a respectful workplace culture and a dependable service experience for customers.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certifications include insurance or operations credentials such as Certificate in General Insurance or MS Office specialist.

 We are seeking a highly motivated NOC Analyst to join our Network Operations Center team. This role focuses on proactively monitoring, analyzing, and running routine health checks. The ideal candidate will identify potential issues before they impact business operations, perform trend analysis, and collaborate with technical teams to drive preventive actions.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibility**
* Proactively monitor network, server, cloud, and infrastructure health using monitoring tools.
* Identify potential issues, performance degradation, and capacity risks before they impact services.
* Analyze alerts, trends, and recurring incidents to recommend preventive actions.
* Perform initial troubleshooting and coordinate with technical teams for issue resolution.
* Escalate critical incidents and support major outage management activities.
* Monitor service availability and ensure adherence to operational SLAs.
* Generate health, performance, and capacity reports for stakeholders.
* Optimize monitoring thresholds, alerting mechanisms, and operational processes.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Security, and Service Desk teams.
* Maintain accurate documentation, operational procedures, and incident records.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability and performance.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in a NOC, Infrastructure Operations, Managed Services, or IT Operations environment.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, and switching.
* Experience monitoring Windows and Linux server environments.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring tools such as: SolarWinds/PRTG/LogicMonitor
* Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware and Hyper\-V.
* Understanding of cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, ConnectWise, or Jira.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer.  The Field Service Engineer (FSE) will be in charge of delivering excellent service support either on site or via phone, email and remote support to end users and channel partners on our core histology, digital pathology and advanced staining products to our academic research, clinical diagnostic customers in Tamil Nadu. FSE is responsible for installation, maintenance and repair of the system with full technical background of the system, use of proper tools and understanding of the standard process.

* Build strong relationships with laboratory managers, Pathologists, Bio\-medical, hospital stakeholders and gather customer feedback and proactively communicate market insights to management.
* Commercial and Service growth towards achievement of annual service revenue targets.


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Degree in Bio\-medical engineering, Electronics, IT and experience in Clinical diagnostic or Histopathology product supports.
* Good understanding of computer hardware, software, networking, and remote support tools.
* Good command of written and spoken English and a team player with own initiative who focus on problem solving skills


**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements**
* Extensive travel \=/\>50%, Overnight journey within North Region
* Ability to respond to customer service needs on short notice when required.
* Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 120 lb.
* Valid driving license preferred.

Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

title: Senior Purchase Executive
description:
**Role summary :**
 The Direct Material Purchaser is responsible for procuring raw materials, components, and supplies essential for the manufacturing process. This role involves negotiating with suppliers, managing inventory levels, and ensuring the timely delivery of high\-quality materials to support production schedules and meet business objectives.
   

  

**Key responsibilities and activities include, but is not limited to :**
* Should have good hands on sourcing activities , Identify and evaluate potential suppliers for raw materials, components, and supplies.
* Negotiate contracts, terms, and pricing with suppliers to achieve cost savings and favourable terms.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers to ensure reliable supply and resolve any issues that may arise.
* Prepare and process purchase orders for direct materials based on production requirements and inventory levels.
* Monitor order status and ensure timely delivery of materials to meet production schedules.
* Address and resolve any discrepancies or issues with orders, including delays, shortages, and quality concerns.
* Maintain optimal inventory levels to support production needs while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
* Collaborate with production and inventory control teams to forecast material requirements accurately.
* Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies.
* Monitor and analyze market trends, pricing, and availability of direct materials.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives and strategies to optimize procurement spend.
* Track and report on key procurement metrics, including cost savings, supplier performance, and inventory levels.
* Ensure all purchased materials meet required specifications and quality standards.
* Collaborate with the quality control team to address any quality issues with suppliers.
* Conduct supplier audits and assessments to ensure compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, contracts, and supplier agreements.

title: Executive Personal Assistant
description:
Brilo AI builds AI voice agents that answer, qualify and book calls for businesses in the US. Our agents handle thousands of calls a day. We expect the same from ourselves: small team, no headcount for work a machine can do, decisions in hours not weeks.
 



  





 We need an EA who already works this way. Someone whose day already runs on AI tools, and whose default is to get the thing done rather than wait for instructions.
 



  





**The attitude we are hiring for** 



* You take an ambiguous ask and come back with it done, or with a clear "here is where it stands and what I need".
* You do not wait to be chased. You do not let a thread die because the other side went quiet.
* Blocked is not a status you sit in. You find the workaround, then flag it.
* You would rather close ten things today than plan twenty for next week.
* Nothing is beneath you and nothing is above you. Booking a cab and prepping an investor doc get the same care.



  





**Non\-negotiable: you must know how to use AI tools to do this job** 



* You already use AI tools daily, whichever ones work for you. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Grok, Otter or Fireflies for notes, Canva or Gamma for decks, whatever you have found. We care that you use them well, not which logo is on them.
* You know how to prompt properly: give context, give examples, iterate, and get a usable draft on the second try instead of the tenth.
* You use AI across the real work: drafting emails, summarising long threads and documents, researching people and companies before meetings, cleaning up spreadsheets, transcribing and turning notes into follow\-ups, building first\-cut decks.
* You have the judgment to catch when the output is wrong, invented or off\-tone, and you never send an unedited AI draft.
* When a task repeats, you build something so it stops repeating: a saved prompt, a template, an automation.
* You know what should never go into an AI tool. Confidential and personal data stays out.
* You try new tools without being told to. A tool drops on a Tuesday, you can say by Thursday whether it is useful.
* Nice to have: n8n, Linear. We use them, and you will pick them up fast if you have not.



  





**What you will do** 



* Own the founder's calendar across India and US time zones. Nothing double\-booked, focus blocks protected, reshuffles handled before they are asked for.
* Run inbox triage: what matters surfaced, replies drafted in the founder's voice, quiet threads chased.
* Meeting prep in minutes, not hours: agenda, background on the person and company, notes and follow\-ups after.
* Travel end to end, including visas, flights, hotels, itineraries.
* Track every commitment the founder makes and drive it to closed.
* Vendor, invoice and expense follow\-ups with finance and ops.
* Research, decks, spreadsheets and summaries on short notice.
* Personal logistics when they are blocking work.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* Minimum 3 years as an EA, PA or in business support, ideally to a founder or senior leader.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will write and speak as the founder.
* Fast. A same\-day ask gets a same\-day answer, even if the answer is "here is where it stands".
* Genuinely organised. You close loops without being reminded.
* Comfortable with a few evenings a week of US overlap.
* Discreet. You will see confidential information daily.
* Fluent in Google Workspace, Slack and WhatsApp.
* Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate.



  





**Location and working style** 




 Hyderabad. Hybrid: in office when the founder is in town and for anything needing a physical presence, work from home the rest of the week. Not a fully remote role.
 



  





**Why this role** 




 We are a startup, which means the job is bigger than the title. You sit next to the decisions instead of outside them, and you will see an AI company built from the inside: customer calls, hiring, fundraising, product, go to market. You will learn AI tools and workflows most people will not touch for another two years, and you will learn them by using them on real work every day. Take on more and you get more. If you want to grow into operations, business ops or chief of staff, that path is open and short.
 



  





**How to apply: call us, do not email us** 




 We build AI voice agents, so our first round is one. Pick up your phone and dial
 **\+91 8071582828 or 08071582828** 
 .
 



  





 You will have a five minute conversation with Casey, our AI interviewer. It will ask about your experience, how you use AI in your work, and how you handle a messy calendar. Talk to it exactly as you would talk to a person.
 



  




* This call line is open 24x7\. Call from somewhere quiet
* No CV needed to start. Shortlisted candidates get an email the same week asking for one.
* One call per candidate. If it drops, call back and say so.
* If you can figure out how to have a good conversation with an AI agent, you can do this job.

title: Specialist, LCS Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Centre helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Specialist, Software Engineering within the Enterprise IT Legal, Compliance \& Security Value Team, you will support the Compliance Product Line, delivering technology solutions for the Ethics \& Compliance Office (ECO). Working under the guidance of Sr. Software Engineers and the Solution Architect, you will initially focus on the Restricted Party Screening (RPS) program, building and modifying moderately complex integrations within established architectural standards and design patterns. You will participate in design reviews, execute testing and documentation activities, and collaborate with cross\-functional team members to deliver reliable, compliant integration solutions. This role is primarily execution\-focused — you are not expected to own the architecture or serve as the primary technical lead, but rather to develop high\-quality code within defined designs, grow your technical expertise, and progressively take on greater complexity and independence. Over time, this role may expand to support additional programs and products across the broader Compliance Product Line. You should be ready to learn from senior team members, take direction effectively, and demonstrate initiative in building your skills within a compliance\-driven, multi\-system enterprise environment.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Develop, modify, and maintain MuleSoft integrations of moderate complexity between enterprise systems, following established architectural standards, design patterns, and technical guidance from Sr. Software Engineers and the Solution Architect.
* Write clean, well\-documented, and testable Java backend code to support integration logic, data transformations, and system connectivity within the RPS integration landscape.
* Participate in design reviews, contributing input and seeking guidance when deviating from established patterns or encountering unfamiliar technical challenges.
* Execute unit testing, integration testing, and support system testing activities, ensuring code quality, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards.
* Support AWS Aurora RDS database activities under guidance, including executing data modification scripts, assisting with database monitoring, and escalating complex database issues to senior team members.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including code comments, integration specifications, and deployment guides, ensuring all artifacts are current and aligned with team standards.
* Follow DevOps practices (Git, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability) to support build, deployment, and monitoring of integration solutions.
* Assist with incident investigation and resolution, troubleshooting integration issues and escalating complex problems to the Sr. Software Engineer or Solution Architect as appropriate.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional team members — including Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Delivery Managers, the Product Manager, and fellow developers — to ensure integration solutions align with requirements and technical standards.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and providing accurate estimates for assigned work items.
* Learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI/LLM capabilities, under the guidance of senior team members to enhance automation and integration solutions.
* Contribute to broader Compliance Product Line initiatives as the portfolio evolves, applying and developing integration development skills across additional compliance programs and products in partnership with the Ethics \& Compliance Office.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and collaborating with the Product manager. Participate in product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and product goals.


**What Should You Have**
**Primary Skills \- Mulesoft Integration, Java Backend, Devops CI/CD
   

  

 Seccondary Skills \-AI \- LLM**
 Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of enterprise software development experience, with hands\-on experience in MuleSoft integration development and Java backend development.

Civil Maps’ mission is to make it possible for fully autonomous vehicles (SAE Levels 4\-5\) to drive anywhere smoothly and safely. Through artificial intelligence and vehicle\-based local processing, Civil Maps converts sensor data into meaningful map information built specifically to direct fully autonomous vehicles. The company will use the seed investment to accelerate product development and deployment with a number of leading automotive companies and technology partners. Civil Maps’ artificial intelligence software aggregates raw 3D data from LiDAR (high\-resolution laser imaging), camera and other sensors onboard autonomous vehicles and organizes the information into machine\-readable maps.
