description:
🚨
 **We’re Hiring: Manager – Business Control Tower, Fleet Optimization \& EV Energy Analytics** 




**Companies:** 
 Radiance Green Mobility Pvt. Ltd. \& Jyoti Transport \& Freight Services Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai / Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8\+ Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 Engineering / MBA / PGDM / Operations / Analytics background preferred
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Business Head / Founder\-Director
 



 We are looking for a highly analytical and execution\-oriented professional to lead our
 **Business Control Tower, Fleet Optimization and EV Energy Analytics** 
 function.
 



**This is not an MIS reporting role. The person must actively challenge under\-utilisation, identify productivity gaps and work with Operations, Fleet, Maintenance and Site teams to improve business results.** 




 The primary objective is simple:
 



**Maximum Fleet Utilisation \+ Maximum Vehicle Productivity \+ Minimum Idle Time \+ Optimum Fuel/Energy Cost \+ Maximum Contribution per Vehicle** 



 Key Responsibilities
 
 • Take central ownership of
 **fleet utilisation and optimisation** 
 across all projects and locations.
 



 • Monitor deployed, available, idle, breakdown and under\-utilised vehicles daily.
 



 • Ensure every available vehicle is deployed where it can deliver the
 **highest productivity and commercial return** 
 .
 



 • Identify surplus fleet at one project and coordinate redeployment to higher\-demand operations.
 



 • Improve
 **trips per vehicle, kilometres per vehicle, MT/TEU/container productivity and overall asset utilisation** 
 .
 



 • Reduce idle vehicles, empty kilometres, waiting time and unproductive movement.
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks and work directly with Site and Operations teams for corrective action.
 



 • Monitor vehicle\-wise and project\-wise performance through a central Business Control Tower.
 



 • Develop dashboards covering
 **fleet, operations, targets, maintenance, drivers, customer SLA, costs and profitability** 
 .
 



 • Track daily and monthly target vs achievement across all projects.
 



 • Identify vehicles and projects operating below expected productivity.
 



 • Monitor GPS and telematics data including route deviation, excessive idling, stoppages, overspeeding and driver behaviour.
 



 • Analyse vehicle\-wise revenue, operating cost and contribution.
 



 • Support project\-level and customer\-level P\&L analysis.
 



 • Identify low\-margin or loss\-making operations and recommend measurable improvement actions.
 



 • Work closely with Operations, Maintenance and Fleet teams to improve availability and reduce breakdown downtime.
 



 • Support fleet requirement forecasting and future vehicle allocation planning.
 



 • Optimise the mix of
 **owned, leased and subcontracted fleet** 
 based on utilisation and profitability.
 


 EV \& Energy Optimization
 
 • Monitor EV fleet availability, utilisation and productivity.
 



 • Analyse
 **kWh/km, kWh/trip, kWh/MT and kWh/TEU** 
 .
 



 • Monitor charging time, charger utilisation and charging downtime.
 



 • Optimise charging schedules around vehicle operating requirements.
 



 • Reduce vehicle waiting time at charging and battery\-swapping locations.
 



 • Analyse energy consumption by vehicle, route, driver and project.
 



 • Identify abnormal EV energy consumption and drive corrective action.
 



 • Reconcile vehicle energy consumption with charging infrastructure and energy\-provider data.
 



 • Monitor energy cost per km, trip, MT and TEU.
 



 • Compare
 **ICE vs EV operating economics** 
 to determine the most suitable deployment model.

**Fleet Availability \| Fleet Utilisation \| Trips \| Target vs Actual \| Revenue \| Cost \| Margin \| Fuel/Energy \| Maintenance \| Drivers \| Customer SLA \| Key Risks**

**Why is this vehicle idle?** 




**Why are trips below target?** 




**Why is fleet utilisation low?** 




**Why is this vehicle repeatedly breaking down?** 




**Why is this project losing margin?** 




**Why is this EV consuming more energy?** 




**Can this vehicle be moved to a more productive project?** 




**What specific action will improve the result?** 



 Key KPIs
 
 ✅ Fleet Utilisation
 



 ✅ Fleet Availability
 



 ✅ Trips per Vehicle per Day
 



 ✅ Productive KM per Vehicle
 



 ✅ MT / TEU / Container Productivity
 



 ✅ Idle Fleet Reduction

 ✅ Revenue per Vehicle
 



 ✅ Contribution per Vehicle
 



 ✅ Project Profitability
 



 ✅ Daily \& Monthly Target Achievement
 


 Candidate Profile

 **fleet management, transportation, logistics, operational excellence, business analytics or EV operations** 
 .

 • Strong analytical and commercial mindset.

title: Operations Associate / Founders office
description:
We are a recruiting firm hiring a Chief of Staff for the Founder's Office of one of our clients: a funded, venture\-backed startup growing fast. Small team, high visibility, zero bureaucracy. Company details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Whether your last title was Chief of Staff, Founder's Associate, or you sat in a founder's office running strategy and operations, the job here is the same: you are the CEO's right hand, sitting at the center of everything the company does. One week you might be building an investor update, the next you are unblocking a hiring pipeline, running a go\-to\-market experiment, or fixing a business operations process that is breaking as they scale.
 



  





 You will see every function up close: sales, product, hiring, fundraising, strategy, and operations. You will be in the rooms where decisions get made, and you will be expected to have opinions in those rooms.
 



  





 To be upfront: this is not a 9 to 5\. The pace is intense, the hours flex with what the business needs, and the ambiguity is constant. If you want a defined lane and a predictable schedule, this role will frustrate you. If you have done this job before and loved it, read on.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Act as a force multiplier for the CEO: own the founder's priorities end to end, from prep to execution to follow\-through
* Drive special projects and strategic initiatives across functions: GTM experiments, hiring sprints, ops fixes, market research, whatever the business needs most that month
* Build decks, models, memos, and dashboards that drive real decisions (board updates, investor materials, internal business reviews)
* Run point on cross\-functional initiatives, chasing down owners and removing blockers until things ship
* Sit in on leadership, investor, and client conversations, capture what matters, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Spot problems before they become fires and fix them without being asked



  





**Who you are** 



* You have already worked as a Chief of Staff, in a Founder's Office, or as a Founder's Associate or EIR at a startup. This is a hard requirement. This role is not open to consultants, investment bankers, or people hoping to break into this kind of role for the first time
* You know what the job actually involves: the ambiguity, the context switching, the odd hours, and you have thrived in it before
* Extremely high ownership: you close loops, you do not wait to be told, and "not my job" is not in your vocabulary
* Structured thinker who communicates clearly in writing and in person
* Strong with numbers and tools: spreadsheets, decks, and ideally AI tools and modern SaaS
* Low ego, high urgency, and bias to action



  





**What's on offer** 



* A front\-row seat to company building, working directly with the founder daily
* Ownership and decision\-making exposure most people wait a decade for
* A clear launchpad: people in this seat typically grow into leadership roles in strategy, operations, or growth
* Competitive compensation

description:
\# Founding Member — Growth \& Sales\*\*Company:\*\* Reframe Studios\*\*Location:\*\* Remote\*\*Job Type:\*\* Founding Member / Equity\-Based Opportunity \*\*Compensation:\*\* Equity\-based; no cash salary at present\*\*Equity:\*\* 17% initial equity \+ up to 3% additional performance\-based equity\#\# About Reframe StudiosReframe Studios is an early\-stage growth and storytelling company focused on helping businesses and individuals strengthen their brand, build credibility, create high\-quality content, and generate meaningful business opportunities.We are currently in the early stages of building our ideal customer strategy and commercial engine.Rather than assuming exactly who our best customers are from day one, we want to work with someone who can help us identify \*\*which customer segments have the strongest need, highest potential value, and best potential for outbound acquisition\*\*.Our approach will involve testing markets, validating different customer segments, refining our positioning, and identifying where Reframe Studios can create the strongest commercial opportunity.We are looking for a \*\*Founding Member — Growth \& Sales\*\* to take significant ownership of this process.Think of it like \- Youtube as a Service ( YAAS ) \-\-\-\#\# About the OpportunityThis is \*\*not a traditional sales job\*\*.You will work directly with the founder to build the commercial side of Reframe Studios from the ground up.A major part of your role will be helping us answer questions such as:\* Who should we target?\* Which customer segments have the strongest demand?\* Who can we reach effectively through outbound?\* Which type of companies or individuals have the highest willingness to pay? \* Which acquisition channels work best?
 



 \* How should we position our services for different markets?\* How do we build a repeatable pipeline of qualified prospects?You will be involved in both \*\*growth and sales\*\*.Your role begins with finding and creating opportunities in the market and continues through building relationships, qualifying prospects, understanding their needs, and converting the right opportunities into clients.This role requires significant ownership, experimentation, initiative, and comfort operating in an early\-stage environment.\-\-\-\#\# What You’ll Do\#\#\# 1\. Market Research \& Customer Identification\* Research and identify potential customer segments for Reframe Studios. \* Help determine which industries, businesses, founders, creators, or organizations we should target.\* Evaluate different markets based on:\* Demand\* Ability and willingness to pay\* Ease of reaching decision\-makers \* Outbound potential\* Deal size\* Long\-term customer value\* Test different Ideal Customer Profiles and refine them based on real market feedback.\* Identify the customer segments most likely to generate strong outbound opportunities.\* Work with the founder to continuously refine our positioning and offers.\-\-\-\#\#\# 2\. Growth \& Lead GenerationYour primary responsibility will be helping build a predictable pipeline of qualified prospects.This may include:\* Cold email outreach.\* Cold DMs.\* LinkedIn and other platform\-based outreach.
 



 \* Community\-based outreach.\* Relevant online communities and platforms.\* Reddit and other niche communities.\* Content\-led lead generation.\* Founder\-led and company\-led personal branding.\* Partnerships and strategic relationships.\* Referral opportunities.\* Other creative outbound and inbound acquisition strategies.The focus is not simply on sending a high volume of messages.The focus is on finding the \*\*right prospects\*\*, reaching them with the right message, creating interest, and generating qualified conversations.You will continuously experiment with different channels and approaches to identify what works.\-\-\-\#\#\# 3\. Pipeline Development\* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified prospects.\* Identify potential decision\-makers and relevant contacts.\* Develop systems for prospecting and lead qualification.\* Create outreach sequences and follow\-up systems.\* Track prospects and conversations through a CRM or pipeline management system.\* Ensure interested prospects are properly nurtured.\* Develop a repeatable process for moving prospects from:\*\*Prospect → Contacted → Interested → Qualified → Sales Conversation → Client\*\*The objective is to create a consistent flow of relevant opportunities into the sales process.\-\-\-\#\#\# 4\. Sales \& ClosingOnce a prospect becomes interested, you will take responsibility for moving the opportunity toward conversion.This includes:\* Conducting discovery calls.\* Understanding the prospect’s business, goals, and challenges.
 



 \* Explaining Reframe Studios’ services and value proposition. \* Answering questions and handling objections.\* Helping shape proposals, offers, packages, and pricing.\* Following up with interested prospects.\* Negotiating where necessary.\* Closing deals.\* Ensuring a smooth handover to the product and delivery team.You will help build a sales process that can eventually become repeatable and scalable.\-\-\-\#\#\# 5\. Relationship BuildingWe do not want to build a business around one\-time transactions. Long\-term relationships will be an important part of this role.You will be responsible for:\* Building trust with prospects and clients.\* Maintaining relationships beyond the initial sale.\* Identifying opportunities for repeat business.\* Encouraging referrals and introductions.\* Building relationships with potential partners and industry contacts. \* Creating a network that can support long\-term business growth.A strong relationship with one client should have the potential to create multiple future opportunities.\-\-\-\#\#\# 6\. Building Reframe StudiosAs a Founding Member, your responsibility goes beyond traditional sales and marketing tasks.You will:\* Work directly with the founder on growth and commercial strategy. \* Help identify the best customer segments to target.\* Help shape the company’s Ideal Customer Profile.\* Test acquisition channels and growth experiments.\* Bring market feedback into the development of our services. \* Help improve our offers, positioning, and pricing.\* Build systems and processes from scratch.
 



 \* Help establish the foundations of the company’s growth and sales function. \* Take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for instructions.\-\-\-\#\# What We’re Looking ForWe are looking for someone who:\* Has experience in growth, marketing, sales, business development, or client acquisition.\* Understands outbound lead generation.\* Can identify and research potential customer segments.\* Is comfortable testing markets instead of assuming everything is already known.\* Can start conversations and build relationships from scratch.\* Understands how to find and qualify prospects.\* Is comfortable with cold outreach through email, DMs, LinkedIn, communities, or other channels.\* Can take interested prospects through a sales process.\* Can think strategically about customer acquisition and revenue.\* Is highly self\-driven and comfortable working independently. \* Can operate effectively in an early\-stage environment.\* Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions. \* Is comfortable with experimentation and uncertainty.\* Wants to build a company rather than simply perform a predefined role.\* Understands the risks and opportunities associated with an equity\-based founding position.\-\-\-\#\# Bonus Points\* Experience in B2B sales or business development.\* Experience building an outbound acquisition engine.\* Strong cold email or cold outreach experience.\* Experience generating leads through LinkedIn or other platforms.\* Experience in agency growth or professional services.\* Experience with content, media, branding, or marketing services.\* Experience building a sales process from an early stage.\* Experience identifying and validating new customer segments.\* Experience using CRM and outbound tools.\* Existing relationships that could potentially create business opportunities.\-\-\-\#\# Compensation \& Equity
 



 This opportunity currently does \*\*not include a cash salary\*\*. The compensation structure is equity\-based.\#\#\# Proposed Structure\* \*\*20% initial equity\*\* for joining as a Founding Member and taking ownership of Growth \& Sales.\* \*\*Up to an additional 5% performance\-based equity\*\* based on mutually agreed milestones related to growth, revenue, customer acquisition, and company\-building.\* \*\*Up to 25% total potential equity.\*\* The exact structure, including:\* Vesting schedule\* Performance milestones\* Dilution provisions\* Equity terms\* Roles and responsibilities \* Other founder\-level termswill be documented in a written agreement with the selected candidate.This opportunity is designed for someone who wants meaningful ownership and is interested in building Reframe Studios over the long term.\-\-\-\#\# What Success Looks LikeIn the early stages, success will include:\* Identifying the most promising customer segments.\* Developing a clear and validated Ideal Customer Profile.\* Finding the markets that generate the strongest outbound opportunities. \* Building a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.\* Establishing effective outreach systems.\* Identifying the most effective acquisition channels.\* Building a repeatable sales process.\* Closing and onboarding initial clients.\* Building strong long\-term client relationships.\* Generating referrals and repeat opportunities.\* Creating systems that can eventually scale beyond the founding team.\-\-\-

 \#\# The Ideal Person You are part:\* Growth strategist\* Lead generation specialist \* Salesperson\* Relationship builder\* Business developer\* EntrepreneurYou do not need to have done everything before. However, you need to be comfortable figuring things out.The ideal person is someone who can look at a new business, research the market, identify where opportunities exist, reach out to potential customers, generate interest, build relationships, close deals, and continuously improve the process.If you are specifically looking for an \*\*equity\-based founding opportunity\*\* and want to take meaningful ownership of the growth and commercial side of an early\-stage company, we would like to hear from you.\*\*Important:\*\* This is an equity\-based opportunity with no cash salary at present. Candidates should carefully consider the risks and uncertainty associated with joining an early\-stage venture before applying.

 ECCU is primarily focused on cyber security and offers both a Bachelors (BS) and a Master (MS) degree program.  www.eccu.edu

 The Enrollment Advisor position at EC\-Council University offers a rewarding career in the highly growing field of cyber security education. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.
   

  

 EC\-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. title: VP, Finance
description:
**Company Overview** 




 Protectt.ai is India’s 1st Mobile App Security Platform focused on delivering cutting\-edge security \& fraud control for mobile app, device, and transaction security. Our platform’s advanced mobile app security technologies includes Runtime Application Self\-Protection (RASP), Code \& API protection, identity protection, fraud control, malware protection, device intelligence and real\-time defence against sophisticated mobile app threats.
 



 We partner with India’s leading enterprises across Banking, Insurance, Finance, FinTech \& Government organizations to help securing their mobile app ecosystem. Our platform is unparalleled in scale and innovation \- uniquely positioned through its comprehensive solution architecture and proprietary patented technology.
 



 Headquartered in Mumbai, India, with an Innovation Centre in Chennai and offices in the USA, and the UAE, We are proudly backed by Bessemer Venture Partners (BVP) \- a globally renowned venture capital firm investing in transformative technology companies \& Bajaj Finance \- one of India’s leading financial institutions committed to driving innovation in digital security.
 



**Our expansion into AI Security Posture Management** 




 As AI usage evolves, so do we. We are focused on developing innovative products that provides AI Red Teaming, Model Scanning \& Runtime Security to Agentic AI. Through the development of next generation AI\-Security Posture Management, we aim to ensure a secure and trustworthy AI adoption for our customers. We believe the future of digital security lies in the convergence of mobile, cloud, and AI, and we’re leading the charge.
 



**Awards and Recognition** 




 Protectt.ai has raised Series A Funding from Bessemer Venture Partners for global expansion and to further strengthen our R\&D efforts. Our innovations have earned multiple prestigious awards, including:
 



 • Security Product Company of the Year by Data Security Council of India (DSCI)
 



 • Cybersecurity Company of the Year by BWSECURITY
 



 • Innovative Security Product of the Year by BWSECURITY
 



 • DSCI Innovation Box Winner
 



 • Great Place To Work® certified
 



  





**Company Link:** 
 (https://www.protectt.ai)
 



**Role:** 
 VP, Finance \& Accounts
 



**Experience: 9 to 1** 
 6 years
 



**Job Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Qualification:** 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for a Chartered Accountant with 10–15 years of experience to lead the Finance \& Accounts function at Protectt.ai. As Head – Finance \& Accounts, you will be responsible for the overall financial governance of the organization, including financial reporting, accounting, taxation, treasury, statutory compliances, audits, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, investor reporting, and international finance operations.
 



  





 The role will work closely with the CEO, leadership team, investors, auditors, tax advisors, legal, HR, business, and international teams and will play a critical role in supporting Protectt.ai’s next phase of growth and global expansion. This is a hands\-on leadership position suited to a finance professional who can combine strong technical accounting and compliance expertise with commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and execution orientation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Financial Reporting \& MIS** 




 • Own and lead the overall Finance \& Accounts function of the organization.
 



 • Establish robust financial processes, policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
 



 • Ensure accuracy, integrity, and timely completion of all financial activities.
 



 • Drive a disciplined monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing process.
 



 • Act as a strategic finance partner to the CEO and senior leadership team.
 



 • Identify opportunities for improving financial efficiency, controls, processes, and systems.
 



 • Build and develop a high\-performing finance team with clear ownership and accountability.
 



  





**2\. Compliance \& Regulatory** 




 • Oversee direct and indirect tax compliances (GST, TDS, income tax filings, returns and reconciliations).
 



 • Liaison with tax consultants, auditors and regulatory authorities.
 



 • Ensure compliance with Companies Act requirements (ROC filings, board documentation support).
 



  





**3\. Audit Management** 




 • Lead statutory audit, internal audit and tax audit processes.
 



 • Coordinate with external auditors and provide required schedules and explanations.
 



 • Closure of audit observations and implementation of internal control improvements.
 



 • Support due diligence requirements for investors, lenders and strategic partners.
 



  





**4\. Procurement \& Payables Oversight** 




 • Oversee procurement process and ensure adherence to company procurement policy.
 



 • Review vendor onboarding documentation and contract compliance.
 



 • Monitor purchase orders, invoice verification and approval workflows.
 



 • Ensure proper accounting and timely payment to vendors.
 



  





**5\. Payroll \& Employee Finance Processes** 




 • Oversee payroll processing, final settlements and reimbursements.
 



 • Ensure compliance with PF, ESIC, PT and labour related statutory requirements.
 



 • Review payroll accounting entries and reconciliation with HR records.
 



 • Support implementation and monitoring of employee benefit programs (NPS, ESOP accounting support).
 



  





**6\. International Subsidiary \& Group Reporting** 




 • Supervise accounting and compliances of overseas/group entities.
 



 • Coordinate with foreign accountants and consultants.
 



 • Review consolidation data and intercompany reconciliations.
 



 • Monitor transfer pricing documentation and cross\-border transactions.
 



 • Assist in preparation of consolidated financial statements.
 



  





**7\. Financial Planning \& Budgeting** 




 • Assist in preparation of annual budget and periodic forecasts.
 



 • Track departmental budgets and spending.
 



 • Support cash flow planning, working capital management and treasury monitoring.
 



 • Provide financial insights to support operational decision\-making.
 



  





**8\. Strategic \& Business Support** 




 • Support fundraising, investor reporting and data room preparation.
 



 • Assist in financial modelling, business planning and scenario analysis.
 



 • Support M\&A evaluation, due diligence and integration activities.
 



 • Work closely with business teams to evaluate pricing, profitability and cost optimization.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




 • Strong knowledge of accounting standards and financial controls
 



 • Understanding of SaaS revenue recognition and subscription business models
 



 • Experience with audits, taxation and regulatory compliance
 



 • Advanced Excel and financial analysis skills
 



 • Experience with ERP/accounting systems (Tally, Zoho Books, NetSuite, SAP or similar)
 



 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment
 



 • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 • High ownership and attention to detail
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




 • Experience in Technology, SaaS, Cybersecurity, FinTech, or Product companies.
 



 • Exposure to investor reporting and fundraising
 



 • Handling international subsidiaries or cross\-border transactions
 



 • Experience in a VC/PE\-backed or high\-growth startup environment.
 



 • Experience working with institutional investors and participating in fundraising processes.
 



 • Exposure to ESOP accounting and valuation concepts

Together, we improve financial performance and patient experience, helping to build sustainable healthcare businesses.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Accounts Receivable Associate is responsible for managing and following up on outstanding claims, ensuring timely collections, and resolving payment discrepancies. This role plays a crucial part in the revenue cycle process by reducing outstanding accounts receivable, improving cash flow, and maintaining accurate financial records.
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office

 8pm to 5am/9pm to 6am (Night Shift)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Primary Functions**

**Claims Follow\-Up \& Collections**
* Monitor outstanding insurance claims and patient balances.Conduct timely follow\-ups with insurance providers to ensure claim resolution.
* Investigate and resolve denials, underpayments, and delays in claim processing.
* Contact patients for outstanding balances, set up payment plans, and provide billing support


**Payment Reconciliation \& Posting**
* Work closely with the payment posting team to ensure correct application of payments and adjustments.
* Reconcile daily AR reports and accounts to track collections and pending claims.
* Identify and escalate billing errors or discrepancies for resolution.


**Denial Management \& Appeals**
* Analyze denial trends and collaborate with the billing team to correct recurring issues.
* Prepare and submit appeals for denied or underpaid claims with appropriate documentation.
* Maintain records of appeal status and follow up with insurance carriers.


**Reporting \& Compliance**
* Generate and maintain aging reports, AR summaries, and collection reports.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, Medicare, Medicaid, and private payer policies.
* Document all collection activities and maintain accurate AR records.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work with the billing, payment posting, and coding teams to resolve claim discrepancies.
* Communicate with insurance representatives and internal stakeholders to streamline the AR

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
* 1\+ years of experience in accounts receivable, medical billing, or revenue cycle management.

**(Preferred/Good\-to\-Have Skills)**

* Strong knowledge of insurance reimbursement processes, AR management, and medical billing.
* Familiarity with CPT, ICD\-10, and HCPCS codes for claim verification.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, financial reconciliation, and reporting tools.
* Ability to work independently and manage high\-volume AR portfolios.


**Skills/ Behavioural Skills**
* Problem\-Solver: Identifies and resolves healthcare billing discrepancies.

* Maintain the day\-to\-day relationship with the internal, external payroll partners.

* Should be able to work with the business, cross\-functional collaboration and provide the appropriate solutions.

* Preparing and filing tax reports, communicating with 3rd party payroll and tax reporting vendors.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
On a day\-to\-day basis, you will work as a Senior Java Developer supporting the ongoing development, optimisation, and enhancement of a critical enterprise technology platform. You will be responsible for feature development, product improvements, and helping solve complex business and technical challenges across a large\-scale environment.

Working within a distributed architecture consisting of more than 100 microservices, you will design, develop, maintain, test, and optimise backend services while contributing to new features, reporting capabilities, dashboards, alerts, and broader platform enhancements.
 



  





 A significant portion of the role will focus on improving system performance, scalability, observability, and resilience while supporting event\-driven architectures and cloud\-native solutions hosted in AWS. You will work closely with architects, product teams, and fellow engineers to implement enhancements, improve service reliability, and ensure the long\-term maintainability of the platform.

* 7\+ years of enterprise level Java 8\+ development experience
* Deep expertise with Spring Boot, microservices, and event\-driven distributed architectures
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs
* Hands on experience with AWS
* Working knowledge of Docker and container\-based deployment
* Hands\-on experience with MySQL, including schema design, query tuning, and performance optimisation
* Enterprise level experience with Cloud Watch
* Experience in unit testing with JUnit and Mockito
* Familiarity with resiliency patterns, including Resilience4j, circuit breakers, retries, failover, self\-healing services, and bulkheads
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

title: Software Development Engineer V
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

**Avalara** 
 is accelerating its AI\-first transformation by building intelligent systems that automate complex compliance workflows, understand unstructured and structured data, and enable product teams to deliver AI\-powered experiences at scale. As Avalara works toward its ambition of being part of every transaction in the world, we are investing in a Senior Tech Lead to build the next generation of production AI capabilities.
   

  

**Design \& Architecture**
* Lead the end\-to\-end design of complex, distributed features — from data flow and API contracts through to deployment and operational observability.
* Apply proven design principles (SOLID, domain\-driven design, event\-driven architecture, 12\-factor apps) to ensure systems are scalable, maintainable, and resilient.
* Define and document architecture decisions clearly, with well\-reasoned trade\-offs that the team and stakeholders can understand and act on.
* Design multi\-tenant, cloud\-native services that handle high classification throughput with low latency and strong fault tolerance.


**Agentic AI Engineering**
* Build and operate agentic AI workflows — multi\-step pipelines where LLM\-based


 agents reason over product descriptions, retrieve external evidence (web content, trade
   

  

 documents, regulatory data), and deliver classification decisions with calibrated
   

  

 confidence.
   

  

* Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases to


 ground LLM reasoning in authoritative customs and trade reference data.
   

  

 Design human\-in\-the\-loop orchestration — intelligent escalation logic that determines
   

  

 when an AI agent can classify autonomously versus when it should route to a human
   

  

 expert, with transparent confidence signals and audit trails.
   

  

* Build and extend MCP (Model Context Protocol) server capabilities — exposing


 classification APIs as tools that AI agents and partner platforms can discover and invoke
   

  

 autonomously, enabling agentic compliance workflows inside ERPs and marketplace
   

  

 systems.
   

  

* Evaluate, fine\-tune, and govern LLM\-based components in production — managing


 prompt engineering, output validation, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI
   

  

 practices.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Full\-Stack Engineering**
* Build high\-quality backend services and APIs in Java (Spring Boot) and Python


 (FastAPI) that handle large\-scale product classification intake, orchestration, and
   

  

 delivery.
   

  

* Design and maintain asynchronous processing pipelines using message queues (e.g.,


 AWS SQS) and batch frameworks to handle classification volumes ranging from dozens
   

  

 to millions of items per customer.
   

  

* Develop or contribute to frontend components and internal tooling where needed to


 complete features end\-to\-end.
   

  

* Work confidently with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and vector stores for


 both transactional and semantic retrieval workloads.
   

  

**Platform \& Operations**
* Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes (AWS EKS) — writing Helm configurations,


 defining resource policies, and ensuring services meet availability and latency SLOs.
   

  

* Build observability into every service — structured logging, distributed tracing, and


 dashboards that make system behavior transparent in production.
   

  

* Own incident response for classification services — perform root cause analysis,


 implement durable fixes, and document post\-incident learnings.
   

  

* Embed security best practices (secrets management, least\-privilege IAM, OWASP


 principles) across all services.
   

  

**Team \& Engineering Culture**
* Conduct high\-quality code and design reviews — providing specific, constructive


 feedback that raises technical standards and accelerates the growth of junior engineers.
   

  

* Mentor I3 and I4 engineers through pairing sessions, technical coaching, and structured


 knowledge transfer.
   

  

* Proactively identify and address technical debt before it compounds — proposing and


 leading refactors that improve long\-term velocity.
   

  

* Champion engineering best practices: CI/CD discipline, automated testing,


 documentation, and clear Definition of Done.
   

  

**Elevate The Team**
* Share agentic workflow patterns, prompt engineering techniques, and AI tool


 recommendations with the broader engineering team.
   

  

* Identify new agentic use cases within the product roadmap and advocate for their


 prioritization with engineering and product leadership.
   

  

* Help junior engineers go from "AI\-aware" to "AI\-effective" through hands\-on


 demonstration and coaching.
   

  

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Minimum 10 years of professional software engineering experience, with a


 demonstrated track record of senior\-level technical ownership and impact.
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience designing and building distributed backend systems —


 RESTful APIs, microservices, asynchronous messaging, and event\-driven architectures.
   

  

* Proficiency in at least one of Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI / asyncio), with


 the ability to read and contribute across both.
   

  

* Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs or ML models into production systems —


 including prompt design, output validation, latency management, and model
   

  

 observability.
   

  

* Experience deploying and operating services on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)


 using containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
   

  

* Strong understanding of software design principles — SOLID, clean architecture,


 domain\-driven design, and design for scalability and resilience.
   

  

* Experience building and enforcing automated testing strategies — unit, integration,


 and end\-to\-end testing — with a disciplined approach to test coverage.
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technology stacks — comfortable picking up


 unfamiliar languages, frameworks, or tooling when required by the problem.
   

  

* Demonstrated, hands\-on AI usage that has produced measurable improvements in


 engineering or product outcomes — this is a required qualifier, not a nice\-to\-have.
   

  

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills for effective collaboration with


 globally distributed engineering, product, and business teams.
   

  

**AI Bar Raiser**
 This role carries explicit
 **Agentic AI expectations** 
 .
   

  

 Casual or passive AI use is not sufficient —
   

  

 AI must materially change what you and the team can deliver.
   

  

**Accelerate Your Own Engineering**
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) in your daily


 workflow and demonstrate measurable gains — reduced cycle time, higher test
   

  

 coverage, faster code reviews, or improved documentation quality.
   

  

* Apply LLMs to accelerate design documentation, runbook authoring, API specification


 drafting, and code review commentary.
   

  

* Critically evaluate all AI\-generated outputs and apply sound engineering judgment — AI


 assists; you own the result.
   

  

**Build Agentic Product Capabilities**
* Design classification agents that can autonomously plan, retrieve, reason, and decide —


 going beyond single\-step ML inference to full reasoning loops.
   

  

 Implement responsible, explainable AI — every classification decision should carry a
   

  

 confidence signal, a rationale trail, and a graceful human\-escalation path.
   

  

* Govern LLM behavior in production — prevent prompt injection, manage output


 variability, monitor for drift, and apply security\-conscious AI practices.
   

  

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
 At Avalara, we hire only Bar Raisers — individuals who make the team permanently better by
   

  

 their presence. This is not about tenure or title; it is about raising the standard of what the team
   

  

 delivers and how it delivers it.
   

  

**As An I5 Engineer On This Team, You Will**
* Hold a high bar for design and code quality — own every system you touch, and leave


 it better than you found it.
   

  

* Bring data and reasoning into technical discussions — opinions backed by evidence,


 trade\-offs clearly articulated.
   

  

* Challenge and be challenged — contribute to healthy engineering debate and maintain


 intellectual humility when better approaches emerge.
   

  

* Make AI a team habit, not a personal trick — share what works, teach others, and


 drive measurable AI adoption across the team.
   

  

* Grow the engineers around you — the team's output is your output.


 If a candidate cannot demonstrate that their work has materially improved the quality, speed, or
   

  

 scale of what their team delivers, they do not meet the Bar Raiser standard for this level.
   

  

**12\-Month Success Signals**
* Delivered at least one production\-grade agentic AI capability — such as an autonomous


 classification agent that retrieves product evidence and improves coverage — with
   

  

 measurable accuracy improvement.
   

  

* Led the design and delivery of one significant architectural improvement to the


 classification platform (e.g., a new intake integration, a new API layer, or a reliability
   

  

 upgrade).
   

  

* Measurably improved engineering velocity for the India team through AI\-assisted


 development practices — demonstrable through cycle time, test coverage, or deployment
   

  

 frequency metrics.
   

  

* Contributed to at least one MCP server tool expansion enabling external AI agents or


 partner platforms to consume classification capabilities.
   

  

* Grown at least two junior engineers through regular mentoring, with documented


 improvements in their scope of ownership and delivery quality.
   

  

* Established or improved at least one team engineering standard (testing, code review,


 observability, or architectural
   

  

 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

* Collaboration \& Teamwork

* Process Improvement Mindset
* Adaptability \& Learning Agility

title: Application Development & Support Analyst
description:
**Role Statement**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Junior RPA, Automation \& AI Analyst is an entry\-level role supporting the delivery of process automation and operational efficiency initiatives within the ERP Tech Factory. Under the guidance of a Senior Analyst or the ERP Tech Factory Lead, this role contributes to the design, development, and deployment of RPA \& automation solutions and AI\-powered tools.
   

  

 This role focuses on building core technical skills, executing assigned automation tasks, maintaining solution assets, and contributing to the Automation Factory's delivery pipeline. It serves as the foundational entry point into the RPA \& Automation discipline, providing exposure to enterprise\-scale automation, AI\-powered tooling, and structured development practices.
   

  

**Key Duties**
**Automation \& AI Solution Development**
* Develop and deploy automation solutions and AI\-powered tools under senior guidance, executing assigned development tasks in accordance with established architectural standards and best practices.
* Build automations using RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, WePath) to reduce manual effort and support process efficiency across business functions.
* Support the configuration and testing of AI\-powered tools, ensuring solutions are functional, reliable, and aligned with defined requirements.
* Participate in technical reviews and testing cycles, providing input on solution quality and flagging issues for senior review and resolution.


**Asset Maintenance \& Documentation**
* Maintain and update reusable automation and AI solution assets, ensuring they remain accurate, functional, and consistent with the latest platform and process requirements.
* Document developed solutions, workflows, and operational procedures to support knowledge retention, team onboarding, and future maintainability.
* Follow established development frameworks, naming conventions, and version control practices to ensure all deliverables meet team quality standards.
* Support incident resolution for assigned automation solutions by performing root\-cause analysis and implementing fixes under senior supervision.


**Process Analysis Support**
* Support the identification of automation and AI use case opportunities by analyzing process inefficiencies, repetitive manual tasks, and error\-prone workflows.
* Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements, process flows, and use case specifications required for automation scoping and development.
* Contribute to the preparation of business case materials by collecting data on manual effort, processing volumes, and anticipated automation benefits.
* Translate business process knowledge into automation\-ready specifications, supporting the pipeline from opportunity identification through to development handover.


**Collaboration \& Learning**
* Work closely with ERP Second Level Support, Third\-Level Support Engineers, and Software Development/Platform Engineers to understand system context, data flows, and integration dependencies relevant to assigned automation tasks.
* Actively participate in team meetings, technical reviews, and knowledge\-sharing sessions, contributing observations and lessons learned from assigned deliverables.
* Pursue continuous learning in RPA platforms, AI tooling, and development practices, including relevant certifications (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate) to build technical depth.
* Coordinate submission of resolved issues, applied fixes, and process documentation to the broader team to support knowledge retention and operational continuity.


**Required**
**Qualification and Experience**
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in RPA (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, WePath), process automation,\[NS1\.1] or AI tool development; fresh graduates with relevant project experience or internships will be considered.
* Basic experience automating business processes or working with ERP or enterprise platforms, including exposure to data entry, report generation, or workflow automation tasks.
* Foundational knowledge of RPA platform capabilities, AI tool development concepts, and how automation solutions are designed, built, and deployed in enterprise environments.
* Understanding of software development and release practices, including version control, testing principles, and structured delivery workflows (e.g., Agile, Kanban).
* Ability to translate business processes into automation\-ready specifications with clear steps, inputs, outputs, and exception\-handling requirements.
* Collaborative mindset with a strong sense of accountability for assigned deliverables, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn and grow within a structured technical team.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to Oracle EBS or similar ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics), particularly in the context of process automation or data operations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira Cloud for task tracking, incident management, or agile delivery workflows.
* Relevant certifications or training in RPA platforms, such as UiPath Foundation, Microsoft Power Automate Fundamentals, or equivalent, demonstrating a commitment to professional development.
* Background or academic exposure in computer science, information systems, business process management, or a related technical discipline.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Task completion rate and quality (% of assigned automation tasks delivered on time and meeting defined acceptance criteria)
* Automation execution success rate (% of bot runs completing without error for solutions under ownership)
* Development time\-to\-deliver (average cycle time for assigned development tasks from briefing to deployment)
* Learning \& certification progress (completion of targeted RPA/automation training courses and certifications within agreed timelines)

title: Advanced Customer Support Engineer – Teamcenter
description:
**Role Description**
**Siemens Digital Industries Software**
 We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation, helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start\-up, we have fun together while crafting a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
   

  

**Position Overview**
* We are seeking a sophisticated Customer Support Engineer to join our Global Teamcenter Customer Support organization.
* This role is ideal for someone who already has a solid foundation in technical or application support and is ready to take the next step in their career. You will receive onboarding, product training, and continuous support from experienced engineers while developing deeper expertise in Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product and its supporting technologies.
* As a sophisticated Support Engineer, we are looking for someone who can learn quickly, take initiative, and progress toward working independently faster than an entry\-level engineer.
* You will troubleshoot enterprise applications, infrastructure, configuration, integration, and performance\-related issues across Linux and Windows environments. You will work directly with customers while collaborating with experienced Support Engineers, Product Development, Cloud/IT teams, and other specialists across our Global organization.
* Over time, you will be expected to independently manage increasingly complex customer cases, recognize when additional expertise is needed, and actively drive investigations toward resolution.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for Siemens Teamcenter and its supporting technologies.
* Investigate application, configuration, integration, infrastructure, and performance\-related customer issues.
* Analyze application logs, configuration files, diagnostic data, error messages, thread dumps, and other technical information to identify possible causes and next troubleshooting steps.
* Troubleshoot issues across Linux and Windows environments, including application services, file systems, permissions, processes, connectivity, and resource utilization.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues in internal environments and develop clear test scenarios.
* Manage assigned customer cases and maintain ownership of investigation and communication through resolution.
* Prioritize multiple cases based on severity, customer impact, and business urgency. (Knowledge of SLA’s)
* Participate in technical critical issues and collaborate with senior Support Engineers, SME’s, Cloud Operations, IT, and other specialists when deeper expertise is required.
* Recognize when an issue may originate outside the application layer and collect the appropriate technical evidence before engaging other teams.
* Communicate investigation progress, technical findings, solutions, and next steps clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Document troubleshooting steps, root\-cause findings, solutions, and workarounds.
* Contribute to Knowledge Base articles and other reusable technical documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve troubleshooting processes, documentation, and customer experience.
* Continuously develop technical knowledge of Teamcenter and its underlying technology stack.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in technical support, application support, systems engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Experience troubleshooting enterprise or server\-based software applications.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to technical problem solving.
* Solid understanding of Linux and Windows operating systems, including command\-line tools, services, processes, permissions, and file systems.
* Understanding fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, proxies, firewalls, ports, certificates, and client/server communication.
* Experience reviewing and analyzing application or system logs.
* Ability to lead multiple technical issues and organize work according to priority and customer impact.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly and apply new knowledge to customer problems.
* Initiative and the ability to work increasingly independently following the initial training and onboarding period.
* Good judgment in recognizing when additional technical expertise or customer concern is required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional proficiency in English is required, as English is the primary working language across our global Support and Engineering organization.
* Ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to collaborate effectively within a geographically distributed global team.
* Ability and willingness to use AI technologies responsibly as part of day\-to\-day work to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and customer support outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
   

  

* Java or Java\-based enterprise applications, particularly application troubleshooting.
* Apache HTTP Server and web application architectures.
* SQL databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
* AWS or other cloud infrastructure and services.
* Enterprise authentication technologies such as SAML, OAuth/OIDC, LDAP, Active Directory, or SSO.
* SQL and basic database troubleshooting.
* JVM configuration, heap/thread dump analysis, or Java application performance troubleshooting.
* Load balancers, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and enterprise network architectures


**Training and Development**
* We recognize that Teamcenter is a complex enterprise platform with a broad technology stack. New team members receive an onboarding and training period that includes product training, technical knowledge transfer, shadowing experienced engineers, and exposure to real customer cases.
* During onboarding, you will have access to experienced team members who can provide guidance and help you build product knowledge.
* Because this is an Advanced\-level position, we expect you to build on your existing technical support experience, pick up new concepts quickly, become comfortable making technical decisions, and progress toward independently handling your workload and customer cases.
* Strong problem\-solving skills are essential, including the ability to investigate complex issues, ask the right questions, research unfamiliar technologies, collaborate effectively with technical experts, and resolve appropriate next steps toward resolution.
* The position is based around Pacific (and/or Asia Pacific) Time Zone business hours, with some flexibility in the daily schedule. As part of a global organization, there may occasionally be opportunities to adjust your schedule slightly to collaborate with colleagues or attend meetings across different time zones.


**What Success Looks Like**
* As you complete onboarding and develop your Teamcenter knowledge, you will become increasingly comfortable managing customer cases independently.
* You will be able to assess an issue, collect the appropriate technical information, perform an initial investigation, and determine reasonable next troubleshooting steps. For more sophisticated issues, you will know when and how to collaborate with experienced engineers, Engineering, or other technical teams.
* You will have daily support, collaboration, and technical resources from your immediate team, as well as access to our global Support organization and domain experts across different regions and time zones. Our collaborative environment provides opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues, exchange knowledge, and work together on sophisticated technical challenges.
* Successful engineers in this role are curious, proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable learning continuously. They take ownership for moving their cases forward while recognizing that sophisticated problems are often solved through teamwork.


**Why us?**
 Working at Siemens Software means flexibility. Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
   

  

 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

title: Structured Finance Analyst
description:
**Structured Finance Analyst** 




 Graystone Capital \| Global Enablement Centre, India
 



 www.graystone\-capital.com
 



  





**About Graystone Capital** 




 Graystone Capital arranges and structures debt financing for businesses across the GCC and wider region, trade finance, working capital, structured credit, and syndicated facilities, connecting clients with banks, private credit funds, and institutional investors.
 



  





 Our Global Enablement Centre in India is the analytical engine behind that work. This is not a back\-office support function. The Centre produces the credit and diligence work product that goes directly to investment committees, lenders, and investors.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own the analytical work that decides whether a transaction proceeds. Two distinct workstreams:
 



  





**Financial due diligence** 
 on borrowers and investment targets, testing whether reported earnings are repeatable, whether cash conversion is real, and what the balance sheet actually contains.
 



  





**Credit and investment memoranda** 
 for debt financing mandates and private equity opportunities, the documents on which capital is committed.
 



  





 You will see transactions end to end, from first data request to committee decision. The analysis is yours; you will be expected to defend it.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 




  





**Financial due diligence** 



* Build Quality of Earnings analyses: normalise reported EBITDA for one\-off, non\-recurring, out\-of\-period and owner\-related items, and construct a defensible adjusted earnings bridge
* Prepare working capital analyses, trailing twelve\-month averages, seasonality, and a normalised working capital peg
* Analyse cash conversion and free cash flow, distinguishing accounting profit from cash actually generated
* Identify debt\-like items and off\-balance\-sheet exposures that belong in the net debt calculation
* Perform revenue and customer concentration analysis, cohort retention, and pricing\-versus\-volume decomposition
* Review related\-party transactions, revenue recognition policies, and internal controls, flagging inconsistencies and red flags in the underlying data
* Produce clean supporting schedules that tie to source documents and survive external scrutiny



  





**Credit memoranda and investment analysis** 



* Draft full credit memoranda: business and promoter background, industry and competitive position, financial analysis, transaction structure, security package, risks and mitigants, and a clear recommendation
* Build and maintain three\-statement financial models with integrated debt schedules, covenant calculations, and cash sweep mechanics
* Calculate and interpret the ratios that drive decisions — Net Debt/EBITDA, Interest Coverage, DSCR, Fixed Charge Coverage, current and quick ratios, and working capital cycle
* Run base, management and downside stress cases, testing covenant headroom and refinancing capacity under adverse conditions
* Prepare LBO and returns analyses for private equity opportunities, including entry and exit multiple sensitivities and IRR/MOIC bridges
* Assess security structures, guarantees, and post\-dated instrument arrangements typical of GCC trade finance
* Support term sheet preparation and respond to lender and investor queries during syndication



  





**Ongoing** 



* Monitor portfolio covenant compliance and flag early warning indicators
* Maintain comparable company and precedent transaction databases across our sectors
* Work directly with the Dubai origination team, and with client finance teams during live diligence



  





**What we are looking for** 




  





**Essential** 



* 3–6 years in financial due diligence, credit analysis, leveraged or structured finance, transaction advisory, private credit, or investment banking
* CA, CFA (any level cleared), MBA (Finance), or equivalent
* Demonstrable Quality of Earnings and working capital experience, you should be able to walk us through an EBITDA bridge you built and defend every adjustment
* Advanced financial modelling in Excel, built from scratch rather than adapted from templates
* Genuine command of financial statement analysis under IFRS, including the ability to spot what is missing rather than only analyse what is presented
* Strong business writing. A credit memo is a piece of persuasive writing supported by numbers, and we will test this at interview
* Ability to work to transaction timelines, a mid\-market diligence typically runs four to six weeks and the deadline is set by the deal, not by us


- 


**Advantageous** 



* Exposure to GCC or wider MENA markets, or to Islamic finance structures such as Murabaha
* Big Four transaction services background
* Trade finance, supply chain finance, or asset\-based lending experience
* Familiarity with Capital IQ, Bloomberg, or comparable platforms
* Working knowledge of Power BI or Python for data\-heavy analysis



  





**What will make you successful here** 




 Intellectual honesty above all. We would rather hear that a deal does not work than receive an analysis engineered toward the answer someone wants. Judgement about which questions matter. And the confidence to escalate an inconsistency in a data room rather than reconcile around it.
 



  





**Why this role** 



* Direct exposure to live transactions and to the investment committee, not to a processing queue
* Work across both debt and equity, which few analyst roles offer at this stage
* A genuinely growing platform — you will help build how this function operates rather than inherit a fixed process
* Close working relationship with the Dubai team, with travel opportunity

**About The Role**
 A Creative Director who can translate brand and business objectives into every deliverable, and own and create creative benchmarks across process and output
   

  

 The brand strategy and positioning are already defined. The core challenge now is execution: translating the brand into campaigns, films, ads, social content, product stories, website experiences, copy and communication that customers can consistently recognise and remember.
   

  

 This role sits alongside the marketing/category owner. The marketing or category lead will define the business objective, consumer problem, category opportunity and communication direction. The Creative Director will turn that direction into a strong creative idea and carry it through to execution.
   

  

 You will lead an existing in\-house creative pod and determine how it should evolve for the next stage. This includes setting the quality bar, allocating work, coaching talent, identifying capability gaps and recommending any restructuring required.
   

  

**Role**
 This is not a writer\-only, editor\-only or production\-only role. The strongest candidate will have proof of work across all three connected disciplines:
   

  

* Writing and developing ideas across pre\-production domains
* Directing or executing on\-set shoots
* Editing, packaging and delivering the final piece


 You do not need to personally perform every task on every project. You do need to understand the full production process well enough to shape the idea, direct the execution, review the work and protect the final quality.
   

  

 You will not own the P\&L directly. You will, however, be accountable for creative quality, brand distinctiveness and the leading indicators that show whether the work is building the channel and the brand \- such as watch time, view\-through rate, engagement, content performance, channel growth, brand\-led IPs and creative contribution to conversion.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Day\-to\-day**
**Translate strategy into creative direction**
* Convert Rabitat’s positioning, personality and strategic objectives into clear creative direction.
* Define how Rabitat should look, sound and behave across different consumer touchpoints.
* Build and maintain practical creative principles, content pillars, messaging frameworks and visual systems.
* Translate category and consumer insights into relevant hooks, stories, formats and campaigns.
* Ensure that the brand has a recognisable point of view rather than producing disconnected content.
* Maintain the balance between creativity, clarity, product truth and commercial relevance.


**Lead the in\-house creative agency**
* Lead and organise the existing creative team across design, video and content execution.
* Set the creative quality bar and establish a consistent review process.
* Evaluate the team’s current strengths, gaps, roles and output quality.
* Decide what should be handled internally and what should be assigned to agencies, freelancers or production partners.
* Coach team members to improve their thinking, craft, speed and understanding of the brand.
* Recommend changes to team structure, capability or workflow where necessary.
* Build a culture that values strong ideas, high standards, ownership and timely delivery.


**Own concepts and content across channels**
* Develop campaign ideas, content franchises, social formats, product stories and brand\-led IPs.
* Concept and produce static content, short\-form video, long\-form video, UGC, creator content, product demonstrations and campaign films.
* Write or oversee scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, product copy, landing\-page copy and campaign messaging.
* Build communication for:
+ Organic social media
+ Meta and other paid media
+ Website and landing pages
+ Product pages and marketplaces
+ Email and CRM
+ Influencer and creator partnerships
+ Parent communities
+ Product launches and seasonal campaigns

* Create work that is useful for both brand building and performance marketing.
* Develop content that gives parents a reason to trust Rabitat and children a reason to enjoy it.


**Own end\-to\-end production**
* Take a project from brief and idea through to final delivery.
* Develop treatments, scripts, mood boards, references, shot lists and production plans.
* Plan and direct product, lifestyle, creator and campaign shoots.
* Guide casting, locations, props, styling, production design and on\-set decisions.
* Work closely with videographers, photographers, editors, designers, creators and production partners.
* Review rough cuts, edits, sound, motion, design, copy and final exports.
* Ensure that the work holds attention, communicates the product clearly and delivers on the original idea.
* Create platform\-specific versions without losing the core creative thought.
* Maintain a high standard of craft across both large campaigns and everyday content.


**Partner with marketing and performance teams**
* Work with the marketing/category lead to understand business priorities, consumer needs and category opportunities.
* Work with the D2C and performance teams to develop multiple creative routes, hooks and formats for testing.
* Understand the difference between making a creative asset and building a creative system.
* Use data and performance feedback to improve creative decisions without reducing the brand to discount\-led communication.
* Track creative leading indicators such as:
+ View\-through rate
+ Watch time and retention
+ Engagement and saves
+ Creative fatigue
+ Channel growth
+ Performance by hook, format and message
+ Growth of brand\-led content franchises or IPs
+ Contribution to conversion and customer action

* Build a feedback loop between creative output, consumer response and future production.


**Manage agencies and external partners**
* Brief and manage creative, production, influencer, social, editing and design partners.
* Communicate the quality bar and creative direction clearly.
* Review external work and ensure that it is aligned with the brand strategy.
* Build a reliable network of specialist partners who can be activated quickly.
* Ensure that external partners are used for leverage, not as a substitute for internal ownership.
* Coordinate with the Creative Producer / Project Manager on timelines, budgets, deliverables and approvals.


**Improve the operating system**
* Create a clear process for briefs, ideation, reviews, approvals, production and delivery.
* Establish a central tracker for all active creative work.
* Improve turnaround time without compromising quality.
* Create reusable templates, formats and production systems for recurring content.
* Build an organised asset library with clear naming, versions, masters and usage rights.
* Create a regular creative review and learning rhythm with the marketing and performance teams.


**Typical day\-to\-day**
* Review the creative pipeline and prioritise work against business objectives.
* Develop or review concepts, scripts, copy and creative briefs.
* Direct or review shoots and post\-production.
* Give precise feedback on agency, team and freelancer work.
* Work with performance marketing on creative tests and learnings.
* Review social, website, product and campaign communication for consistency.
* Guide the in\-house team and unblock delivery.
* Coordinate with the producer on upcoming shoots, deadlines and dependencies.
* Identify opportunities to build Rabitat\-owned formats, franchises and IPs.
* Decide what Rabitat should say, how it should say it and where it should show up next.


**30\-60\-90 day plan**
**First 30 days: Understand, audit and establish trust**
* Build a clear understanding of Rabitat’s products, consumers, category and growth priorities.
* Study the existing brand strategy, positioning, rebrand work and strategic recommendations.
* Understand the relationship between the marketing/category lead, D2C team, performance team and creative pod.
* Audit current work across social, paid media, website, marketplaces, content and product communication.
* Review creative output, existing KPIs, production processes and team capabilities.
* Meet the current creative team and key agency or freelancer partners.
* Identify immediate quality gaps and high\-impact opportunities.
* Create a prioritised creative backlog and initial content roadmap.


**Expected outcome:** 
 A clear diagnosis of the current creative function, its team, its output and the first set of improvements required.
   

  

**Days 31\-60: Set the bar and deliver visible work**
* Translate the brand strategy into practical creative principles and executional guidance.
* Define the creative review, briefing and approval process.
* Establish roles, ownership and ways of working within the creative pod.
* Deliver quick\-win improvements across social, performance content, website and product communication.
* Lead at least one meaningful content or product shoot from concept to final delivery.
* Develop new creative routes, hooks and formats for performance testing.
* Create or improve recurring content formats and brand\-led content franchises.
* Set up a reliable system for managing agencies, freelancers, budgets, files and timelines.
* Begin tracking creative leading indicators consistently.


**Expected outcome:** 
 Rabitat’s work becomes visibly more consistent, distinctive and effective, with a stronger operating system behind it.
   

  

**Days 61\-90: Build the creative engine**
* Own the next quarter’s brand, content and campaign roadmap.
* Scale the formats, hooks and content territories that are showing promise.
* Build a repeatable in\-house production system for both brand and performance content.
* Recommend any changes required to the existing team structure, roles or capabilities.
* Establish a regular creative and performance review with marketing, category and D2C stakeholders.
* Build a pipeline of Rabitat\-led IPs, content franchises and high\-quality brand films.
* Improve production speed, asset reuse and cross\-channel adaptation.
* Define the long\-term partner, agency and talent requirements for the creative function.
* Present a clear plan for how Rabitat can operate like a high\-quality in\-house creative agency.


**Expected outcome:** 
 Rabitat has a stronger creative identity, a capable internal team and a repeatable system for producing work that builds the brand and supports growth.
   

  

**Past Experience And Candidate Requirements**
**Must\-haves**
* Typically 5\-7\+ years of experience in creative, content, advertising, production, brand or integrated marketing roles.
* Experience leading creative work from idea to final execution with an in\-house creative team, agency team, freelancer, creators, production partners or creative pod.
* A portfolio that demonstrates all three of the following:
+ Strong writing and concept development
+ On\-set direction or production experience
+ Editing, packaging and final delivery

* Experience developing and directing video, social\-first content, advertising or brand campaigns and performance marketing creatives
* Strong creative judgement and the ability to recognise what makes an idea distinctive across both brand and conversion contexts.
* Ability to evaluate talent, improve output quality and make clear decisions on team structure.
* Strong writing skills across scripts, hooks, headlines, captions and product communication.
* Comfort working with creative metrics and using performance feedback to improve the work.
* Ability to present and defend a creative point of view while remaining open to useful feedback.


**Good\-to\-haves**
* Experience building a brand or creative function from an early or transitional stage D2C, consumer, kids, parenting, lifestyle, foodware, FMCG or e\-commerce brand.
* Experience creating brand\-led IPs, recurring content franchises or creator ecosystems.
* Experience with parent communities, influencer marketing or UGC.
* Experience working with products where safety, quality, utility and trust are important purchase drivers.
* Experience writing or directing content in Hinglish or Indian languages.
* Familiarity with website, marketplace, CRM and product\-page content.
* Basic understanding of motion design, sound, colour, cinematography or post\-production.
* Experience creating high\-quality, film\-led brand work with limited resources.
* Experience managing a creative budget or production budget.
* Background as a creator, director, writer\-editor, creative producer or content lead.


**Non\-negotiables**
* You must have proof of work across writing, shoots and edits.
* You are a hands\-on creative leader who can still get into the work.
* You understand that Rabitat is building a brand, not operating a factory for producing disconnected creatives.
* You are comfortable using metrics such as watch time, view\-through rate, engagement and channel growth to learn and improve.
* You can work with ambiguity and create structure where none exists.
* You are comfortable leading an existing team and making difficult calls about quality, capability and accountability.
* You can work productively with founders, marketing leaders, category owners, agencies and junior team members.
* You care about building something distinctive, not just completing a brief.
