title: Quality Control Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 MESSIANIC CLOTHING PRIVATE LIMITED is a textiles company headquartered in the M Block Market of Greater Kailash II, New Delhi, India. The company operates from a basement retail and operational space, focusing on apparel and textile\-related products. Situated in a well\-established commercial area, the organization serves local and regional customers seeking quality clothing. Team members work in a dynamic environment that prioritizes product quality, consistency, and timely delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Delhi, India for a Quality Control Specialist. The role involves inspecting textile and garment products at various stages of production to ensure they meet established quality standards and specifications. The Quality Control Specialist will perform routine checks on raw materials, in\-process items, and finished goods, document inspection results, and report defects or deviations to the production and management teams. The position includes collaborating with production staff to implement corrective actions, maintaining quality records, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. The specialist will also help align processes with company policies and relevant quality guidelines.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Quality Control and Quality Assurance, with the ability to apply these practices in a textiles or apparel manufacturing environment.
* Experience or knowledge in Quality Management and Quality Auditing to monitor processes, perform inspections, and support compliance with internal standards.
* Understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) principles and their application in production workflows to ensure consistency and safety.
* Attention to detail, ability to identify defects and patterns, and skill in maintaining accurate documentation and reports.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate with production teams and management, and to clearly convey quality\-related findings.
* Ability to work on\-site in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple inspections, and prioritize tasks to meet production timelines.
* Prior experience in textiles, garment manufacturing, or a related quality\-focused role is preferred.
* Relevant diploma or degree in textiles, quality management, industrial engineering, or a related field is an advantage.

Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, we have made significant progress and our balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several midsized Banks and NBFCs.
   

  

 A well established brand and top 3 player in the Capital Markets space, today our product suite comprises of a welldiversified look, with equal weightage and focus given to the 3 lines of business. Having seen a y.o.y cumulative growth of 50% in both topline and bottom line, sustainable profitability continues to be the key management agenda.
   

  

 The company has a welldefined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending spacespread across both retail HNI and corporate clientele. We have made significant investments in our process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all our business processes. Spread across 18 cities, we plan on further diversifying our risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing our customers a onewindow shop for all their financing needs.
   

  

 The Risk and Compliance function is engaged in evaluating the creditworthiness of the loan applications for CMG, CFG, SME and BIL/PL lending divisions considering the quantitative \& qualitative factors like ownership, size \& market presence of the client business, capital adequacy, collateral quality, earnings quality, liquidity, management quality \& client credibility \& adherence to statutory requirements.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify early warning signals of stress and to minimize NPAs. Currently monitoring is done in association with Business Teams as RMG does not have presence at Branch level. It carries out over due loan recovery from defaulting clients in coordination with Business Teams.
   

  

 The Credit Analyst is an integral part of the Risk \& complianceand is responsible for analyzing the proposal with the required due diligence and to ensure that all information required to take a credit decision is captured in the proposal.

 Ensuring faster TATs in a highly competitive \& dynamic market conditions and scale of operations due to voluminous retail transactions as well as structured high value deals.
   

  

 Liasing with external agencies (legal, Technical, verification) to ensure that crdit risk, customer risk \& property risk are all mitigated.
   

  

 Cross functional coordination to enable timely approval of credit proposals.
   

  

 Pro active monitoring and regularization of sticky accounts as well as pending documents.
   

  

 Self updation on economic / sectoral changes in the economy
   

  

 Seamless coordination with multiple internal and external entities
   

  

 Profile also requires good interpersonal skills due to high cross functional engagement not only internal teams and stake holders but also with external agencies.
   

  

 The role also calls for team management and manmanagement skills as the Sr. Credit Analyst needs to coordinate with various people to achieve his job objectives.

title: Presales Engineer (Android)
description:
**About Wiseasy** 




 At Wiseasy, we're not just leading the charge in payment innovation; we're redefining it. Our mission is to empower and integrate global innovation in Intelligent Payments. We do this by specializing in cutting\-edge 'SMART' terminals and comprehensive payment technology services.
 



 Our full suite of enterprise solutions, encompassing "Cloud \+ Software \+ Terminals," is designed to transform the landscape of financial transactions. We are the catalysts for change in the payments space, enabling banks, acquirers, fintech companies, telecom operators, and Industry Solution Providers (ISVs) to offer a spectrum of financial services and create new revenue streams. These services are tailored to enhance cost\-efficiency, operational effectiveness, and raise the bar of customer satisfaction.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 As a Presales Engineer (Android) at Wiseasy, based in India, you will play a crucial role in driving the adoption of our innovative payment solutions across the region. This is a
 **client\-facing role**
 where you will support customers and business partners — including resellers, distributors, and system integrators — by developing demo applications and Proof of Concept (PoC) solutions using Android SDK resources, tools, and technical expertise to effectively promote, sell, and support our products and services. The primary goal is to strengthen our customer and partner ecosystem and drive mutual success. This role requires approximately
 **15–20% travel**
 within India and potentially across the APAC region.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Collaborate with the Sales team to identify new business opportunities and drive customer acquisition across the Indian market.
* Engage with customers and business partners to understand technical requirements and propose appropriate solutions.
* Develop demonstrative applications to validate customer\-specified proof of concepts.
* Ensure seamless integration of our SDKs and APIs into clients' applications by analyzing logs and technical documents.
* Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate customers on our products and solutions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and provide timely, effective resolutions.
* Stay informed on India's digital payments landscape, including UPI, RuPay, and regulatory frameworks such as RBI guidelines, to better contextualize Wiseasy solutions for local clients.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* At least 2–3 years of experience in Android development or a Technical Support role, preferably in fintech or the card\-present transaction domain.
* Prior experience with Android POS terminals, payment gateways, and EMV specifications is a strong advantage.
* Proficiency in Java, Kotlin, or Flutter, with hands\-on experience in Android Studio or similar IDEs.
* Familiarity with India's payments ecosystem (UPI, NPCI, RuPay, Aadhaar\-based authentication) is a plus.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand and troubleshoot software issues independently.
* Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional Indian languages is an advantage. Mandarin communication skills will also be considered a plus.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, multicultural, and multilingual environment while managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on building long\-term customer relationships.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The
 **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** 
 is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.
   

  

 Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**
* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.


**Customer Service Excellence**
* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.


**COD \& Documentation Management**
* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.


**Operational Compliance**
* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.


**Safety \& Security**
* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.


**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**
* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.


**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**
* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


**Team Collaboration**
* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


**Experience** 
 :
   

  

  

* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.


**Eligibility Requirements:**
* Minimum age 18 years.
* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


**Key Competencies:**
* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**
**KRAs**
**KPIs**
 Delivery \& Pickup Performance
   

  

 On\-Time Delivery
   

  

  

* Pickup Adherence
* Delivery Productivity


 Service Quality
   

  

 First Attempt Delivery
   

  

  

* Shipment Handling Accuracy
* Customer Satisfaction


 COD \& Documentation
   

  

 COD Collection Accuracy
   

  

  

* POD Completion
* Zero Documentation Errors


 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

 Safe Driving
   

  

  

* SOP Adherence
* Uniform \& Grooming Compliance


 Operational Productivity
   

  

 Shipments Delivered/Picked Up
   

  

  

* Scanner Compliance
* Route Efficiency


**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
   

  

 Here’s what makes us stand out:
   

  

  

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


 This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work.
 **Come grow with us.**
**Disclaimer:**
 At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).
   

  

 Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.
   

  

 Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.**

description:
**Summary**
**Job Description:**
 A Warranty Claims Processor reviews, validates, and processes warranty claims for products and services. This role confirms claim eligibility, maintains accurate documentation, calculates reimbursements, and communicates with service partners, technicians, and internal support teams to resolve issues and monitor claim status.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Review, process, and submit warranty claims accurately and in accordance with Pentair product guidelines and policies.
* Monitor claim progress and follow up to resolve delays or outstanding issues.
* Maintain complete records of warranty work, including parts, labor, claim status, and supporting documentation for audits.
* Verify customer warranty coverage and clearly explain applicable terms and conditions.
* Partner with internal departments and external service partners to coordinate warranty repairs and support a timely, smooth customer experience.
* Track and order warranty parts as needed to help prevent service delays.
* Stay informed on tech bulletins, warranty policies, and procedures to ensure accurate claim filing.
* Support service, parts, and new equipment sales teams with warranty\-related questions or issues.
* Communicate via email with customers, technicians, and FPAs to support a seamless warranty process.
* Process claims payment for verified work orders dispatched
* Perform other warranty\- and claims\-related duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Education: High school diploma or equivalent; some industries or technical roles may require an associate's degree or specialized certification.

title: IP Admin Senior Analyst/ SME
description:
We are looking for IP Admin Senior Analyst/ IP Admin SME to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action. This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings. We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.
   

  

**Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments**
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Professionals with minimum 2 Years experience in Docketing will be considered
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision


**It would be great if you also had . . .** 
  

  

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data


**What will you be doing in this role?**
* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution


**About The Team**
 The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations. Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.
   

  

**Hours of Work** 
  

  

* This is a full\-time role requiring 40 working hours per week based out of Noida, India (IST).
* Work Mode\-Hybrid as per Clarivate location


 At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

 The typical journey will be:
 



**Find Organiser → Instagram Outreach → Call → Explain WhyNotTrips → Onboarding → GMeet Support → Experience Listing → Follow\-up → Activation** 




 You will work closely with the
 **founding and organiser\-success teams**

* Answer initial questions and address concerns

* Ensure interested organisers move from
 **lead → registered → onboarded → active**

 You will:
 


* Schedule and conduct
 **Google Meet sessions** 
 with organisers when required
* Walk organisers through the onboarding and listing process
* Understand their problems and help resolve onboarding\-related issues
* Coordinate with the product/technology team when a technical issue needs escalation
* Ensure organisers are comfortable using the platform before moving forward


 5\. Experience Listing \& Follow\-ups
 
 Getting an organiser onboarded is only the beginning.
 



 You will be responsible for following up with organisers to ensure they actually list their experiences.
 


* Follow up with organisers regarding pending experience listings
* Help them understand what information, images, pricing, availability, and other details are required

 The Ideal Candidate

**Find → Reach Out → Pitch → Follow Up → Solve Problems → Convert**

**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The
 **Ops Staff** 
 is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.
   

  

 The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Shipment Processing \& Operations**
* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.


**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**
* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.


**Operational Support**
* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.

title: Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – Embedded Source/Drain (eS/D) Epitaxy Integration
description:
**About the job** 




 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India's first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission "To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust."
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are seeking an experienced Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – Embedded Source/Drain (eS/D) Epitaxy Integration for advanced CMOS technologies at 28nm and below, including FinFET nodes. This role is responsible for driving advanced CMOS Process Integration Development, with primary ownership of embedded Source/Drain (eS/D) epitaxy process integration, enabling technology development, device performance optimization, yield enhancement, and manufacturing readiness.
 



 The successful candidate will drive embedded Source/Drain epitaxy process integration while working across FEOL integration, process\-device interactions, silicon characterization, DOE development, process optimization, technology qualification, technology transfer, and high\-volume manufacturing ramp. The role requires close collaboration with Process Module, Device, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
 



 At Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL), the Technology Development organization is responsible for developing, qualifying, and transferring various technology platforms from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing, enabling world\-class semiconductor technologies and manufacturing excellence.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Own embedded Source/Drain (eS/D) epitaxy process integration for advanced CMOS technologies (28nm and below), including selective epitaxial growth of SiGe, SiC, and SiP stressors, strain/stress engineering, dopant and junction optimization, eS/D integration scheme development, and thermal budget management to achieve target device performance, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Develop and optimize CMOS Process Integration technologies for 28nm and below technology nodes by driving process\-device interactions, DOE\-driven silicon learning, process characterization, and process window optimization.
* Analyze process integration trade\-offs using strong semiconductor device physics to optimize transistor characteristics, including Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, matching, variability, and reliability, while achieving target device performance and manufacturability.
* Support technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp activities, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Drive manufacturing excellence through defect reduction, process capability enhancement, process robustness, and yield ramp activities using SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, defect Pareto analysis, excursion investigations, and root\-cause analysis to improve process stability, device performance, and yield.
* Establish process\-to\-device and yield correlations through analysis of inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Utilize DOE, TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical analysis, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) to accelerate technology learning, process optimization, and yield enhancement. Experience with one or more of these tools is a plus.
* Collaborate with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to drive device characterization, reliability qualification, yield improvement, technology transfer, and production ramp.
* Provide technical expertise to solve complex process integration challenges while driving innovation, continuous improvement, and manufacturing excellence.



**Essential Attributes** 



* Strong expertise in advanced CMOS Process Integration for 28nm and below technology nodes, with solid understanding of FEOL integration, process\-device interactions, and semiconductor manufacturing.
* Demonstrated expertise in embedded Source/Drain (eS/D) epitaxy process integration, including selective epitaxial growth of SiGe, SiC, and SiP stressors, strain/stress engineering, dopant engineering, junction optimization, eS/D integration scheme development, and thermal budget management.
* Hands\-on experience in 28nm planar CMOS or more advanced logic technology nodes. Experience with FinFET technology, advanced patterning, selective epitaxial growth, and next\-generation device architectures is a plus.
* Strong semiconductor device physics foundation with the ability to optimize transistor performance parameters such as Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, variability, matching, reliability, and manufacturability through process integration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven experience in DOE development, process characterization, statistical analysis, process window optimization, silicon learning, and root\-cause analysis of process, device, yield, and reliability issues.
* Proven experience in technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated track record in yield improvement, defect reduction, SPC, Cp/Cpk enhancement, excursion management, process robustness, and high\-volume manufacturing support for advanced semiconductor technologies.
* Ability to correlate inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Experience with TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical tools, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) is a plus.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Strong communication, technical presentation, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical decision\-making in a fast\-paced semiconductor technology development environment.



**Qualifications** 



* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 3\+ to 10 years of experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 7\+ to 15 years of experience.
* Experience in 28nm planar CMOS, FinFET, or advanced logic technologies.
* Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics, process integration, DOE, statistical analysis, yield analysis, and process optimization.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

title: Lead Data Scientist - Industrial AI & Prognostics
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist with expertise in Predictive Maintenance, Prognostics and Health Management (PHM), and Industrial AI. You will develop advanced machine learning and AI solutions that improve equipment reliability, predict failures before they occur, optimize maintenance strategies, and enhance operational performance across NOV's global products and services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as an internal data science and AI expert, providing technical leadership and consulting to NOV business units, with a focus on Predictive Maintenance ( PdM ), Condition\-Based Maintenance (CBM), and Prognostics \& Health Management (PHM).
* Design, develop, validate, and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) and solutions for equipment health monitoring, anomaly detection, fault diagnosis, Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, and maintenance optimization.
* Develop predictive analytics solutions using operational, engineering, and sensor data to improve asset reliability, operational efficiency, and business performance.
* Lead the end\-to\-end data science lifecycle, including problem definition, data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, and performance monitoring.
* Research and apply advanced AI technologies, including deep learning, computer vision, Generative AI (GenAI), and Large Language Models (LLMs), to solve other complex engineering challenges.
* Collaborate with engineers, software developers, product teams, and subject matter experts to translate business needs into scalable, production\-ready AI solutions.
* Design scalable analytics pipelines and contribute to cloud\-based data science and MLOps platforms that support enterprise AI applications.
* Communicate technical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and contribute to technical documentation, publications, patents, and innovation initiatives.
* Mentor junior team members and promote best practices in data science, machine learning, and AI across the organization.


**Qualifications**
 You may be a good fit for our team, if you also meet the following requirements:
   

  

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related STEM discipline. A Ph.D. is preferred.
* 7–10\+ years of experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in industrial or engineering environments.
* Demonstrated experience in PdM /CBM/PHM, or asset reliability applications.
* Experience working with cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver production\-ready analytics solutions.
* Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics..
* Experience developing models for time\-series analysis, anomaly detection, fault diagnosis, Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, or failure forecasting.
* Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch , or Keras .
* Experience with computer vision, natural language processing (NLP), Generative AI, or Large Language Models (LLMs) is an advantage.
* Experience working with industrial equipment, sensor data, or operational systems in manufacturing, energy, oil \& gas, or related industries.
* Knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP), condition monitoring, rotating machinery, hydraulic systems, or reliability engineering is highly desirable.
* Ability to interpret Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), engineering drawings, and system architectures to understand equipment configurations is a big plus.
* Familiarity with Digital Twins, physics\-informed machine learning, or engineering simulation is a plus.
* Strong programming skills in Python and scientific computing libraries.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate software development, debugging, testing, and documentation while maintaining high standards of code quality.
* Experience with PySpark , SQL, and big data processing frameworks is an advantage.
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and software engineering best practices.
* Experience deploying machine learning models on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Proficiency with Cloud, Github , and Docker is required, while Databricks, MLflow , CI/CD, or other MLOps technologies is preferred.
* Proven ability to translate research into practical engineering solutions.
* Experience authoring patents, invention disclosures, peer\-reviewed publications, or technical papers is a big plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to solve complex engineering challenges.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Self\-motivated, collaborative, and capable of leading multiple projects in a dynamic environment.
* Strong written and spoken English.

 We own the full lifecycle of tenants and teams, the management dashboards, and the public APIs that enable enterprise customers to programmatically govern their Auth0 environments at scale. Our work spans RBAC, self\-service SSO, and the tooling that enables internal teams to support customers on their Auth0 journey.
 



 We work with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and React to build highly available and performant services. We ship with quality our recent launches have gone live with zero production bugs.
 


**What you'll be doing:**

* Strong expertise using Node.js (TypeScript) to build backend services and create and maintain public or internal APIs.
* Production experience building fullstack applications with React component architecture, state management, rendering performance, and modern tooling.
* Deep experience with PostgreSQL schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and migrations.
* Production experience with MongoDB document modeling, aggregation pipelines, and scaling patterns.
* Hands\-on experience designing and tuning caching layers (Redis) cache invalidation strategies, write\-through/write\-behind patterns, and TTL management.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve performance problems using profiling tools, APM instrumentation, load testing, and capacity planning.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and cloud environments; AWS and/or Azure experience is preferred.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated interest in mentoring and helping teammates grow.


**Good to haves:** 
* Experience building RBAC systems, multi\-tenant platforms, or identity and access management products.
* Experience designing and shipping APIs at scale, including versioning, rate limiting, schema design, and SDK readiness.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures, pub/sub systems, or asynchronous job processing.

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
Ozyn is an AI assistant that does real work. It researches, drives a browser, fills spreadsheets, sends email, and pauses to ask permission before doing anything consequential. It runs today on web, Slack and Telegram.
   

  

 It does not run properly on a phone. That is the single biggest gap in the product, and you would be the person who closes it.
   

  

 THIS IS OUR FIRST MOBILE HIRE
   

  

 You own iOS end to end: the architecture, the code, the App Store Connect account, releases, crash triage, and the decision about what stays web and what goes native. There is no mobile team above you or around you yet — you are the start of one.
   

  

 WHY THE PHONE MATTERS MORE HERE THAN FOR MOST PRODUCTS
   

  

 Ozyn's core interaction is an approval gate: the assistant works for several minutes, then stops and asks before it sends an email or spends money. Today that question arrives on a screen the user may not be looking at. A phone with a working, actionable notification isn't a nice\-to\-have for this product — it's the missing half of the core loop.
   

  

 THE FIRST THIRTY DAYS
   

  

 We want the app live on the App Store within your first month. That is a deliberately hard target and we would rather say so plainly than dress it up: it means shipping the shell we already have, well, rather than building the app you would design from scratch. The native rebuild comes after, informed by real usage.
   

  

 • Week one — Revive the shell, decide which of our two web skins it wraps, and put a TestFlight build on every phone at Tipstat, rough edges included.
   

 • Week two — Sign\-in working on every path: phone OTP, Google and Microsoft native bridges, and Sign in with Apple, which App Store review requires of us because we offer third\-party login. Safe areas and the Dynamic Island handled properly.
   

 • Week three — APNs live end to end: approve or reject a pending agent action from the lock screen, exactly once. Live progress for twenty\-minute runs that survives backgrounding.
   

 • Week four — Through App Store review and publicly live, crash\-free sessions above 99\.5%, and a release process written down so it doesn't live only in your head.
   

  

 THE PROBLEMS THAT MAKE THIS INTERESTING
   

  

 • Runs that outlive the screen — showing live progress across twenty\-minute agent tasks, surviving backgrounding and dropped connections, and reconciling state without ever showing an invented status.
   

 • Approvals as a first\-class mobile object — interactive notifications, idempotent actions, and the design question of how you give someone enough context on a lock screen to safely approve an email they haven't read.
   

 • Handing control back to the human — when our browser agent hits a login wall it asks the user to take over the session. On a desktop that's a window. On a phone it's an open design problem, and yours to answer.
   

 • Voice as a real input, on Indian mobile networks, with honest offline states and no silent data loss.
   

  

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   

  

 • 5\+ years building iOS, with at least two apps you shipped to the App Store and then maintained — through review rejections, OS upgrades and crash reports, not just to a v1\.
   

 • Swift and SwiftUI in production, and enough UIKit to know when to reach for it.
   

 • Push notifications done properly: APNs, notification service and content extensions, actionable notifications.
   

 • Comfort with a web view and a JS bridge. Version one wraps our web app. If that offends you on principle we're not a fit; if you can make a hybrid app feel genuinely good and then argue for what should go native, we are.
   

 • You've owned releases: certificates, provisioning, App Store Connect, and at least one rejection you talked your way through.
   

 • You write clearly. You'll be specifying backend work for people who aren't mobile engineers, and that specification is most of the coordination this role needs.
   

  

 Helpful, not required: real\-time and WebSocket\-heavy clients, Firebase Auth, accessibility as a habit rather than a retrofit, and a view on whether Android should be native or cross\-platform next year.
   

  

 Probably not a fit if you want a defined backlog and a mobile team around you, you won't touch the web codebase, or you want to work remotely. This role is on\-site in Bengaluru because the coordination is the job.
   

  

 HOW WE INTERVIEW
   

  

 Four conversations — an intro call, a teardown of an app you built, a practical session where you tell us how you'd get our actual situation to the App Store in a month, and a team and founder conversation. No algorithm puzzles, no unpaid take\-homes. We aim to decide within two weeks.
   

  

 To apply, send a note with links to apps you've shipped — tell us which one you're proudest of and what you'd do differently now.

description:
**About Eightfold**
 Eightfold is a global leader in AI\-native enterprise talent platforms, trusted by many of the world’s largest Fortune 500 organizations. Our platform is built from the ground up to operate at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4\-compliant environments for the U.S. Government, supporting users in 100\+ countries and 30\+ languages.
   

  

 Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still in the experimental phase. Backed by $410M\+ in funding and valued at $2B\+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
   

  

 What sets Eightfold apart is not just our technology and mission, but our people. We are a deeply technical, execution\-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our teams work closely across functions and locations to build systems that scale in real\-world enterprise environments.
   

  

**About the role :** 
 Eightfold is building the AI platform that powers talent decisions for enterprises worldwide. As our Test Architect, you own the overall quality of what we ship — across a complex, multi\-tenant SaaS platform and the AI models and copilots at its core. This is a hands\-on architecture role: you'll set the quality strategy, build the frameworks and guardrails that teams test against, and pioneer how we assure AI systems — from deep\-learning matching models to generative\-AI agents — at production scale. You won't just catch defects; you'll design the system that makes quality inevitable.
   

  

 What you'll own;
   

  

 Product quality strategy
   

  

* Define and drive the end\-to\-end test architecture, standards, and quality strategy across all products and services.
* Own the test strategy across layers — unit, API/contract, integration, UI, end\-to\-end — and the frameworks teams build on.
* Design quality gates into CI/CD so quality shifts left; make "green build \= releasable" true and trustworthy.
* Lead non\-functional testing: performance and scalability, reliability/resilience, security, and data quality across a high\-volume, multi\-tenant system.
* Build test data management and environment strategy for a platform handling sensitive candidate and employee data.
* Define the quality metrics that matter (coverage, escape rate, flakiness, MTTR, release confidence) and hold the org to them.
* Mentor and raise the bar for SDETs and QA engineers; influence engineering\-wide quality culture without needing authority.


 AI quality \& assurance
   

  

* Own quality for LLM\-powered copilots and agents — groundedness/hallucination checks, prompt and output regression, guardrail and safety testing, and red\-teaming.
* Drive AI\-accelerated testing: AI\-generated test cases, self\-healing automation, intelligent test triage and coverage analysis, and synthetic test\-data generation — using AI to make the whole QA function faster and smarter.


 What we're looking for;
   

  

* Bachelors Degree in Engineering (B.E/B.Tech in computer science or related discipline is preferred)
* 3\+ years in software quality/engineering ,owning quality at platform scale.
* Deep automation expertise — strong coding ability in one or more of Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks like Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar; solid API/contract testing.
* Proven design of test architecture and CI/CD quality gates (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) in cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strength in non\-functional testing — performance/load (k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar), reliability, and security fundamentals.
* Experience testing data\- or ML\-driven systems, or a clear track record of ramping fast into new technical domains and a genuine pull toward AI quality.
* The judgment and influence to set standards across many teams, and the communication to make quality a shared goal, not a gate.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently and within a team structure


 Bonus points
   

  

* Hands\-on experience building LLM/GenAI evaluations (RAG evaluation, prompt regression, LLM\-as\-judge, eval frameworks) or testing ML pipelines and model performance.
* Familiarity with responsible\-AI concepts: bias/fairness metrics, model explainability, AI governance.
* Enterprise multi\-tenant SaaS background; HR\-tech or other regulated/high\-compliance domains a plus.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted tooling into a QA or engineering org.


 Why this role matters
   

  

 The quality of Eightfold's products directly shapes career and hiring decisions for millions of people. Getting AI quality right here isn't a nice\-to\-have — it's a matter of trust and fairness. You'll be the person who makes sure we earn that trust every release.
   

  

 Hybrid Work
   

  

 Eightfold follows a hybrid work model that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration. Employees based near our Santa Clara, Bangalore, and Noida offices are expected to work from the office three days per week, as regular in\-person engagement is essential to how we build high\-impact products and strong teams.

Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

 **Summarized Purpose**


Join ThermoFisher Scientific as a Senior Systems Developer and help build the software platforms that support scientific workflows and customer outcomes. You will design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable Java applications and services used across enterprise and laboratory\-facing environments. Working with product, QA, platform, and business partners, you will turn complex requirements into reliable cloud\-ready solutions that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.  

This role is suited to a hands\-on senior Java engineer with strong Spring Boot and microservices experience. You will contribute across the delivery lifecycle\-from technical design and API development through automated testing, deployment, production support, and mentoring teammates.

 **Education / Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification.
* Minimum of 7\-9 years of professional software or systems\-development experience, with substantial hands\-on Java development experience.
* Experience delivering enterprise applications in an Agile, cross\-functional environment.
 **Major Job Responsibilities**  

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain production\-grade Java and Spring Boot applications, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Translate functional and non\-functional requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and maintainable code.
* Build service integrations using well\-designed, versioned APIs and resilient communication patterns.
* Develop data\-access components and optimize SQL for relational databases, including MySQL and Oracle.
* Partner with architects and engineering teams on scalable microservices architecture, service boundaries, observability, and performance.
* Produce automated unit, integration, and API tests; investigate defects; and improve code quality, test coverage, and application reliability.
* Participate in peer reviews, technical design discussions, release planning, and continuous improvement activities.
* Use Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Jira to plan, build, test, release, and trace work through the software\-development lifecycle.
* Apply secure coding practices, including authentication/authorization, input validation, secrets management, and dependency/security remediation.
* Create and maintain technical documentation for APIs, designs, operational procedures, and support handoffs.
* Collaborate effectively with product owners, QA, DevOps, and global engineering teams; communicate risks, decisions, and progress clearly.
* Guide and support less\-experienced developers through code reviews, technical coaching, and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in an on\-call support rotation, as needed, to diagnose and resolve production issues.
 **Must\-Have Skills**  

* Strong, hands\-on proficiency in Java and Spring/Spring Boot for enterprise application and service development.
* Demonstrated experience designing, developing, documenting, and consuming RESTful Web APIs.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed\-system fundamentals, and API integration patterns.
* Experience with Spring ecosystem capabilities such as Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, or comparable tools.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle; ability to design schemas, diagnose query performance, and maintain data integrity.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud deployment concepts.
* Hands\-on Node.js development experience.
* Proficiency with Git\-based source control, pull\-request workflows, and Maven or comparable build tooling.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and using Jira for backlog, sprint, and defect management.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills, including production\-issue investigation.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate independently across technical and business teams.
 **Good\-to\-Have Skills**  

* Experience with Angular and TypeScript front\-end development in applications backed by Java microservices.
* Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, service discovery, and observability/monitoring tools.
* Experience with test\-driven development, JUnit, Mockito, integration testing, and code\-coverage tools such as JaCoCo.
* Experience designing or operating CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including automated builds, deployments, and release management.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and practical integration of AI services or capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Experience in regulated, scientific, healthcare, life\-sciences, or other quality\-sensitive software environments.

title: Web Developer (React.js, Laravel, and MySQL)
description:
**About Us** 





 Highshine IT Solutions is a leading provider of ERP services, dedicated to helping businesses streamline their processes and achieve operational excellence. We pride ourselves on delivering tailored ERP solutions that meet the unique needs of our clients.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 At Highshine, we don't see our website as a digital brochure; we see it as a growth engine. We're looking for a Web Developer who can combine technical skills, analytical thinking, user experience understanding, and marketing collaboration to continuously improve our websites and turn visitors into customers.
 




  






 This is a hybrid role, roughly 60% hands\-on development (React.js, Laravel, MySQL) and 40% growth, optimisation, and marketing collaboration. You'll be the person responsible for ensuring our websites are fast, effective, measurable, and constantly evolving, building websites, optimising user journeys, running experiments, improving conversion rates, integrating tools, and owning a business\-critical digital asset.
 




  






 You'll report directly to the leadership team and have full deployment authority for day\-to\-day changes, with major initiatives reviewed jointly with marketing and leadership before rollout.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) Website Development \& Maintenance** 

  
 




 Design, build, and maintain company websites across India and Europe using React.js, Laravel, and MySQL, including API integrations, feature builds, and bug fixes. Ensure website reliability, security, hosting, backups, and performance, coordinating with external agencies when required.
 



  





**2\) Website Growth \& Optimisation** 

  
 




 Own website performance, UX, and conversion rates end\-to\-end, with a focus on improving conversion rates and reducing page load times; analyse user behaviour and monitor outcomes to identify growth opportunities.
 



  





**3\) Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)** 

  
 




 Run A/B tests and growth experiments on landing pages, forms, CTAs, and user journeys, and implement winning variations in partnership with leadership and marketing.
 



  





**4\) Marketing Technology \& Integrations** 

  
 




 Configure and maintain tools like Hotjar, Google Analytics, Tag Manager, and CRM/marketing automation platforms, ensuring leads are tracked and routed correctly.
 



  





**5\) SEO \& Website Visibility** 

  
 




 Implement technical SEO and Core Web Vitals improvements, including multi\-region optimisation for European markets, supporting marketing on on\-page SEO for organic growth.
 



  





**6\) International Website Management** 

  
 




 Manage regional websites, domains, and localisation across geographies while maintaining brand consistency.
 



  





**7\) Product Ownership** 

  
 




 Gather and convert requirements from leadership, sales, and marketing into prioritised initiatives, validating solutions pre\- and post\-launch.
 



  





**8\) Web Design** 

  
 




 Design website visuals, banners, and layout elements, along with posters and creatives for campaigns, events, and marketing collateral, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines. Should be familiar with Figma, Canva, or other relevant tools.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




**Must Have** 



* 2\-4 years of experience in website development, web operations, growth engineering, or digital product management (1\-2 years considered for an Associate track).
* Strong hands\-on experience with the following tech stack: Frontend \- React.js, Backend \- Laravel, Database \- MySQL.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern website architectures.
* Experience with Git/version control and writing clean, maintainable, testable code.
* Experience working with CMS platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Framer, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of website analytics and user behaviour tools.
* Working knowledge of web design tools such as Figma, Canva, or similar, for creating website visuals and layout elements.
* Familiarity with AWS (or similar cloud platforms) for hosting, deployment, and basic infrastructure management.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and Core Web Vitals.
* Ability to independently own projects from idea to implementation.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Experience with Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Hotjar, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation.
* Experience working with marketing teams.
* Understanding of APIs and integrations.
* Exposure to international websites and localisation strategies.
* Basic UI/UX understanding.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Full ownership of a business\-critical digital asset with direct visibility to senior leadership.
* Close collaboration with a technically strong marketing and sales team to shape growth strategy.
* Exposure to international website management across India and Europe.
* A defined growth path aligned with company expansion.
* The opportunity to build and scale a growth engineering function from the ground up.



  






 Career growth and advancement opportunities: If you are a driven engineer or growth professional looking to build a high\-impact career at the intersection of technology, marketing, and product, we invite you to grow with us. Join Highshine IT Solutions and take ownership of a digital asset that directly shapes business growth.
 




  





**How to Apply** 





 Please send your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this position to
 
 recruitment@highshine.in
 
 .
 




  





*Highshine IT Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

* Security\-first engineering: audit logging, secrets handling, OWASP awareness, least\-privilege design.



  





**Nice\-to\-have:** 



* LLM model\-gateway concepts, token metering, and cost attribution.
* BFSI / regulated\-industry experience; PII handling and data\-residency awareness.
* Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability (Prometheus / Grafana).

title: Senior Backend JavaScript Developer
description:
We’re looking for exceptional Senior Backend JavaScript Developers to join our DCA\_csm team, with deep expertise in Node.js and building production\-grade backend services.
   

  

 In this role, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of product and feature development, building SaaS applications and services in a microservices architecture, using modern technologies in a fast\-paced and professional environment.
   

  

**Tech Stack:**
 Node.js, JavaScript, MongoDB, Kubernetes, Redis (including Redis Streams), Snowflake
   

  

*(plus additional relational/NoSQL data stores as needed)*
 Responsibilities:
   

  

* End\-to\-end feature development, from design and implementation to production rollout and ongoing improvements.
* Build and operate backend services with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and performance in a microservices environment.
* Participate in system design and architecture planning, and contribute to technical decisions across the team.
* Work with asynchronous, message\-driven components using Redis Streams, including debugging, tuning, and ensuring resilient processing.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code with appropriate test coverage; participate actively in code reviews.
* Collaborate effectively with teammates and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-impact outcomes.
* Continuously learn, adapt, and stay up\-to\-date with best practices and evolving technologies.


 Requirements:
   

  

* 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, including 3\+ years focused on backend JavaScript / Node.js development.
* Proven experience building and maintaining SaaS applications and/or production backend services.
* Experience working in a microservices architecture (service boundaries, APIs, reliability patterns).
* Hands\-on experience with MongoDB and Redis (including practical experience with Redis Streams or similar pub/sub/stream processing).
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized deployments.
* Good understanding of system design fundamentals: APIs, data modeling, performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Fast learner, able to work both independently and as a team player.
* Proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.


**Nice to Have:**
* Experience with Snowflake and data pipelines/analytics.
* Experience with AWS and cloud\-based production environments.
* Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL/MySQL) and additional NoSQL technologies.
* Experience with observability tooling (logging/metrics/tracing) and incident response.
* Fully remote position (for candidates who are not from Israel)\*

description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. ****Job Description****
 In this role, you will help design, build, and deliver the next generation of operational claims systems supporting Allstate Dealer Services. This platform is a strategic investment in the future of the business, enabling more efficient operations, faster service delivery, improved customer experiences, and long\-term cost optimization.
   

  

 As a technical leader on the team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, and delivery of modern backend services and applications that support key business capabilities. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate complex operational needs into scalable, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions.
   

  

 This role includes ownership of applications in production, driving engineering best practices, and helping shape the technical direction of a platform that will modernize how Dealer Services manages claims operations. Your work will directly contribute to reducing operational complexity, accelerating delivery of new capabilities, and improving outcomes for customers and the business.
   

  

* .Net Developer:\-


 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting enterprise payment solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including iteration planning, standups, and retrospectives, helping drive continuous improvement across the team.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver customer\-focused solutions.
* Contribute to the architecture, development, and operation of scalable microservices and distributed systems.
* Apply engineering best practices including clean code principles, test\-driven development, code reviews, and automated testing.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes that support reliable software delivery.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in production environments.
* Contribute to the codebase while ensuring adherence to coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices.


**Essential Skills**
* 6\+ years of software development experience using C\# and the .NET framework, including designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing enterprise applications.
* Experience designing and building REST APIs, including documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), versioning, testing, and service integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of software development concepts, object\-oriented design principles, and modern engineering practices.
* Solid knowledge of relational database design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and SQL development.
* Experience creating products using Test Driven Development (TDD) and testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, or equivalent.
* Experience with CI/CD and DevOps methodologies using tools such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, SonarQube, or similar technologies.
* Experience developing and supporting production services and implementing observability using Datadog or equivalent monitoring solutions.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker for deploying and managing applications.
* Familiarity with modernizing applications and services toward current .NET platforms, including .NET 8\.
* Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
