description:
**About InRhythm** 




 InRhythm (www.inrhythm.com) is a leading modern product consultancy and digital innovation firm with a mission to make a dent in the digital economy. Founded in 2002, InRhythm is currently engaged by Fortune 50 enterprises to bring their next generation of digital products and platforms to market. InRhythm has helped hundreds of teams launch mission\-critical products that have created a positive impact worth billions of dollars.
 



  





 InRhythm’s unique capabilities of Product Innovation and Platform Modernization services are the most sought\-after in the industry. An Inc. 5000 Hall of Fame Fastest Growing Company for 9 years, Deloitte Fast 500 company for 5 years, and Consulting Magazine Fastest Growing Company winner several years in a row.
 



  





 Our clients include a broad range of highly visible enterprises including Goldman Sachs, Fidelity, Morgan Stanley, Mastercard.
 



  





**Job Title: Senior Java Backend Engineer (L3\) (Strong Expertise in DSA)** 




**Experience: 7–10 Years Experience** 




**Work Mode: Mon \- Fri (On\-site) Full\-Time** 




**Location: Bangalore, India** 




  





**Data Structures \& Algorithms** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a talented and driven Senior Java Backend Engineer (L3\) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be a key individual contributor responsible for designing, developing, and owning critical backend services and components. You will work alongside senior architects and leads to build high\-performance, reliable systems while demonstrating technical ownership, mentoring junior engineers, and contributing to engineering best practices.
 



 This is an individual contributor role with technical influence – you’ll be expected to independently drive feature delivery, make sound design decisions, and raise the bar for engineering quality.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •Design, develop, and maintain scalable Java\-based backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
 



 •Own feature delivery end\-to\-end – from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
 



 •Build and optimize microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and event\-driven architectures.
 



 •Write clean, well\-tested, production\-ready code following SOLID principles and design patterns.
 



 •Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and frontend engineers to define and deliver product requirements.
 



 •Participate actively in architecture discussions, design reviews, and sprint planning.
 



 •Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive, actionable feedback to peers.
 



 •Mentor junior engineers (L1/L2\) through pairing sessions, knowledge transfers, and
 



 technical guidance.
 



 •Troubleshoot and resolve production issues; improve system observability, performance, and reliability.
 



 •Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and DevOps best practices.
 



 •Stay current with industry trends, evaluate new tools/frameworks, and recommend adoption where appropriate.
 



 •Write and maintain technical documentation for systems, APIs, and runbooks.
 



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 




 •5–8 years of professional Java backend development experience (Java 11 / 17 / 21\).
 



 •Strong expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and Hibernate/JPA.
 



 •Solid experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
 



 •Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) – query optimization, indexing, schema design.
 



 •Working knowledge of NoSQL databases (Redis, MongoDB, or Cassandra).
 



 •Hands\-on experience with messaging systems – Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.
 



 •Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
 



 •Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design.
 



 •Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
 



 •Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and practicing TDD (JUnit 5, Mockito, TestContainers).
 



 •Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading, and JVM internals.
 



 •Strong communication and collaboration skills in an Agile/Scrum environment.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** 




 •Experience in financial services, fintech, or capital markets domain.
 



 •Familiarity with cloud platforms – AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, SQS, RDS) or GCP.
 



 •Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
 



 •Experience with GraphQL or gRPC APIs.
 



 •Exposure to reactive programming – Project Reactor or RxJava.
 



 •Familiarity with observability tools – Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog.
 



 •Experience with Kotlin or Python as a secondary language.
 



 •Contributions to open\-source projects.
 



  





**Tech Stack** 




 Java 17/21, Kotlin
 



 Frameworks
 



 Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate
 



 Databases
 



 PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
 



 Messaging
 



 Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ
 



 Testing
 



 JUnit 5, Mockito, TestContainers
 



 DevOps
 



 Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions
 



 Cloud
 



 AWS / GCP
 



 Observability
 



 Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack
 



  





 InRhythm is committed to being an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds regardless of race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law. We encourage
 



 you to apply and join our community of thought leaders and innovators.

title: Software Engineer, Rust Platform
description:
**About Soket AI** 




 Soket is an AI research firm headquartered in Bengaluru with a mission to build efficient and generalized intelligence for humanity. We are focused on advancing frontier AI research through the development of large\-scale foundation models in math, code and reasoning that are open, energy\-efficient, multilingual, and responsible by design. At Soket, we work across large language models, multimodal systems, speech technologies, reasoning systems, and large\-scale AI infrastructure, with a strong focus on open research and practical deployment.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Software Engineer – Platform with 3–4 years of professional software engineering experience to help build and scale the platform powering Tensorstudio — Soket's AI API and developer platform.
 



  





 This is primarily a backend/platform engineering role, with opportunities to work across infrastructure, APIs, developer tooling, integrations, and internal interfaces.
 



  





 Rust experience is mandatory for this role (minimum 2 years of production Rust experience required).
 



  





 You will work closely with backend engineers, AI researchers, infrastructure teams, and product teams to build reliable systems that expose and operate AI capabilities at scale.
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 



* Design, develop, and improve backend services powering Tensorstudio and Soket's enterprise AI services.
* Build scalable APIs and platform services for AI applications.
* Develop platform capabilities such as authentication, API management, usage metering, billing, payments, and account management.
* Build and maintain services and components in Rust (minimum 2 years production experience required), along with other backend technologies where appropriate.
* Integrate backend systems with third\-party libraries, AI providers, payment systems, and cloud services.
* Build asynchronous and distributed services for AI workloads.
* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud\-native services using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Build reusable SDKs, utilities, and developer tooling.
* Contribute to developer\-facing interfaces, dashboards, and analytics where required.
* Work with AI researchers and product teams to productionize AI capabilities.
* Participate in debugging, performance optimization, monitoring, and reliability improvements.



  





**You Are a Good Fit If You** 



* Have 3–4 years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, or full\-stack development.
* Have strong hands\-on experience with Rust (minimum 2 years in production systems) and have built production\-quality software using Rust.
* Have experience building backend services, APIs, or distributed systems.
* Understand REST APIs, service architecture, databases, caching, and asynchronous processing.
* Can independently take ownership of a feature from implementation through testing and deployment.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Are comfortable working across backend, infrastructure, and developer tooling when required.
* Enjoy solving platform, integration, scalability, and reliability problems.
* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**Required Technical Experience** 




  





**Backend** 



* Rust — minimum 2 years of production experience (mandatory)
* Experience with at least one additional backend language such as Go (1\+ year), Python (1\+ year), or Node.js/TypeScript (1\+ year)
* REST APIs and backend service development (2\+ years)
* Streaming APIs or event\-driven systems (1\+ year)
* PostgreSQL or similar relational databases (2\+ years)
* Redis or similar caching / messaging systems (1\+ year)
* Familiarity with asynchronous processing and distributed systems (1\+ year)



  





**Platform \& Infrastructure** 



* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Authentication, authorization, and API security (1\+ year)
* CI/CD and cloud deployments (1\+ year)
* Monitoring, logging, and observability tools (1\+ year)
* Familiarity with Linux and production debugging (2\+ years)
* Experience building SDKs or developer tooling
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure (1\+ year)



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building AI/LLM APIs or AI infrastructure (1\+ year preferred)
* Payment gateway integrations
* Usage metering and billing systems
* OpenMeter or similar metering systems
* Message queues / job processing systems
* React or Next.js for internal dashboards



  





**Why Work With Soket?** 




 At Soket, you'll work on the platform behind the next generation of AI applications.
 



 You'll get the opportunity to work across backend systems, Rust services, AI infrastructure, APIs, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, and platform integrations, while collaborating closely with researchers building frontier AI systems.
 



  





 If you enjoy building reliable systems, learning quickly, and solving challenging engineering problems at the intersection of software infrastructure and AI, you'll feel right at home at Soket.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Are you excited about working with cutting\-edge network technologies?**
**Are you a developer who loves solving complex problems?**
**Join the Network Operations Systems Group**
 Our team develops innovative solutions crucial to deploying and maintaining Akamai's global network. Our network carries over 20% of the world's web traffic. We care about empowering Network Infrastructure, Operations and Engineering teams to work faster, reliably and more efficiently. We believe collaboration and continuous improvement lead to the best solutions.
   

  

**Partner with the best**
 You will be part of a diverse team that designs, develops and maintains high\-reliability systems. You'll have an opportunity to work and collaborate in an international environment with cross\-functional teams, including stakeholders and other developers. You will be responsible to deliver high\-quality software solutions. These solutions include distributed systems with both web and console interfaces.
   

  

 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Analyzing, designing, and implementing high availability systems software
* Bringing new functionality to a portfolio of services focused on automation, observability and identity management.
* Supporting the full product life cycle \- ideation, implementation, operation.
* Improving the ability of our software systems for testing, deployment, monitoring and maintenance
* Mentoring less experienced engineers to ensure quality solutions are implemented
* Evaluating emerging trends and technologies related to network operations and automation


**Do What You Love**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

* Have a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, or related field
* Have at least 4 years experience with programming in Python, Go and/or shell script
* Have at least 4 years development experience on Linux/ Unix platforms
* Have knowledge of common internet protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS and/or TLS/SSL
* Have experience with git/Stash and Perforce version control systems.
* Demonstrate exceptional communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal abilities \& a good team player.


**About Us**
 At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
   

  

 Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
   

  

**Our Focus Is Simple**
**Cloud and Edge:** 
 Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
   

  

**Security** 
 : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
   

  

**Content Delivery** 
 : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
   

  

**AI** 
 : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
   

  

 At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
   

  

**Benefits at Akamai:** 
 We support your health, well\-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
   

  

**FlexBase adapts to your job's needs**
 Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
   

  

 We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
   

  

 Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

description:
**About The Company**
 Marketnode is a digital market infrastructure (DMI) operator backed by Euroclear, HSBC, SGX Group and Temasek. title: Software Engineer (Systems) 3
description:
Responsibilities:
 



 Design and build scalable, distributed Data as a Service that ingest, process, and serve data from robotics, manufacturing, engineering, and clinical sources in real time and batch modes.
 



 Develop and maintain robust APIs, data services, and tooling to provide internal teams with secure, efficient, and intuitive access to high\-quality data.
 



 Partner with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to evolve data contracts and models that support emerging use cases and ensure semantic consistency.
 



 Implement CI/CD practices for data services, including automated testing for data quality, service reliability, and schema evolution.
 



 Championing a self\-service data culture by building discoverable, well\- documented data products and guiding teams toward empowered, autonomous data access.
 



 Act as a technical leader within the data domain driving best practices, mentoring teammates, and continuously improving how data is produced, shared, and consumed across the organization.
 



 Qualifications:
 



 Key Skills \& Experience:
 



 Solid quantitative background in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Math, or 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technically demanding role.
 



 Proficient in at least two major programming languages such as Python, Go, Scala, C\+\+, or Java, with a strong understanding of software design and architecture.
 



 Proven experience building data pipelines and working with distributed systems using technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, and Airflow.
 



 Strong collaborator who actively contributes to code reviews, system design discussions, sprint planning, and KPI evaluations to drive team excellence and technical quality.
 



 Minimum a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
 



 Bonus Points:
 



 Experience working on Data Platform or Infrastructure Engineering teams.
 



 Hands\-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, and Terraform.
 



 Familiarity with CI/CD best practices for DataOps and deployment automation.
 



 About the Data Services Team:
 



 We are a rapidly growing organization made up of Software and Data Engineers, with a strong DevOps culture, focused on building a next\-generation Data as a Service (DaaS) platform. We are seeking a strong technical lead who is passionate about designing scalable, real\-time data systems that deliver high\-quality, trusted data across the company.
 



 Our platform leverages technologies such as Apache Kafka for real\-time data ingestion, Apache Flink for stream processing and transformation, Snowflake for scalable warehousing, and AWS as our cloud backbone. We focus on serving data via APIs and event streams to enable on\-demand access, analytics, and machine learning across product and engineering teams.

**The role**
 As a
 **SAP Commerce Cloud Developer** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **4\-6\+ YEARS** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


****Role Responsibilities****
 Development \& Customization: Develop, customize, and extend SAP Commerce Cloud applications using Java, Spring Framework, and SAP\-specific extensions.
   

  

 Headless Commerce: Build and maintain headless storefronts using Spartacus (Angular/TypeScript) and integrate them via REST/OData APIs.
   

  

 Data \& Configuration: Write and maintain complex Impex scripts, FlexibleSearch queries, and manage Backoffice configurations.
   

  

 Integrations: Design and implement integrations between SAP Commerce Cloud and backend systems (SAP S/4HANA, SAP ERP, SAP CI/CPI, OMS, Payment Gateways, PIM).
   

  

 Cloud Management: Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications in the SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2\) environment using the Merchant Center / Cloud Portal and HAC.
   

  

 Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
   

  

 Code Quality: Conduct peer code reviews, write unit tests, and ensure adherence to SAP best practices and coding standards.
   

  

 Support \& Optimization: Provide L3 support, perform performance tuning, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
   

  

****Required Qualifications****
 Experience: \[4\-6\+] years of hands\-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development and implementation.
   

  

 Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Java (J2EE), Spring Framework, Hibernate, and object\-oriented design.
   

  

 SAP Commerce Expertise: Deep understanding of SAP Commerce data models, extension framework, Impex, FlexibleSearch, Backoffice, and WCMS (SmartEdit).
   

  

 Accelerators: Experience working with SAP Commerce B2B and/or B2C Accelerators.
   

  

 Frontend / Headless: Solid experience with Spartacus (Angular) or traditional SAP Commerce frontend (JSP/Tag files, AngularJS).
   

  

 Integration Skills: Experience with RESTful APIs, SOAP, OData, and integration middleware (SAP Cloud Integration / CPI is a strong plus).
   

  

 Database: Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., SAP HANA, MySQL, Oracle).
   

  

 Methodology: Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)**
 Certifications: SAP Certified Development Professional – SAP Commerce Cloud Developer.
   

  

 Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the broader SAP Customer Experience (CX) suite, including SAP CPQ, SAP Emarsys, or SAP Service Cloud.
   

  

 CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, and Cloud Foundry.
   

  

 Domain Experience: Previous experience in the \[Retail / Manufacturing / Wholesale / etc.] industry.

title: Sr. Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**


As a Staff AI Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling Teradata’s enterprise AI platforms and capabilities. This role goes beyond feature delivery—you will own architecture level decisions, influence AI platform strategy, and lead complex initiatives spanning agentic AI, LLM platforms, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, and developer facing AI systems.


You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, partner closely with product and architecture leadership, and raise the technical bar across multiple teams.


Key Responsibilities


*Technical Leadership \& Architecture*

* Lead the design and evolution of largescale, distributed AI systems that power Teradata’s AI platform and AI native products.
* Own end\-to\-end architecture for critical AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, vector search, semantic retrieval, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Drive technical strategy and architectural consistency across multiple engineering teams.

*AI Systems \& Platform Development*

* Design and implement production grade AI systems using LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and agent based architectures.
* Build scalable, secure, and reusable platform services and APIs supporting AI workloads across the software development lifecycle.
* Define and implement guardrails for reliability, safety, governance, and cost control in enterprise AI systems.

*Cross Functional Influence*

* Partner with product management, architecture, research, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
* Influence roadmap decisions by providing deep technical insight, tradeoff analysis, and long\-term platform thinking.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex system design, performance, and reliability challenges.

*Quality, Performance \& Operational Excellence*

* Drive best practices for testing, observability, evaluation, and production readiness of AI systems.
* Identify systemic performance bottlenecks and lead efforts to optimize distributed systems and AI pipelines.
* Establish engineering standards that improve development velocity, quality, and operational resilience.

*Mentorship \& Org Level Impact*

* Mentor Senior and Staff level engineers, providing guidance on architecture, design reviews, and technical decision making.
* Raise the overall engineering bar through design forums, technical reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Lead by example through hands on contributions to the most complex and business critical problems.

**Who You’ll Work With**


You will partner closely with product and architecture leadership, and raise the technical bar across multiple teams.


**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience building backend services, distributed systems, or data/AI platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Go, or Python, with experience building largescale services.
* Deep understanding of distributed system design, scalability, fault tolerance, and cloud native architectures.
* Proven experience designing and operating production systems with SQL and NoSQL data stores.

**What You’ll Bring**


* Experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Exposure to agentic AI patterns such as tool calling, planning, memory, and multi\-step reasoning.
* Experience building or operating AI systems in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production\-grade observability.

**Why We Think You'll Love Teradata**

We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Software Development Manager - Automation and AI Tools
description:
Software Development Manager \- Automation and AI Tools  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



In the HPE **Hybrid Cloud,** we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next\-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

**What you’ll do:**


Our engineering organization builds and operates the test automation, IO validation, and AI\-enabled developer tooling that HPE's global storage engineering teams rely on every day. This includes workload validation tools used across thousands of test cycles, emerging AI agents that accelerate product development through AI\-First SDLC, and high velocity test automation enabling advanced BI analysis. We're looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a talented team of roughly 10 engineers in Bangalore who build these tools, and to coordinate with a customer and stakeholder base that spans India, the US, and beyond.


This is not a purely technical management role. The team's leadership, roadmap partners, and end users are split across geographies and time zones. Success in this role depends as much on relationship\-building, negotiation, and influence as it does on engineering management fundamentals. If you enjoy the challenge of leading a strong local team while representing its work and priorities on a global stage, this role was built for someone like you.

***Responsibilities:***

* Provides direct and ongoing leadership for a team of individual contributors designing and developing new products, enhancements and updates, and coordinating projects for systems software.
* Manages headcount, deliverables, schedules, and costs for multiple ongoing projects, ensuring that resources are appropriately allocated and that goals, objectives, timelines, and budgets are met in accordance with program and organizational roadmaps.
* Communicates project status and escalates issues to direct managers, program managers, and internal and external development partners.
* Manages relationships with outsourced partners and suppliers, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, product quality, schedules, and costs; ensures that team members are effectively communicating and collaborating with outsourced resources.
* Proactively identifies opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
* Provides people\-care management for assigned team members, including hiring, setting and monitoring of annual performance plans, coaching, and career development; ensures that proper knowledge and career development tools are in place to support ongoing team member and process development.
* Serve as the primary bridge between the India\-based engineering team and a globally distributed stakeholder base, building trust, ensuring priority alignment, and maintaining momentum across time zones.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed organization, influencing peer managers, program leadership, and senior executives without direct authority to drive consensus and unblock cross\-team dependencies.
* Comfortable representing the team's work and advocating for its priorities in front of senior leadership located outside India, including navigating differing regional norms around process, escalation, and decision\-making.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education:***

* Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in CS, CEE, or related engineering discipline with supporting experience.

***Experience Required:***

* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2 to 5\+ years directly leading engineering teams (individual contributors and/or leads).
* Demonstrated success operating in a globally distributed organization by leading or closely partnering with teams/stakeholders in a different country and time zone than your own. Ideally this includes managing work and relationships between India and the US.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; able to distill technical status and risk into clear, concise updates for both engineers and senior executives.
* Track record of influencing peers and leadership without formal authority through negotiation, data, and relationship capital rather than escalation alone.
* Solid technical grounding in software engineering practice (SDLC, CI/CD, agile and/or waterfall project management) to enable making sound technical trade\-off decisions.

***Additional Experience Preferred:***

* Experience with test automation, hardware/storage validation, or developer productivity tooling.
* Sufficient working knowledge of languages and frameworks such as Python, React, C\+\+, and Go to review designs and engage credibly in technical discussions, not necessarily to write production code day\-to\-day.
* Familiarity with modern AI engineering concepts such as agents, agent skills, MCP servers, and applied LLM tooling.
* Prior experience managing outsourced partners, suppliers, or contingent staff alongside a core team.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Strong leadership skills, including coaching, team building, and conflict resolution.
* Advanced project management skills including time and risk management, resource prioritization, and project structuring.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage team members across geographies to drive workforce development and achieve desired results.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation, presentation, and influence skills.
* Advanced business acumen, technical knowledge, and extensive knowledge in applications and technologies.
* Strong multi\-tasking and prioritization skills.
* Strong communication skills (e.g. written, verbal, presentation); mastery in English and local language.
* Good understanding of the company's policies and processes.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**

title: Salesforce Chatbot Engineer
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Salesforce Chatbot Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
  
  

Scope of Services
  
  

* Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and enhance Salesforce Service Cloud solutions for enterprise customer\-service operations.
* Build Einstein Bots and digital assistants, including dialog design, intents, entities, variables, rules, actions, menus, authentication, contextual responses, and multilingual experiences.
* Implement seamless bot\-to\-agent escalation using Omni\-Channel, skills\-based routing, queues, presence, transcripts, pre\-chat context, and appropriate service\-level controls.
* Integrate bots with Salesforce data and external systems through Apex, Flow, REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and secure enterprise integration patterns.
* Develop responsive web experiences and supporting components using Lightning Web Components, Apex, Flows, and Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Implement and support digital messaging channels. Experience with WhatsApp messaging, routing, templates, consent, session handling, and escalation is preferred.
* Collaborate with service operations, product owners, architects, security, compliance, UX, analytics, and integration teams to translate customer journeys into scalable solutions.
* Establish automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, security scanning, code\-quality controls, release documentation, and production\-support practices.
* Analyze containment, transfer, fallback, abandonment, response, and resolution patterns to improve bot effectiveness and customer outcomes.
* Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and optimize reliability, performance, scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.


Required Service Cloud and Digital Assistant Experience
  
  

* Five to seven years of Salesforce platform experience, including at least four years of hands\-on Salesforce development.


Strong hands\-on Service Cloud experience with Case Management, Knowledge, Omni\-Channel, queues, routing, entitlements, milestones, macros, quick text, console applications, and service analytics.
  
  

* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering Einstein Bots or comparable enterprise conversational assistants for large companies with complex security, integration, availability, and support requirements.
* Experience developing conversation architecture, dialog flows, intents, entities, utterance handling, disambiguation, fallback strategies, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff.
* Experience grounding chatbot responses in approved enterprise content, Salesforce Knowledge, CRM data, and authenticated back\-end transactions while protecting sensitive information.
* Experience with asynchronous and synchronous digital channels such as web chat, in\-app messaging, SMS, social or messaging applications, and voice\-adjacent service journeys.
* Experience with WhatsApp as a customer\-service or chatbot channel is strongly preferred, including knowledge of channel setup, approved templates, opt\-in/consent, routing, session boundaries, and operational monitoring.
* Experience designing multilingual and localized assistants, preferably including English plus Spanish and/or Portuguese.
* Understanding of conversational UX, accessibility, plain\-language prompts, privacy by design, auditability, responsible AI controls, and regulated\-enterprise delivery practices.

title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll help develop and test software for scientific instruments and laboratory solutions. As a Software Test Engineer III, you'll ensure the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive testing strategies. Working in an adaptable environment, you'll collaborate with teams to validate software for mass spectrometers, electron microscopes, and other analytical instruments that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.  

  

You'll participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through final release. Your role includes designing and executing test plans, automating test procedures, documenting defects, and verifying resolutions. You'll work closely with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure our software meets the highest quality standards while supporting continuous improvement in our testing processes.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a highly experienced **Lead Quality Assurance Engineer** with 6–15 years of software testing and quality assurance experience, with strong expertise in **functional testing, regression testing, test case design, defect management, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support**. The role also requires strong hands\-on test automation expertise, including Squish GUI Tester for desktop GUI automation and Playwright with Python/Pytest for web, end\-to\-end, and regression automation.


The ideal candidate should have extensive experience validating complex enterprise applications, defining comprehensive test strategies, managing test execution, and ensuring high\-quality product releases. The candidate will work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, UX teams, and other stakeholders to ensure that software solutions meet functional, business, and quality requirements. The candidate should be able to define and evolve maintainable automation frameworks, select appropriate automation coverage, and integrate automated regression suites into CI/CD workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute **functional testing** activities for complex software applications and business workflows.
* Define test approaches, test scenarios, and detailed **test cases** based on functional and business requirements.
* Perform comprehensive **regression testing** to ensure that application changes do not impact existing functionality.
* Review requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and design specifications to identify test scenarios and potential gaps.
* Develop and maintain reusable manual and automated test cases, test suites, test data, and traceability between requirements and tests.
* **Design, develop, and maintain** automated GUI tests using Squish GUI Tester for desktop applications, including robust object identification, synchronization, reusable components, and data\-driven execution.
* **Design, develop, and maintain** end\-to\-end browser automation using Playwright with Python and Pytest for web application workflows.
* **Build and evolve** maintainable Pytest\-based automation frameworks using fixtures, parametrization, markers, reusable utilities, page\-object/component patterns, and clear test reporting.
* **Integrate automated regression suites** into CI/CD pipelines, support headless and parallel execution where appropriate, and analyze failures, flaky tests, and environment\-related issues.
* Execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and document test evidence and failures appropriately.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
* Perform detailed defect analysis and work closely with development teams to facilitate timely resolution.
* Conduct defect triage meetings and support prioritization based on severity, business impact, and release requirements.
* Verify defect fixes and perform appropriate regression testing before closure.
* Support **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** by preparing test scenarios, coordinating testing activities, and assisting business users.
* Analyze UAT findings and coordinate with product and development teams for issue resolution.
* Validate end\-to\-end workflows and integrations across multiple application components and systems.
* Participate in release planning and provide recommendations regarding application quality and release readiness.
* Monitor testing progress, defect trends, coverage, and overall quality metrics.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor QA team members and promote consistent testing standards and quality practices.

**Required Skills**

* **12–15 years of overall experience in software testing and quality assurance**.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **functional testing of enterprise software applications**.
* Extensive experience in **regression testing and end\-to\-end system validation**.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Squish GUI Tester** for desktop GUI automation, including object recognition, synchronization, reusable scripts/components, and maintenance of stable regression suites.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright** for browser\-based UI and end\-to\-end test automation, preferably using Python.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Pytest**, including fixtures, parametrization, markers, test organization, reusable utilities, and test reporting.
* **Strong Python scripting skills** for test automation, framework development, troubleshooting, and test\-data utilities.
* **Experience designing and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks** with reusable abstractions, page\-object/component patterns, configuration management, logging, and reporting.
* **Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines** and version\-control workflows, with the ability to diagnose automation, application, data, and environment failures.
* Strong expertise in designing effective **test scenarios, test cases, and test data**.
* Ability to analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria from a testing perspective.
* Strong experience with **defect identification, reporting, prioritization, tracking, and closure**.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as **Azure DevOps, Jira, ALM, or equivalent tools**.
* Strong understanding of the complete **Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)**.
* Good understanding of the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**.
* Experience supporting and coordinating **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**.
* Experience validating complex business workflows and application integrations.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and distinguish application defects from configuration, data, environment, and integration issues.
* Strong understanding of test coverage, requirements traceability, and risk\-based testing.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Ability to communicate testing status, quality risks, and release concerns clearly to stakeholders.

**Testing \& Quality Leadership Expectations**


The candidate should be capable of operating beyond an individual contributor role and should:

* Provide testing and quality leadership for complex software products and projects.
* Define appropriate **test strategies, test approaches, and quality standards**.
* **Define the test automation strategy** across desktop and web applications, including automation scope, framework standards, maintainability, execution model, and CI/CD integration.
* **Review automation architecture**, test code, and framework changes; mentor engineers on Squish, Playwright, Pytest, Python, and automation engineering best practices.
* Identify testing risks early and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Review and improve test scenarios and test cases developed by team members.
* Ensure adequate functional, automated, and regression coverage for product releases.
* Establish effective defect\-management and defect\-triage practices.
* Coordinate testing activities across development, product, business, and other QA teams.
* Provide clear quality assessments and recommendations for release readiness.
* Mentor QA engineers and promote testing best practices across the team.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, documentation, metrics, and overall product quality.
* Work effectively with globally distributed and cross\-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing **large\-scale enterprise, scientific, healthcare, engineering, or data\-intensive applications**.
* Experience testing complex web and desktop applications.
* Experience validating **REST APIs and backend integrations**.
* Familiarity with database validation and basic SQL queries.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent solutions.
* Experience with API automation, automation reporting, test\-result dashboards, parallel execution, and strategies for reducing flaky tests.
* Hands\-on familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing practices for executing Squish and Playwright/Pytest regression suites.
* Experience testing applications involving complex workflows, dashboards, configuration, or data visualization.
* Understanding of usability, accessibility, performance, and security testing concepts.
* Experience with requirements and test traceability in regulated or quality\-driven environments.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed development and business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate them into effective test scenarios.
* Ability to identify risks and communicate quality concerns effectively.
* Strong ownership and accountability for testing deliverables.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, business analysts, product owners, and end users.
* Strong mentoring and team\-coordination capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and testing activities across releases.
* Strong customer\-focused and quality\-oriented mindset.

**Education**


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.

title: NodeJS Developer
description:
Responsibilities:

\- Design, develop, and implement robust and scalable backend solutions using Node.js.

\- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

\- Collaborate with front\-end developers to integrate user\-facing elements with server\-side logic.

\- Implement Unit test to ensure the quality and reliability of the codebase.

\- Optimize application performance and scalability.

\- Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.

\- Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and best practices in backend development.

\- Mentor junior developers and contribute to their growth and development.

Requirements:

\- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field.

\- 5\+ years of experience in backend development using Node.js

\- Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks/libraries

\- Experience with relational databases e.g., MsSQL Server

\- Strong understanding of microservices architecture and RESTful API design principles

\- Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.

\- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

\- Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

\- Proficiency in using process management tools such as PM2 for monitoring, managing, and scaling Node.js applications in production environments

\- Familiarity with popular Node.js libraries and frameworks such as Express.js, Socket.IO, Koa, Nest.js, or Hapi.js

\- Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as JWT, OAuth, or Passport.js

\- Knowledge of asynchronous programming and handling of asynchronous operations in Node.js using Promises, async/await, or callbacks.

\- Understanding of event\-driven architecture and proficiency in using EventEmitter and other event\-driven patterns in Node.js applications.

\- Experience with testing frameworks such as Mocha, Chai, Jest, or Jasmine for writing unit tests, integration tests, and end\-to\-end tests for Node.js applications.

title: AI Native Engineer - RCFCR AI CoE
description:
**Job Summary**
* The AI\-Native Engineer is responsible for discovering, assessing, prototyping and redesigning end\-to\-end business processes using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation and data products. The role performs structured process discovery, assesses business value, establishes baseline metrics, evaluates data readiness, identifies the most appropriate AI solution pattern, and builds rapid prototypes using Microsoft AI suites or open\-source models. Enter input
* The role sits within the AI Centre of Excellence and acts as a practical bridge between business, process, data, engineering and governance teams. It is accountable for translating current\-state process pain points into future\-state AI\-enabled operating models aligned to a North Star 2030 vision.
* The role is expected to deliver measurable outcomes across productivity, cycle\-time reduction, quality improvement, control uplift, risk reduction and user experience.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Support the AI transformation agenda by identifying processes that can be materially improved or reimagined using AI, GenAI, agentic AI, workflow automation and data\-enabled solutions.
* Apply a 2030\-forward mindset to challenge current ways of working and design future\-state operating models that are simpler, faster, more intelligent and better controlled.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities, Microsoft AI tools, open\-source models and reusable enterprise patterns to recommend practical solutions for business problems.
* Contribute to reusable AI design patterns, prototype assets, discovery methods, value frameworks and process redesign playbooks.


**Business**
* Conduct structured process discovery with process owners, product owners, SMEs, operations teams and technology partners to understand the current\-state journey.
* Map end\-to\-end processes including upstream inputs, workflow steps, systems, decisions, controls, handoffs, rework, exceptions, downstream outputs and user experience.
* Identify process friction, manual effort, delays, duplication, control gaps, data issues, knowledge gaps and decision bottlenecks that can be addressed using AI.
* Assess business value across productivity, capacity release, cycle\-time reduction, cost avoidance, quality improvement, risk reduction, improved control effectiveness and better decision support.
* Create value hypotheses and business cases supported by quantified benefit assumptions, baseline metrics and prioritization rationale.


**Processes**
* Establish baseline metrics for current\-state processes, including process volumes, effort consumption, cycle time, SLA performance, error rates, rework levels, control breaks, cost per transaction and productivity measures.
* Assess data readiness by reviewing data availability, quality, lineage, ownership, access pathways, source systems, unstructured content, knowledge repositories and remediation needs.
* Determine the right AI tool or solution pattern for the business problem, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, intelligent automation, RAG architectures, knowledge agents, agentic workflows or open\-source LLMs.
* Perform build, buy, reuse or partner assessments and recommend the most appropriate path based on business value, feasibility, risk, scalability, governance requirements and delivery complexity.
* Build prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts and minimum viable solutions using Microsoft AI suites, approved enterprise platforms or open\-source models where appropriate.
* Redesign the end\-to\-end process into a North Star 2030 blueprint, defining the future\-state human plus AI operating model, agent\-in\-the\-loop and human\-in\-the\-loop controls, decision flow, data dependencies and adoption approach.


**Risk Management**
* Ensure proposed AI solutions are designed in line with responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, operational resilience, conduct and regulatory expectations.
* Identify process, data, model, control, adoption, operational and implementation risks during discovery, prototyping and future\-state design.
* Build appropriate human oversight, control checkpoints, usage boundaries, monitoring requirements and escalation points into solution designs.
* Partner with governance, risk, compliance and assurance stakeholders to ensure prototypes and scalable solutions are evidence\-led, controlled and auditable.


**Governance**
* Maintain clear documentation of process discovery outputs, baseline metrics, value assessments, data readiness findings, solution fitment decisions, prototype results and North Star process designs.
* Support AI stage\-gate forums and governance reviews with evidence\-based recommendations on prioritisation, investment, progression, redesign or retirement.
* Track expected and realised value against agreed baselines and success measures.
* Ensure AI initiatives are traceable from problem statement to value case, prototype, future\-state design and adoption plan.


**Key Deliverables**
* End\-to\-end process discovery reports and current\-state process maps.
* Process friction analysis, AI opportunity assessment and prioritisation recommendations.
* Baseline metrics scorecards covering volume, effort, cycle time, quality, rework, SLA, control and cost measures.
* Data readiness assessments covering data quality, availability, ownership, lineage, access and remediation requirements.
* AI solution fitment recommendations across Microsoft AI suites, enterprise platforms and open\-source model options.
* Prototype solutions, proof\-of\-concepts and AI demonstrators validating feasibility, value and adoption potential.
* North Star 2030 process blueprints and future\-state operating models for selected journeys.
* Human plus AI workforce design, including agent\-in\-the\-loop and human\-in\-the\-loop control models.
* Value realisation models, benefit tracking dashboards and executive\-level transformation updates.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
* Lead or support the relevant business/function/team to achieve outcomes aligned to Conduct Principles, where applicable.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have Skills**
* Process discovery, process mining and end\-to\-end journey mapping
* Value engineering, baseline metric definition and benefit realisation
* Data readiness assessment including data quality, ownership, lineage and access
* AI solution fitment across Microsoft AI suites, GenAI, agentic AI, RAG and automation patterns
* Rapid prototyping using Microsoft AI platforms, Power Platform, Azure AI and approved open\-source models
* Future\-state process redesign and North Star 2030 operating model design


**Other Skills**
* Action Oriented
* Collaborates
* Customer Focus
* Courage
* Instils Trust
* Nimble Learning
* Decision Quality
* Manages Ambiguity
* Strategic Mindset


**Motivations**
* The AI\-Native Engineer is successful when they can discover a process, quantify the opportunity, establish baseline metrics, assess data readiness, select the right AI solution pattern, build a working prototype, and redesign the end\-to\-end process into a North Star 2030 operating model that delivers measurable business value.


**Qualifications**
* 5\-8 years of experience in process transformation, consulting, AI delivery, digital transformation, business architecture, product engineering or operational excellence.
* Experience conducting process discovery, baseline measurement, value assessment and business case development.
* Experience building prototypes or MVPs using Microsoft AI platforms, enterprise automation tools or approved open\-source technologies.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, automation, data products and responsible AI considerations.
* Experience working across business, technology, data, governance, risk and operations teams in a regulated environment is desirable.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  


As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

  


**About the Role:**

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.



In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.

  


### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals.
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development.
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus.
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access.
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases.
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers.
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day.

### **We’re looking for:**

* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must.
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team.
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

**Language:**JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. **Problem\-Solving**

* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.

**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  


As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

  


**About the Role:**

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.



In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.

  


### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals.
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development.
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus.
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access.
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases.
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers.
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day.

### **We’re looking for:**

* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must.
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team.
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

**Language:**JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.
