title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Offers Expansion
description:
**Description**
 Behind every "Buy," "Rent," "Subscribe," or "Bundle" button on Prime Video is a decision our system made in milliseconds: what offer to show, at what price, with what promotions, for which customer, in which country. We own that decision.
   

  

 Our team within Prime Video Commerce owns critical offer orchestration and pricing services that power the global commerce experience. Our systems determine pricing, apply promotions, compose bundles, and serve the right offer to the right customer across every Prime Video surface. We process millions of requests per second, operate across 100\+ markets, and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction worldwide, spanning subscriptions, rentals, purchases, channels, and bundles.
   

  

 The challenge is not scale alone. It is scale plus rapid change. We are expanding into dozens of new marketplaces each year, each with unique payment methods, regulatory requirements, and pricing models. We are building dynamic pricing capabilities, enabling promotional experiences for major commercial events, and evolving how offers are composed as the product portfolio grows. Every new market and every new offer type adds combinatorial complexity to a system that must remain correct, fast, and available.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior SDE who wants to own hard problems in a system where getting it wrong means a customer sees the wrong price, cannot complete their purchase, or misses an offer they should have seen. You will own services end\-to\-end, make architectural calls, ship to production, and operate what you build. The work is technical, the impact is immediate, and the problems do not come pre\-solved.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and evolve offer orchestration and pricing services that determine what customers see globally, making architecture decisions for correctness, latency, and resilience
* Design systems that handle the combinatorial complexity of multi\-market, multi\-currency, multi\-promotion offer serving at millions of TPS
* Investigate and resolve production issues that cross service boundaries, often requiring deep analysis of traffic patterns, caching behavior, and downstream dependencies to find non\-obvious root causes
* Drive marketplace expansion from an engineering perspective: configuration, offer distribution, compliance requirements, and end\-to\-end validation across new territories
* Build and maintain operational health for Tier\-1 services: stress testing, capacity planning, alarm tuning, scaling strategies, and incident prevention
* Propose and drive architectural improvements that reduce operational toil, improve system reliability, or eliminate classes of production defects, without waiting to be asked
* Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture guidance, helping engineers across the team make better decisions and grow in scope
* Leverage AI tooling strategically to accelerate engineering workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve development velocity while maintaining quality and ownership of all design decisions


 A day in the life
   

  

 One morning you are tracing why an offer disappeared for customers in a specific region, following the data flow through multiple services until you find the filtering logic that does not account for a lifecycle edge case. The next day you are designing how a new promotional pricing type should propagate through the offer pipeline without breaking existing business rules. Later in the week you are reviewing stress test results, comparing actual traffic distribution against test configurations, and filing a scaling request based on your analysis. On Friday you are pairing with a newer engineer on their first multi\-market configuration change, helping them understand the compliance implications before they ship.
   

  

 The work moves between deep technical investigation, system design, production operations, and people development. You will not do the same thing two days in a row.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are part of the Prime Video Commerce organization, based in Bengaluru. We own services that power offer serving, pricing, and commerce experiences for customers globally. Our scope spans pricing and promotions, offer composition, bundling, and international expansion across dozens of markets.
   

  

 We work as part of a global engineering organization with counterparts across multiple locations and time zones. We respect time zones, value directness, and believe that the best engineering happens when people feel ownership over their domain and trust within their team. We are a high\-ownership team where individual contributions are visible and impactful.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Knowledge of professional software engineering \& best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* 3\+ years of distributed systems experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non\-technical leaders
* Experience building and operating high\-availability services in production with demonstrated ownership of operational health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in payments or e\-commerce
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in technical support and experience with automation and any version control tools
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience with international expansion: regulatory compliance, local payment methods, market\-specific configuration at scale
* Familiarity with caching strategies, traffic analysis, and capacity planning for high\-TPS services
* Hands\-on experience using AI/GenAI tools to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining quality standards
* Track record of identifying and driving improvements to operational health, testing practices, or development processes without explicit direction

description:
**About Connected Vehicle Data Platform**
 At Ford, data is at the heart of our transformation towards becoming a technology\-driven mobility company. Connected Vehicle Data Platform's mission is to build foundational, company\-wide systems and processes designed to intelligently collect, manage, control, and democratize all vehicle\-related data as key data products. Its purpose is to eliminate data fragmentation and duplication, enabling robust cloud and vehicle data capabilities that facilitate proactive issue identification, reduce regulatory penalties, recalls, and warranty claims, and ensure global compliance for evolving data use cases, especially for 2026 MY\+ vehicles.
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking a visionary Principal Engineer to serve as the technical authority for our Connected Vehicle Data Platform(200\+ engineering org), with a specific focus on
 **AI\-driven data architecture** 
 . In this role, you will bridge the gap between Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Applied AI. You will drive the architectural vision for how we process massive streams of vehicle data and lead the implementation of
 **Agentic flows and AI agents** 
 to automate data collection, governance, and insight generation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a "player\-coach" who remains hands\-on in the code while providing high\-level technical leadership. You will be responsible for designing resilient streaming architectures that leverage the latest in AI/ML to ensure our 2026 MY\+ vehicle data is not just stored but intelligently utilized to drive proactive business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Grounds\-Up Streaming Re\-architecture: Lead the technical vision and execution for re\-building the connected vehicle streaming foundation. Replace legacy systems with a modern, high\-throughput, and low\-latency stack designed for global scale and efficiency.
* IC Leadership of Senior Talent: Act as the primary technical mentor and lead for the portfolio’s Staff and Senior Staff Engineers. Drive technical alignment across an 80\+ person engineering organization through RFCs, architecture reviews, and "Golden Path" implementations.
* Advanced Data Modeling: Define the standards for database and time\-series data modeling. Architect specialized schemas for high\-cardinality vehicle telemetry that balance high\-speed ingestion with cost\-effective, performant querying.
* Agentic Data Insights: Design and develop AI Agentic flows that revolutionize how Ford interacts with data. Move beyond static dashboards by building agents capable of autonomously "answering data questions" interpreting natural language queries to generate real\-time insights from billions of vehicle data points.
* AI\-Driven Efficiency: Architect systems where Applied AI/ML is used to drive massive efficiency gains. This includes intelligent data pruning, automated anomaly detection, and AI\-optimized compute resource allocation (GCP Dataflow/Dataproc).
* Agentic Data Collection: Develop autonomous agents for "Intelligent Ingestion," enabling self\-healing pipelines and automated metadata tagging to eliminate data fragmentation and ensure global compliance.
* Efficiency \& Cost Ownership: Lead the technical strategy for optimizing cloud unit economics. Drive architectural changes that significantly reduce the total cost of ownership (TCO) for vehicle data products while increasing reliability.


**Hands\-on Excellence:** 
 Maintain a high level of technical craft by prototyping the most difficult segments of the architecture and solving the portfolio’s most complex technical bottlenecks.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education: Minimum – Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. Preferred – Master’s or PhD in a highly technical field.
* Experience:10\+ years of professional experience in software and data engineering, with a proven track record of architecting large\-scale (Petabyte\-scale) streaming and distributed systems.
* IC Leadership: Demonstrated experience as a Staff or Senior Staff Engineer (or equivalent) providing technical leadership for large organizations (50\-100\+ engineers).
* Modeling Expertise: Expert\-level knowledge of Database Modeling (Relational, NoSQL) and specialized Time\-Series Data Modeling (e.g., handling high\-frequency sensor data, windowing, and compaction).
* AI \& Agentic Mastery: Deep hands\-on experience in Applied AI, including the development of Agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI) and utilizing LLMs to automate data exploration and insight generation.
* Streaming \& Cloud Stack: Expert proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Dataflow, and Vertex AI. Mastery of Kafka or Pub/Sub for high\-throughput messaging.
* Efficiency Mindset: Proven ability to re\-drive architectures specifically for efficiency gains, cost reduction, and performance optimization in a cloud\-native environment.
* Modern Engineering Standards: Mastery of SDLC, MLOps, and LLMOps, with the ability to set the standard for testing, observability, and deployment of AI\-integrated data systems.
* Technical Sovereignty: As the lead IC for the portfolio, you have the autonomy to re\-drive the foundation of Ford’s connected vehicle future.
* Scale \& Complexity: Work with one of the world's largest and most complex IoT datasets.
* Innovation: Lead the industry move from "Data Pipelines" to "Agentic Data Ecosystems."
* Impact: Directly influence the safety, compliance, and efficiency of the 2026 MY\+ vehicle fleet.
* Join Us in Re\-driving the Future of Automotive Data at Ford!

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tax & Accounting Tech
description:
**Description**
 Are you interested in building a high\-performance, globally scalable gross\-to\-net payroll calculation engine with deep tax calculation capabilities that supports Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services? Do you have a passion for ensuring accurate financial calculations that directly impact employees? This is the job for you.
   

  

 Amazon's Payroll Tax \& Accounting Technology team is looking for a results\-oriented, driven Senior Software Development Engineer who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable gross\-to\-net calculation infrastructure with sophisticated tax processing at its core. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex regulatory contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We need someone to lead the technical design and develop a single global system that processes gross earnings through complex multi\-jurisdiction tax calculations to net pay for millions of employees, with local configuration driven by our "policy as code" approach with LLM\-based rule extraction.
   

  

 A Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) at Amazon works on real world problems on a global scale, owns their systems end to end and influences the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions of customers around the world. You can expect to design flexible and scalable solutions, and work on some of the most complex challenges in large\-scale computing by utilizing your skills in data structures, algorithms, and object oriented programming. Coming to Amazon gives you the opportunity to lead technical initiatives on a small development team in one of our many rapidly growing organizations.
   

  

 You will learn all about how to design, implement and test highly scalable solutions using AWS cloud platform and its many products, in challenging agile projects, working with best in class professionals.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Lead the architecture and technical design of a globally deployed, locally configured gross\-to\-net calculation engine that leverages LLM\-based rule extraction to formalize complex jurisdiction\-specific tax regulations, including multi\-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and statutory compliance requirements
* Design and develop deterministic tax calculation algorithms that handle employee withholding, employer tax obligations, and process gross earnings through deductions to calculate net pay across multiple countries
* Drive technical decisions for the LLM\-based rule extraction pipeline and establish patterns for converting regulatory documents into executable "policy as code"
* Create accounting integration services that generate GL entries and journal entries for all necessary payroll entries, like earnings, tax, \& benefits
* Implement GenAI shadow mode validation frameworks to ensure accuracy against existing systems
* Mentor engineers on the team and establish engineering best practices for deterministic financial calculations
* Partner directly with Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Technical Program Managers, tax specialists, and payroll operations teams to understand features and continuously identify opportunities to build and deploy software solutions


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the architecture and technical design for the global gross\-to\-net calculation engine with complex tax processing capabilities using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment
* Drive engineering excellence by defining and implementing engineering best practices for deterministic financial calculations and using data to define and improve operational best practices
* Own the technical direction and architecture choices for the LLM\-based rule extraction pipeline and tax\-centric gross\-to\-net calculation products
* Design, develop and deploy large\-scale software solutions for Amazon's global payroll tax calculation and gross\-to\-net accounting needs
* Raise the bar on code quality, including security, auditability, readability, consistency, and maintainability across the team
* Leverage GenAI capabilities to build validation frameworks and continuously improve system accuracy
* Mentor and guide junior engineers on technical design, implementation approaches, and best practices


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll start your morning leading technical discussions with tax specialists and payroll operations teams across multiple countries to understand jurisdiction\-specific requirements and define system architecture. Mid\-day, you'll design high\-level system components, review code from team members, and architect deterministic tax calculation algorithms leveraging our "policy as code" approach with LLM\-based rule extraction. You'll investigate how different countries structure their tax codes, exploring edge cases and regulatory nuances. Afternoons involve mentoring engineers, making key technical decisions on GenAI shadow mode validation frameworks, and refining accounting integrations. You'll tackle complex challenges like multi\-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and ensuring sub\-millisecond performance while maintaining 100% statutory compliance for millions of employees globally.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team, or experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead, or experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment

 At TORM, our corporate and technology teams work closely together to move the business forward through innovation and intelligent automation. By combining technical skills with a collaborative mindset, we build scalable, reliable GenAI solutions that support real operational workflows across the organization.
 



  





 As a Gen AI Engineer, you'll design and build GenAI/RAG applications and agentic solutions on Databricks (including Agent Bricks), work with open\-source RAG frameworks, and contribute to the team's broader AI strategy and roadmap, working alongside experienced engineers to deliver reliable solutions for fleet and shore\-based operations.
 



  





**Your Role: Make an Impact** 




  





 In this role, you'll be part of a Data \& AI team, building and scaling GenAI, RAG, and agentic solutions end\- to\-end. You'll work closely with senior engineers on architecture decisions and help shape the team's strategic direction on emerging AI tooling.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, build, and maintain GenAI/RAG applications on Databricks (Unity Catalog, vector search, model serving, Knowledge Assistant\-style architectures)

* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using open\-source frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar), including chunking, embeddings, and retrieval tuning
* Design and refine system prompts and agent guidelines for accuracy and reliability across multi\-turn interactions
* Monitor and improve model/agent performance \- context retention, latency, and cost optimization
* Set up and run evaluations for agentic/LLM solutions to continuously measure quality, accuracy, and reliability
* Set up observability (tracing, logging, metrics) for agentic applications and APIs, preferably using Open Telemetry
* Design and build APIs using FastAPI (or a similar modern framework) to expose GenAI/agentic capabilities to other systems
* Design data models and integrate with transactional databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) supporting GenAI/agentic applications
* Apply sound software design and solution architecture principles to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are maintainable, scalable, and production\-ready
* Contribute to strategic initiatives \- evaluating emerging GenAI trends, running POCs, and supporting roadmap planning



  





**Your Profile** 




  





 We're looking for a hands\-on GenAI engineer who is curious about emerging AI tooling, enjoys solving production\-scale problems, and is eager to contribute both technically and strategically in a collaborative, technology\-driven environment.
 



  





**To succeed in this role, you bring** 




  




* At least three years of experience in AI/ML, data, or software engineering, with hands\-on experience delivering GenAI solutions
* Strong experience with Databricks (including notebooks, workflows/jobs, Unity Catalog, and ideally vector search)
* Hands\-on experience building RAG and agentic AI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agent Bricks, or similar tools
* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including solution design and architecture for production\-grade applications
* Experience evaluating, testing, and monitoring LLM/agentic applications, including quality, accuracy, observability, and performance
* Experience building and integrating APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks
* Working knowledge of Azure cloud services and PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability, with fluency in English, both written and verbal



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Basic exposure to Microsoft Copilot Studio or a similar low\-code conversational AI platform
* Experience with multi\-agent architectures or agent orchestration frameworks
* Prior experience in a regulated or data\-residency\-sensitive environment (GDPR, EU data handling)



  





**What We Offer** 




  





 At TORM, we are committed to people, communities, and the environment. We offer a competitive salary along with a bonus scheme, pension, and flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work\-life balance. You’ll have access to continuous learning and growth opportunities with a variety of initiatives, from e.g., Fun club, Family Day, Festival celebrations, CSR programs etc., that help you connect, grow, and thrive.
 



  





 Diversity and inclusion are integral to our success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value the perspectives they bring to our global organization.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Excited to join the team? Submit your application via www.torm.com/careers by 21 September 2026\.
 



  





 We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
**Senior Full Stack Developer \- AI \& Data** 




  





**Job Overview** 




 We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer who works across backend engineering, data infrastructure, applied LLM systems, and SEO\-optimized web builds. You'll build the APIs, pipelines, websites and dashboards that power our internal tools and client delivery \- owning features end to end, from database migration to UI.
 



 Comfort with AI coding tools and LLM APIs is essential, not optional. It's how we ship.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Backend \& APIs** 



* Build scalable services in Python (FastAPI/Django), containerized with Docker.
* Design REST APIs, including long\-running jobs with streaming progress.
* Build dashboards and internal UIs in React, Next.js and TypeScript.



  





**Cloud Infrastructure (GCP)** 



* Deploy and operate containerized services on Cloud Run \- revisions, scaling, concurrency, cold starts, secrets.
* Manage Cloud Storage buckets for assets, reports and backups, with sane lifecycle and access policies.
* Provision and maintain Compute Engine VMs for long\-running or non\-containerized workloads.
* Set up recurring pipelines with Cloud Scheduler and job queues.
* Work with Secret Manager, IAM roles and service accounts, Artifact Registry, and Cloud Logging/Monitoring for debugging production.



  





**Data Handling at Scale** 



* Ingest, clean and normalize large structured and unstructured datasets \- CSVs, scraped web content, transcripts, PDFs, third\-party API exports.
* Build extraction and enrichment pipelines that turn messy raw input into queryable, deduplicated records.
* Handle the unglamorous parts properly: entity resolution, canonical naming, missing and conflicting values, validation gates before data reaches a client.
* Keep pipelines resumable and auditable so a failed run can be traced and re\-run, not restarted from zero.



  





**SEO\-Optimized Website Building** 



* Build fast, technically clean marketing sites in Next.js with a headless CMS (Payload).
* Own technical SEO: structured data (JSON\-LD), sitemaps and robots, canonicals, metadata, internal linking.
* Optimize Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy and crawlability.
* Build for AI search visibility, not just Google rankings.



  





**Databases** 



* Design and normalize PostgreSQL/Supabase schemas; write migrations by hand.
* Implement RLS, backups and access controls.
* Optimize queries and connection handling under concurrent load.



  





**LLM Engineering** 



* Work across multiple providers through a unified gateway.
* Build structured\-output flows, RAG and retrieval pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Optimize cost and latency: prompt caching, model routing, token accounting.
* Treat hallucination as an engineering problem \- build validation and evals, not vibes.



  





**AI Coding Tools** 



* Daily, skilled use of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar. Decompose tasks well, review output critically, and know when to write it yourself.
* Never ship generated code you can't explain.



  





**Internal Team Enablement \& Automation** 



* Sit with non\-technical teams, map how they actually work, and find the manual steps worth automating.
* Turn those workflows into tools the team can run themselves \- no engineer in the loop for routine runs.
* Write clear internal docs and walk teams through new tools; support and iterate after launch.
* Measure what you automated: time saved, errors avoided, throughput gained.



  





**Integrations \& Automation** 



* Integrate third\-party APIs with rate limiting and failure isolation.
* Handle OAuth, JWT and service\-to\-service auth; manage SDK version drift.
* Automate manual workflows end to end \- ingestion through to insight delivery.



  





**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Build automated dashboards and client\-facing PDF/HTML reports.
* Translate business goals into metrics and KPIs; investigate trends and anomalies.



  





**Testing \& Debugging** 



* Write real tests (pytest, Playwright, Vitest), including deterministic mocks for LLM code.
* Debug across the stack \- job state, silent failures, provider timeouts, concurrency. Root\-cause it.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4\+ years shipping production full\-stack applications.
* Strong Python and PostgreSQL; solid React/Next.js/TypeScript.
* Hands\-on GCP experience \- Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, Cloud Scheduler.
* Experience working with large, messy datasets \- cleaning, normalizing and making them usable.
* Production experience with LLM APIs \- RAG, structured outputs, cost optimization.
* Hands\-on technical SEO experience on sites you've built and shipped.
* Fluent, critical use of AI coding assistants.
* Docker, Git, and a genuine testing habit.
* Comfortable working directly with non\-technical teams.



  





**Nice to have:** 
 pgvector/embeddings, Supabase, headless CMS (Payload/Sanity), marketing\-analytics background.

**Company Description**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through an intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and technology into a single System of Action. **Job Description**

 Cursor

* Git


**EDUCATION**

* M.S. / M.Tech in Computer Science or AI/ML is a plus.

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.

This role involves assisting in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of backend services and automation solutions that streamline clients’ business processes. The engineer will implement features under the guidance of senior engineers, write clean and efficient code, debug issues, and participate in code reviews. title: Microservices Java backend engineer/ Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Build and run core services for Rates trade booking and trade storage, with a design that can extend across broader FICC products. Own end\-to\-end delivery for your services: technical design, hands\-on development (60–70%), CI/CD, production readiness, and operational support (“you build it, you run it”).
* Engineer for high availability, strong data consistency, and high throughput, including resilience patterns, capacity planning, and performance tuning.Design and implement service interfaces using gRPC/Protobuf and streaming patterns (e.g., HTTP SSE) to integrate with upstream/downstream platforms.
* Ensure robust auditability and controls: versioning of trade changes, traceability, access controls, data retention, and secure\-by\-design engineering. Drive a step\-change in engineering culture: raise standards through design/code reviews, automation, observability, and incident learning, mentoring engineers through practical examples. Partner with Product Owners/BAs and stakeholders to shape requirements into clear user stories and deliver iteratively with predictable outcomes. Build and maintain lightweight UIs where needed to support trade enquiry, operational workflows, and exception handling.
* Strong experience as a senior Java backend engineer (microservices), with proven ownership of production systems. Solid understanding of distributed systems: concurrency, idempotency, failure handling, consistency models, and resiliency patterns.Hands\-on experience designing APIs and integrations using gRPC and Protobuf; familiarity with streaming/real\-time update patterns (e.g., SSE).
* Strong PostgreSQL skills (data modelling, indexing, performance tuning) and experience building consistent, auditable transactional stores. DevOps/SRE mindset: CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, monitoring/alerting, and operational tooling (e.g., Grafana/Prometheus/ELK).
* Secure engineering practices: vulnerability management, secrets handling, access control, audit logging, and compliance\-aware delivery.Domain knowledge of trade lifecycle and STP, ideally in Rates (broader FICC exposure a plus). Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and influencing engineering culture without formal line management.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* 7\+ years of IT experience in Java development as an Individual contributor as well as mentor. Excellent problem\-solving, interpersonal, presentation and analytical skills
* Experience in micro services architecture, Elasticsearch and ELK. Experience in Monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus
* Exposure to Message driven architectures working on JMS, IBM MQ / Artemis / Solace etc. Hands\-on experience with DevOps, CI/CD and Cyber Security tools ex. Teamcity /Jenkins / JIRA/ Confluence / NexusIQ / CheckMarx
* Hands\-on experience with RDBMS (e.g. Oracle) or NOSQL DBs (e.g. MongoDB). In\-depth knowledge of Trade Life cycle \& Straight Through Processing (STP)
* Exposure to Fixed Income Currency and Commodities products. High Frequency and Low latency coding, Rust, Go, Python


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Full-Stack Angular/Java development and/or Testing
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Digital S/W Engineer Analyst SDE is a Technology/ Engineering role involving both development and Testing. As a member of the SCRUM team, you will be delivering Customer facing Banking and/or Credit Card features on digital channels such as Browser and Mobile. You will be involved in all stages of the Agile SDLC cycle. It includes but not limited to (a) **Requirement analysis**: Grooming of user stories, Story pointing, decomposing big stories into smaller stories and define acceptance criteria. (b) **Design****Review:** Reviewing screens, flows, features, and customer communications (emails, SMS’s, notifications, PDF documents) and making sure that they are consistent with user story acceptance criteria (c) **Software development**: Developing, configuring and debugging applications comprising of web frontend and Micro services. (d) **Validations:** Creating automated and manual test scripts on BDD (Behavior Based Development) framework, executing test scripts. Identifying, triaging and fixing any defects. Conditioning and maintaining the test data. (e) **Artifact Ownership:** Creating and maintaining testing artifacts such as Test plans and Exit reports and maintaining traceability as per SDLC guidelines. Maintaining SDLC hygiene involving stories. Test cases and defects. Ensuring that no untested code goes out to production. (f) **SDLC Process and Standards:** Adhering to ADA (Americans with Disability Act) Guidelines, participating in retrospectives, process improvement workshops, audits and performing root cause analysis. (g) **Postproduction****support**: Supporting the technical check outs during release go live and postproduction activities.


**Responsibilities**


* Translate application designs into code across one or more development platforms (e.g., Angular, Java Spring Boot services), with guidance from senior developers.
* Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to assist with code generation, refactoring, and debugging tasks.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of BDD (Behavior Driven Development) automated and manual test scripts in a code repository; execute scripts and record results in a test management tool.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to help accelerate unit test creation, API scaffolding, Angular components, and Spring Boot boilerplate code.
* Participate in the software development lifecycle including development, integration, and E2E testing within a CI/CD environment (e.g., RTC, Jenkins).
* Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code under the guidance of senior engineers, and take accountability for assigned features.
* Build and maintain documentation for your features and begin developing subject matter expertise in specific areas of the application.
* Assist in analyzing root causes for application issues and performance concerns; collaborate within the scrum team to triage and report defects.
* Learn and adhere to SDLC control processes and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.
* Perform functional validations to meet acceptance criteria; gain familiarity with Responsive Web Design validation and ADA Accessibility testing tools (e.g., NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, Axe).
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to tracking progress against team objectives.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced environment involving onshore and offshore teams.

**Education, Qualification \& Certifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or a related STEM field, or comparable work experience.
* 2–5 years of experience in full\-stack /Angular development and/or testing in a professional environment.
* Basic familiarity with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) concepts; exposure to test automation frameworks such as Selenium with Cucumber is a plus.
* Exposure to or interest in cloud\-based development platforms such as OpenShift is desirable but not required.
* Basic working knowledge of collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Eagerness to learn, self\-motivated, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Good written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team.

title: Cloud AI Engineer (English)
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience building generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM\-powered solutions, and working directly with technical customers.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience building and orchestrating agents using Agent Development Kits (ADKs) or popular frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
* Experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and securely connecting LLMs with external productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace) and internal databases.
* Experience in leveraging LLMs to deploy multimodal solutions encompassing text, image, video, and voice.
* Experience deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise\-grade generative AI platforms, particularly Gemini Enterprise, with an understanding of security, governance, and compliance requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud computing, including serverless execution environments, virtualization, hosted services, multi\-tenant cloud infrastructures, and secure cloud networking.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Cloud AI Engineer, you'll play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production\-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You'll work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Deliver, deploy, and implement Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve complex technical customer challenges.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to Google’s most strategic customers to drive and accelerate the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Provide guidance on existing product challenges, and collaborate with the engineering team to address the challenges or provide possible workarounds.
* Deliver leading practice recommendation and technical presentations adapted to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders to proactively foster Gemini Enterprise adoption and enablement.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law.  Knifedge Lab Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (BetterDrones)
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)
 



**Experience:** 
 4–6 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





  





**About BetterDrones**




 BetterDrones is a rapidly growing Drone, GIS, and Geospatial Technology company delivering AI\-powered inspection and analytics solutions for the Power, Renewable Energy, Infrastructure, Telecom, Mining, and Government sectors.
 



 Our flagship platform,
 **ENRZY** 
 , is an AI\-powered digital inspection platform for Power Transmission, Distribution, and Renewable Energy assets. ENRZY combines drone imagery, thermal inspection, LiDAR, GIS, and AI analytics into a single enterprise platform for utilities.
 



 The platform processes images, videos, thermal data, LiDAR, point clouds, GIS layers, and AI\-generated insights to automate inspections, detect defects, monitor progress, and generate actionable reports.
 



  





  





**Role Summary**




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full Stack Developer** 
 who can take ownership of the end\-to\-end development of
 **ENRZY** 
 , from architecture and feature development to deployment and production.
 



 The candidate will work closely with the founders, Product Team, AI Engineers, GIS Engineers, and DevOps team to build scalable, secure, and production\-ready applications.
 



  





 This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys working across the full technology stack and solving complex engineering challenges involving AI, GIS, drone data, geospatial technologies, and enterprise applications..
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead and contribute to the end\-to\-end development of the ENRZY platform, from product architecture and technical planning to production deployment.
* Design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices for enterprise utility customers.
* Build responsive and intuitive web applications using modern frontend technologies.
* Develop GIS\-enabled dashboards, asset visualization, inspection workflows, analytics modules, and reporting features.
* Integrate drone inspection outputs, thermal data, LiDAR, point clouds, GIS layers, and AI/image analysis results into the platform.
* Develop secure and well\-documented REST APIs and reusable frontend and backend components.
* Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, and secure application practices.
* Design and optimize database structures and queries for high\-volume enterprise applications.
* Own cloud deployment, containerization, DevOps, security, monitoring, and platform scalability.
* Deploy containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, including configuration of Ingress, Secrets, ConfigMaps, and Autoscaling.
* Build and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines and support production releases.
* Work closely with AI and GIS teams to integrate inference services and build efficient workflows for processing imagery, thermal data, LiDAR, point clouds, and GIS layers.
* Collaborate with founders and technical teams to define product features, technical requirements, releases, and development priorities.
* Lead technical planning, sprint execution, code reviews, and production deployments.
* Follow secure coding practices aligned with OWASP Top 10 and contribute to code quality, vulnerability scanning, monitoring, and engineering best practices.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture, scalability, reliability, and maintainability of the ENRZY platform.













**Required Technical Skills**



* **Frontend** 
 : React.js / Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, Material UI, Redux Toolkit / Context API.
* **Backend** 
 : Node.js and/or Python, REST APIs, microservices, secure and scalable backend development. Java 17\+ / Spring Boot is an added advantage.
* **Database:** 
 PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL optimization, database design, and PostGIS preferred.
* **Cloud \& DevOps** 
 : Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Git, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), and cloud deployment on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Helm / ArgoCD and object storage (S3, MinIO, Azure Blob) preferred.
* **Security \& Observability** 
 : OAuth2/JWT, RBAC, OWASP Top 10, secure coding, application monitoring/logging, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK, and SonarQube.
* **GIS \& AI** 
 : Experience with Mapbox, Leaflet, ArcGIS, OpenLayers, GeoServer, or CesiumJS. Exposure to LiDAR/Point Cloud Processing, Computer Vision, Image Analytics, OpenCV, TensorFlow/PyTorch, FFmpeg, or AI/LLM integration is an advantage.
* **Domain \& Product** 
 : Experience with SaaS/enterprise platforms, Power, GIS, DroneTech, Infrastructure, Renewable Energy, or Industrial AI products, with exposure to product releases and engineering execution.













**What Success Looks Like**




 The successful candidate will:
 


* Deliver production\-ready full\-stack features independently
* Build scalable and maintainable backend services
* Develop modern and responsive web applications
* Successfully deploy services on Kubernetes
* Build reliable CI/CD pipelines
* Integrate AI and GIS workflows seamlessly
* Improve engineering quality through automation and best practices
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture of BetterDrones' Drone Intelligence Platform



  





  





**Who Should Apply**




 We are looking for developers who:
 


* Have
 **4–6 years** 
 of hands\-on full\-stack development experience
* Have worked in
 **product\-based companies or technology startups**
* Can independently own features from design to production deployment
* Have experience building scalable cloud\-native applications
* Enjoy solving complex engineering, AI, and geospatial challenges
* Are passionate about building high\-quality products
* Aspire to grow into
 **Technical Lead or Engineering Leadership** 
 roles



  





  





**Preferred Education**




 Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related Engineering discipline.
 



 Equivalent practical experience with strong technical expertise will also be considered.
 



  





  





**Why Join BetterDrones?**




 At BetterDrones, you'll work on cutting\-edge technologies that combine
 **AI, Drones, Cloud Computing, GIS, LiDAR, and Enterprise Software** 
 to solve real\-world infrastructure challenges.
 



 You'll have the opportunity to:
 


* Build products used by leading Power Utilities, Renewable Energy Companies, EPCs, and Government Organizations.
* Work directly with experienced engineering leaders.
* Influence product architecture and technology decisions.
* Solve large\-scale engineering problems involving AI and geospatial data.
* Grow rapidly in a high\-impact, innovation\-driven startup environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Client Platform
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 The Client Platform team is seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to help us raise the quality bar across our frontend ecosystem. You'll establish engineering excellence through improved architecture, performance optimization, and maintainable code patterns that ensure our platform delivers exceptional experiences to both internal engineering teams and our 35\+ million customers. This role is a unique opportunity to have immediate impact on the foundation that hundreds of Postman engineers rely on daily.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The Client Platform team is a global engineering organization responsible for creating a "paved path" for all Postmanauts to develop and release web\-based applications. Our platform is the foundation that hundreds of engineers at Postman rely on daily to deliver new features and improvements to over 30 million customers. We manage everything from build tooling and shared libraries to development infrastructure, best practices and our cross\-platform desktop application.
   

  

**Specifically You Will**
* Design and develop modular, well\-documented SDKs and component libraries that serve both internal engineering teams as well as external developers, with focus on usability, accessibility, performance, and cross\-platform compatibility.
* Architect extensible frontend systems with clear boundaries, well\-defined interfaces, and appropriate abstraction layers that balance customization needs with consistency requirements
* Establish and evangelize architectural patterns that promote code quality, maintainability, and scalability across Postman's frontend ecosystem
* Champion engineering excellence through active participation in architectural decisions, mentorship of other engineers in frontend best practices, and creation of standards that become embedded in our engineering culture and measurably improve code quality
* Proactively partner with product and engineering to identify, prioritize, and eliminate technical debt through strategic refactoring and system enhancements, driving improved development velocity and platform reliability.


**About You**
* 8\+ years in Frontend software engineering with demonstrated expertise in code quality, performance optimization, and engineering excellence.
* Deep understanding of modern web technologies and best practices (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, state management, testing frameworks, etc.).
* Experience designing and implementing maintainable, scalable frontend architectures for complex applications, including component libraries and SDKs that can be effectively reused across multiple systems.
* Proven track record of raising the quality bar in previous roles through both technical solutions and positive cultural impact.
* Additionally, you are someone who:


* 
+ Communicates clearly and listens effectively. You seek new perspectives and build trust with your colleagues.
+ Loves the challenge of constraints and excels at finding creative solutions.
+ Takes ownership of problems, not solutions, and celebrates success as a team.


**Nice\-to\-have**
* Experience with cross\-platform applications (Electron or similar) and understanding the unique challenges of desktop/web hybrid environments.
* Creating widely\-adopted (open source) libraries/SDKs with 1000\+ active developers.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6\.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.



At Greenlight, we're here to make the day\-to\-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

  

We are seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to join our growing security team. This role will be critical in ensuring the security of our products across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) and provide support on different security initiatives. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed security best practices from design through to deployment. You will play a critical role in shaping our security posture, embedding security into our development lifecycle, and protecting our customers' data.



### **Technologies we use:**


* Backend: Node.js, Kotlin, Java, Go
* Frontend: React, Redux, Swift, Kotlin
* REST, gRPC, graphQL
* AWS
* MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis
* Kubernetes, Ambassador, Helm, Rancher
### **What you will be doing:**


* Support in executing a comprehensive product security strategy that aligns with the company's goals and risk appetite.
* You will work hands on across code, infrastructure, and CI/CD to create agents, services and pipelines that detect, prevent and remediate risks leveraging AI where it adds value.
* Design, build and operate security automation for the SDLC (code scanning, dependency risk management, secrets detection, policy\-as\-code) integrated into CI/CD.
* Perform Manual Design and Implementation Reviews of Greenlight products and services from a security perspective.

description:
**Who We Are**
 Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting\-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. **What We Offer**
 Location:
   

  

 Pune,IND

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

 As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground\-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high\-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on senior software engineer / architect who is an expert in UI/UX design and development to work on our multi\-physics computational modeling codes. Your primary responsibility will be to redesign, extend, and improve our existing UI packages in every respect, including the user experience, robustness and performance, graphical elements, and integration and unification with other codes and AI/ML tools.
   

  

**Essential Functions / Job Description**
* Extend and modify existing UI packages to improve their intuitiveness and their support for easier and more efficient workflows and greater automation. This role requires working with users and domain experts to understand their personas, modelling processes, and intentions, and to iterate on design artifacts with them.
* Redesign, extend, improve, and develop existing UI packages to support additional functionalities, including functionalities related to Python scripting, to the generation of Reduced Order Models and Surrogate Models, and to coupling with external AI/ML tools and agents and DOE packages.
* Redesign and re\-factor existing UI packages to improve their robustness, speed, and ability to handle very large models.
* Redesign and re\-implement existing UI/UX packages to enable CPU\-GPU parallelization.
* Integrate and unify existing UI packages into a single unified package and implement client\-server and distributed computing architectures
* Participate in and contribute to all phases of the software lifecycle for several UI packages, including identifying promising future technologies, defining technical requirements, planning the work, designing the software, implementing and testing the code, and working on the ongoing related extensions, maintenance, support, and documentation.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to other UI/UX and graphics developers working on the UI/UX packages.


**Education And Skills / Job Requirements**
* A B.Sc., B.Tech, M.Sc, or M.Tech degree in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, physics, or a computational simulation or modeling discipline.
* Proven and demonstrable talent and skill in UI design, development, and testing.
* Demonstrable skill in understanding and anticipating the needs, behaviors, and intentions of users and in developing user\-centered interfaces.
* Expertise in Qt, JavaFX, Flutter, .NET, or any other UI desktop or mobile development framework.
* Expertise in modern C/C\+\+ and Python and in integrating C/C\+\+ application functions with graphics components.
* Expertise in using modern OpenGL APIs for graphics\-intensive UI components, and a sound understanding of real\-time graphics performance maximization.
* Expertise in profiling, debugging, and parallelizing code on both CPUs and GPUs.
* Proficiency in XML data and schema management and in the XML ecosystem.
* Familiarity with distributed system UI development and client\-server architectures.
* Originality, creativity, and excellent problem\-solving skills.
* Some background in developing and using UI packages for simulation, modeling, or scientific computing packages.
* Ability to work independently as well as in close collaboration with teams of computational scientists and computer scientists.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills


 The successful candidate will work with the Computational Products and Solutions Center (CPS) of Excellence at Applied Materials. The work environment is stimulating, collaborative, and rewarding, with good opportunities for learning, growth, and diversification of expertise and knowledge. Your work will have a far\-reaching impact at Applied Materials and beyond. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for UI development, programming, graphics, high\-performance computing, and an interest in scientific computing or modeling and simulation.
   

  

**Location**
 The position is open in the Applied Materials India offices in both Pune and Bengaluru.

 Assignee / Regular

 Yes

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
 Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume \+ complex business rules in a highly distributed and service\-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper\-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
   

  

 This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid\-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade\-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
   

  

**A Day In The Life**
 You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand\-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on\-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

They play a key leadership role in supporting teams and stakeholders in planning, executing, and delivering technical solutions in alignment with the established target architecture. Solution Architects are expected to remain closely engaged during solution delivery, including incrementally reviewing technical design and implementation to ensure the utilization of best practices and adherence to architectural guidance. Solution architects may strategically contribute to implementation activities when there is an opportunity to establish an example and provide crucial implementation guidance. Solution Architects contribute to defining architecture patterns, building reference implementations of these patterns, and proof of technologies to accelerate solution delivery. * What we do — Trust \& Safety keeps Swiggy safe on both sides: the platform stays safe for our consumers, and the platform and our businesses stay protected from fraudsters and bad actors.

* Your charter — own architectural decisions end\-to\-end, lead projects independently, mentor engineers, and partner with product, analytics and business teams to translate risk and customer\-experience goals into scalable, production\-grade solutions.

* Decide technology and tool choices for your team, and be responsible for them

* Proficiency in Go or Python (ideally both)

**Systems and scale**
* Strong experience building and operating distributed systems — message queues, event\-driven architectures, stream processing, caching, async processing
* Solid system design skills, comfortable owning end\-to\-end architecture
* Experience building latency\-sensitive services in a transactional critical path — p99s, timeouts, circuit breaking, fallback behavior
* Experience with NoSQL databases, Kafka or similar streaming systems, and AWS

title: Lead Data Architect (AWS)

In this role, you will be the mastermind behind our data strategy, bridging the gap between complex business requirements and robust technical execution.
   

  

 You will bring exceptional problem\-solving abilities, deep expertise in Databricks and Snowflake, and a proven track record of engineering high\-throughput, real\-time data pipelines that drive business value at scale.
   

  

 Key Information
   

  

* Location: Bengaluru
* Project Duration: Ongoing
* Shift Timings: UK Hours
* Experience Required: 10\+ Years


 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

 Design end\-to\-end scalable, secure, and highly available data architectures leveraging modern cloud data ecosystems (Databricks and Snowflake). Establish data governance frameworks and strategic direction for enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Pipeline Engineering
   

  

 Architect, optimize, and oversee the deployment of reliable streaming and batch data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to process complex, large\-scale datasets. Ensure fault\-tolerance, performance optimization, and cost\-efficiency across all pipeline implementations.
   

  

 Cloud Architecture
   

  

 Architect and deploy scalable enterprise data platform components natively within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring tight integration with core security, IAM, and networking protocols. Design cloud\-native solutions that maximize performance and minimize operational overhead.
   

  

 API Ingestion \& Orchestration
   

  

 Design and implement robust data ingestion frameworks leveraging Databricks APIs and external REST/GraphQL APIs for automated workflows, platform orchestration, and data delivery. Build scalable ingestion solutions that support diverse data sources and formats.
   

  

 Real\-time Processing
   

  

 Design and implement robust frameworks for real\-time data ingestion and processing to solve business\-critical, low\-latency use cases. Architect streaming solutions that deliver insights with minimal latency while maintaining data quality and reliability.
   

  

 Hybrid Data Modelling
   

  

 Harmonize traditional relational data warehousing patterns (Kimball/Inmon, Star/Snowflake schemas) with unstructured and semi\-structured modern paradigms. Create flexible, scalable data models that support diverse analytical and operational use cases.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 Act as a core problem\-solver for complex data bottlenecks and performance challenges. Provide technical governance, establish best practices, and mentor engineering teams on data architecture and optimization strategies. Drive technical excellence across the organization.
   

  

 AI Integration
   

  

 Collaborate with Data Science and AI teams to architect data layers that seamlessly support LLMs, Machine Learning pipelines, and advanced analytics solutions. Design feature stores and data infrastructure optimized for AI/ML workloads.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

**Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, and Data Architecture
* Proven track record of designing and implementing enterprise\-scale data platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and influencing architectural decisions


**Educational Background**
* Bachelor of Engineering (BE) / B.Tech in Computer Science or related field

* Scala: Solid experience for Spark\-based distributed computing

* Apache Kafka: Proven expertise in designing and implementing Kafka\-based data streaming architectures

**Technical Expertise**
* Data Pipeline Excellence: Exceptional expertise in designing distributed, fault\-tolerant data pipelines using Python, Scala, or SQL
* Real\-time Systems: Proven track record with stream processing technologies for real\-time, low\-latency use cases
* Polyglot Persistence: Solid foundation in traditional Data Warehousing and relational database management systems (RDBMS); hands\-on experience with NoSQL ecosystems
* Cloud Platforms: Deep understanding of AWS services including Lambda, S3, EC2, IAM, and VPC configurations
* Data Governance: Experience implementing data governance, lineage tracking, and metadata management solutions


 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Problem\-Solving: Elite analytical mindset with a proven track record of troubleshooting complex distributed systems and resolving performance degradation issues
* Communication: Ability to articulate complex technical architectures clearly to both engineering teams and non\-technical business stakeholders
* Leadership: Natural ability to mentor, guide, and elevate technical teams; strong influence without authority
