title: Purchase & Procurement Executive / Manager
description:
**Industry:** Alcohol Manufacturing / Distillery \& Real Estate  
**Department:** Purchase / Procurement  
**Location:** Mumbai / Plant \& Project Locations  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Reporting To:** MD

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Purchase \& Procurement professional** to manage purchasing and procurement activities for our **Alcohol Manufacturing / Distillery operations as well as Real Estate and Construction projects**.

The candidate will be responsible for **vendor development, sourcing, quotations, negotiations, purchase orders, material coordination, cost control, delivery follow\-up and vendor management**.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in **industrial procurement**, preferably from **distillery, alcohol manufacturing, sugar, FMCG, manufacturing or similar industries**, along with exposure to **construction and real estate procurement**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Purchase \& Procurement – Alcohol Manufacturing / Distillery

* Handle day\-to\-day purchase requirements for the **alcohol manufacturing / distillery plant**.
* Procure **plant machinery, spare parts, engineering materials, electrical items, mechanical items, pumps, valves, pipelines, motors, bearings, tools and consumables**.
* Source materials required for **RO/DM plants, utilities, bottling operations, maintenance and production**.
* Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Stores and Utility departments to understand material requirements.
* Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate **price, quality, payment terms, delivery timelines and commercial conditions**.
* Prepare and process **Purchase Orders (POs)** after approval.
* Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.
* Coordinate with Stores for material receipt, quantity verification and documentation.
* Resolve issues relating to shortages, wrong materials, quality problems and delayed deliveries.

2\. Packaging \& Alcohol\-Business Procurement

* Handle procurement of **bottles, caps, labels, cartons, mono cartons, packaging materials and other bottling\-related requirements**.
* Coordinate with suppliers for artwork/specification\-related requirements where applicable.
* Ensure packaging materials are available as per production requirements.
* Maintain supplier records, prices and historical purchase data.
* Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing and cost reduction.

3\. Real Estate \& Construction Procurement

Handle procurement requirements for **bungalows, guest houses, factories, restaurants, outlets, offices and other real estate/construction projects**.

* Procure **cement, steel, sand, aggregates, bricks, blocks, tiles, sanitaryware, plumbing materials and electrical materials**.
* Source **doors, windows, hardware, glass, paint, waterproofing materials and other construction items**.
* Handle procurement of **furniture, fixtures, lighting, interiors and project\-related materials**.
* Coordinate with Architects, Project Managers, Contractors and Site Teams regarding material requirements.
* Obtain quotations and negotiate with contractors, suppliers and manufacturers.
* Compare rates and prepare commercial comparisons before purchase approval.
* Ensure materials are delivered according to project schedules.
* Track material requirements against project timelines and budgets.

4\. Vendor Management

* Develop and maintain a reliable **vendor and supplier network**.
* Identify new suppliers and manufacturers for better pricing and quality.
* Conduct vendor comparison and evaluation.
* Maintain vendor database with contact details, product categories, rates and payment terms.
* Negotiate long\-term rates wherever possible.
* Monitor supplier performance, delivery and quality.
* Maintain professional relationships with key suppliers.

5\. Cost Control \& Negotiation

* Obtain a minimum of **2–3 quotations** for major purchases wherever practical.
* Prepare quotation comparison statements.
* Negotiate aggressively but professionally to achieve **best price and commercial terms**.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities through alternate vendors, bulk purchasing and rate contracts.
* Monitor price fluctuations for frequently purchased materials.
* Avoid unnecessary purchases and control procurement costs.

6\. Purchase Orders \& Documentation

* Prepare Purchase Orders based on approved requirements.
* Ensure correct **item description, specification, quantity, rate, taxes, delivery location, payment terms and delivery timeline** are mentioned.
* Maintain purchase files and supporting documents.
* Track PO status from order placement through delivery.
* Coordinate with Accounts for vendor invoices and payment\-related documentation.
* Maintain proper procurement records for audit and management review.

7\. Inventory \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with Stores to monitor critical stock levels.
* Identify fast\-moving and critical items requiring advance procurement.
* Avoid production/project delays caused by material shortages.
* Monitor pending purchase orders and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate urgent procurement requirements during plant breakdowns or project emergencies.

8\. Market Research \& Supplier Development

* Regularly identify new suppliers and manufacturers.
* Conduct market research for industrial, construction and project materials.
* Compare market prices and identify alternative products/vendors.
* Develop direct relationships with manufacturers wherever possible to reduce costs.
* Keep management informed about significant price changes and market conditions.

Required Skills \& Experience

* **3–7 years of experience in Purchase / Procurement.**
* Experience in **Alcohol Manufacturing / Distillery / Sugar / Manufacturing / FMCG** will be highly preferred.
* Exposure to **Real Estate / Construction / Interior procurement** is an advantage.
* Strong negotiation and vendor\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of industrial materials, engineering spares and consumables.
* Knowledge of construction and building materials will be preferred.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and compare products.
* Good knowledge of **Purchase Orders, quotation comparisons, vendor evaluation and procurement documentation**.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel and ERP/purchase software**.
* Should be commercially aware and capable of identifying cost\-saving opportunities.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on procurement professional** who can independently manage purchases across two major areas:

**1\. Alcohol Manufacturing / Distillery Operations**  
Plant machinery, engineering spares, utilities, bottling, packaging, electrical, mechanical and maintenance materials.

**2\. Real Estate / Construction Projects**  
Civil materials, electrical, plumbing, interiors, furniture, fixtures and project requirements.

The candidate should be comfortable dealing with **local suppliers, manufacturers, contractors and large vendors**, and should have strong negotiation and follow\-up abilities.

Key Performance Areas

* Purchase cost savings
* Timely material availability
* Vendor development
* Supplier quality
* On\-time delivery
* Reduction in emergency purchases
* Proper PO and procurement documentation
* Inventory coordination
* Vendor payment/documentation coordination
* Project and plant procurement support

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their **updated CV on WhatsApp to HR**.

**HR WhatsApp: 8788339043**

Please mention **“Purchase \& Procurement – Alcohol / Real Estate”** while sending your CV.

**Job Title – AI Business Analyst cum Scrum Master**

**Job Description :**

**We are seeking an AI Business Analyst \& Scrum Master to drive the successful delivery of AI and Generative AI initiatives across the organization. The role involves identifying business opportunities, gathering and translating requirements into AI solutions, conducting feasibility assessments, and collaborating with business and technical teams to deliver measurable outcomes. As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate Agile ceremonies, manage backlogs, remove delivery impediments, and ensure timely execution of projects. You will act as a bridge between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring business objectives, user needs, and AI capabilities are aligned to create sustainable business value.**

**Your Role**

We are looking for an AI Business Analyst cum Scrum Master who can translate business needs into effective AI/GenAI solutions while enabling disciplined Agile delivery. The role covers feasibility assessment, requirements documentation, process optimization, solution design collaboration, proof\-of\-concept execution, and end\-to\-end Scrum facilitation across cross\-functional teams.


**Responsibilities:**

* Collect, analyze, and document business requirements, and draft solution design documents based on approved business needs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product quality teams, and other relevant functions, to assess current processes and systems.
* Identify opportunities where AI/GenAI techniques can improve business outcomes and recommend tailored solutions for specific challenges.
* Conduct feasibility assessments of AI solutions in terms of resource productivity, revenue enhancement, cost savings, efficiency improvement, data readiness, technical viability, risks, and adoption potential.
* Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), including functional and non\-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, process flows, data requirements, and AI/GenAI\-specific considerations.
* Collaborate with AI solution architects to define the TO\-BE process and technical architecture, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, security, and scalability requirements.
* Support AI solution development teams during development, testing, production deployment, user acceptance testing, hyper care, and transition to operations.
* Drive proof\-of\-concept development tailored to stakeholder use cases to validate feasibility, demonstrate value, and uncover new opportunities for engagement and collaboration.
* Work closely with development teams, Product Owners, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure cohesive development and deployment of AI solutions.
* Prepare stakeholder\-ready artifacts such as case studies, presentations, solution collaterals, value assessments, process diagrams, and implementation roadmaps.
* Act as Scrum Master for AI/GenAI initiatives and facilitate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Partner with the Product Owner and stakeholders to create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog with clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and Definition of Done.
* Track sprint progress, milestones, dependencies, risks, capacity, and impediments using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent Agile platforms.
* Remove or escalate delivery blockers by coordinating across business, architecture, data, development, security, infrastructure, and operational teams.
* Promote Scrum and Agile principles, continuous improvement, collaboration, transparency, accountability, and predictable delivery across cross\-functional teams.
* Monitor and communicate delivery metrics such as velocity, burndown, backlog health, release progress, team capacity, risks, and impediment status.
* Ensure end\-to\-end traceability from business requirements and user stories through solution development, testing, stakeholder acceptance, deployment, and benefits realization.
* Facilitate stakeholder communication, manage expectations, and provide clear status updates on scope, timelines, risks, decisions, and business value.

**Must\-have Qualifications and Experience:**

* Engineering graduate or postgraduate qualification such as BE, B.Tech., ME, M.Tech., MS, or MBA, with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst and in the delivery or deployment of AI/GenAI models, products, or services\-based solutions.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, or equivalent enterprise technology platforms.
* Ability to present technical concepts, AI/GenAI solution methodologies, feasibility findings, and use cases through compelling visual content and stakeholder presentations.
* Proficiency in business documentation and diagramming tools such as Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, or equivalent tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and technical development teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Proven experience facilitating Scrum or Agile delivery for software, data, AI, GenAI, or digital transformation projects.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, backlog management, estimation, sprint planning, release planning, user\-story creation, acceptance criteria, and Agile metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to manage cross\-functional collaboration, facilitate decisions, resolve impediments, coordinate dependencies, and communicate delivery status effectively.

**Good\-to have Qualifications:**

* Certification from leading providers such as Microsoft, Google, IBM, or AWS, for example Azure AI Fundamentals or Azure Solutions Architect.
* Understanding of cloud security, data privacy, responsible AI, model governance, and enterprise compliance best practices.
* Experience creating and publishing whitepapers, blogs, case studies, intellectual property, or patent submissions.
* Scrum Master certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent.
* Experience managing Agile delivery for cloud\-based AI/ML, data engineering, analytics, or GenAI products.

**What You Can Expect from Us**

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
### **Role Overview**



We are transitioning our organization to an AI\-first operational model. We are seeking an **AI Product Engineer** to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.



In this role, you will be the primary builder of **automated intelligence systems**—tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.


### **Role Profile**



This is a high\-impact, hands\-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:



* **Software Engineering (50%):** Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production\-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).


* **AI Engineering (30%):** Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.


* **Data Analytics (20%):** Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture \& Integration)**


* Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.
* Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI\-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce

**2\. AI Logic \& Agent Implementation**


* Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks
* Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
* Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non\-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.

**3\. Data Engineering \& Governance**


* Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real\-time or near\-real\-time AI applications.
* Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.

### **Qualifications**


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Software Engineering:** 3\+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.
* **AI/ML Application:** Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.
* **Data Proficiency:** Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* **Business Systems Knowledge:** Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).
* **Workflow Automation:** Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.
* **B2B Domain Expertise:** Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

### **Competencies**


* **The "Builder" Mindset:** You are comfortable taking a high\-level strategic requirement from leadership (e.g., "We need to automate lead qualification") and independently architecting and coding the solution.
* **Systemic Thinking:** You understand how a change in product data schema impacts the downstream marketing automation flow.

title: Architects Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Manager/General Manager – Architecture** with **15\+ years of experience** in architecture and interior fit\-out projects, with strong exposure to **corporate offices, healthcare, hospitality, and large\-scale commercial projects**.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing strategic and technical leadership to the Architecture and Design function, overseeing projects from **concept development through design, coordination, execution, and completion**. The role requires strong leadership, client management, project coordination, design expertise, and the ability to drive quality, timelines, and commercial objectives.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of interior fit\-out methodologies and be capable of managing multiple projects and leading a team of architects, interior designers, and technical professionals.

Key Responsibilities1\. Design \& Architectural Leadership

* Lead the development of architectural and interior design concepts in line with client requirements, project objectives, and business expectations.
* Review and approve design concepts, space planning, layouts, elevations, sections, details, and working drawings.
* Ensure design solutions are practical, innovative, cost\-effective, and suitable for execution.
* Provide strategic direction on design development, materials, finishes, furniture, and technical detailing.
* Ensure consistency and quality of design standards across all projects.

2\. Project Management \& Delivery

* Oversee multiple architecture and interior fit\-out projects from concept to execution and handover.
* Monitor project progress against agreed **timelines, quality standards, budgets, and client expectations**.
* Ensure timely closure of design deliverables, drawings, approvals, material selections, and technical queries.
* Identify project risks and proactively implement corrective measures.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Teams, MEP Consultants, Procurement, Vendors, Contractors, and other stakeholders.

3\. Client \& Consultant Management

* Act as a senior point of contact for key clients and consultants.
* Lead client presentations, design reviews, project meetings, and negotiations.
* Understand client expectations and translate them into effective design and execution strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and business partners.
* Resolve design, technical, and project\-related concerns in a timely and professional manner.

4\. Team Leadership \& Development

* Lead, manage, and mentor architects, interior designers, and drafting teams.
* Allocate resources and responsibilities based on project requirements and priorities.
* Review team performance, deliverables, productivity, and quality of work.
* Develop processes, standards, and best practices for the Architecture and Design function.
* Encourage collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.

5\. Technical \& Quality Control

* Review architectural and interior drawings to ensure accuracy, constructability, and coordination.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, fire and life\-safety requirements, statutory regulations, and industry standards.
* Ensure proper coordination between architectural, interior, structural, MEP, and other services.
* Conduct design audits and site visits to ensure design intent is maintained during execution.
* Identify and resolve technical and design\-related issues arising during project execution.

6\. Commercial \& Business Support

* Support project teams in maintaining project budgets and controlling design\-related costs.
* Review and provide inputs on **BOQs, specifications, material selections, and value\-engineering proposals**.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Vendors to ensure materials and finishes meet approved design and commercial requirements.
* Support the management in new business opportunities, design proposals, and client presentations.
* Contribute to improving project profitability through efficient design and execution strategies.

7\. Process \& Strategic Development

* Establish and continuously improve design standards, workflows, templates, and documentation processes.
* Drive adoption of technology and digital tools to improve design productivity and project coordination.
* Support management in developing the company's architectural and design capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost optimization, and improved project delivery.
* Maintain awareness of current design trends, materials, technologies, and sustainable design practices.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in **Architecture** from a recognized institution.
* Minimum **15\+ years of relevant experience**, preferably with significant experience in interior fit\-out and commercial projects.
* Proven experience in **Corporate Offices, Healthcare, Hospitality, Retail, or large\-scale commercial projects**.
* Strong knowledge of architecture, interior design, construction methodologies, materials, finishes, and detailing.
* Strong understanding of complete project lifecycle from **concept, design development, tendering, execution, and handover**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, 3D Max, Photoshop, MS Office**, or equivalent design and documentation software.
* Strong knowledge of technical drawings, detailing, BOQs, specifications, and design coordination.
* Excellent project planning, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong client\-facing and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to lead and manage multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong commercial and business understanding.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing **large\-scale or multiple fit\-out projects simultaneously**.
* Experience working with leading corporate, healthcare, hospitality, or commercial clients.
* Exposure to project budgeting, tendering, procurement, vendor management, and contract coordination.
* Experience in design management or leadership roles within an interior fit\-out organization.
* Strong understanding of local building regulations, fire \& life\-safety requirements, and statutory approvals.

Key Competencies

* Architectural \& Design Leadership
* Strategic Thinking
* Project Management
* Client Management
* Team Leadership
* Technical Expertise
* Commercial Awareness
* Design \& Execution Coordination
* Problem Solving \& Decision Making
* Negotiation Skills
* Quality Orientation
* Time Management
* Communication \& Presentation Skills
* Business Development Support

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
 Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands\-on” role: you will write security\-centric code, conduct deep\-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
 Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800\-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
   

  

 Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
   

  

 Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
   

  

 Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
   

  

 Identity/Auth: Expert\-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2\.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Experience: 10\+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4\+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
   

  

 Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
   

  

 Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
   

  

 Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non\-technical leadership.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Secure Architecture \& Threat Modeling


 Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
   

  

 Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep\-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
   

  

 Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
   

  

  

* Offensive Security \& Exploitation


 In\-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
   

  

 Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
   

  

 Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high\-severity fixes.
   

  

  

* Secure Coding \& SDLC Integration


 Secure Code Review: Review high\-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
   

  

 Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine\-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
   

  

 Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair\-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Director – Observability, Response & Reliability (ORR)
description:
**About The Company**
 Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
   

  

 Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a visionary
 **Director – Observability, Response \& Reliability (ORR)** 
 with
 **15\+ years of overall technical experience, including 5\+ years in engineering leadership** 
 , to serve as our primary authority on system resilience, full\-stack observability, and enterprise incident management across Netspend's global financial ecosystem.
   

  

 In this high\-visibility role, you will lead our India\-based ORR organization, driving the strategy that transforms how Netspend monitors, predicts, responds to, and resolves critical operational events. You will establish a
 **world\-class Observability and AIOps practice** 
 , institutionalize
 **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** 
 principles across all product teams, and safeguard systems handling ACH processing, core payment rails, millions of daily card transactions, and bank\-sensitive data.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Observability Strategy \& Telemetry Architecture
* Unified Telemetry Vision: Design and execute the enterprise Observability roadmap, establishing full\-stack, end\-to\-end visibility across microservices, legacy monoliths, cloud infrastructure, and data pipelines (Kafka, Cassandra).
* MELT Standardizer: Define unified logging, metrics, traces, and synthetics standards (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk, Dynatrace) across all engineering groups to enable granular transaction\-level tracing for payment flows.
* AIOps \& Self\-Healing Systems: Pioneer the adoption of AIOps, Machine Learning, and anomaly detection to shift the engineering culture from reactive alert firefighting to proactive noise reduction, predictive fault detection, and automated self\-healing workflows.
* Financial Data Observability: Build custom monitoring, alert thresholds, and real\-time dashboards for critical FinTech protocols, payment rails, ACH file watching, and bank connectivity channels (Axway, SFTP, AS2\).
* Reliability Engineering, Resilience \& SLO Management
* SRE Practice Ownership: Institutionalize SRE paradigms (SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets, Reliability Reviews) across all software product squads, embedding reliability directly into the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Chaos Engineering \& Testing: Establish proactive resilience practices, including failure injection, Chaos Engineering, and regular multi\-AZ/multi\-region Disaster Recovery (DR) simulations for critical financial services.
* Cost\-Effective Reliability (FinOps): Partner with cloud and finance leadership to balance extreme uptime demands with cost efficiency across Splunk, Dynatrace, AWS telemetry storage, and log ingestion limits.
* Enterprise Incident Response \& Operational Governance
* Major Incident Command (P0/P1\): Oversee the high\-severity Incident Management framework, ensuring 24/7 incident readiness, rapid mean time to detect (MTTD), and swift mean time to resolve/recover (MTTR).
* Blameless Post\-Mortems \& RCA: Champion a culture of psychological safety through rigorous, blameless post\-mortems and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to drive systemic platform fixes and prevent recurring outages.
* Executive Reliability Reporting: Establish transparent reporting frameworks to translate uptime metrics, availability SLAs, error budget consumption, and platform risks directly to C\-suite leadership (CTO, CIO).
* Strategic Cloud Transformation \& Infrastructure Evolution
* Strangler Pattern Execution: Provide reliability oversight for moving critical functions off legacy platforms (Xymon, Puppet, SVN) to cloud\-native AWS architectures without risking live financial traffic or data loss.
* CI/CD \& IaC Standards: Enforce strict Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/Ansible) and GitLab CI/CD pipeline reliability, integrating automated canary deployments, security scans, and instant rollback mechanisms.
* Security \& Compliance Oversight: Partner with security teams to ensure all observability logging, tracing, and automation frameworks comply strictly with PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, mTLS, and banking audit standards.
* Organizational Leadership \& Vendor Ownership
* India ORR Center of Excellence: Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing team of Site Reliability Engineers, Observability Specialists, and Incident Response Leads in India.
* Talent Development: Define technical career paths, performance benchmarks, and continuous learning opportunities in observability and SRE for mid\-level and senior engineers.
* Vendor Governance: Manage strategic relationships, licensing, contractual negotiations, and technical roadmaps with key observability and cloud partners (Splunk, Dynatrace, AWS, GitLab).


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education \& Overall Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.
* 15\+ years of total experience in SRE, Systems/Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Architecture, and Enterprise Observability.


**Core Observability \& Reliability Expertise**
* Observability Mastery: Deep expertise architecting enterprise telemetry solutions using tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
* AIOps \& Automation: Proven track record implementing AIOps tools, automated incident remediation, and AI/ML\-based anomaly detection engines.
* SRE Leadership: Expert knowledge of SRE best practices, error budget policy enforcement, SLO modeling, and incident response frameworks.


**Technical \& Systems Foundation**
* Cloud \& Modern Infrastructure: Strong hands\-on architectural understanding of AWS services (EC2, ALB/NLB, Direct Connect, IAM, KMS, Transfer Family).
* Legacy\-to\-Cloud Modernization: Practical experience executing "strangler fig" migration strategies off legacy tooling (Puppet, SVN, Xymon) to modern GitOps/IaC (GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Ansible).
* Data \& Middleware: Experience monitoring and troubleshooting distributed middleware and database technologies (Apache Kafka, Cassandra) under heavy throughput.
* FinTech \& Secure Protocols: Understanding of secure file transfer (SFTP, AS2\), mTLS, cryptographic key management (HSMs, Virtucrypt), and high\-availability payment processing environments.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Observability: Splunk Certified Architect, Dynatrace Master / Professional, or equivalent.
* Cloud \& DevOps: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
* SRE \& Methodologies: Certified Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), ITIL v4 (Incident/Problem Management focus).

title: Senior BIM Engineer - Geo Environmental Engineering
description:
The suitable candidate for this role is a Senior BIM Engineer specialising in Geo\-Environmental, Civil infrastructure projects, with a strong focus on digital delivery and Civil 3D modelling. The role involves close coordination with design engineers and multidisciplinary teams across India and global regions, supporting project delivery through high\-quality CAD and 3D modelling outputs.


The Senior BIM Engineer will take ownership of 3D modelling, drafting, and preparation of design documentation for Geo\-Environmental, civil infrastructure, including water supply, wastewater, stormwater systems, and utility networks. The role supports projects across all stages, from concept and preliminary design through to detailed design and construction documentation.


Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining Civil 3D models (surfaces, alignments, corridors, pipe networks), integrating GIS and survey data, ensuring QA/QC compliance, and delivering accurate, coordinated, and construction\-ready digital deliverables aligned with project standards and client expectations.


  
Responsibilities


* Develop, review, and maintain high\-quality 2D and 3D CAD models and drawings for Geo\-Environmental, civil infrastructure projects, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project requirements, Australian standards, and company guidelines.
* Produce and manage detailed 3D civil models in Autodesk Civil 3D, including surfaces, alignments, profiles, corridors, grading, and utility models.
* Prepare accurate engineering drawings and documentation, including plans, sections, long sections, details, and construction drawings suitable for tender and construction stages.
* Manage and process spatial/geospatial data (GIS/CAD) to support design development, analysis, and project documentation workflows.
* Coordinate closely with engineers, designers, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure design intent, technical standards, and project requirements are fully achieved.
* Lead the coordination and integration of digital design models across disciplines (civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical) to ensure clash\-free and constructible solutions.
* Maintain and enforce CAD/BIM standards, naming conventions, and modelling best practices, ensuring consistency and quality across deliverables.
* Perform quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) checks and audits of drawings and models in line with project specifications, company standards, and client requirements.

title: Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor
description:
### **Position Summary**



We are seeking a Cybersecurity \& Compliance Advisor to strengthen cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities across business functions and digital solutions. The role will serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, technology teams, and leadership by ensuring cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and corporate policies are effectively integrated into business operations and digital programs.



The Cybersecurity \& Compliance Advisor will assess security risks, define mitigation strategies, support compliance initiatives, and guide teams through security assurance activities across cloud, enterprise, and operational technology environments. The position requires strong expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, security controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance, combined with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical business solutions.



This is a highly collaborative role requiring effective stakeholder engagement, governance leadership, and the ability to drive security awareness and compliance maturity across global and cross\-functional teams.



A Snapshot of your Day



A typical day involves collaborating with project teams, solution architects, IT leaders, and business stakeholders to evaluate cybersecurity risks and compliance requirements for ongoing initiatives. You review security assessments, advise on remediation activities, and ensure controls align with enterprise standards and regulatory obligations.



You may participate in governance reviews, support audits, assess cloud and application security designs, and provide recommendations that enable secure business operations while balancing productivity, innovation, and risk management objectives.



How You’ll Make an Impact (responsibilities of role)



Strategic


* Develop and promote cybersecurity governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Advise business and technology leaders on cybersecurity risks, compliance obligations, and security\-by\-design principles during digital transformation initiatives.
* Drive cybersecurity risk management programs by identifying emerging threats, assessing business impact, and recommending pragmatic mitigation strategies.
* Support the development and execution of compliance roadmaps to improve organizational security maturity and regulatory readiness.
* Partner with stakeholders to establish security requirements for enterprise applications, cloud services, operational systems, and third\-party solutions.
* Monitor cybersecurity trends, industry standards, and evolving regulations, ensuring the organization remains aligned with best practices and compliance expectations.
* Promote security awareness and foster a culture of accountability for cybersecurity and data protection throughout the organization.


Operational


* Conduct security risk assessments, control reviews, and compliance evaluations across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and operational processes.
* Support internal and external audits by coordinating evidence collection, control validation, remediation tracking, and compliance reporting.
* Review solution architectures, project designs, and implementation plan to identify security gaps and recommend appropriate controls.
* Perform vendor and third\-party security assessments to evaluate cybersecurity posture and contractual compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with technical teams to implement security controls related to identity management, data protection, network security, monitoring, and incident response.
* Track cybersecurity findings, vulnerabilities, and compliance deviations while driving corrective and preventive actions.
* Support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned activities from a governance and compliance perspective.
* Maintain cybersecurity documentation, risk registers, policy records, and compliance artifacts to support governance and auditability.


What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets)


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security governance, compliance, risk management, or related advisory roles.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and industry standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting compliance programs related to data privacy, information security, cloud security, and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to conduct security risk assessments, define mitigation plans, and communicate risk decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with enterprise security controls including identity and access management, data protection, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response.
* Strong understanding of cloud security principles across Azure, AWS, or hybrid environments.
* Experience collaborating with global cross\-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance security requirements with operational and business objectives while driving practical outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CCSP, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting cybersecurity requirements within industrial, energy, engineering, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure environments.
* Knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) security and industrial cybersecurity controls.
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance frameworks such as GDPR and related international standards.
* Experience with security governance platforms, GRC solutions, and audit management tools.
* Exposure to DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle methodologies.
* Experience leading cybersecurity awareness initiatives, compliance assessments, or regulatory audits at enterprise scale.


Tech Stack


* Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC): ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer, MetricStream, or similar platforms for risk management, control monitoring, and audit readiness.
* Cloud Security: Microsoft Azure Security Center, Microsoft Defender, AWS Security Services, and cloud governance solutions to manage security posture and compliance.
* Identity \& Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Privileged Access Management, RBAC, and multi\-factor authentication technologies.
* Security Monitoring \& Threat Detection: SIEM and security analytics platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent solutions.
* Vulnerability \& Risk Management: Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar solutions for vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, and risk reporting.
* Compliance \& Audit Management: Policy management, evidence collection, control testing, and regulatory reporting tools supporting governance activities.
* Collaboration \& Reporting: Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, and ServiceNow for stakeholder engagement, reporting, and governance workflows.
* Methodologies \& Frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, Risk Management Frameworks, and Security\-by\-Design principles.

title: Project Lead - MEPF

This position ensures that MEP/FP installations meet client requirements, comply with codes and standards, and are delivered on time and within budget.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Leadership \& Design Oversight
  
Provide technical leadership for all MEPF systems throughout project planning, design, construction, and commissioning phases. Review and approve design drawings, specifications, and calculations to ensure compliance with building codes, industry standards, and client requirements. Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and other design consultants to integrate MEPF systems effectively into overall building design.
  
Project Management \& Coordination
  
Lead MEPF scope definition, budget development, and scheduling for projects ranging from tenant improvements to ground\-up construction. Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper installation and system integration. Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, verify quality, and resolve technical issues.
  
Quality Assurance \& Compliance
  
Ensure all MEPF installations comply with local, state, and federal regulations including building codes, energy codes, and safety standards. Review submittals, shop drawings, and product data for conformance with design intent and specifications. Oversee testing, balancing, and commissioning activities to verify system performance.
  
Client \& Stakeholder Management
  
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients on MEPF matters. Present design options, value engineering alternatives, and technical recommendations to clients and stakeholders. Prepare technical reports, progress updates, and presentations for client meetings.
  
Risk Management \& Problem Solving
  
Identify potential technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout the project lifecycle. Resolve design conflicts, construction issues, and system performance problems efficiently. Manage change orders and assess their impact on project scope, schedule, and budget.
  
Team Development \& Collaboration
  
Mentor junior engineers and technical staff on MEPF best practices and standards. Collaborate with JLL's multidisciplinary project teams including project managers, cost consultants, and sustainability advisors. Support business development efforts through technical proposal preparation and client presentations.
  
Required QualificationsEducation \& Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Plumbing Engineering (or related field). Minimum 8\-10 years of experience in MEPF design, construction, or project management within commercial real estate, preferably in consulting or owner's representation roles. Professional Engineering (PE) license preferred or required depending on jurisdiction.
  
Technical Expertise
  
Deep knowledge of HVAC, electrical power distribution, lighting systems, plumbing, and fire protection systems. Proficiency in reading and interpreting construction drawings, specifications, and technical documents. Understanding of building energy codes, sustainability standards (LEED, WELL, etc.), and life safety codes. Familiarity with building automation systems (BAS/BMS) and energy management strategies.
  
Project \& Business Skills
  
Strong project management capabilities with experience managing multiple concurrent projects. Proven ability to manage budgets, schedules, and resources effectively. Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non\-technical audiences. Strong problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  
Software \& Tools
  
Proficiency with MS Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, or other design software beneficial. Experience with project management tools and document control systems.
  
Preferred QualificationsLEED AP, CEM (Certified Energy Manager), or CxA (Commissioning Authority) certification. Experience with data centers, healthcare facilities, laboratory environments, or other mission\-critical facilities. Knowledge of smart building technologies, IoT integration, and building analytics platforms. Experience working on corporate workplace, life sciences, or industrial projects.
  
Working ConditionsPosition requires regular site visits to active construction sites (PPE required). Occasional travel to project sites, client meetings, and industry events. Office\-based work with flexible hybrid arrangements depending on location. Standard business hours with occasional extended hours during critical project phases.
  
About JLL Projects \& Development Services
  
JLL's Projects \& Development Services delivers comprehensive project and development management solutions for corporate occupiers, investors, and developers worldwide. We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

1. Define and enforce code review, design review and security review standards.
2. Maintain final approval authority on architecture decisions and technical debt trade\-offs.
3. Drive the development of reusable frameworks, accelerators and reference implementations.

1. Lead, structure and scale the engineering organisation across all technical disciplines.
2. Own technical hiring, including role definition, assessment frameworks and interview panels.
3. Establish performance management, career progression paths and technical competency frameworks.

description:

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The **Senior Partner Sales Account Manager (PSAM) – Prime Segment** is a senior sales leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth, net\-new customer acquisition, and aggressive territory expansion within top\-tier ("Prime") enterprise partner ecosystems.


Designed for a seasoned sales professional with **10 to 12 years of enterprise sales and partnership experience** , this position blends strategic territory development with senior\-level deal execution. You will build and scale new geographic or vertical territories, lead complex co\-selling pursuits, and align matrixed teams—orchestrating tight execution across **Territory Sales Managers (TSMs)** , **Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs)** , and executive partner leadership.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Strategic Territory Development \& New Customer Acquisition**

* Formulate and execute multi\-year territory growth plans to capture white space and drive aggressive **net\-new customer acquisition** across Prime enterprise accounts.
* Lead end\-to\-end sales pursuits for high\-value strategic opportunities, establishing multi\-threaded connections across C\-suite executives, procurement, and technical leadership.
* Own the overarching revenue and pipeline development results for the Prime Segment portfolio.

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Sales Orchestration (TSM \& ISR Leadership)**

* **Territory Sales Managers (TSMs):** Co\-develop regional GTM plans, align on field coverage, and co\-sell high\-stakes enterprise deals to drive velocity and deal size.
* **Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs):** Direct inbound and outbound pipeline\-generation initiatives, set lead\-qualification standards, and convert high\-intent prospects into closing opportunities.
* Establish clear rules of engagement across partner, field, and inside channels to eliminate overlap and maximize rep productivity.

### **3\. Senior Partner Alliance \& Executive Alignment**

* Architect and manage Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with Prime partners, securing executive buy\-in, co\-investment budgets, and dedicated partner sales resource commitments.
* Design and deploy advanced partner enablement models, sales playbooks, and co\-selling frameworks that increase partner\-led deal sourcing.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic deal structuring, commercial negotiations, and high\-value renewals.

### **4\. Operational Rigor \& Commercial Execution**

* Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate multi\-quarter forecasting using enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
* Lead high\-impact Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with internal executive sponsors and external partner leadership to evaluate performance.
* Gather market and competitor intelligence to influence product roadmaps and strategic GTM investments.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**
----------------------------------

### **Experience \& Track Record**

* **10–12\+ years** of progressive experience in B2B enterprise sales, channel account management, or strategic alliances within SaaS, Enterprise Software, or Cloud Infrastructure environments.
* Consistent track record of managing enterprise\-level client and partner accounts.
* Demonstrated history of launching **net\-new territories** and building high\-yield partner co\-sell ecosystems from the ground up.

### **Leadership \& Collaborative Competencies**

* Master\-level expertise in orchestrating tri\-party coverage models with **Field Sales (TSMs)** and **Inside Sales (ISRs)** teams.
* Executive presence with proven capability to negotiate complex, multi\-stakeholder commercial terms with C\-level executives (CEO, CRO, CIO).
* Strategic mindset with strong financial literacy, capable of designing revenue\-share models, joint GTM budgets, and commercial contracts.

### **Technical \& Systems Proficiency**

* Advanced proficiency in CRM ecosystems (Salesforce), partner relationship management (PRM) tools, and sales engagement stacks

title: System Software Engineer - Performance Verification Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 Join NVIDIA's GPU Performance Infrastructure team and be part of a brand\-new journey in validating and shipping next\-generation GPU architectures. At NVIDIA, we empower our engineers to innovate and drive powerful performance through innovative infrastructure and workflows. This role is uniquely positioned to influence the entire lifecycle of GPU performance verification, from early\-stage modelling to post\-silicon validation. * Design and maintain automated chip performance verification pipelines spanning workload trace generation, multi\-target test execution, results post\-processing, and correlation with architectural performance targets.
* Develop performance monitoring and measurement infrastructure that provides consistent observability across simulation, emulation, and silicon environments.
* Build scalable data pipelines and full\-stack dashboards to ingest, visualize, and compare performance metrics across builds and environments.
* Coordinate with GPU architects to craft infrastructure for performance verification of upcoming architectures.
* Work closely with HW teams to automate and accelerate verification workflows, enabling faster GPU build iteration.
* Empower GPU architects by providing insights to understand current performance and model industry\-leading performance for future builds.
* Improve the daily workflows of the world's top chip architects, contributing to the creation of the next greatest generation of GPUs!


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in C\+\+, with Python for tooling and automation.
* Strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, OOP, and system design.
* Full\-stack experience with backend (Java/Python), REST APIs, and modern frontend (React/Ember) for data\-intensive applications is a plus.
* Proficiency in databases (SQL, MongoDB) for metrics storage and querying is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and messaging systems (RabbitMQ) is a plus.
* Exposure to GPU/CPU/SoC chip performance verification is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI development tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Integrations)
description:
**About The Position**
 The Principal Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, deploys, monitors, and supports software solutions. Ensures quality, security, privacy, reliability, availability, maintainability, performance, compatibility, and integrations of solutions throughout. Advances the team's technical foundation to deliver modern, simple, and secure solutions, and raises the engineering skills within the squad. Scope of delivery is for a single squad.
   

  

**How You’ll Make a Difference**
 Responsible for design, development, testing, maintenance, monitoring, and support of a platform or application. Maintains thoughtful application design that promotes reuse, portability, and ease of code maintenance. Builds subject matter expertise in the business area that the platform or application supports. Leads with high autonomy the execution and utilization of reference implementations, best practices, frameworks and standards, and architectural and design decisions within a squad. Notifies technical stakeholders of technical or functional changes.
   

  

 Contributes to the team's backlog to capture work that promotes the team's mission and advances the team's technical foundation. Partners with teammates to refine the product backlog. Partners with peer Engineers and the Product Owner to lead the team in breaking down larger bodies of work (epics) into smaller, well\-understood items (stories) that can be accomplished in a single iteration. Ensures stories have clearly understood value and defined acceptance criteria. Communicates with key partners and dependent squads to understand scope of planned work. Partners with Product Managers in the domain to inform prioritization, identify dependencies, and influence the product roadmap. Generates stories for backlog to address performance, non\-functional requirements, tech debt, modernization, and simplification.
   

  

 Participates in team's agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-up, backlog refinement, planning, review/demo, and retrospectives. Helps drive collaboration within the team through practices such as pair programming. Actively seeks ways to drive continuous improvement within team. Leads team through resolution of blockers, and implementation of new practices identified as part of team's continuous improvement goals.
   

  

 Understands the team's application architecture and how it fits into the team's broader area as well as to the enterprise via key dependencies. Partners with Solution Architects to understand, help define, and adopt enterprise patterns and technology goals. Implements reference architectures with tool selection and implementation to deliver cost effective solutions that drive the right business value. Helps maintain architecture documentation for relevant capabilities and systems.
   

  

 Mentors individuals in the squad and peers on partner squads on technical delivery. Works to build technical skills in teammates through direction, example, and by creating opportunities for others to learn. Participates in communities of practice on technical topics and encourages team members to join where technical interests or development opportunities align.
   

  

 Partners with established vendors on implementations, modernization, capability improvements, and framework updates. Influences partners' roadmaps. Performs technical evaluations and makes recommendations around new incoming solutions.
   

  

 Establishes and manages quality standards, decisions, and implementations. Leverages automation where possible to create efficiency and reliability in delivery of software. Ensures application, performance, uptime, and scale. Defines and maintains high standards of code quality. Participates in peer code reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and knowledge transfer is part of regular delivery. Troubleshoots and fixes bugs and security risks. Identifies bottlenecks, patterns, and potential solutions related to incoming bugs and defects to improve software efficiency. Partners with peer engineers on software development lifecycle improvements. Creates and maintains support playbooks.
   

  

 Leverages best practices, technologies, and instrumentation to lead the team in regular monitoring and observation of health, availability, and performance of software in production to provide appropriate application support and inform roadmap/backlog improvements. Partners with the squad and peers across squads to diagnose performance issues found in monitoring. Identifies and implements new monitoring and proactive alerting mechanisms to inform the squad of issues before problems reach consumers and stakeholders.
   

  

**YOU ARE**
* Bachelor’s degree, applicable certification or equivalent experience.
* Typically requires 8\+ years of professional experience and mastery of relevant technical or business skills required to accomplish the job.
* 5\+ years of designing Big Data systems and processes in a Cloud environment.
* Expert in SQL and query optimization techniques.
* 5\+ years’ experience with programming languages.
* 3\+ years of Apache Spark with Python Experience in design and development of an Enterprise CI/CD process.
* Expert in all technologies in the data platform (Data Factory, Databricks, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and SQLDB).
* Coding proficiency in a modern programming or scripting language Azure stack experience preferred (Logic and Function apps).

title: Staff Software Engineer - DSP FW
description:
Responsibilities:
The Staff SW Engineer \- DSP FW role involves developing embedded firmware for MaxLinear SoCs, including low\-level drivers, boot code, RTOS\-based software, and DSP algorithm implementation. The position requires expertise in C/C\+\+, RTOS (ThreadX/FreeRTOS), ARM/Tensilica processors, and digital signal processing for communication systems. The engineer will work closely with ASIC, algorithm, and systems teams, while also focusing on debugging, performance optimization, code reviews, and firmware development for RF control, calibration, and signal processing applications. You will focus on:
* Design and implement software for Maxlinear SoCs; this includes developing low level firmware drivers, system boot code, RTOS abstraction layers, firmware features and host applications
* Develop FW to exercise the HW data paths
* Develop FW to implement DSP algorithms
* Participate in peer code and design reviews and Unit testing
* Interface with ASIC, algorithm, and systems engineers
* Performance tuning and optimization of firmware stack

Qualifications:
* Excellent C/C\+\+ programming skills
* Experience of developing embedded firmware/software on top of an RTOS
* Experience in working on ARM/Tensilica processors
* In depth understanding of RTOS (ThreadX/FreeRTOS)
* Understanding/implementation of Digital signal processing for communication systems
* Experience of debugging embedded firmware using JTAG and/or instruments like oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, etc
* Experience in implementing signal processing algorithms in C
* Experience with FW control loops for RF front end, ADC/DAC calibration
* Experience with DPD, AGC, power control FW
* In depth understanding of version control software – SVN or Git or Perforce
* Ticketing systems like JIRA or Redmine or Bugzilla
* BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science or communications or related domain – 2 to 6 yrs


Company Overview:

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ\-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system\-on\-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio\-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed\-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi\-market applications.  

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.  

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high\-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high\-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long\-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end\-to\-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.  

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.  

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside\-the\-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high\-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

title: Enterprise App Admin II - DocuSign CLM Administrator & Workflow Developer
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.


Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.


DocuSign CLM Administrator and Workflow Developer  

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience  

software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide.  

Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive  

while enjoying the journey together.  

We are seeking a skilled DocuSign CLM Administrator and Workflow Developer to join our Business  

Technology team. This role is responsible for administering, configuring, and maintaining the DocuSign  

CLM platform, including users, permissions, templates, workflows, metadata, and repositories, and for  

building and maintaining the commercial document templates and workflows used to generate, route,  

negotiate, and execute Five9's customer agreements.  

The ideal candidate has three to five years of business systems administration experience, including at  

least two years of hands\-on DocuSign CLM administration, and holds a Certified DocuSign CLM  

Administrator credential, with a Certified DocuSign CLM Workflow Developer credential strongly  

preferred.  

The position is a hybrid role combining in\-office and work\-from\-home days, based in Chennai or  

Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until  

approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.  

Key Responsibilities  

* Administer, configure, and maintain the DocuSign CLM platform, including users, permissions,


templates, workflows, metadata, and repositories.  

* Create and maintain commercial document templates — including Master Services Agreements,


service orders, order forms, amendments, and renewals — using legal language and clauses  

approved by the Legal team.  

* Develop and maintain DocuSign CLM workflows for document generation, review, approval,


negotiation, signature, storage, amendments, and renewals.  

* Configure conditional content and clause selection based on product, pricing, transaction type,


and geography.  

* Support the generation of service orders and commercial documents from Salesforce CPQ quotes


and quote line information, and maintain related field mappings between Salesforce CPQ,  

DocuSign CLM, and DocuSign eSignature.  

* Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and other stakeholders to translate


business and legal requirements into scalable templates and workflows.  

The New CX Starts Here  

* Troubleshoot document generation, workflow, data mapping, and electronic signature issues, and


drive them to resolution.  

* Identify opportunities to simplify contract processes, reduce manual effort, and accelerate


contract execution.  

* Participate in moderately complex CLM enhancements and projects, working independently with


guidance on broader architectural or strategic decisions.  

Key Requirements  

Required Qualifications:  

* Three to five years of business systems administration experience, including at least two years of


hands\-on DocuSign CLM administration.  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent


practical experience.  

* Certified DocuSign CLM Administrator credential required; Certified DocuSign CLM Workflow


Developer credential strongly preferred, given the role's focus on building and modifying approval  

and document workflows.  

* Experience configuring and supporting a production DocuSign CLM implementation, including


users, permissions, security, repositories, and metadata.  

* Hands\-on experience building DocuSign CLM workflows, including approval routing, conditional


steps, notifications, escalations, and exception handling.  

* Experience building and maintaining commercial document templates (e.g., Master Services


Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, renewals) and clause libraries using legal  

language approved by the Legal team.  

* Experience supporting Salesforce CPQ generated quotes and commercial documents, including


familiarity with the underlying Salesforce data (Account, Opportunity, Quote, Quote Line, Product,  

Contract).  

* Experience maintaining integrations and field mappings between Salesforce CPQ, DocuSign CLM,


and DocuSign eSignature, and ensuring contract status and executed agreements are accurately  

returned to Salesforce.  

* Working knowledge of DocuSign eSignature, including envelope templates, recipients, signing


order, and authentication.  

* Basic Salesforce administrator\-level knowledge (objects, fields, relationships, and permission sets)


and familiarity with the Salesforce CPQ data model and document generation process.  

* Working knowledge of XML, JSON, HTML, basic JavaScript, REST APIs, and SQL.


The New CX Starts Here  

* Proficiency with Microsoft Word template formatting, including tables, styles, sections, headers,


and conditional content.  

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to work


independently across Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT, and across a distributed,  

global team.  

Preferred Qualifications:  

* DocuSign eSignature Administrator or Salesforce Certified Administrator certification is a plus.
* DocuSign CLM Implementation Consultant or Technical Consultant certification is a plus,


particularly for candidates building more complex integrations or performing solution  

architecture.  

Why You'll Love This Role:  

* You will play a central role in shaping how Five9 generates, negotiates, and executes customer


contracts at scale.  

* You will partner closely with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance, gaining broad


visibility into the commercial contracting process.  

* You will work at the intersection of Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, DocuSign CLM, and DocuSign


eSignature, solving practical, cross\-system problems that directly impact deal velocity.  

* If you enjoy simplifying complex processes and building reliable, well\-documented systems, this


role offers strong opportunities to grow your CLM and business systems expertise.
Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.



View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.  

  



Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.
