title: Application Development & Support Analyst
description:
**Role Statement:**

The Junior RPA, Automation \& AI Analyst is an entry\-level role supporting the delivery of process automation and operational efficiency initiatives within the ERP Tech Factory. Under the guidance of a Senior Analyst or the ERP Tech Factory Lead, this role contributes to the design, development, and deployment of RPA \& automation solutions and AI\-powered tools.
  

This role focuses on building core technical skills, executing assigned automation tasks, maintaining solution assets, and contributing to the Automation Factory's delivery pipeline. It serves as the foundational entry point into the RPA \& Automation discipline, providing exposure to enterprise\-scale automation, AI\-powered tooling, and structured development practices.


**Key Duties**

Automation \& AI Solution Development
  

* Develop and deploy automation solutions and AI\-powered tools under senior guidance, executing assigned development tasks in accordance with established architectural standards and best practices.
* Build automations using RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, WePath) to reduce manual effort and support process efficiency across business functions.
* Support the configuration and testing of AI\-powered tools, ensuring solutions are functional, reliable, and aligned with defined requirements.
* Participate in technical reviews and testing cycles, providing input on solution quality and flagging issues for senior review and resolution.
  

**Asset Maintenance \& Documentation**  

* Maintain and update reusable automation and AI solution assets, ensuring they remain accurate, functional, and consistent with the latest platform and process requirements.
* Document developed solutions, workflows, and operational procedures to support knowledge retention, team onboarding, and future maintainability.
* Follow established development frameworks, naming conventions, and version control practices to ensure all deliverables meet team quality standards.
* Support incident resolution for assigned automation solutions by performing root\-cause analysis and implementing fixes under senior supervision.
  

**Process Analysis Support**  

* Support the identification of automation and AI use case opportunities by analyzing process inefficiencies, repetitive manual tasks, and error\-prone workflows.
* Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements, process flows, and use case specifications required for automation scoping and development.

title: Application Development & Support Senior Analyst
description:

This role leads the end\-to\-end design, development, and deployment of scalable Robotic Process Automation (RPA), broader automation solutions, and AI\-powered tools that eliminate manual effort, reduce error rates, and accelerate business process performance.
  

Acting as the technical lead for automation and AI initiatives, this role owns architectural decisions, defines development standards and reusable frameworks, and ensures solutions progress from proof\-of\-concept through to globally standardised, production\-grade deployments. The Senior Analyst mentors junior team members, leads technical reviews, and actively partners with ERP Second Level Support, Third\-Level Support Engineers, and Software Development/Platform Engineers to ensure automation solutions are aligned with platform architecture and business priorities.

You will work at the intersection of deep learning, real\-time video processing, and scalable backend systems, contributing to use cases across security, retail, traffic, and industrial environments. * Strong programming skills in Python and preferably C\+\+ along with good command of Linux development environments.
* Hands\-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Practical knowledge of video processing and CV tooling such as OpenCV, GStreamer, FFmpeg, or NVIDIA DeepStream.
* Experience deploying or optimizing models using TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO, or similar inference frameworks.
* Good understanding of object detection, tracking, and classification techniques, with the ability to evaluate model behavior using real\-world data.

* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, edge GPUs, NVRs, or other resource\-constrained deployment platforms.
* Exposure to action recognition, pose estimation, segmentation, face recognition, or license plate recognition.
* Familiarity with model benchmarking, experiment tracking, and validation workflows.
* Understanding of challenging deployment conditions such as crowding, occlusions, low light, and varied camera angles.
* Basic exposure to MLOps tooling such as MLflow, DVC, Weights \& Biases, or Kubeflow.
* Awareness of streaming protocols such as RTSP, WebRTC, HLS, or SRT.
* Interest in applied research, experimentation, and adapting recent computer vision approaches for production use.

  
* Design and develop end\-to\-end video analytics pipelines covering ingestion, decoding, preprocessing, inference, and post\-processing.
* Build, fine\-tune, test, and deploy computer vision models for object detection, tracking, classification, action recognition, and anomaly detection.
* Analyze model outputs, identify common failure cases, and support experiments to improve robustness under occlusion, crowd density, lighting variation, and camera diversity.
* Optimize inference performance on edge and cloud GPUs using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, or similar runtimes.
* Implement real\-time video processing using GStreamer, FFmpeg, or DeepStream, with low\-latency streaming over RTSP, WebRTC, or HLS.
* Support dataset curation, annotation review, data augmentation, and retraining workflows to improve model quality over time.
* Collaborate with product, QA, and senior technical teams to translate business requirements into deployable analytics features.
* Contribute to benchmarking, validation, and performance measurement using clear metrics for accuracy, latency, and throughput.
* Engineer backend services and supporting utilities for multi\-camera orchestration, metadata handling, and monitoring.
* Maintain documentation, write unit and integration tests, and follow CI/CD best practices for model and service releases.

title: Medical Coding Auditor-1
description:
**Position Summary**

Veradigm is seeking experienced Medical Coders to support our enterprise coding capability. Applicants will focus on ensuring accuracy in AI\-generated medical codes, chart preparation, and drafting clinical notes. You will review the outputs of AI agents and compare to clinical documentation, to ensure that codes are supported, billable, and accurate. Coders will also shape the guidelines we use and help define clinical metrics we report to customers.


This is a role where you will use your experience and critical thinking skills to improve systems. It is not a standard coding position; you will not handle billing, provider education, or denials. The consistency and defensibility of your reasoning are prioritized over high\-volume processing.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Coding Evaluation**

* Review AI\-generated ICD\-10\-CM, CPT, and HCPCS code sets against the clinical documentation, recording for each code whether the note supports it and where.
* Distinguish clinically defensible additions from unsupported inference. Identify both over\-coding, which creates audit risk, and under\-coding, which leaves care unreimbursed.
* Evaluate E/M level selection, including correct setting and visit type, against documentation and applicable CMS guidelines.
* Apply and improve the scoring guide consistently from the first case to the hundredth.
* Participate in dual review, independently scoring the same encounter as another reviewer and working through disagreements to a documented resolution.
* Flag cases where the scoring guide is ambiguous or silent rather than resolving them quietly, so the guide can be corrected before the ambiguity spreads through the dataset.
* Work across specialties, beginning with internal medicine, applying specialty\-specific conventions and noting where documentation patterns change how output should be judged.

**Beyond Coding**

* Review outputs that providers flag as incorrect in our products, determining whether the flag reflects a genuine agent error, a documentation gap, or a difference in provider preference.
* Help validate automated scoring systems by reviewing a sample of cases an automated judge has already scored, so we can measure where it agrees with expert judgment.
* Explain patterns in agent errors to machine learning engineers and product managers in terms they can act on, escalating systemic issues rather than scoring the same error repeatedly, and give feedback where the review tool slows accurate review.

**Benefits**

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.


* Quarterly Company\-Wide Recharge Days

* Tuition Reimbursement Program

title: Product Manager Agentic AI
description:
**About the Role** 




 Innefu Labs is looking for a Product Manager who has personally taken an agentic AI product from a blank whiteboard to a production system — not someone who has only added AI features to an existing roadmap. You will own the vision, architecture\-level tradeoffs, and go\-to\-market for a multi\-agent, LLM\-driven product line, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineering, applied AI, and design to ship autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act with minimal human handholding.
 



 This is a builder's role. You are expected to be technically fluent enough to sit inside architecture discussions on agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate that into a roadmap, prioritization model, and business outcome the rest of the company can rally behind.
 



 Location Delhi
 



 5 Days Work from office
 



**What You Will Own** 



* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic AI product built from zero — problem discovery, architecture direction, MVP scoping, and scale\-up.
* Translate ambiguous, open\-ended problems into a phased agentic system design: which tasks are agent\-driven vs. deterministic, where human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints belong, and how autonomy expands release over release.
* Partner with engineering on core architecture decisions — agent orchestration and planning layers, tool\-calling/function\-calling design, memory and state management, RAG and retrieval pipelines, and multi\-agent coordination patterns.
* Own the evaluation framework for agent quality — task success rate, hallucination/error rate, latency, cost\-per\-task, and safety guardrails — and use it to drive prioritization, not just measure it after the fact.
* Define prompt, tool, and knowledge\-source specifications working directly with applied AI/ML engineers; review agent behavior transcripts and failure cases as part of the regular product cycle.
* Run structured discovery with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders to identify high\-value workflows for autonomous or semi\-autonomous automation.
* Own the build\-vs\-buy and framework decisions in collaboration with engineering (agent frameworks, vector databases, LLM providers, orchestration layers) and stay current on the fast\-moving agentic AI ecosystem.
* Define and track north\-star and input metrics for the product — adoption, task completion, time\-saved, cost\-to\-serve — and report outcomes to leadership.
* Own the end\-to\-end roadmap prioritization, sprint\-level scoping with engineering, and release planning; write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for agent\-based features.
* Represent the product externally — customer demos, RFP/technical proposal support, and partner/analyst conversations — with the technical depth to answer architecture\-level questions directly.



**What You Bring** 



* 8–12 years in product management, with demonstrable ownership of at least one AI/ML or agentic AI product taken from concept/zero to a live, adopted release — not just a feature add\-on to an existing product.
* Working technical fluency in agentic AI system design: agent orchestration and planning (e.g., ReAct\-style reasoning, task decomposition, multi\-agent coordination), tool/function calling, and agent memory patterns.
* Solid working knowledge of the surrounding AI stack: LLM APIs and fine\-tuning/prompting tradeoffs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and evaluation/observability tooling for LLM\-based systems.
* Familiarity with common agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI\-style orchestration, or equivalent in\-house frameworks) and emerging standards such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool/agent interoperability.
* Track record of writing clear PRDs/specs for ML\-driven features, defining success metrics for probabilistic (not just deterministic) systems, and running structured experimentation.
* Comfort partnering closely with engineering and applied AI/ML teams on architecture\-level tradeoffs — you don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate deep technical tradeoffs into business language for leadership, sales, and customers, and vice versa.
* Prior experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, security/intelligence, fintech, or another data\-sensitive domain is a plus, given Innefu Labs' customer base.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an MBA or equivalent is a plus but not a substitute for hands\-on technical depth.



**Nice to Have** 



* Direct experience owning or contributing to a knowledge\-graph or retrieval\-heavy product (e.g., Neo4j, Qdrant/pgvector or similar vector stores).
* Exposure to agent safety/guardrail design — RBAC for agent actions, audit logging, human\-in\-the\-loop escalation design.
* Past experience as an engineer, applied scientist, or technical founder before moving into product.

title: Associate Specialist – Hydraulics
description:
**Job Description:**
====================

**Position Requirements**

Provide high\-quality CFD and hydraulics support while contributing as an experienced mechanical engineer across new product development, engineering testing, proof\-of\-concept development, rapid prototyping, design improvement and product issue resolution. The role combines deep analytical capability with hands\-on product engineering and cross\-functional execution

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**CFD, Hydraulics and Simulation Support**

* Perform CFD and hydraulic analyses for Pentair products and systems, including flow distribution, pressure drop, thermal\-flow interaction where applicable, cavitation risk, pump/system performance and design optimization.
* Develop appropriate analysis plans, modelling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies and solver approaches; assess result quality and clearly communicate limitations and engineering implications.
* Provide project teams with timely, decision\-oriented technical recommendations rather than analysis output alone.
* Support root\-cause investigations and product issue resolution using simulation, first\-principles engineering and test evidence.
* Promote consistent CFD and hydraulics methods, templates, review practices and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**Mechanical Engineering, NPD and Product Realization**

* Contribute across the NPD lifecycle, from problem definition and concept generation through detailed design, verification, validation and design transfer support.
* Develop and evaluate mechanical concepts, layouts and design trade\-offs using sound engineering judgement, calculations, CAD and simulation.
* Work with laboratories and technicians to define test objectives, test setups, instrumentation, acceptance criteria and data interpretation.
* Apply design\-for\-manufacture, design\-for\-assembly, tolerance, material and cost considerations when maturing concepts into product\-ready solutions.
* Support value engineering, cost reduction, reliability improvement, field failure analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong fundamentals in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, turbomachinery, and mechanical design.
* Hands\-on expertise with Ansys CFX and/or Ansys Fluent for pump or turbomachinery applications.
* Practical experience in geometry preparation, meshing, solver setup, convergence assessment, and CFD post\-processing.
* Experience with centrifugal pump hydraulic design and performance characteristics, including head, flow, efficiency, power, NPSH and cavitation.
* Proficiency with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo/ProE or equivalent, including solid modelling, surface modelling and assemblies.
* Working knowledge of pump design tools such as CFturbo, BladeGen or equivalent is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or equivalent language for engineering calculations, data processing, or workflow automation.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Strong analytical thinking with a hands\-on, product\-focused mindset.
* Comfort operating across both specialist analysis work and broader mechanical engineering assignments.
* Ownership, adaptability and the ability to progress work despite incomplete information.
* Effective teamwork, mentoring, stakeholder management and technical communication.
* Commitment to engineering quality, safety, integrity and continuous learning.

**Education and Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, preferably with specialization in CFD, turbomachinery, thermal engineering or a related field.
* 5\-7 years of relevant professional experience in CFD analysis and mechanical or hydraulic design.
* Demonstrated experience with pumps, turbines, or other rotating machinery is strongly preferred.

**Added Advantage**

* Experience correlating CFD results with laboratory test data and supporting prototype validation.
* Exposure optimization, process automation, AI/ML applications in engineering, or patent\-related product development.
* Experience in VAVE, cost reduction, sustaining engineering, and new product development for industrial products.

* **Position title will be given based on the experience \& work capability of the candidate**

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================


Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross\-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

description:

The  simulation engineer would work on bridging the gap between real world and state\-of\-the\-art simulation platforms.  The role involves running physical experiments with robots, tuning model parameters, and improving simulation fidelity. You will collaborate on projects that connect simulation environments with real robotic systems.

* Conduct experiments with robotic platforms and compare results with simulations.

**Qualifications:** 



* MTech (or higher) in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Mechatronics, Control Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, or a related field
* Working knowledge of multibody dynamics, contact and friction, flexible bodies, cable or wire simulation, deformable objects, stiffness handling etc.
* Hands\-on experience with physics\-based simulation tools (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or with physics engines in Unity/Unreal Engine).
* Programming skills in Python and/or C\+\+



  





**Desirable skills:** 



* Experience with real robotic hardware
* Knowledge of deep learning (reinforcement learning and transfer learning)

* Familiarity with Omniverse, PhysX, Newton, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or industrial digital twin platforms.

description:
About the Role

We're hiring an AI Engineer to deploy and productionize large open\-weight LLMs entirely on\-premise, in an air\-gapped environment with no external API dependencies. You'll own the full stack from GPU infrastructure and inference serving up through the LLM\-backed features that end users actually touch — assisted review, natural\-language querying over structured data, and bulk triage workflows. This role is for someone who wants to solve real inference\-engineering problems (throughput, latency, memory) rather than wrap a hosted API.

What You'll Do

* Deploy and operate large open\-weight LLMs on\-premise across multi\-GPU, H100\-class node infrastructure.
* Stand up and tune inference serving stacks (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, or equivalent) for production workloads.
* Apply quantization, batching, and capacity sizing strategies to support concurrent users within hardware constraints.
* Design and build LLM\-backed application features on top of the serving layer, including:
* Assisted review workflows
* Natural\-language querying over structured data
* Bulk triage tooling
* Operate entirely within an air\-gapped / restricted\-network environment, with zero reliance on external APIs or cloud LLM providers.
* Monitor and optimize inference performance, GPU utilization, and cost/throughput trade\-offs over time.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and product stakeholders to translate feature requirements into deployable, resource\-aware LLM systems.

Must\-Have Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience deploying **large open\-weight LLMs** on **GPU infrastructure on\-premise** (multi\-GPU, **H100\-class** nodes).
* Hands\-on experience with **inference serving and optimization** — vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, or equivalent — including quantization, batching, and sizing for concurrent users.
* Experience building **LLM\-backed features**, such as assisted review, natural\-language querying over structured data, or bulk triage workflows.
* Comfortable working in an **air\-gapped / restricted\-network environment** with no external API dependencies.

Nice to Have

* Experience with model quantization formats (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF) and trade\-offs between them.
* Background in evaluating and benchmarking open\-weight models for domain\-specific tasks.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Konnect Co. Ltd is building an AI\-powered super app that simplifies how international visitors, students, and residents experience daily life in Korea. The platform removes common barriers such as language, payments, and identity requirements that typically demand a Korean phone number, national ID, or local bank account. **Job Title:** 
 Senior AI Engineer (LLM Architecture \& Optimization)
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer with a deep foundation in neural network architectures to lead the curation, optimization, and scaling of our language models. You will be responsible for building multilingual datasets from scratch, performing surgical modifications on transformer layer weights, implementing advanced dimension reduction on latent spaces, and deploying highly optimized quantized models into production serving engines.
 



  





**Work Structure** 




 Format: Hybrid (eventually onsite in South Korea)
 



 Compensation: As per industry Standard \- commensurate with experience
 



 Joining: Immediate if possible
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**\-Neural Network Optimization:** 
 Analyze and manipulate internal neural network layer matrices ($W\_q, W\_k, W\_v, W\_{gate}$) to safely perform post\-training quantization and minimize perplexity degradation.
 



**\-Dataset Engineering:** 
 Architect the end\-to\-end data pipeline, including sourcing, filtering, and normalizing diverse multilingual open\-source datasets (e.g., Aya, Flores) to expand the model's linguistic capabilities.
 



**\- Latent Space Manipulation:** 
 Design and implement high\-density dimension reduction workflows (e.g., Matryoshka Representation Learning) on hidden states to optimize embedding pipelines without losing semantic meaning.
 



**\- High\-Throughput Serving:** 
 Deploy optimized models directly into vLLM, configuring PagedAttention and continuous batching for maximum production efficiency.
 



**\- Architectural Safety:** 
 Mitigate critical neural network issues such as catastrophic forgetting, gradient interference, and activation outliers during multi\-lingual fine\-tuning.
 



  





**Technical Requirements** 




  





**\- Neural Network Mechanics:** 
 Deep theoretical and practical mastery of Transformer blocks, multi\-head attention mechanisms, FFN sub\-layers, and backpropagation behavior.
 



**\- Inference Engines:** 
 Hands\-on production experience serving models via vLLM or TensorRT\-LLM.
 



**\- LLM Quantization:** 
 Proven track record with AWQ, GPTQ, BitsAndBytes, and GGUF, including a deep understanding of weight distribution and activation scaling (e.g., SwiGLU/GeLU).
 



**\- Dimension Reduction:** 
 Mastery of PCA, SVD, and modern vector quantization techniques applied directly to embedding spaces.
 



**\- Multilingual Training:** 
 Expert knowledge of SentencePiece/BPE tokenizers, cross\-lingual vocabulary expansion, and managing vocabulary overlap.
 



**\- Core Ecosystem:** 
 Expert\-level Python, PyTorch, and the Hugging Face library suite (transformers, peft, accelerate).
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 \- Strong programming skills in C\+\+ or CUDA for writing or modifying custom optimization kernels.
 



 \- Experience deploying high\-density vector workflows in vector databases like Qdrant, Milvus, or Pinecone.
 



 \- Experience handling data crawling, deduplication, and quality filtering tools at scale.
 



  





**Experience \& Education** 




  





 \- Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
 



 \- 5\+ years of professional experience focusing heavily on neural networks, NLP, LLM architecture, or machine learning infrastructure.

title: Model Trainer (Post-Training and Evals)
description:
**Model Trainer (Post\-Training and Evals)** 




  





**The job** 




  





 Take an agentic task that currently runs on a frontier model, fine\-tune an open\-weight model on it, and prove with evals that the small model does the task better and cheaper. Then do it again on the next task, and the next.
 



  





 You will work on real enterprise workloads. Some of it runs on customer GPUs, some on ours. You own the model from data through to the eval report that convinces a customer to switch traffic over.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build training sets from real agent traffic and traces, not scraped benchmarks
* Run LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA, full fine\-tunes, CPT, DPO and GRPO depending on what the task needs
* Design task\-specific evals for agentic behavior: tool calling accuracy, multi\-step reliability, output format adherence, groundedness. Benchmarks are not the bar, the customer's task is
* Get the model serving on vLLM and measure real latency and token cost against the frontier baseline
* Work inside ShadowLM, our open\-source fine\-tuning SDK, and improve it as you go


- 


**What we are looking for** 




  




* You have post\-trained open\-weight models yourself and can talk about what failed, not just what worked
* Comfortable across llama, qwen, mistral, gemma, phi, deepseek and whatever ships next month
* Strong on evals. You know that most fine\-tuning projects die because nobody built an honest measurement first
* You can read a paper on Monday and have it running on Wednesday
* Practical about hardware. You know what fits on one GPU and what does not



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Reward modeling or RL for agents
* Quantization and distillation
* Experience getting a model past an enterprise security review

title: Senior Software Engineer - Agents
description:
Workfabric AI is the enterprise simulation company. We build digital twins of every account, team, product, and persona — so the enterprise can simulate decisions before shipping them.
 



  





 Our product, ContextFabric, is the simulation layer that senses across your apps, synthesizes operational context, and grounds every twin in how your teams actually work. We believe operational context is the real competitive advantage in enterprise AI, and we're building the platform that turns it into decisions.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We simulate the enterprise by creating digital twins — of people, and of entities such as accounts, teams, and products. This role is about building them. You'll work on building one of these twins, and own problem statements within it — shaping the problem, designing the architecture, writing the code, and shipping it to production. You'll be accountable for the systems that ship, not just the pull request.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 




 Three hard problems sit at the centre of this role:
 


* Ground every twin in real work. Make each twin reason from the enterprise's actual behavioural context, so its output stays grounded and defensible — per tenant, never crossing a boundary.
* Run thousands of twins in parallel. Build the runtime that executes twins at scale — thousands running concurrently and collaborating with each other to do the work.
* Give twins the right tools and permissions. Ensure every twin has the tool sit needs to do its work and the permissions to use them safely — governed by identity, policy, and an audit trail you could replay for a regulator.



  





 The surface area you'll own, and set the patterns for
 


* The twin runtime that executes and composes twins at scale.
* State management for execution history, checkpointing, and recovery across long\-running twin runs.
* Event streaming and messaging for real\-time progress, with logging, metrics, and tracing instrumented throughout.
* Authentication and identity across the platform — including access controls and approval workflows for twin operations, in partnership with security.
* The engineering patterns and quality bar for your area — through code review and pairing with the engineers around you.
* The operational backbone the platform runs on — deployment, CI/CD, autoscaling, and reliability as infrastructure\-as\-code.



  





**Who you are** 




 You may be a good fit if you have
 


* B.E. / B. Tech from a top university in India in one of the following departments (i) Computer Science, (ii) Information Sciences, (iii) Information Technology (iv) AI/ML
* 5\+ years building production software in Python, with strong backend fundamentals in API design and data modelling.
* Hands\-on experience building services with FastAPI as your primary framework.
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-backed applications in production —orchestrating multi\-step reasoning, retrieval, and state — with any orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent).
* Comfort designing for concurrency and latency — async, parallelism, and caching — so multi\-step systems stay fast under load.
* A track record of owning features or services end to end, from design through production.
* Clear communication and the ability to work autonomously in an ambiguous, fast\-moving space.



  





**Strong candidates may also have** 



* Depth with a specific orchestration framework such as LangChain or LangGraph, plus hands\-on RAG and vector databases.
* Experience building evaluations for LLM or agentic systems — measuring quality, catching regressions, and guarding against unsafe behaviour.
* Experience with React for building customer\-facing UIs and dashboards.
* Comfortable deploying, operating, and maintaining your own services in a production cloud environment (Azure a plus).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform, plus Kubernetes and Helm for deployment.
* Observability — structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics.

description:

We want to make millions of people happy with games that they would love to grow old with. With our fearless team of dreamers and innovators we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of mobile gaming. **Highlight Reel:*** We've rocked an impressive 250M\+ game downloads.

* We were in the list of Top 10 India HQ Games Publisher in 2021\.

 **Cool Tidbits:*** Our games attract a monthly player base equivalent to the population of Australia, with over 20M players engaging each month!
* Players spend an astronomical 297\.6 Mars Round Trips worth of time on our Games daily!!!

 **About the role:**  

We’re looking for a Gen AI Design Intern who’s excited to create visuals using generative AI tools and has a foundation in art and design. You’ll spend your time primarily prompting, experimenting, and turning creative briefs into images and assets, along with editing and refining them in Photoshop as needed. This is a hands\-on learning role for someone curious, self\-driven, and who treats AI tools as a craft to get better at, not just a button to press. You don’t need years of experience. We care more about your eye, your curiosity, and how you think through a problem than about a long resume. **What You'll do:*** Use generative AI tools (ComfyUI, Scenario, Higgsfield, Magnific, Midjourney, or similar) to create images and assets from creative briefs.
* Write, test, and refine prompts to get precise, consistent, high\-quality results.
* Take a problem or brief, break it down, and figure out the right approach to solve it visually.
* Apply art fundamentals to guide your outputs and identify what needs improvement.
* Use Photoshop to edit, clean up, composite, and finish images, and create or prepare layered files and exports as needed.
* Keep your work consistent in style, palette, and quality across a set of assets.
* Document what you tried and what worked so others can follow your process.
* Experiment with new tools and techniques and share what you learn.

 **What We are Looking for:*** Strong prompting skills — you understand how to structure a prompt, iterate, and steer a model toward what you actually want.
* A good design eye and a basic understanding of art fundamentals —composition, colour, light and shadow, form, proportion, and perspective.
* Basic art development skills — the ability to use references, explore visual ideas, and develop them into finished assets.
* Hands\-on Photoshop skills for editing, cleanup, finishing, and file preparation.
* The ability to think through a problem statement — to take an open\-ended brief, ask the right questions, and plan an approach rather than waiting to be told every step.
* Curiosity, self\-direction, and willingness to experiment and learn fast.

 **Nice to Have (Optional):*** A degree in fine arts, applied arts, illustration, design, or a related field.
* Experience building node\-based workflows in ComfyUI or similar.
* Ability to clean up, refine, and finish your outputs using AI tools only.
* Building your own AI\-powered tools or utilities to speed up your work.
* Familiarity with video or animation generation.
* Any traditional art, design, photography, or 3D background, including familiarity with Blender or similar software.

 **What to Include in Your Application :*** A portfolio or sample of AI\-generated work you’ve made (any format is fine), along with examples of Photoshop editing or finishing.
* A short note on a project where you solved a visual problem — what the brief was, how you approached it, and what you’d do differently.
* Any drawings, paintings, illustrations, or other work that shows your art skills.
* Optional: any workflows or tools you’re proud of, even rough ones.

At Gameberry Labs, we're all about riding the wave of new trends, tech and building the best possible player experience that shapes the gaming universe. We strive to be at the forefront of casual game entertainment.
When you join us, you're stepping into a place where your ideas count and your impact matters.  

We offer an autonomous studio setup that fosters fast decision\-making, empowering you to make a significant impact and accelerate your professional growth. **Why Choose Us:*** Freedom to be you.
* Get in on a seriously competitive salary.
* Hungry?Enjoy free daily lunches.
* We've got your back with company\-paid health insurance.
* Team fun?It's our thing!
* Opportunity knocks with limitless growth potential.
* We're making a global splash.
* Your playground: a studio that owns the P\&L of its creations.
* Inspiring, down\-to\-earth teams are our secret sauce.
* Dive into challenges, learning, and growth at warpspeed.
* We want to take India to the list of "Top 10 Gaming Studios" in the World.

  

Ready to embark on this thrilling quest? Join us and let's create gaming history, one Pixel at a time.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**About 2070 Health**


2070 Health is India's first venture studio, established by W Health Ventures. It builds healthcare companies from scratch by identifying gaps in the market that remain unserved. Unlike an accelerator, the studio is directly involved in idea generation, daily operations, and strategic decisions as each company grows. Companies established in the last 24 months include Elevate Now, Nivaan Care, Reveal Healthtech, BabyMD, Everhope Oncology, and Everbright Health.

**About Xponentiate**


Xponentiate is a healthcare\-focused executive search and talent firm, backed by W Health Ventures and 2070 Health. We place senior leadership across healthtech startups, hospitals, and healthcare VCs, drawing on a network of 250,000\+ healthcare professionals. As the firm scales, business development is moving from a founder\-led activity to a dedicated function — and this role is the person who builds and owns it.

**About the Role**


The Business Development Manager owns Xponentiate's BD function end to end — from building and running the outbound engine that generates pipeline, through to pitching, negotiating, and closing new search mandates. This is not a role plugged into someone else's process. You build the machine, run it, and are accountable for what it produces in signed mandates and revenue.


You will work closely with the founder and the research and delivery teams, but the origination motion — who to target, how to reach them, and how to close them — is yours to design and run.

**What the Role Owns**

* Outbound infrastructure. Owning lead sourcing (Apollo), cold email infrastructure and deliverability (via platforms such as Instantly), and list\-building against defined ICPs — healthtech founders, hospital CHROs, and healthcare VCs, across verticals such as fertility, cardiology, biotech, dermatology, and clinical trials.
* Pipeline generation. Running multi\-touch outbound sequences across email and LinkedIn that convert cold contacts into qualified conversations.
* Full\-cycle selling. Pitching Xponentiate's services, leading client meetings and presentations, and negotiating commercial terms on retained and engaged search mandates through to signature.
* Client relationships. Building and maintaining relationships with CXOs, CHROs, Talent Acquisition heads, founders, and healthcare VCs, including within the 2070 Health and W Health Ventures portfolio.
* Delivery handoff. Working closely with the research and delivery team once a mandate is signed, to ensure a clean handover and protect the relationship through execution.
* Pipeline reporting. Maintaining an accurate CRM (e.g. Airtable), forecasting, and reporting business performance to leadership.

**Working with AI Tools**


This role is expected to use AI tools as a default part of the workflow, not as an occasional add\-on. That includes using LLMs such as Claude or ChatGPT for account research and personalized outreach rather than generic templates, and using AI features inside outbound and CRM tools to speed up list\-building, enrichment, and reporting.

**Scope of Work**


The role covers two areas, introduced in sequence as the function matures.

* New mandate acquisition, as the starting point. Building and running the outbound engine, prospecting healthtech founders and hospital CHROs, and closing new client mandates for Xponentiate's core executive search business.
* Portfolio and investor network expansion, at a later stage. Deepening relationships across the 2070 Health and W Health Ventures portfolio to generate repeat and referred mandates.

**Working Model**


This is a build\-and\-run role rather than a seat in an existing playbook. Expect direct access to leadership, ownership of the function from day one, and accountability measured against pipeline built and mandates closed rather than daily activity.

**Growth Path**


This starts as a single\-owner function: you build it, you run it, you close on it. As pipeline and signed mandates scale, the role is expected to grow into building and leading Xponentiate's business development team.

 **Requirements**  

* 4–7 years of experience in business development or sales, ideally within executive search, recruitment/staffing, or another B2B services business with a comparable sales cycle.
* A proven track record of originating and closing new client relationships, not only managing inbound or existing accounts.
* Comfort owning outbound infrastructure directly (tools such as Apollo, Instantly or Smartlead, LinkedIn, and a CRM such as Airtable or HubSpot), or the ability to learn and run it hands\-on rather than delegate it.
* Demonstrated use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day work.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to pitch confidently to CXOs, founders, and investors.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior exposure to healthcare, healthtech, or life sciences clients.
* Experience selling into venture\-backed or founder\-led organizations.
* Familiarity with retained or engaged executive search commercial models.

**This Role Is Not a Fit If**

* You have only worked in a purely client\-servicing or delivery role, with no origination or closing experience.
* You need an established playbook and a built\-out team in place before you can operate.
* You are looking for a narrow, single\-channel role — only outbound, or only closing — rather than owning the full function.

Description \- ExternalJob Description: Senior Data Engineer (6–9 Years Experience)  

Location: Bengaluru


Employment Type: Full\-Time

  

Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with 6–9 years of experience to design, build, and optimize scalable data platforms and pipelines using modern cloud\-based data technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Unity Catalog, and workflow orchestration tools, along with experience in data governance, security, and performance optimization.

  

This role involves leading data engineering initiatives, enabling analytics and data science use cases, implementing governance frameworks, and ensuring high\-performance, reliable data systems across enterprise environments.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

1\. Data Architecture \& Platform Engineering


* Design and implement scalable data architectures using Azure Databricks and modern lakehouse principles.


* Architect batch and streaming data pipelines for large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets.


* Implement Databricks Delta Lake patterns including Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers).


* Define data modeling strategies for analytics and reporting workloads.


* Collaborate with architects and stakeholders to align platform design with business objectives.

  

2\. Advanced Pipeline Engineering


* Design and manage Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipelines and Structured Streaming solutions for real\-time analytics.


* Develop complex ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and SQL.


* Lead development of high\-performance data workflows including advanced Spark tuning and optimization.


* Implement reusable frameworks and engineering standards for pipeline development.


* Optimize data processing workflows for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  

3\. Performance Engineering \& Optimization


* Analyze system performance and identify bottlenecks across data pipelines and infrastructure layers.


* Optimize cluster configuration, resource utilization, shuffle behavior, caching, and partitioning strategies.


* Improve pipeline latency, throughput, and execution reliability.


* Monitor and optimize Spark workloads and SQL query performance.


* Lead performance tuning initiatives across large\-scale data environments.

  

4\. Governance \& Security (Unity Catalog Administration)


* Act as the primary administrator for Databricks Unity Catalog ensuring fine\-grained access control, centralized metadata management, and data lineage tracking.


* Architect and implement Delta Sharing protocols for secure cross\-platform data exchange.


* Define and enforce data governance standards, policies, and compliance requirements.


* Develop and execute risk management strategies to ensure data integrity, privacy compliance, and system reliability.


* Implement data security controls including role\-based access and audit mechanisms.

  

5\. Workflow Automation \& DevOps


* Automate workspace configuration, cluster provisioning, and deployment using Databricks CLI, Python scripting, and CI/CD pipelines.


* Design and manage workflow orchestration using Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory (ADF), or Apache Airflow.


* Ensure fault\-tolerant execution of complex job dependencies.


* Implement monitoring, alerting, and automated recovery mechanisms.


* Support DevOps and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices for data platforms.

  

6\. Data Platform Reliability \& Quality


* Implement automated data validation, monitoring, and quality checks.


* Maintain metadata, lineage, and auditability across datasets.


* Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root cause analysis.


* Ensure high availability, reliability, and maintainability of data pipelines.

  

7\. Analytics, Data Science \& Business Collaboration


* Partner with data analysts and data scientists to enable analytics and machine learning workflows.


* Support feature engineering pipelines and model data requirements.


* Execute complex Databricks SQL queries to derive actionable insights and audit pipeline performance.


* Provide optimized datasets for BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.


* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

  

8\. Strategy, Solution Design \& Leadership


* Partner with Data Architects and stakeholders to translate high\-level requirements into technical blueprints.


* Participate in architecture discussions and technology decision\-making.


* Mentor junior data engineers and provide technical leadership.


* Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and engineering best practices.


* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production challenges.

  

Required Skills


* Strong expertise in Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Unity Catalog, and Delta Lake architecture.


* Hands\-on experience with Delta Live Tables (DLT), Structured Streaming, and Databricks Workflows.


* Experience with Azure Data Factory or Apache Airflow.


* Strong knowledge of distributed data processing and Spark performance tuning.


* Solid understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.


* Experience with CI/CD and automation for data pipelines.


* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

  

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Event Hubs.


* Exposure to data warehousing platforms such as Synapse, Snowflake, or Redshift.


* Knowledge of Python beyond PySpark.


* Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.


* Understanding of machine learning pipelines and MLOps practices.


* Azure or Databricks certifications are a plus.

  

Education Requirements


* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Computer Science or Information Technology) is required.


* Candidates from other educational backgrounds may be considered if they have 100% relevant professional experience in data engineering.

  

Experience


* 6 to 9 years of experience in data engineering, big data development, or related roles.


* Proven experience working with enterprise cloud data platforms, preferably Azure.

  

Key Competencies


* Performance optimization mindset.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.


* Technical leadership and mentoring capability.


* Collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.


* Ownership and accountability.


* Continuous learning and innovation orientation.

title: Collaboration Manager - Advanced Therapies (Bengaluru)
description:
Job Description: Collaboration Manager \- Advanced Therapies


### **Role Purpose**



The Collaboration Manager –The role focuses on translating customer and clinical insights into impactful research activities, product improvements, and innovation opportunities.



The successful candidate will actively engage with key customer sites, support collaboration programs from concept to outcome, and ensure alignment across country teams, global business lines, R\&D, and other internal stakeholders. The role also includes driving visibility of collaboration outcomes in the public domain and strengthening long\-term strategic partnerships with customers.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Collaborate with leading clinicians and researchers (institutional and non\-institutional) on furthering the field of angiographic imaging science by first understanding the clinical needs and then developing solutions to address those needs.
* Work with clinicians, research, technical, and medical staff, on\-site, to support research\-related interventional cases. Share clinical workflows to a broader audience within Advanced Therapies (AT) to further procedural knowledge.
* Act as the primary interface between external collaborators and internal stakeholders including business lines, R\&D, product management, and country organizations. Work closely with KoLs, physicians and internal teams (including Innovation, Business Line, Sales, Marketing, R\&D) to define and execute research studies.
* Work with AT Innovations, R\&D (both in Forchheim, Germany), and on\-site service personnel to install, learn detailed operation of, and pre\-test prototype hardware and software.
* Analyze research data with physicians, and prepare reports, publications, and conference presentations. Promote a culture of generating clinically and scientifically relevant outcomes that are visible through publications, presentations, workshops, and other public scientific channels.
* Drive collaboration programs from initiation through execution, ensuring alignment on goals, milestones, timelines, deliverables, and outcomes. Track budget, milestones, and deliverables throughout the project.
* Work with legal, research, and logistics personnel on (both internally and with academic centers) to develop research agreements that define the required equipment, funding and deliverables for each research project.
* Facilitate strong coordination between local collaboration activities and global headquarters to ensure strategic alignment and sustainable integration. Work with project manager in Forchheim and the site Principal Investigator to define the research protocol for each project.
* Write and present reports to AT Headquarters and Senior management regarding project results and new project ideas from the field. Represent local collaboration activities and outcomes at regional and international forums, including conferences, scientific meetings, and internal review platforms
* Where applicable, work with the regional organization to develop research priorities for strategic partnerships with institutions.

* Contribute to scientific marketing initiatives and customer engagement strategies related to collaboration programs and research outcomes

title: Genesys Cloud Technical Architect
description:
### **Job Summary**



As a Genesys Technical Architect, you will be responsible for defining, designing and governing the technical architecture of the global Genesys Cloud contact center platform. The role will translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable Genesys Cloud solutions across Universal UI, voice, digital channels, routing, IVR, integrations, reporting and automation capabilities. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, service owners, integration teams, vendors and delivery teams to ensure architecture quality, platform standardization, solution consistency and successful implementation of Genesys capabilities across regions.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Define the end\-to\-end technical architecture for Genesys Cloud contact center solutions, ensuring alignment with global platform standards, business requirements and enterprise architecture principles.
* Design scalable Genesys Cloud solutions across IVR, call flows, queues, routing strategies, skills, data tables, callbacks, voicemail, digital channels, workforce management, analytics and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Lead technical solution design for integrations between Genesys Cloud and enterprise systems such as CRM, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft Teams, identity management, reporting platforms and middleware solutions.
* Translate business processes, customer journeys and operational needs into technical designs, architecture documents, configuration blueprints and implementation guidelines.
* Provide technical leadership to delivery teams during configuration, development, testing, deployment and transition to operations for new Genesys features and enhancements.
* Review and validate solution designs, integration patterns, security controls, data flows, API usage and configuration changes to ensure stability, performance, maintainability and compliance.
* Missing Telco Architecture capability – Technical knowledge \& setup, Global geo capability of legal laws/regulation
* Internal SHS Infra setup – know\-how \& understanding
* Integration Architecture – Data Lake / DB (Snowflake/SQL/Azure), Pipeline (Snaplogic) \& other middleware with source
* Support complex technical issue resolution by analyzing platform behavior, integration failures, routing logic, call flow defects, performance concerns and configuration dependencies.
* Maintain technical architecture documentation, reusable design patterns, standards, decision logs and roadmap inputs for continuous platform evolution.


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Strong hands\-on experience in Genesys Cloud architecture, configuration and implementation for enterprise contact center environments.
* Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud capabilities including Architect call flows, IVR, ACD routing, skill\-based routing, bullseye routing, queues, users, roles, divisions, scripts, wrap\-up codes and reporting.
* Experience designing omnichannel contact center solutions across voice, email, chat, messaging, SMS, callbacks, voicemail and digital engagement channels.
* Strong knowledge of Genesys Cloud APIs, integration patterns, event\-driven architecture, authentication, SCIM/user provisioning, data actions and middleware\-based integrations.
* Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with CRM, ITSM, ERP, Microsoft Teams, identity platforms, data lake, analytics or reporting solutions.
* Good understanding of cloud architecture, security, network connectivity, telephony concepts, SIP, SBC, BYOC/Cloud Voice concepts and enterprise identity management.
* Ability to create technical architecture documents, solution designs, sequence flows, integration specifications, test support documentation and operational handover materials.
* Strong communication and stakeholder \& project management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade\-offs to business, IT and vendor stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications or a related technical discipline.
* 8\-10 years of overall IT experience, including significant experience in contact center technology, cloud platform architecture or enterprise communications solutions.
* Minimum 4\-5 years of practical experience with Genesys Cloud or Genesys PureCloud implementation, configuration, architecture or technical leadership.
* Genesys Cloud certifications such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional, Architect or Developer are preferred.
* Experience with integration platforms and cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, Snaplogic, REST APIs, JSON, JavaScript or similar technologies is an advantage.
* Experience working in global transformation programs, multi\-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.
* Experience working with managed service providers, platform vendors and distributed support teams across multiple countries and time zones.

description:

**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Sectigo** is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud\-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest\-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500\. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.  

  

**Simplicity at Scale.**  

  

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as \#OneSectigo by living out our core values \- Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are looking for a versatile, mid\-level Video/Graphic Designer to join our Brand \& Creative team. In this role, you will turn complex cybersecurity and digital\-trust topics into clear, compelling visual stories across video, motion, and static design. Working closely with brand, campaigns, and demand generation, you will produce on\-brand creative that drives awareness, pipeline, and engagement across digital channels, events, and sales enablement. The ideal candidate pairs strong design fundamentals with hands\-on video editing and motion skills, and thrives in a fast\-paced B2B environment where creative directly supports measurable marketing outcomes.


Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* Edit, animate, and produce video content for demand generation campaigns, product launches, social media, webinars, customer stories, and sales enablement.
* Create motion graphics, animated explainers, and short\-form video that simplify complex security and technical concepts for B2B audiences.
* Design and produce a broad range of marketing assets — including social graphics, digital ads, landing pages, infographics, email templates, presentations, and event collateral — that are on\-brand and conversion\-focused.
* Partner with campaign and demand generation managers to develop creative concepts tied to pipeline and revenue goals, then adapt assets across channels and formats.
* Apply and help evolve Sectigo’s brand guidelines, ensuring a consistent visual identity across every deliverable.
* Manage multiple projects at once, balancing quality with deadlines in a high\-velocity marketing organization.
* Source, organize, and maintain creative assets, footage, stock, and templates to improve team efficiency and reuse.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (product marketing, content, web, and events) and external vendors or freelancers as needed.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to iterate on creative and improve results.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.


More information about this role:

* This is a full\-time and in\-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week, working in the 3PM IST schedule unless otherwise notified.
* This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Director of Account Based Marketing.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 8,00,000 and INR 11,00,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Media, Film/Video Production, Visual Communications, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience supported by a strong portfolio.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience in graphic design and video production, must be within a B2B, technology, or agency environment. A portfolio or demo reel showcasing both design and video/motion work is required.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Strong motion graphics and video editing skills, including pacing, sound, captioning, and exporting for multiple platforms and aspect ratios.
* Solid command of design fundamentals: typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience designing for digital marketing and demand generation (paid social, display, landing pages, and email).
* Familiarity with Figma and collaborative, design\-system\-based workflows is a plus.
* Ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into clear, engaging visuals — experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, or technology is a strong advantage.
* Comfortable working from briefs, taking creative direction, and managing feedback from multiple stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines.
* A collaborative, proactive mindset and genuine interest in how creative drives marketing performance.
* Bonus: experience with basic 3D, AI\-assisted creative tools, photography, or live event/webinar production.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Sectigo is one of the largest, longest\-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500\. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.  

  

**Simplicity at Scale.**  

  

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as \#OneSectigo by living out our core values \- Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We're setting up a Demand Generation Operations Support function in Chennai to serve as the execution engine behind our pods. As Program Manager, Demand Generation, you own the operational workflow that turns campaign plays into deployed, monitored outbound. Think of it as a supply chain: a pod and marketing leader calls the plays, the onshore demand center assembles the campaign, and you operationalize it — building the sequences, loading the target lists, dropping the cadences to the right reps on schedule, and tracking execution end to end.


Above all, this is an AI\-first role. You are an AI\-native demand expert who uses advanced AI tools to stitch together multiple threads — intent signals, account data, content, and sequencing — into one clean, efficient engine, and who is relentless about maximizing speed and efficiency. You're the reason precision outbound happens consistently: a disciplined, repeatable, fully visible workflow rather than a set of good intentions. This is a build\-and\-run role for someone who loves turning strategy into scalable operational rhythm.


Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* Operationalize the demand workflow. Take campaign plans and target lists from pod leaders and the onshore demand center and build them into ready\-to\-run Sales Loft sequences for rep execution.
* Run the engine AI\-first. Use advanced AI tools to stitch together multiple threads — intent signals, account and content data, and sequencing — automating and streamlining the workflow to maximize efficiency and speed at every step.
* Own list loading and task setup in Sales Loft and Salesforce. Build and load target account/contact lists and deploy tasks so AEs, SDRs, and renewal reps have their plays queued and ready — no chasing, no guesswork.
* Deploy cadences across pods on schedule. Coordinate the “drop” so each pod's reps receive their sequences on the planned launch date, tied to the quarterly campaign calendar.
* Monitor execution and drive compliance. Track whether reps are starting and completing their sequences (all steps), surface reps who are behind, and produce the reporting that keeps outbound disciplined.
* Build activity and coverage reporting. Turn Sales Loft activity data into clear reporting on engagement, dials and conversations, account coverage, and white\-space opportunity.
* Free up the onshore team. Absorb high\-volume operational build work so onshore marketers can focus on campaign strategy, content, and pod planning.
* Maintain the operational backbone. Keep the workflow, documentation, and process standards clean so the engine stays scalable and repeatable as we add pods and segments.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.


How your success will be measured:

* Sequences built and deployed on schedule against the campaign calendar.
* Efficiency and speed gains delivered through AI\-enabled workflow automation.
* Rep adoption and compliance — sequence starts and completions across pods.
* Onshore team capacity freed up as measured by operational work absorbed.
* Data quality and coverage visibility, including account white\-space insight.
* Contribution to predictable, scalable outbound pipeline.


More information about this role:

* This is a full\-time and in\-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week, working in the 3PM IST schedule unless otherwise notified.
* This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Director of Account Based Marketing.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 8,00,000 and INR 11,00,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field is strongly recommended.

**Experience:**

* AI\-first demand expert (must\-have). You are AI\-native and have personally deployed multiple workflows using advanced AI tools — stitching together multiple threads and systems to maximize efficiency — with proven, measurable results doing exactly this in a fast\-paced B2B technology environment.
* Proven project management. A track record of running complex, multi\-workstream programs end to end and on schedule, coordinating across distributed teams and time zones.
* 3–5 years in demand generation operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or campaign/sequence execution — ideally in B2B technology or SaaS.
* Hands\-on sequence\-building experience. Direct experience building and deploying cadences in Sales Loft (or a comparable tool such as Outreach), plus working knowledge of Salesforce and HubSpot.
* Program discipline. You can run tooling “like a program” — build it, deploy it, track adoption, and hold the line on execution and compliance.
* Service\-oriented and structured. You bring structured processes and a genuine service mindset to your internal stakeholders — pod leaders and reps — and make their execution easier.
* Comfort with list building, segmentation, and data hygiene in Salesforce.
* Strong reporting and analytics instincts — able to translate activity data into clear compliance and coverage reporting for leaders.
* Clear communicator across time zones. Excellent written English and proactive, reliable communication with an onshore team and pod leaders.
* Highly organized and able to run multiple pods' workflows in parallel against fixed drop schedules.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Exposure to intent\-data platforms (Intentsify) and ABM programs.
* Familiarity with a pod / segment\-based go\-to\-market model.

description:

This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level:

Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business.
  
Uphold our values, role modeling them in every action and decision.
  
Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
  
This includes leading with strategic ability, architecting client value, driving AI\-led innovation, executing with discipline, building a collaborative ecosystem, and amplifying human potential.
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
About the role
  
As a HR Lead \- Global Capability Centers, you will make an impact by shaping, mobilizing, and scaling HR solutions that enable the successful launch and ongoing performance of Cognizant's Global Capability Centers (GCCs). You will be a valued member of the HR leadership team and work collaboratively with senior business leaders, client stakeholders, and HR functional teams across Recruitment, Career Architecture, Total Rewards, HR M\&A, and Talent Management.
  
In this role, you will
  
Partner with senior business leaders and client stakeholders to translate strategic objectives, GCC scope, and operating model expectations into integrated HR solutions, while anticipating people, capability, and governance risks and providing commercially grounded mitigation.
  
Serve as a trusted, executive\-level HR advisor to clients on leading HR practices, country\-specific talent considerations, HR operating models, and governance approaches, showcasing Cognizant's differentiated GCC experience.
  
Design and continuously improve a scalable GCC HR playbook—covering stage gates, governance routines, functional deliverables, escalation paths, and success measures—and codify best practices to accelerate implementation and strengthen repeatability.
  
Mobilize and lead a high\-performing, cross\-functional HR task force and network of functional experts to deliver against critical milestones and sustain effective GCC people practices.
  
Establish robust governance mechanisms, including steering committees and operating reviews, and provide clear, executive\-ready updates on progress, risks, decisions, and talent outcomes.
  
Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead through strategic agility, client value creation, AI\-led innovation, disciplined execution, collaborative ecosystem building and amplifying human potential through a culture of growth, inclusion and effective human\-AI collaboration.
  
What you need to have to be considered
  
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 15 years of progressive HR leadership experience, ideally spanning HR business partnering, HR Centers of Excellence, transformation, and large\-scale service delivery environments.
  
Deep enterprise HR expertise across hire\-to\-retire processes, with the ability to integrate multiple functional disciplines into practical, scalable, and client\-relevant solutions.
  
Strong business acumen with a demonstrated ability to connect talent strategy, operating model design, financial considerations, and delivery execution.
  
Proven success in client\-facing, consultative, or advisory roles, with exceptional executive communication skills and the ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders.
  
Strong understanding of global service delivery models, GCC operating environments, and the talent practices required to enable scale, quality, and sustained performance across a complex, matrixed, multi\-time\-zone environment.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead with strategic vision, client\-centric thinking, innovation, disciplined execution, collaboration and a commitment to developing people in line with the Cognizant Way to Lead.
  
Proven track record of building trust, demonstrating ownership, exercising sound judgment and fostering an inclusive culture that supports growth and associate success.
  
These will help you stand out
  
Experience leading, influencing, and developing diverse, multicultural teams and cross\-functional stakeholder groups.
  
Comfort navigating ambiguity, shaping new solutions, and bringing clarity, governance, and momentum to rapidly evolving business priorities.
  
A commitment to promoting an ethical workplace culture and supporting compliance processes and programs.
  
Experience thriving in complex, fast\-evolving environments by translating strategy into action, fostering cross\-functional collaboration and championing continuous learning and curiosity.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 4 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

You will work closely with data analysts, project managers, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity and accuracy throughout the migration process.

* Analyze source and target data structures to develop comprehensive data mappings.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather data requirements and understand business rules.
* Design, implement, and document data mapping specifications.
* Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure the accuracy of the migrated data.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data\-related issues during and after the migration process.
* Develop and maintain documentation related to data mapping processes and methodologies.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data migration and mapping.

  

Skills and Tools Required:
  

* Strong understanding of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL).
* Proficiency in data mapping tools and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) solutions.
* Familiarity with data modeling concepts and data governance frameworks.
* Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL) for data manipulation.
* Analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
