title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manage project scope, timelines, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies to ensure successful delivery of product initiatives following the product management lifecycle
* Partner with Product Management to translate roadmap priorities into actionable delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, and release schedules
* Establish governance processes and provide weekly status reporting to leadership and executives on project health, milestones, risks, and mitigation plans
* Collaborate with client\-facing teams and, when appropriate, directly engage customers to gather feedback, support pilot programs, validate readiness, and communicate delivery plans
* Identifies solutions to non\-standard requests and problems

* Apply critical thinking, sound judgment, and structured problem\-solving to navigate ambiguity, resolve complex cross\-functional challenges, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive timely decision\-making
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of project or program management experience leading complex, cross\-functional product technology initiatives
* Experience managing product roadmap delivery from concept through release and adoption
* Experience leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI, and AI\-powered productivity tools to improve planning, reporting, decision\-making, and delivery execution
* Experience partnering with Product Management, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Operations, Support, and Client Implementation teams
* Solid experience with Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, Excel, and Copilot
* Experience evaluating business processes and recommending automation strategies to improve efficiency and scalability
* Experience creating executive summaries, status reports, leadership presentations, and stakeholder communications
* Experience facilitating meetings ranging from working sessions to governance meetings
* Experience with communicating complex technical concepts in clear, concise business language
* Knowledge of AI agents, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and emerging AI capabilities within enterprise environments
* Solid understanding of Agile, Scrum, and product development lifecycle processes
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, system dependencies, and technical architecture concepts sufficient to facilitate discussions between business and engineering stakeholders
* Advanced proficiency in project management software (Smartsheet preferred), including project dashboards, reports, automation workflows, and executive reporting
* Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies, risks, issues, and timelines across multiple teams simultaneously
* Proven ability to create executive dashboards and actionable project metrics
* Proven ability to influence decisions and drive alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Proven solid organizational skills and attention to detail
* Experience with a backlog management software (Aha! preferred), roadmap planning, and delivery tracking
* Experience presenting project status, risks, recommendations, and business outcomes. Preference on presenting to senior leadership and executive stakeholders
* Demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, streamline workflows, and improve project delivery effectiveness through innovation and operational excellence

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* AI, Copilot, or automation\-related certifications

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Intellectual Property Associate Director
description:
**Company Description**  

In a world that is constantly evolving we help our clients thrive by simplifying the complex, illuminating new paths, and shaping solutions that make a difference.


At S\&W our mission is to help navigate challenges, unlock potential, and achieve the extraordinary.


As the UK’s top 10 fastest growing accountancy firm, we’ve been there, as a trusted partner, helping businesses and individuals meet challenges and seize opportunities across generations.


Since 1881, we’ve been a trusted partner, building a legacy on expertise, simplicity, and an unrelenting commitment to client success.


Our specialists provide an extensive range of services from tax and accountancy, advisory and assurance, to corporate finance and restructuring, helping businesses and individuals both in the UK and internationally meet challenges and seize opportunities.


We are a brand built on expertise, driven by ambition, and defined by our purpose \- to help our clients navigate complexity and create opportunity.


S\&W acquired ClearViewIP in September 2025 to complement the existing advisory services that S\&W currently offers its clients including corporate finance, valuations, transaction services and forensic services, along with business tax, audit, consulting and business outsourcing services.


The ClearViewIP team comprises experienced IP professionals, with decades of experience in managing, protecting and commercialising innovation and ensuring best practise IP approaches are deployed to help clients win in the market.

 **Job Description** **What you will be doing?**


The IP Operations Associate Director (AD) will support the growth of the India team through being a hands\-on expert. This role is responsible for the delivery of advanced IP research solutions – including Freedom\-to\-Operate (FTO) analyses, licensing \& commercialization support, technology \& patent landscapes, and competitive intelligence – while ensuring operational excellence and innovation. The AD will leverage their deep operational \& research expertise to optimize service delivery and enhance the firm’s offerings. Acting as a strategic partner to the client teams, they will foster long\-term relationships with the global team and clients, identify new business opportunities with their internal client teams, and contribute to demonstrable revenue growth through exceptional delivery of client\-focused solutions.


AI is at the forefront of the team and it’s essential that the AD has an AI first mindset. Experience in using and assisting the internal development of AI/ML tools and emerging technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), to improve efficiency, consistency \& quality are an essential requirement.


This demanding role will allow exposure to a wide variety of global clients, sectors and types of work, which will be highly rewarding to an individual who enjoys working on diverse projects and the dynamic of working as part of a rapidly growing global team.


This is an office\-based role in our Gurugram, India office, 5 days a week.

**As a Intellectual Property Associate Director your responsibilities will include among others:**

**Client Service/Client Work**

* Deliver exceptional client service by prioritising customer experience, proactively managing relationships, and ensuring timely, high\-quality execution of advice and services.
* Achieve Exceptional Advisor competencies by aligning client work with the appropriate expertise, seniority, and capacity to meet the highest standards.
* Foster a global “one team” mindset by collaborating across S\&W and ClearViewIP teams, partnering with stakeholders, and supporting global client needs, including occasional travel and cross\-time\-zone work.

**Growing the business**

* Build and enhance ClearViewIP’s reputation both internally and externally while strengthening relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Drive business growth by promoting cross\-selling opportunities across ClearViewIP and the wider S\&W group.
* Embed an AI\-first mindset by leveraging AI and RPA extensively across your team to improve efficiency and outcomes.

**Quality control, compliance and risk management**

* Ensure full compliance with internal procedures, the compliance manual, and all relevant operating standards to mitigate risk for the group.
* Maintain strong technical competence while adhering to regulatory and business line requirements.
* Manage risk effectively by reporting complaints and potential PI issues promptly in line with group procedures.

**Financial Management**

* Monitor and manage key financial metrics (chargeable hours, utilisation, recoveries, WIP, billing, and lock\-up), ensuring timely billing and minimising lock\-up.
* Ensure accurate and prompt time recording through effective oversight of timesheet submission.
* Maintain financial control and compliance by reporting WIP and bad debt risks to the HoD and adhering to Delegated Authority Limits and relevant debtor/WIP policies

**Staff Management \& Development**

* Demonstrate strong leadership aligned with Exceptional Leader competencies, working collaboratively with global research and operations teams while managing day\-to\-day responsibilities for direct reports.
* Drive people development by conducting ADRs, mentoring talent, and supporting continuous growth in technical, professional, and leadership capabilities across the team.
* Maximise team performance by coaching and developing direct reports in line with talent plans, ensuring alignment with individual potential, skills, and client delivery expectations.

**Financial Job Dimensions**

* An associate director should be responsible for a client portfolio of a minimum £300,000 per annum.
* An associate director would be expected to keep tight control of debtors and demonstrate a commercial approach in connection with outstanding fees.

 **Qualifications** **To be successful in this role, you should have**

* Extensive background in intellectual property consulting, with expertise in delivering strategic IP solutions across diverse sectors including Freedom\-to\-Operate (FTO) analyses, prior art searches, invalidity searches, claim charting, patent landscapes, competitive intelligence, and portfolio assessments.
* Skilled in managing high\-value client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Build and sustain strong client and internal partnerships while driving repeat business and expanding service offerings through strategic business development.
* Leverage advanced expertise in AI, machine learning, and LLM platforms (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to enhance patent analytics, optimise service delivery, and develop innovative IP solutions.
* Deliver consistent revenue growth by establishing new service lines, expanding client portfolios, and executing client\-centric, high\-impact strategies.
* Understanding of working as part of a global team and working with international clients with willingness to travel \& work on clients time zones as required.
* Educated to degree level or equivalent.
* Excellent English both speaking \& written
* A relevant qualification (such as qualifications in IP) is desirable, although not essential.

 **Additional Information**  

We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S\&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workplace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.


We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know.

title: Economic Policy Manager, India
description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Public Policy Manager to lead policy engagement on economic regulations in India. In this role, you will report to the Public Policy Director, India, proactively engaging with Indian government officials, regulators, and key external stakeholders on issues affecting Meta's family of apps and technologies, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and emerging technologies such as AI and wearable devices. You will focus on developing and executing public policy strategies across Competition Policy, Infrastructure/Telecom Policy, Commerce Policy, and Monetisation/Ads Policy, advancing Meta's mission while navigating India's evolving regulatory landscape.  

  

  

### **Economic Policy Manager, India Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive public policy strategies for India across Competition Policy, Infrastructure/Telecom Policy, Commerce Policy, and Monetisation/Ads Policy, reporting to the Public Policy Director, India
* Proactively develop and maintain relationships with Indian government officials, regulators, parliamentary committees, and relevant industry and civil society stakeholders to advance Meta's policy positions on economic regulations
* Monitor, analyze, and communicate the implications of Indian legislative and regulatory developments in competition, telecom/infrastructure, commerce, and advertising policy to internal cross\-functional teams including legal, product, communications, and operations
* Support Meta's participation in industry associations and multi\-stakeholder forums relevant to India's economic and digital policy environment
* Develop policy positions, briefing materials, and written submissions for regulatory consultations, parliamentary inquiries, and government engagements on economic regulation matters
* Partner with global and regional policy teams to align India\-specific strategies with broader policy frameworks while maintaining focus on India's unique regulatory context
* Provide research, analysis, and decision support to the Public Policy Director on high\-priority economic policy risks and opportunities in India
* Collaborate with product and legal teams to assess the policy implications of new product launches, monetisation features, and platform changes in the Indian market
* Identify emerging policy risks in competition, infrastructure, commerce, and advertising regulations and contribute to mitigation strategies, coordinating cross\-functional responses to regulatory inquiries or enforcement actions
* Support organizational strategy by contributing to goals and priorities for India economic policy engagement

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years of experience in public policy, government affairs, regulatory affairs, or a related field, with direct engagement in India's policy or regulatory environment
* Experience engaging with Indian government institutions, regulatory bodies, or legislative processes on technology, digital, competition, or economic policy matters
* Experience developing policy positions, written submissions, or briefing materials for government or regulatory audiences
* Experience working in a rapidly evolving environment, collaborating with multiple cross\-functional teams, adapting flexibly to ambiguous situations, and aligning on shared goals with team members

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience translating complex regulatory or legislative developments into actionable product or business guidance for non\-policy audiences
* Experience working within or alongside technology companies, trade associations, or regulatory bodies on competition, commerce, or digital infrastructure matters
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high\-priority policy workstreams simultaneously, aligning diverse internal and external stakeholders toward shared outcomes
* Experience working on economic policy issues such as competition/antitrust policy, telecom/infrastructure regulation, e\-commerce policy, or advertising/monetisation regulations in India
* Experience providing strategic policy advice and decision support to senior leaders or executives in complex, fast\-moving regulatory environments

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Tech S and T-AI Engineer-ISR-Senior-GDSF02

title: Business Development Executive – Inside Sales
description:
**Business Development Executive – Inside Sales**

**Location:** Golf Course Road, Gurgaon (Gurugram)  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** Minimum 6 months in Calling / Sales / Business Development  
**Education:** Bachelor’s Degree – Minimum Qualification

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Business Development Executive** to join our growing sales team and drive the adoption of our AI\-powered SaaS products — **ProcessHQ.ai** and **OoroAI.com**.

This role is ideal for someone who is confident on calls, enjoys speaking with business owners and decision\-makers, understands the basics of sales, and is excited about selling technology solutions that solve real business problems.

You will be responsible for identifying potential customers, connecting with prospects, understanding their requirements, demonstrating our products, following up with leads, and converting opportunities into customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate and qualify new business leads through outbound calling, online research, referrals and other sales channels.
* Make regular sales calls to prospective customers and identify business needs and pain points.
* Understand customer requirements and position **ProcessHQ.ai and OoroAI.com** as relevant solutions.

**Facilitation and Vendor Management:**

* Support the facilitation of in\-office learning events in Crowe India offices, including logistics, course designs, communication, and course follow up.

**Qualifications:**

* Critical thinking skills to analyze course goals and instructional strategies, ensuring they align with evidence\-based practices.


This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative learning solutions while ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency. If you are a proactive and detail\-oriented professional with a passion for learning and development, we encourage you to apply.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

title: Machine Learning Engineer — Data Matching & Record Linkage
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a hands\-on Machine Learning Engineer to own the design and implementation of our entity resolution and record\-linkage pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of applied data science and large\-scale data engineering: you'll be building the models and heuristics that decide when two records from different, messy source systems represent the same real\-world entity — and the ETL infrastructure that feeds them.

This is not a "pipeline plumbing" role. We need someone who can genuinely apply data\-science and statistical techniques to a hard matching problem, evaluate models rigorously, and iterate based on measured outcomes.

What You'll Do

* Design, build, and evaluate machine learning models for entity matching, including feature engineering on structured and semi\-structured data.
* Implement and tune statistical record\-linkage methods, including Fellegi–Sunter\-style models — estimating field\-level match/non\-match weights from labelled data, computing likelihood\-ratio based match scores, and setting evidence\-driven decision thresholds.
* Build and maintain large\-scale ETL processes to ingest heterogeneous databases, map disparate schemas to a common data model, and profile and repair data quality issues (placeholders, junk values, inconsistent encodings, malformed fields).
* Develop fuzzy and phonetic string\-matching logic, name normalization routines, and blocking/candidate\-generation strategies to make matching tractable at scale.
* Calibrate scoring thresholds against labelled data and business requirements, balancing precision and recall.
* Group matched records using graph\-style techniques (clustering / clique formation) to resolve multi\-record entities.
* Run iterative rerun\-and\-tune cycles: evaluate model/pipeline output, diagnose failure modes, and refine features, weights, and thresholds accordingly.
* Write clean, production\-grade Python and SQL, and maintain Parquet\-based data pipelines.

Must\-Have Qualifications

* **Genuine ML experience** — feature engineering, model evaluation methodology, and hands\-on application of data\-science techniques to real problems (not just orchestrating pipelines).
* Working knowledge of statistical record\-linkage methods such as the **Fellegi–Sunter model**, including:
* Estimating field\-level match/non\-match weights from labelled data
* Likelihood\-ratio based scoring
* Setting evidence\-driven decision thresholds
* Proven experience with **large\-scale ETL**:
* Ingesting heterogeneous databases
* Mapping them to a common data model
* Profiling and repairing data quality issues (placeholders, junk values, inconsistent encodings)
* Strong **Python** (Pandas / PySpark or similar), **SQL / Postgres**, and **Parquet\-based pipelines**.
* Practical experience with fuzzy and phonetic string matching, name normalization, blocking/candidate\-generation strategies, and scoring/threshold calibration.

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with graph\-style grouping (clustering / clique formation) for multi\-record entity resolution.
* Experience running iterative rerun\-and\-tune workflows on production matching pipelines.
* Exposure to distributed data processing at scale (Spark, Dask, or similar).

Texas Instruments is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a first\-of\-its\-kind team where advanced analytics, mathematical rigor, and machine learning meet semiconductor innovation. You will leverage optimization theory, linear algebra, probability theory, and statistical inference to create robust, physics\-informed models that enhance design efficiency, reduce development cycles, improve yield, and ensure product quality. title: Applied Scientist II, Seller Fee Science
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s third\-party marketplace is a multibillion\-dollar global ecosystem, connecting customers and sellers across the world through millions of transactions annually. The Seller Fee Science Team integrates economic modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to guide business fee strategy, ensure fees are accurately computed for millions of products, and improves the seller experience with AI tools that support any fee related contact (understanding, audit, and dispute). We build the scientific foundation that empowers sellers to grow their businesses with clarity and confidence.
   

  

 Our team brings together world\-class economists, physicists, mathematicians, and computer scientists to tackle diverse challenging problems that require theoretical rigor and deliver real\-world impact. For example, precision measurement of difficult to measure products, large\-scale simulation of sales, inventory, and policy changes, as well as leveraging natural language understanding and automated reasoning to interpret policy, generate code, resolve disputes, audit fees, and respond to sellers at meaninful scale.
   

  

 As an applied scientist on our team, this role will focus on the application of machine learning and artificial intelligence to predict and reconcile measurement of products globally. This blends together statistical modeling, application of NLP, image processing, classical machine learning, cost\-benefit analysis, causal modeling, and optimization. Your work will shape not only how fees are implemented, but how they are interpreted, experienced, and trusted at scale. You will partner closely with engineers and product partners to take your solutions from research to production.
   

  

 We are seeking scientists who are motivated by first principles, disciplined experimentation, and the technical challenge of deploying ideas at global scale. This is an opportunity to work on consequential problems where mathematical rigor meets real\-world complexity, and where your models, algorithms, and systems will directly influence the experience of millions of sellers. If you are driven to build elegant solutions to hard problems—and to see them operate in production at meaningful scale—we would welcome the opportunity to build with you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Identify opportunities to improve Seller Experience and translate ambiguous business challenges into well\-defined scientific problems with measurable impact.
* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models that improve fee accuracy, automate policy\-to\-code translation, and enhance seller understanding of fee calculations.
* Partner closely with engineering and product teams to productionize solutions, meeting latency, scalability, reliability, and other system constraints.
* Apply rigorous experimentation, causal inference, and simulation methods to validate models and quantify business impact at scale.
* Communicate scientific innovations and results clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders and contribute to the broader internal and external scientific community through publications, talks, and technical artifacts.


**Basic Qualifications**

The position reports into the Internal Audit Analytics Project Manager and requires collaborating with the Internal Audit team and business partners to provide thought leadership and guide the design and development of complex analytical models and digital solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Lead and deliver analytics\-as\-a\-service engagement for areas of audit (i.e., planning, analytics, etc.) by understanding enterprise data, business processes, and business needs
* Demonstrate thought leadership to solve and provide digital solutions to address key business challenges and derive meaningful insights from data to decision\-making.
* Support the Internal Audit Analytics Project Manager to design and implement digital solutions with high impact by focusing on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the audit process, identifying novel risk\-focused insights, and optimizing the end\-user experience of dashboards and other analytical solutions.
* Lead the design and development of analytic and automation solutions to query, mine, and analyze large complex data sets leveraging data analytical tools (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, etc.).
* Hands\-on project leadership, including defining project goals and milestones, prioritizing and delegating tasks within the DA team to ensure timely and effective delivery, and training and guiding lower\-level team members.
* Keep abreast of the latest advancements in analytics tools and technologies. Serve as a key advisor to audit leadership by identifying opportunities to enhance data acumen and drive digital transformation for internal Audit department.
* Drive the adoption and use of AI across Internal Audit teams by identifying use cases, guiding implementation of AI\-enabled solutions, and promoting best practices that enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.
* Foster relationships with audit leadership and stakeholders to develop thorough understanding of business requirements and communicate work progress and results to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Qualifications**
* 
+ Undergraduate degree in a relevant area (e.g., Accounting, Analytics, Business, Finance, Information Technology, MIS)
+ 8\+ years of working experience in digital/data technologies, internal audit, investigations, internal controls, information technology, data analytics, or risk management fields
+ Technical expertise and previous hands\-on experience with any of the following software tools: Data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Tableau server, Power BI, etc.); Data query/analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Alteryx, Alteryx server etc.); Programming and predictive tools (e.g., Python, R, etc.)
+ Experience evaluating, implementing, or applying AI and machine learning solutions in business or audit\-related contexts, with the ability to identify practical use cases and drive adoption.
+ Experience with Amazon Redshift, SAP ECC and S/4 HANA
+ Ability to work with large complex data sets from multiple data sources in de\-centralized data environments
+ Sound independent judgement, prioritization, and decision\-making skills. Excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills. Strong self\-initiative, comfortable working with ambiguity and limited managerial involvement
+ Ability to lead changes, work through challenges and setbacks.
+ Strong stakeholder management with analytics teams, IT organizations, and business leadership.
+ Strong organizational and project management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at one time
+ Strong communication and presentation skills
+ Business fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese preferred but not required

title: Sr Manager Performance & Insights
description:
**About Us**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy—and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes.
   

  

 That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team, with more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
   

  

 Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference.
   

  

**Pyramid Overview**
 Roundel is Target’s retail media network. Roundel designs and delivers impactful marketing for brands and their agencies, resulting in engagement and incremental sales that can be measured online and in\-store, all within premium, brand\-safe environments.
   

  

**About The Job**
 The Performance \& Insights (P\&I) team enables advertisers to measure, understand, and optimize the business impact of their media investments through advanced analytics, measurement, data visualization, and data\-driven insights.
   

  

 As a Senior Manager, Performance \& Insights, you will lead a team of approximately 7–9 analysts and senior analysts responsible for delivering high\-quality performance measurement, campaign analytics, and strategic insights for a portfolio of advertiser clients.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end quality and effectiveness of P\&I delivery across your team’s book of business. This includes ensuring that advertiser objectives are translated into clear learning agendas, appropriate measurement approaches, rigorous analyses, executive\-ready visualizations, and recommendations that influence media investment and business decisions.
   

  

 You will serve as a senior analytical and consulting partner to PSG, Measurement, Product, and other cross\-functional teams. You will also build relationships with Director\-level client and analytics stakeholders, manage complex client escalations, and clearly articulate how Roundel media contributes to revenue, growth, customer engagement, and other key business outcomes.
   

  

 Success in this role requires strong people leadership, deep marketing analytics and measurement expertise, client consulting experience, operational discipline, and the ability to build a team that consistently delivers analytically rigorous and commercially impactful work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 7–9 Performance \& Insights professionals, establishing clear expectations for analytical quality, client service, collaboration, and business impact.
* Own P\&I delivery across the team’s advertiser portfolio, ensuring work is completed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with established quality standards and client commitments.
* Ensure the team develops a documented understanding of each advertiser’s business objectives, marketing priorities, measurement needs, and key decision points.
* Translate advertiser and business questions into structured learning agendas, analytical frameworks, measurement plans, KPIs, and success criteria.
* Guide the team in selecting and applying appropriate media measurement methodologies, including incrementality measurement, synthetic control approaches, attribution, lift studies, test\-and\-control experimentation, A/B testing, marketing mix modeling, and third\-party measurement solutions.
* Coach team members to independently interpret, challenge, and apply marketing mix modeling and third\-party attribution outputs when developing performance recommendations.
* Ensure analytical solutions—including insight modules, scaled insights, channel\-performance narratives, dashboards, and custom analyses—are effectively used to address advertiser needs and drive measurable business and revenue impact.
* Establish analytical review and quality\-assurance mechanisms covering methodology selection, data validation, KPI definitions, statistical interpretation, dashboard design, visualization, and recommendation development.
* Ensure the team maintains high\-quality learning and measurement plans that are aligned with advertiser business needs and P\&I standards.
* Champion the adoption of Director\-vetted analytical platforms, advanced statistical methods, visualization practices, and measurement capabilities across the team.
* Coach direct reports to transform complex campaign, customer, retail, and media data into clear business narratives that explain performance drivers and identify actionable growth opportunities.
* Ensure deliverables clearly demonstrate how media investments contribute to advertiser revenue, growth, customer engagement, and other key business objectives.
* Oversee the development of executive\-ready dashboards, visualizations, presentations, and post\-campaign analyses that simplify complex findings and enable confident decision\-making.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with Director\-level advertiser, agency, analytics, Sales, and PSG stakeholders.
* Present complex analytical findings and strategic recommendations to senior internal and external stakeholders, confidently articulating the impact of media on business performance and investment outcomes.
* Take ownership of complex client and delivery escalations, driving timely resolution and reinforcing alignment on measurement, performance, and media\-investment priorities.
* Partner with Sales, PSG, Measurement, Product, Business Intelligence, Go\-to\-Market, and P\&I Enablement teams to improve advertiser solutions and strengthen Roundel’s measurement capabilities.
* Proactively gather and apply feedback from advertisers, PSG, and cross\-functional partners to improve team effectiveness, analytical products, and client experiences.
* Participate in strategic P\&I priority plans and ensure the team contributes effectively toward established goals, OKRs, attributable revenue, client satisfaction, and operational performance measures.
* Manage team capacity, account assignments, delivery priorities, and resources, adjusting plans and approaches as business needs and client priorities evolve.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring analyses, standardize dashboards and reporting, create reusable analytical assets, and improve the scalability and efficiency of P\&I delivery.
* Ensure consistent adoption of operational standards, including work\-management systems, documentation, knowledge repositories, delivery tracking, and appropriate attribution of cross\-functional contributions.
* Establish inclusive team norms and forums that encourage constructive challenge, ensure diverse perspectives are heard, and address behaviors that limit collaboration or inclusion.
* Provide timely and transparent performance feedback, address difficult issues directly, and maintain meaningful career\-development plans for every team member.
* Build team capability through coaching, analytical reviews, knowledge\-sharing forums, presentation practice, skill assessments, and targeted development opportunities.


**About You**
* 10–14 years of experience in marketing analytics, retail analytics, digital media measurement, business intelligence, data science, client consulting, or a related analytical function.
* At least 4 years of experience directly managing and developing analytics, insights, business intelligence, or measurement professionals.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team of approximately 7 \- 9 team members while managing multiple clients, priorities, and analytical deliverables.
* MBA/ Master’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Marketing, or another quantitative discipline.
* Deep understanding of digital advertising, retail media, campaign measurement, marketing effectiveness, and performance KPIs.
* Strong knowledge of measurement methodologies including incrementality, attribution, lift studies, experimentation, synthetic controls, marketing mix modeling, and third\-party measurement approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate analytical methodologies, challenge assumptions, review findings, and ensure recommendations are supported by accurate and credible analysis.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and analytical tools such as Python or R, with the ability to guide technical approaches and review analytical outputs produced by the team.
* Experience leading the development of interactive dashboards and executive\-level visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar business intelligence platforms.
* Strong understanding of visualization principles, dashboard design, and data storytelling, with the ability to ensure complex analytical findings are communicated clearly and persuasively.
* Proven client\-consulting and stakeholder\-management skills, including experience influencing Director\-level and senior business leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex analytical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience managing client escalations, resolving ambiguity, and aligning stakeholders around measurement approaches, analytical findings, and recommended actions.
* Demonstrated ability to establish quality standards, operational processes, governance mechanisms, and scalable delivery practices across an analytics team.
* Strong strategic planning, prioritization, resource\-management, and execution skills, with a demonstrated ability to deliver business outcomes in a dynamic environment.
* Inclusive and empathetic leadership style, with a strong commitment to team development, constructive feedback, collaboration, and creating an environment where team members can grow and succeed.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**About Saltmine**  

  

Saltmine is building an AI\-powered workplace strategy and capital projects platform for  

enterprise real estate teams. We help global organizations move from business goals   

spatial programs stack plans test fits execution in a seamless, data\-driven  

workflow.  

Our platform combines:  

* Workplace strategy
* Occupancy planning
* Capital project planning
* AI\-driven automation


to enable faster, smarter, and more cost\-efficient real estate decisions.  

We are now building a next\-generation automated test\-fitting engine that can generate  

high\-quality, architecturally valid layouts in minutes and we’re looking for a Spatial Algorithms  

Engineer to help power this core capability.  

**Role Overview**  

As a Spatial Algorithms Engineer, you will design and build the core layout engine that  

generates optimized floor plans based on spatial constraints, architectural rules, and business  

requirements.  

You will work at the intersection of:  

* computational geometry
* optimization algorithms
* real\-world workplace design

  

Your work will directly power Saltmine’s ability to automatically generate and evaluate  

thousands of layout options for enterprise customers.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**1\. Build Automated Test\-Fit Engine**  

* Develop algorithms to generate 2D layouts within complex floor plates
* Solve for:
* space allocation
* corridor generation
* adjacency constraints
* geometric validity
 **2\. Design Constraint\-Based Systems**  

* Encode real\-world rules into the system:
* door placement
* circulation access
* daylight constraints
* minimum room geometry
* Implement hard and soft constraint frameworks

  

**3\. Optimization \& Layout Generation Systems**  

* Build multi\-objective optimization systems to balance:
* adjacency satisfaction
* space efficiency
* daylight utilization
* constraint compliance
* Apply techniques like:
* greedy algorithms
* simulated annealing
* genetic algorithms
* constraint solvers
 **4\. Geometry \& Spatial Modeling Systems**  

* Work with:
* polygons and floor plate boundaries
* spatial partitioning
* graph\-based circulation systems
* Implement:
* space subdivision

* packing algorithms
* layout refinement logic

  

**5\. Scoring \& Evaluation Systems**  

* Design scoring engines to evaluate layout quality:
* adjacency score
* circulation efficiency
* residual space
* program compliance

  

**6\. Performance Optimization**  

* Ensure system can:
* generate multiple layouts efficiently
* scale to large enterprise floor plates
* support near real\-time feedback

  

**7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

* Work closely with:
* product managers
* architects / workplace strategists
* frontend / visualization teams

 **Required Skills**  

  

**Core Computer Science \& Algorithms**  

* Strong foundation in:
* data structures
* algorithms
* graph theory

  

**Computational Geometry**  

* Hands\-on experience with:
* polygon operations (intersection, clipping, partitioning)
* spatial reasoning and layout systems
* Familiarity with libraries like:
* Shapely / GEOS
* JTS / Turf.js
* CGAL
 **Optimization Techniques**  

* Experience with:
* constraint solving
* heuristic optimization
* Exposure to:
* simulated annealing
* genetic algorithms
* linear/integer programming


Note: We are open for any other technique, the idea is to work towards a solution which is best  

in industry.  

  

**Programming**  

* Strong in:
* Python (preferred)
* or C\+\+ / Rust for performance\-critical systems
 **Data Structures for Spatial Systems**  

* Grids, graphs, spatial indexing
* Quadtrees / BSP trees (good to have)
 **Good to Have**  

* Exposure to AEC / architecture / workplace planning
* Experience with:
* CAD / BIM tools (AutoCAD, Revit)
* Rhino / Grasshopper
* Background in:
* game development (procedural generation)
* robotics (path planning)
* simulation systems
 **What We’re Looking For**  

* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to translate real\-world constraints into


algorithms
* Comfort working with geometry, layouts, and visual systems
* Ability to balance multiple competing constraints in optimization problems
* Ownership mindset and ability to build 0 1 systems

 **Impact**  

* Build the core engine powering automated workplace planning
* Directly influence how global enterprises design offices
* Work on a category\-defining product in PropTech \+ AI


Interview Process  

* Algorithm \& case study round \- A real problem statement
* Discussion around case study
* Technical discussion
* Final discussion with leadership

title: Data Science III - Pricing Analytics
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


The Data Scientist III role sits on the Pricing Analytics team within the Corporate Functions division of Expedia Group. This team turns billions of shopping and booking signals into the pricing decisions travelers see across our brands, online experiments, and analytical toolkit behind them. In this role, your work will directly shape pricing strategy, business outcomes, and the experience of millions of travelers each year.
  

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Deep dive into pricing datasets to uncover patterns and surface clear optimization paths, building out a best\-in\-class analytical toolkit as you go
* Design, run, and analyze online experiments (A/B tests), applying industry best practices to turn results into confident decisions
* Build and maintain clear, user\-friendly dashboards and reports that track pricing KPIs, and train stakeholders to use them well
* Partner with engineering, product, and revenue teams to pinpoint key business challenges and translate analysis into recommendations they can act on
* Drive action to improve pricing KPIs, using the 80/20 rule to focus on the most impactful work and showing creativity and persistence in clearing roadblocks
* Stay close to key metrics and trends so you can proactively flag business opportunities and suggest next moves

**Experience and qualifications:**  

* You have a master’s degree in engineering, economics, statistics, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
* You have 5\+ years of experience in analytics — experience in pricing or the travel industry is a plus
* You have mastery of SQL and have worked in complex data ecosystems; you are comfortable in Python or R, and experience with Spark/Databricks or Airflow is a plus
* You have demonstrated knowledge of statistics and online experimentation
* You have solid business acumen and strong problem\-solving skills, and you connect data to insights people can act on

You communicate and present with clarity, making complex information easy for any audience to follow
**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


About CITI
  

Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial
  

services that enable growth and economic progress. We have 200 years of experience helping
  

our clients meet the world's toughest challenges and embrace its greatest opportunities.
  

Analytics and Information Management (AIM)
  

Citi AIM was established in 2003, and is located across multiple cities in India – Bengaluru,
  

Chennai, Pune and Mumbai. It is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes
  

information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. It identifies fact\-based
  

opportunities for revenue growth in partnership with the businesses. The function balances
  

customer needs, business strategy, and profit objectives using best in class and relevant
  

analytic methodologies.
  

What do we do?
  

The North America Consumer Bank – Data Science and Modeling team analyzes millions of
  

prospects and billions of customer level transactions using big data tools and machine learning,
  

AI techniques to unlock opportunities for our clients in meeting their financial needs and create
  

economic value for the bank.
  

The team extracts relevant insights, identifies business opportunities, converts business
  

problems into modeling framework, uses big data tools, latest deep learning and machine
  

learning algorithms to build predictive models, implements solutions and designs go\-to\-market
  

strategies for a huge variety of business problems.
  

The Specialized Analytics Sr Anlst (AVP) is a developing role for an AI/ML professional. This
  

role is focused on designing and building cutting\-edge solutions by harnessing the power of
  

both advanced machine learning and Large Language Models. The ideal candidate will have a
  

deep understanding of the modern AI landscape, with hands\-on experience applying these
  

technologies to solve real\-world business challenges. You will integrate in\-depth specialty area
  

knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices, and will have the
  

latitude to solve complex problems independently. This role has a direct impact on the
  

business's core activities, and the quality of your work will influence the success of your team
  

and its partners. The role will report to the VP leading the team.
  

Responsibilities:
  

* Design, develop, and deploy end\-to\-end solutions leveraging Large Language Models

(LLMs), with a strong focus on building and optimizing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation
  

(RAG) systems.
  

* Apply the fundamentals of Agentic AI to create autonomous and intelligent systems that

solve complex business problems.
  

* Utilize a broad range of machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling (e.g.,

Gradient Boosting, XGBoost) and unsupervised learning (e.g., Clustering), to generate
  

insights and enhance AI\-driven solutions.
  

* Lead advanced prompt engineering efforts and establish robust testing frameworks to

ensure the performance, accuracy, and safety of LLM\-based applications.
  

* Work with large and complex datasets to source, clean, and prepare data for both

traditional modeling and advanced LLM applications.
  

* Translate complex AI/ML concepts and analytical findings into actionable insights and

communicate them clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  

* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular

consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets,
  

by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
  

Qualifications:
  

* 10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience in an AI, ML, or data science role.
* Strong foundation in classical machine learning algorithms (e.g., Gradient Boosting,

Clustering, XGBoost) and their practical applications.
  

* Deep understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), and proven, hands\-on

experience building end\-to\-end Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
  

* Demonstrable expertise in advanced prompt engineering techniques and a strong grasp

of LLM evaluation and testing methodologies.
  

* Strong proficiency in Python and its core AI/ML libraries
* Expertise in retrieving and manipulating large datasets using SQL.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build partnerships

with cross\-functional leaders in a matrix work environment.
  

* A proactive, can\-do attitude and a strong willingness to learn and adapt within the rapidly

evolving AI landscape.
  

Education:
  

* Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field such as

Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Beghou brings over three decades of experience helping life sciences companies optimize their commercialization through strategic insight, advanced analytics, and technology. From developing go\-to\-market strategies and building foundational data analytics infrastructures to leveraging artificial intelligence to improve customer insights and engagement, Beghou helps life sciences companies maximize performance across their portfolios. Beghou also deploys proprietary and third\-party technology solutions to help companies forecast performance, design territories, manage customer data, organize, and report on medical and commercial data, and more. Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois, we have 10 global offices.  

  

*Our mission is to bring together analytical minds and innovative technology to help life sciences companies navigate the complexity of health care and improve patient outcomes.* **Purpose of Job**

As an Associate, you will be instrumental in providing advanced analytical support to our esteemed life sciences clients while guiding and mentoring our consulting team to deliver exceptional results. You'll be instrumental in building and enhancing our services and deliverables, as well as fostering internal and external relationships to drive business growth and client satisfaction.
### **We'll Trust you to:**

* Provide advanced analytical support to external clients and internal stakeholders on high\-complexity analytical projects/initiatives.
* Lead the India\-based delivery team in executing all business\-related tasks and activities with excellence.
* Utilize structured project management approaches to deliver client deliverables with appropriate documentation and communication.
* Collaborate closely within engagement teams and with clients to conduct high\-quality analysis and develop innovative recommendations.
* Take ownership of project/s, ensuring high\-quality delivery, timeliness, and client satisfaction.
* Develop and manage internal and external relationships, fostering collaboration and driving business growth.
* Contribute to the enhancement of existing services and deliverables, driving innovation within the organization.
* Drive design and enhancement of existing services/deliverables.
* Support Beghou leadership in pursuing new business development opportunities.
* Participate in firm\-level initiatives to strengthen the India practice, including onboarding, training, and mentoring of team members.
* Develop and maintain knowledge repositories within specific function/therapeutic areas.
### **You'll Need to have:**

* Graduate/Master’s degree from a Tier\-I/Tier\-II institution with relevant concentration (e.g., computer science, engineering, statistics)
* 1\-3 years of experience in data science, with a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry.
* Demonstrated success in executing data \& analytics engagements in life sciences or healthcare industries. Preferred expertise in analytics related to drug commercialization (sales force analytics, omnichannel, attribution modeling etc.). Analytical Diversity and agility preferred.
* AI/ML experience is a must, Gen AI experience is a plus.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Python, Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBI).

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills spanning across multiple pharma use cases
* Outstanding communication skills with the ability to tackle unstructured real\-world problems.
* Passion for understanding and devising solutions for current issues in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor junior team members effectively.
* Ability to thrive in an international matrix environment and collaborate with US clients during US working hours.
*At Beghou Consulting, you'll join a highly collaborative, values\-driven team where technical excellence, analytical rigor, and personal growth converge. Whether you're passionate about AI innovation, building commercialization strategies, or shaping the next generation of data\-first solutions in life sciences, this is a place to make an impact!*

**.**

 The Data \& Audience Platform organization is at the forefront of developing and maintaining frameworks, tools, and data products vital to WBD, including flagship streaming product HBO Max and non\-streaming products such as Films Group, Sports, News and overall WBD eco\-system. We are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower teams across the company to catalyze customer growth, amplify engagement, and execute timely, informed decisions, ensuring our continued success in an ever\-evolving digital landscape

title: Senior Data Scientist - Protein Structure ML models
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The Senior Data Scientist \- Protein Structure ML models will play a critical role in advancing AI\-enabled protein and antibody design across Large Molecule Discovery (LMD). This role will focus on building, adapting, and validating machine learning models that predict protein function from structure, with particular emphasis on antibodies and antibody\-like molecules.
   

  

 Working at the intersection of machine learning, structural biology, protein engineering, and experimental discovery, this individual will also develop workflows that combine structure prediction, structure generation, and inverse\-folding models into practical protein design pipelines. The role will partner closely with wet\-lab scientists to guide assay design, generate high\-value property data, and translate internal and externally available datasets into rigorous validation strategies.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys developing technically rigorous geometric ML methods while remaining deeply connected to experimental validation and real\-world biologics discovery needs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Protein Structure to Function Modeling
   

  

* Build machine learning models, either developed in\-house from scratch or adapted from existing examples, to predict protein function from structure.
* Focus model development on antibodies and antibody\-like molecules, including formats that require structure\-aware modeling approaches for downstream property prediction.
* Use internal and externally available structural, sequence, binding, and property datasets to evaluate and improve model performance.


 Antibody Binding Model Validation
   

  

* Design, own, and maintain validation tasks for assessing antibody binding models across internal and externally available datasets.
* Establish well\-curated benchmarks that support quality control, model comparison, and responsible onboarding of external / open\-source ML models.
* Translate validation results into actionable guidance for model selection, model improvement, and downstream protein design decisions.


 Experimental Data Generation Partnership
   

  

* Partner with wet\-lab scientists and structural biologists to guide assays for collecting property data that can improve model training, validation, and decision\-making.
* Help define data collection strategies that connect experimental readouts to ML model objectives and biologics design hypotheses.
* Work cross\-functionally to interpret experimental outcomes and incorporate learnings into iterative model development workflows.


 Integrated Protein Design Workflows
   

  

* Develop workflows that chain or efficiently combine structure prediction, structure generation, and inverse\-folding models for protein design.
* Apply structure\-aware ML tools to support de novo design and optimization of antibodies and related formats.
* Contribute reusable workflows, validation practices, and technical standards that improve scalability and reproducibility of protein design pipelines.


**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Computational Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field and relevant professional experience.
   

  

**Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree and 6\+ years of relevant experience, OR
* Master’s degree and 4\+ years of relevant experience, OR
* PhD


- 

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Programming and ML Frameworks
   

  

* Fluent in Python and able to develop reliable, reusable scientific software for model development, data analysis, and workflow automation.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one modern deep learning framework, such as PyTorch or JAX.
* Ability to work across research codebases, adapt existing implementations, and mature promising examples in the literature into robust internal workflows.


 Protein Structure Modeling
   

  

* Strong foundation and hands\-on experience with protein structure modeling, particularly as applied to antibodies and antibody\-like molecules.
* Experience translating structural biology concepts into computational features, modeling assumptions, and validation strategies.
* Structural modeling experience for small molecules is also welcome, especially where those skills are transferable to understanding protein surfaces.


 Deep Learning for Protein Structures
   

  

* Experience applying deep learning to protein structures, including graph neural networks, equivariance\-aware methods, or related architectures.
* Ability to evaluate structure\-conditioned models for protein function, binding, designability, or related protein engineering objectives.
* Comfortable working with noisy, sparse, or heterogeneous biological datasets and designing validation strategies that reflect practical discovery constraints.


 Generative and Inverse Design Tools
   

  

* Experienced in applying out\-of\-the\-box generative protein structure tools, such as RFdiffusion or Boltzgen, to protein design questions.
* Preferred experience extending or adding features to open source structure prediction or generative modeling tools.
* Preferred experience using inverse design tools such as ProteinMPNN or related sequence\-design methods within end\-to\-end protein design pipelines.


 Scientific Collaboration and Communication
   

  

* Ability to collaborate effectively with wet\-lab scientists, protein engineers, structural biologists, ML researchers, and data engineering partners.
* Strong communication skills for explaining model assumptions, validation results, and design recommendations to both technical and scientific audiences.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, scientific judgment, and attention to detail in the development and deployment of protein design workflows.


 Success Measures
   

  

 Success in this role will be demonstrated through:
   

  

* Delivery of validated ML models that predict protein function from structure and support antibody and antibody\-like molecule design.
* Creation of robust validation tasks that provide clear quality control for internal and external antibody binding models.
* Improved ability to guide wet\-lab data generation toward high\-value property measurements for model training and validation.
* Effective integration of structure prediction, structure generation, and inverse\-folding tools into reproducible protein design workflows.
* Increased confidence in model\-driven design decisions through well\-documented benchmarks and validation practices.
* Positive adoption of protein structure ML workflows by AI, computational biology, and experimental discovery teams.


 Typical Candidate Profile
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with practical experience in protein structure modeling and biologics discovery. They are comfortable building models, adapting frontier methods, and designing validation tasks that determine whether those models are useful for real discovery decisions.
   

  

 Candidates may come from computational biology, machine learning, structural biology, protein engineering, bioinformatics, or related quantitative backgrounds. They are motivated by the opportunity to connect de novo protein design, antibody engineering, experimental validation, and scalable ML workflows into practical discovery capabilities.
   

  

 Organizational Impact
   

  

 This role contributes directly to de novo protein design efforts by developing and validating ML\-enabled workflows that connect protein structure to function. By using internal datasets to guide de novo ML models, the Senior Data Scientist \- Protein Structure ML models will help enable the design of exotic antibody\-like formats and expand the range of biologics concepts that can be explored computationally. The role will also provide critical quality control for onboarding and pipeline use of external ML models through well\-curated validation tasks, improving confidence in model\-driven design decisions across Large Molecule Discovery.

description:
**Role Summary**
 The AI Business Analyst will turn operational data into actionable intelligence for Release Management, Program Management Office, End\-to\-End QA, Operational Deployments, QA integrations, and environment telemetry. This role is responsible for interrogating enterprise data sets across ServiceNow, Jira, telemetry platforms, logs, events, and databases to identify operational bottlenecks, workflow misalignments, stability patterns, and automation opportunities. The AI Business Analyst will act as a bridge between operational teams and AI\-enabled delivery practices: translating raw signals into root\-cause insights, converting recurring manual activities into automation backlog items, documenting remediation runbooks, and ensuring that findings are mapped to the teams that own the relevant operational processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze ServiceNow incident, request, change, catalog task, approval, SLA, and closure data to identify operational bottlenecks, recurring handoff delays, aging queues, rework loops, and ownership ambiguity across SaaS Operations teams.
* Mine Jira workflows to detect process misalignments such as linked Jira issues that remain open after upstream or dependent tickets reach defined DONE state, inconsistent transition usage, missing closure evidence, incomplete acceptance criteria, and stale dependencies.
* Develop repeatable query patterns, dashboards, exception reports, and data validation checks that help teams identify where process friction is occurring and which operational owners need to act.
* Translate findings into clear business narratives that explain impact, root cause, recommended actions, and expected operational benefit.
* Partner with telemetry analyst to mine logs, events, databases, system monitors, job schedules, and operational alerts for patterns that indicate application or platform instability, deployment risk, environment fragility, or recurring failure modes.
* Correlate telemetry findings with ServiceNow and Jira records to connect symptoms to operational actions, code changes, releases, configuration updates, deployment steps, or missing runbook guidance.
* Identify stability trends across environments, modules, clients, releases, patches, upgrades, and deployment windows; surface areas of instability before they become recurring production or client\-impacting issues.
* Document operational remediation steps, escalation paths, environmental checks, validation procedures, and closure criteria for recurring incidents, deployment failures, batch issues, telemetry exceptions, and QA integration environment instability.
* Interface directly with end\-to\-end QA integration environment to document implementation plans, deployment steps, validation activities, environment dependencies, ownership boundaries, and readiness criteria.
* Produce environment workflow maps and implementation planning artifacts that support repeatability, onboarding, operational readiness, and future automation.
* Coordinate with other AI initiatives across the company to understand reusable patterns, governance expectations, prompt practices, data\-source standards, entitlement models, responsible AI requirements, and operational support models.
* Help define practical AI use cases that improve SaaS Operations, deployment readiness, telemetry analysis, workflow compliance, and root\-cause analysis without creating unmanaged operational risk.

* Strong business analysis experience in cloud based technologies (preferred), software delivery, release management, DevOps, QA, or operational process improvement.

* Experience translating technical findings into business\-ready recommendations, runbooks, process maps, user stories, backlog items, acceptance criteria, or executive summaries.
* Comfortable working in ambiguous operational environments where the analyst must define the problem, find the right data, validate the evidence, and drive the next action.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
   

  

 This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting\-edge ML/OR models making split\-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re\-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
   

  

 The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large\-scale, low\-latency data flowing through real\-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well\-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
   

  

 What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting\-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end\-to\-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short\-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end\-to\-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real\-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets
