title: Principal Tech Ops Engineer, AWS Rack Manufacturing
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Tech Operations Engineer to lead and scale regional manufacturing operations across a complex, multi vendor hardware production ecosystem. This role owns the end to end orchestration of external manufacturing partners, driving supplier onboarding, site enablement, technical roadmap development, and sustained performance management across Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Procurement functions. You will shape operational planning inputs that determine how the region builds and delivers enterprise hardware at scale.
   

  

 You will serve as the single threaded owner for manufacturing operations outcomes, aligning diverse stakeholders, setting strategic direction, and delivering results that meet business scaling targets. You will build consensus and drive decisions at velocity across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Risk Management, Public Policy, Finance, and Customer facing organizations while maintaining full accountability for production performance and customer delivery.
   

  

 This is a senior role which requires 10\+ years of technical program management experience. The role demands deep, tenured expertise in high mix, high complexity hardware manufacturing. You will have personally led organizations through product transitions, capacity ramps, supplier onboarding cycles, and operational transformations. You thrive in dynamic environments where shifting product mix, evolving customer demand, and technology transitions require rapid, high judgment decision making that balances quality, cost, throughput, and delivery reliability.
   

  

 You will own complex integration programs from conception through design, validation, implementation, and scaling across manufacturing sites. The scope includes orchestrating a multi vendor ecosystem of manufacturing partners, managing the largest and most complex supplier engagements in the region, and delivering next generation technology programs. This includes enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production, supporting the industry transition from air cooled to liquid cooled infrastructure. In 2027, the role expands to lead the site setup, vendor selection, and operational ramp of a purpose built Manufacturing Center of Excellence, a greenfield facility that will double regional manufacturing capacity and set operational standards for global replication.
   

  

 You will bring strong technical depth across server, storage, and network hardware architectures combined with expertise in program management, supply chain operations, capacity modeling, new product introduction, and manufacturing engineering. You will drive systemic root cause resolution using structured methodologies (5 Whys, 8D, Six Sigma) and own all site capacity planning across the region. You will maintain accountability for critical financial levers including direct and indirect labor optimization, cost per unit, and overall cost competitiveness.
   

  

 You will champion the highest standards of safety, security, and operational excellence across every engagement. You will communicate with clarity through structured business reviews, establish the metrics that define success, and influence across engineering, supply chain, quality, and executive leadership to deliver customer commitments at a global scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Planning and Transformation
   

  

* Define and own the 3 to 5 year manufacturing operations strategy, anticipating future capacity needs, identifying critical capability gaps, and prioritizing technology investments that position the region for sustained growth
* Lead transformational programs that fundamentally reshape manufacturing capability, including advanced automation deployment, robotics integration, and lights out manufacturing initiatives
* Drive manufacturing agility through flexible line configurations, rapid changeover capabilities, and multi product qualification strategies that enable the network to respond to evolving customer demand and technology transitions
* Own capital expenditure planning for manufacturing operations, developing rigorous business cases that quantify returns on equipment investments, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks across the manufacturing network, including single points of failure, capacity constraints, systemic quality issues, and workforce availability challenges before they impact delivery
* Develop high quality strategic documents and investment proposals that influence manufacturing priorities at the executive level, articulating trade offs, quantifying risks, and presenting clear recommendations that drive action


 Final Assembly and System Integration Excellence
   

  

* Architect and continuously evolve production line design, material flow strategies, and workstation configurations across the manufacturing network to deliver step function improvements in throughput, cycle time, and ergonomic safety
* Define the manufacturing execution system strategy for the region, establishing real time visibility into work in progress, station level yields, and production constraints that enable data driven decision making at every level
* Lead a culture of relentless continuous improvement through lean manufacturing principles, kaizen programs, and value stream mapping, systematically eliminating waste and unlocking operational efficiency gains that set the benchmark for global operations


 Data, Metrics, and Operational Excellence
   

  

* Architect and own the manufacturing operations performance framework, defining the metrics that matter (overall equipment effectiveness, throughput, cycle time, first pass yield, on time delivery, cost per unit) and holding the organization accountable to world class targets
* Build executive grade dashboards and reporting systems that provide real time visibility into production health, quality trends, and delivery performance, enabling leaders to make informed decisions at speed across all sites
* Champion Industry 4\.0 adoption including IoT enabled production monitoring, predictive maintenance, and AI driven quality inspection, positioning the manufacturing network at the forefront of smart factory innovation
* Design scalable mechanisms and intelligent automation that eliminate manual effort in production reporting, defect tracking, and capacity planning, creating operational leverage as the network grows
* Translate complex operational data into compelling strategic narratives for executive leadership, shaping investment priorities and manufacturing direction through clear, insight driven recommendations
* Lead digital transformation across manufacturing operations, driving manufacturing execution system modernization, automated test equipment upgrades, and smart factory capabilities that deliver measurable competitive advantage


 A day in the life
   

  

 As the Principal Tech Ops Engineer, no two days look the same but the mission is constant: scale enterprise hardware manufacturing globally. You spend your time defining multi year capacity strategies, onboarding new manufacturing partners, and driving technology transitions such as enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production. You lead manufacturing readiness reviews for new product introductions, build business cases for facility expansions, and architect digital transformation programs across the supplier ecosystem. You own the operational excellence framework, establishing metrics and scalable mechanisms that replicate across sites worldwide. You partner with hardware engineering, supply chain, and executive leadership to shape investment priorities, mitigate operational risks, and deliver next generation manufacturing capabilities. You develop future leaders, influence long term vendor strategies, and drive automation and Industry 4\.0 adoption that positions the manufacturing network for sustained growth at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, project engineering in a manufacturing environment experience
* Knowledge of operating systems, hardware, storage, network, security, database administration and cloud infrastructure, experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing, or experience in material handling equipment (MHE)
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles/ Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements, communicating results to senior leadership in building financial and operational reports
* Degree or equivalent in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field. Experience in problem solving and data analytics


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration
* Experience coordinating complex products with stringent technical requirements, development cycles and schedules
* Knowledge of Six Sigma tools, Lean techniques, PMP or similar standards preferred

**Overview**
 Mastercard is seeking a highly influential Principal Data Platform Architect to help define and deliver the next generation of enterprise data capabilities.
   

  

 This role will lead the design and evolution of strategic platforms that simplify how external data is securely exchanged with Mastercard and enable product teams, consultants, and analysts to more easily discover, access, and leverage enterprise data. The successful candidate will help transform complex, fragmented data processes into scalable, self\-service experiences that accelerate innovation and unlock greater value from Mastercard's data assets.

 Define Enterprise Data Platform Strategy
   

  

 Drive the technical vision and architecture for enterprise data onboarding, exchange, discovery, and consumption capabilities.
   

  

 Develop roadmaps that balance immediate business needs with long\-term platform scalability and reuse.

 Enable Frictionless Data Exchange
   

  

 Design capabilities that streamline the secure onboarding, sharing, and management of external data.
   

  

 Establish reusable patterns for data integration, governance, observability, lineage, and compliance.
   

  

 Reduce reliance on bespoke solutions through automation and self\-service capabilities.
   

  

 Democratize Access to Data
   

  

 Create intuitive ways for product teams, consultants, analysts, and AI\-powered solutions to discover and utilize trusted enterprise data.
   

  

 Enable self\-service analytics and rapid solution development without requiring deep technical expertise.
   

  

 Partner with governance and security teams to balance accessibility with appropriate controls.

 Establish engineering standards, best practices, and reference architectures.
   

  

 Mentor engineers and architects across the organization.
   

  

 Partner Across the Business
   

  

 Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Security, and business stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.
   

  

 Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
   

  

 Build alignment around platform investments and strategic priorities.
   

  

**All About You**
 Extensive experience architecting and building large\-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise integration solutions across both on\-premises and cloud environments, leveraging technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, NiFi, Hadoop/Cloudera, Databricks, and modern cloud\-native data services.
   

  

 Deep expertise in data engineering, data architecture, data integration, and cloud\-native platforms.
   

  

 Experience building reusable platforms that serve multiple products, teams, or business domains.
   

  

 Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, security, metadata, and data quality practices.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across organizations.
   

  

 Exceptional communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Proven track record of translating ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data ecosystems (Oracle, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.).
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Reliability \& Availability

title: Teradata Database Administrator (ATPL-teradata-database-administrator-/2026/09/1002)
description:
**Role – Teradata Database Administrator**
  

Experience: 5\+ yrs


This role is strictly focused on System\-Level Workload Management, Resource Governor Architecture, and TASM (Teradata Active System Management) Tuning.


It is not a SQL/Query\-level performance tuning or indexing role. The ideal candidate must possess deep expertise in controlling system concurrency, configuring Priority Scheduler dynamics, managing resource partitions, and enforcing enterprise SLA governance using Teradata Viewpoint / Workload Designer.


**Key Responsibilities**


TASM Ruleset Design \& Rule Architecture


* Understand the currently TASM Ruleset and Architecture with minimal supervision.
* Document the improvements required suitable for the current usage pattern on the systems.
* Architect, configure, test, deploy enterprise TASM rulesets using Teradata Workload Designer in Teradata Viewpoint.
* Design and implement System Throttles, Workload Throttles, and Query Arrival Rate Throttles to maintain system stability and prevent resource exhaustion (e.g., AMP Worker Thread / AWT depletion).
* Establish System Filters and Workload Filters to intercept and block rogue, unoptimized, or non\-compliant queries prior to execution.
* Define and maintain Workload Definitions (WDs) and Workload Groups to categorize inbound database sessions accurately based on user attributes, application, database, and statement criteria.
* Manage resource allocation across diverse workload tiers: Tactical, Service (interactive/BI), Batch/ETL, and Low/Idle/Dev priority workloads.
* Optimize Delay Queue dynamics to control concurrency spikes during peak business hours without causing downstream job timeouts or thread starvation.
* Balance system resources between concurrent operational reporting, ad\-hoc discovery, and heavy background data ingestion

**Operational Environments**


* Design dynamic Operational Environments (OpEnvs) and TASM States to adapt system rules automatically based on time\-of\-day, day\-of\-week, or business cycles (e.g., Nightly ETL vs. Daytime BI vs. Month\-End Processing).
* Configure System Events and Threshold Triggers (e.g., high CPU utilization, memory pressure, AWT starvation, high skew factors) to initiate automated, adaptive TASM rule shifts during system stress.
* Establish system state transitions that adjust throttles and priority weights dynamically when system health degrades.

**Workload Exception Handling \& Automated Mitigation**


* Design and implement Workload Exception criteria utilizing metrics such as CPU time, I/O limits, execution time, block time, and query skew.
* Configure automated exception actions, including Change Workload (WD demotion/promotion), Abort Query, Send Alert, and Log Only.
* Establish rules to demote runaway ad\-hoc queries out of high\-priority workloads into restricted resource pools automatically.

**Analytics, Telemetry, \& Continuous Improvement**


* Perform deep\-dive telemetric analysis on Database Query Log tables (DBQL: DBQLogTbl, DBQLSummaryTbl, DBQLOutlierTbl, DBQLStepTbl) focusing specifically on workload parameters: WDID, WDName, DelayTime, WDEvalOrder, WDOverride, and exception flags.
* Analyze ResUsage tables (ResUsageSPS, ResUsageSPMA, ResUsageSAMP) to monitor system partition usage, Priority Scheduler allocations, CPU/IO skew, and AWT consumption.
* Generate capacity and workload distribution reports for senior leadership, highlighting SLA compliance, delay queue wait times, and system utilization trends.
* Conduct regular workload profiling to identify misclassified workloads, unassigned sessions falling into default WDs, or unmanaged query floods.

**Technical Skills \& Qualifications**


Must\-Have Technical Expertise


* Core Tooling: Expert hands\-on proficiency with Teradata Viewpoint, Teradata Workload Designer, Teradata Active System Management (TASM), and Teradata Dynamic Workload Management (TDWM).
  

Architecture Knowledge: Deep understanding of Teradata System Architecture (AMPs, PE, AWTs, BYNET, Memory, I/O subsystems).
* System Metrics \& Logging: Mastery of Teradata system tables and logging engines (DBQL, ResUsage, TDWM tables/views) for analyzing workload behavior and delay queue bottlenecks.

  

**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**


* Experience managing workloads on Teradata Vantage (On\-Premises, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* Familiarity with Teradata Vantage Core / Cloud workload management differences vs. traditional on\-premises IntelliFlex systems.
* Scripting capability in Python, BASH, or Perl for automating DBQL/ResUsage workload reporting.
  

Experience migrating legacy TASM rulesets during/post system upgrades.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Consultant – Entra ID with AD Engineer\-(AD, Entra ID, Migrations)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4–7 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365 workloads. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in assessments, transitions, transformations, and migrations across hybrid and cloud identity environments, and will play a key role in advising clients while also executing technical delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and execute assessments of existing Active Directory, Entra ID, and M365 environments to identify gaps, risks, and modernization opportunities.
* Design and drive transition and transformation roadmaps for identity infrastructure (on\-prem AD to Entra ID, hybrid identity models).
* Plan and execute migrations of AD, Entra ID, and M365 workloads (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams) — including tenant\-to\-tenant migrations, domain consolidations, and hybrid setups.
* Provide hands\-on configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of AD DS, Azure AD Connect/Entra Connect, Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and hybrid identity synchronization.
* Work closely with client stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration strategy, and manage risk/rollback plans.
* Prepare technical documentation: assessment reports, architecture diagrams, migration runbooks, and transformation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (security, infrastructure, cloud) to ensure smooth delivery of projects.
* Stay current with Microsoft’s evolving identity and M365 ecosystem, and recommend best practices.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4–7 years of overall IT experience, with strong focus on Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), and M365 workloads.
* Proven, in\-depth hands\-on experience (not just theoretical) in:
* AD DS design, administration, and troubleshooting
* Entra ID / Azure AD (Connect/Entra Connect, Conditional Access, Identity Protection, RBAC)
* M365 workloads: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams
* Strong experience in assessment methodologies for identity and M365 environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading transition \& transformation projects (on\-prem to cloud, hybrid identity).
* Solid experience in migration projects — tenant\-to\-tenant, cross\-forest, domain consolidation, mailbox/data migrations.
* Good understanding of security and compliance considerations in identity/M365 environments.
* Strong client\-facing consulting skills — able to present findings, roadmaps, and recommendations confidently.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.


**Good to Have**
* Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS\-100/101, SC\-300, AZ\-800/801\).
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation of AD/Entra ID/M365 tasks.
* Exposure to third\-party migration tools (Quest, BitTitan, ShareGate, etc.)

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Engage and contribute to the Identity \& Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions
* Hands\-on experience on Azure Active Directory end\-to\-end implementation involving designing, implementation and customization
* Completed at least 0\-2 implementations
* Understanding and experience in different technology of Azure Active Directory, B2E, B2B and B2C
* Implementation experience in ADFS, Azure AD Connect, Azure AD Application Proxy, Conditional Access Policy, LDAP, Active Directory, Application Integrations for SSO and multi\-factor authentication
* Working experience in application integration with header\-based, SAML2\.0, OIDC, OAuth2\.0, WS\-Fed protocols
* Experienced in managing external identities and consumers in Azure AD B2B and B2C tenants
* Onboarding and offboarding applications on AAD B2B and B2C platforms
* Implementing custom policy using Identity Experience Framework for AAD B2C
* Experience in social login and 3rd party identity provider integration with AAD B2C
* Should have experience in assisting application team to use Microsoft libraries like MSAL
* Experience in integrating mobile application with AAD B2C
* Experience in integrating Azure AD with API management solution
* Should have knowledge on different component of Azure being used for Azure AD solution such as tenant creation, subscription, resource group.
* Should have knowledge in Identity management and Privileged Identity Management concepts
* Experienced in renew, update and troubleshoot certificate related issues
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as WAF, Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine\-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Experience and exposure of using/exposing REST APIs including Azure AD graph APIs.
* Hands\-on knowledge of any programming language Java or Python with good understanding of PowerShell.
* Should be familiar with application servers such as Tomcat and IIS.
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Deployment of web application \& basic troubleshooting of web application issues.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on\-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.
* Use case design, Solution Requirements Specification and mapping business requirements to technical requirements (Traceability Matrix).
* Involvement in a successful pursuit of a potential client by being part of the RFP response team.
* Architecture Design for overall IAM solution in customer environment (optimising the resources made available – servers and load sharing etc.).


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Azure Active Directory.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 2\-3 Years’ Work Experience


**Certification:**
* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in Azure Security Domain


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Sr. Operations Engineer
description:
**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here** 




 Transforming the insurance industry is ambitious, we know. That’s why at Applied Systems India Pvt Ltd., an Applied Systems company, we’re building a team that shows up every day ready to learn, willing to try new things, and driven to deliver innovative software and services that make us indispensable to our customers – all within a culture built on values that make us indispensable to each other too. With 40\+ years of experience in the Insurtech game, we’re not just redefining what’s achievable, we’re creating a place where amazing career moments are made possible.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 Applied Systems is seeking a Cloud \& Data Center Operations Engineer to support and maintain our hybrid infrastructure across cloud platforms and on\-premises data center environments. This role requires solid hands\-on experience with Azure, Google Cloud Platform, VMware vSphere, enterprise storage, and modern automation, monitoring, and security tooling.
 



 The ideal candidate is a self\-sufficient operator who can reliably execute day\-to\-day infrastructure work — patching, monitoring, automation scripting, VMware administration, and security vulnerability response — while collaborating effectively across engineering and operations teams. This is an individual contributor role focused on execution and continuous improvement.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Hybrid \& Colocation Infrastructure** 



* Support and maintain infrastructure across colocation facilities and cloud environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Windows Server administration, including patching, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.
* Administer VMware vSphere clusters, ESXi hosts, and vCenter — including VM provisioning, resource management, and day\-to\-day operational support.
* Manage enterprise storage systems including PURE Storage arrays: provisioning, performance monitoring, and snapshot lifecycle management.
* Perform hardware and software troubleshooting across physical and virtualized environments.



**Cloud \& Platform Operations** 



* Administer and support workloads in Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
* Manage cloud resources including virtual machines, storage, networking, and platform services.
* Perform system upgrades, patching, and backup operations across cloud and on\-premises environments.
* Ensure compliance with internal IT policies and relevant industry standards.
* Support identity and access management in Azure Active Directory and related cloud services.



**Patch Management \& Security Vulnerability Response** 



* Execute and maintain patch management processes across Windows server environments using Ansible, PatchMyPC, WSUS, or equivalent tooling.
* Manage patching cadences for production, test, and ancillary environments — coordinating maintenance windows and pre/post\-patch validation.
* Respond to security vulnerability findings from tools such as Crowdstrike or Qualys — triaging, scheduling, and remediating identified exposures.
* Maintain exclusion and deferral tracking for systems that cannot be patched on standard cadence; escalate unresolved exposures per InfoSec policy.
* Support out\-of\-band and zero\-day patch response processes as directed by security leadership.



**Automation \& Configuration Management** 



* Build and maintain automation workflows using Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or Bash to reduce manual operational effort.
* Support Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform or ARM templates for repeatable environment provisioning.
* Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation and deployment tasks.
* Assist with configuration and secret management using HashiCorp Vault or equivalent tooling.
* Identify repetitive operational tasks and implement scripted or automated solutions.



**Monitoring, Observability \& Incident Response** 



* Monitor system performance, availability, and capacity across cloud and on\-premises environments using Datadog, Signoz, or equivalent platforms.
* Configure and maintain observability dashboards and alerting pipelines using open Telemetry, Datadog, or Signoz.
* Respond to alerts and incidents in a timely manner; perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Identify trends and proactively address performance or capacity issues before they impact operations.
* Support incident management processes and contribute to post\-incident reviews and documentation.



**Security, Compliance \& Governance** 



* Collaborate with the security team to maintain system integrity, access controls, and compliance posture.
* Support governance and audit requirements including GDPR, ISO 27001, and internal controls.
* Assist with identity and access management tasks including Okta and Azure AD administration.
* Contribute to security hardening activities and compliance remediation efforts as directed.



**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience** 



* Support and participate in disaster recovery testing and business continuity procedures.
* Maintain snapshot\-based recovery configurations and cross\-site replication for critical workloads.
* Follow and contribute to documented DR runbooks; identify gaps and suggest improvements.



**Collaboration \& Documentation** 



* Work effectively with development, cloud engineering, IT support, and operations teams to support system integration and service delivery.
* Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, and procedural guides.
* Communicate clearly on system status, incident updates, and project progress across teams.
* Participate in team standups, planning, and retrospectives — contributing operational insights to improve team processes.



  





**We’re Excited to Learn More About You** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\-7 years of experience in IT systems administration, cloud operations, or data center engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Windows Server administration, including patching, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter — VM administration, resource pools, and basic cluster operations.
* Working knowledge of Azure administration — virtual machines, networking, storage, Azure AD, and core platform services.
* Experience with patch management tooling such as Ansible, SCCM, or WSUS in a production environment.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language: PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Familiarity with monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Signoz, SolarWinds, or equivalent.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort by applying automation and AI‑driven solutions to operational workflows.
* Understanding of security vulnerability management — scanning, triage, and remediation workflows.
* Solid troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear documentation and runbooks.



  





**You may have other skills, including** 



* Experience with Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, networking, and IAM.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Windows Server administration, including patching, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or ARM templates.
* Experience with Ansible for configuration management and patching automation.
* Exposure to observability tooling — Open Telemetry, Datadog, or Signoz.
* Familiarity with enterprise storage platforms such as PURE Storage, including snapshot and replication management.
* Experience with Hashi Corp Vault or equivalent secret management solutions.
* Exposure to GitLab CI/CD for infrastructure automation workflows.
* Familiarity with Okta or Azure Active Directory for identity and access management.
* Experience with low\-code automation tools such as Power Automate or Tines.
* Relevant certifications: AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, Google Cloud Associate, or Ansible equivalent are a plus.



  





**When You Join Team Applied, You Can Expect:** 




**A culture that values who you are** 
 and recognizes that you aren’t just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day.
 



**We flex our time together** 
 , collaborating remotely and in\-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them.
 



  





**Learn more about the people behind our products at** 
 –
 


* LinkedIn Page Applied Systems India
* https://www1\.appliedsystems.com/en\-us/about\-us/jobs/



  





**Your Security Matters:** 




 Our candidates’ personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At Applied, we proactively protect your personal information and only communicate with candidates via a secure@appliedsystems.com email or through our official career’s portal.
 



  





**EEO Statement** 




 Applied Systems is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diversity and Inclusion is a business imperative and is a part of building our brand and reputation. At Applied, we don’t discriminate, and we are committed to recruit, develop, retain, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

title: Office IT Administrator
description:
**Job Title: Office IT Administrator**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Office IT Administrator with 5–6 years of hands\-on experience to own the day\-to\-day operation of the IT infrastructure supporting a corporate office of 700–1,000 employees. The successful candidate will be responsible for enterprise network administration — with strong, demonstrable expertise in Cisco and NETGEAR switch configuration — as well as server administration, mail system configuration and administration, information security, and end\-user support. This role requires an independent, service\-oriented professional capable of maintaining high availability across a large, business\-critical environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, business applications, and the corporate LAN/WLAN serving 400–500 users
* Administer Active Directory, including user accounts, group policy, permissions, and role\-based access control across all office users
* Administer physical and virtual servers (Windows Server / Linux), monitor system performance and capacity, and resolve incidents within agreed service levels
* Provide first\- and second\-line technical support to employees across desktops, laptops, mobile devices, email, VPN, and printing, and manage escalation and ticket queues
* Configure, administer, and troubleshoot Cisco and NETGEAR managed switches, including VLANs, trunking, inter\-VLAN routing, port security, link aggregation, QoS, and IOS/firmware upgrades
* Own backup, restoration, and disaster\-recovery processes, and periodically test recovery to verify data integrity
* Manage patching, software deployment, endpoint protection, and enforcement of IT security policies
* Configure and administer corporate mail systems (Microsoft 365 / Exchange), including mailbox provisioning, distribution groups, SMTP relay, mail routing, and SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records
* Manage vendors, ISPs, and AMC partners for procurement, licensing renewals, and escalated issue resolution
* Maintain network diagrams, IT documentation, SOPs, and a complete hardware and software asset inventory

**Required Skills:**

* Proven expertise in Cisco switch configuration (IOS CLI, VLANs, trunking, STP, port security, stacking)
* Hands\-on experience configuring and managing NETGEAR managed switches and access points
* Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, and structured cabling
* Solid administration experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and DNS/DHCP services
* Practical experience with mail server configuration and administration (Microsoft 365 / Exchange), including mail flow, security, and anti\-spam controls
* Working knowledge of enterprise firewalls (Sophos, Fortinet, or equivalent) and virtualization (VMware / Hyper\-V)
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder\-coordination skills

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field
* 5–6 years of progressive experience in IT administration, including direct responsibility for an office environment of 700–1,000 users
* Certifications (preferred):
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) — or Cisco CCNP Enterprise for senior candidates
* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate / Messaging Administrator Associate
* CompTIA Network\+ and CompTIA Security\+
* ITIL 4 Foundation (IT service management)
* VMware VCP\-DCV or Microsoft Hyper\-V certification (virtualization)
* Fortinet NSE 4 or Sophos Certified Engineer (firewall administration)

**Additional Requirements (Optional):**

* Experience with CCTV, access control, or AV systems
* Knowledge of backup solutions and disaster recovery
* Ability to support multiple sites and remote users, and to work outside standard hours for planned maintenance windows

 Experience: 6\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: India, Bengaluru, Karnataka, NCR, Telangana, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Chennai
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **SAP HANA Database Administrator** 
 to manage, maintain, monitor, and support SAP HANA database environments across production and non\-production landscapes. The role requires strong expertise in
 **SAP HANA administration, troubleshooting, backup and recovery, performance management, installation, upgrades, and production support** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing critical database environments, resolving complex technical incidents, supporting maintenance activities, and collaborating with global teams to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of HANA systems.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Administer and support SAP HANA databases across production and non\-production environments
* Perform HANA installation, configuration, instance administration, patching, upgrades, and maintenance activities
* Manage HANA 2\.0 MDC and Non\-MDC environments
* Monitor database health, system alerts, availability, resource utilisation, and overall system performance
* Troubleshoot database issues using HANA administration tools, HANA Studio, logs, traces, and OS\-level commands
* Manage HANA backup, restore, recovery, and point\-in\-time recovery activities
* Work with Backint and traditional backup methods and ensure backup processes are reliable and recoverable
* Perform database restart, recovery, and troubleshooting activities during planned and unplanned events
* Monitor and troubleshoot CPU, memory, storage, and database performance issues
* Perform HANA performance tuning and analyse system behaviour to identify bottlenecks
* Manage HANA users, licenses, audit logs, parameters, traces, and related administration activities
* Handle P1/P2 incidents, production outages, and critical database issues within defined service levels
* Perform root\-cause analysis and document corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues
* Manage technical incidents, service requests, change requests, and problem\-management activities
* Support High Availability, Disaster Recovery, migration, and infrastructure\-related activities where required
* Coordinate with infrastructure, SAP, application, security, and other technical teams to resolve cross\-functional issues
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting knowledge articles
* Participate in knowledge\-transfer sessions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
* Support global shift operations and take shift lead responsibilities when required
* Follow established security, compliance, change\-management, and operational procedures


 What Makes You a Great Fit

* Proven experience with HANA 2\.0 MDC and Non\-MDC environments
* Strong hands\-on experience with HANA installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, and instance administration
* Strong knowledge of backup, restore, recovery, and point\-in\-time recovery
* Experience with Backint and traditional HANA backup methods
* Strong troubleshooting skills using HANA Studio, database tools, logs, traces, and Linux/OS\-level commands
* Good understanding of HANA monitoring, alerts, system health checks, and operational support
* Strong knowledge of HANA performance tuning, including CPU and memory troubleshooting
* Experience managing HANA users, licenses, audit logs, parameters, and trace configurations
* Basic to good knowledge of Linux operating systems
* Proven experience handling P1/P2 incidents, production outages, and critical database issues
* Understanding of High Availability and Disaster Recovery concepts is an advantage
* Experience supporting technical migrations and database maintenance activities is desirable
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform effective root\-cause analysis
* Excellent communication and customer\-handling skills
* Ability to work effectively with global, cross\-functional, and distributed technical teams
* Strong documentation, knowledge\-transfer, and operational discipline
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and perform effectively in shift\-based production support environments

title: PIM/PAM Engineer @ Mumbai
description:
The L2 PIM/PAM Engineer is responsible for day\-to\-day administration, onboarding, and incident troubleshooting across enterprise Privileged Access Management platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Microsoft Entra PIM). In addition to operational maintenance, this role actively validates, audits, and assesses technical controls to ensure privileged accounts adhere to strict zero\-trust and least\-privilege standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Implementation \& Support (L2 Operations)** 



* Handle Day\-2 operations, ticket escalations, and incident resolution for PAM components (Safe management, account onboarding, CPM/PSM failures, and policy errors).
* Onboard target systems (Windows, Linux, databases, network devices, and cloud infrastructure) into PAM vaults with automated credential rotation.
* Manage Just\-In\-Time (JIT) access requests, time\-bound approvals, and role\-activation workflows in Microsoft Entra PIM and PAM solutions.
* Monitor health checks for core PAM services (Vaults, Proxies, Discovery agents, Session Recording servers) and coordinate with vendor support or L3 teams for complex outages.
* Configure, test, and maintain custom plugins, CPM platform management policies, and connection components.



**Technical Controls Assessment \& Validation** 



* Conduct routine technical assessments to verify that credential auto\-rotation, check\-in/check\-out policies, and password complexity controls function across all onboarded targets.
* Validate that Privileged Session Monitoring (PSM) and keylogging controls capture and index administrative sessions without bypassing.
* Audit Entra PIM policies: verify mandatory MFA triggers, justification requirements, approval chains, and maximum activation duration limits.
* Perform discovery scans to identify unmanaged privileged accounts, service accounts, and shadow admins across Active Directory, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Generate compliance evidence and remediate gaps aligned with audit standards (CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, SOC 2\).



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Core Platforms:** 
 Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise PAM tool (CyberArk PAS/Privilege Cloud, BeyondTrust Password Safe, Delinea/Thycotic) and Cloud PIM (Microsoft Entra ID PIM).
* **Operating Systems \& Networking:** 
 Working knowledge of Windows Server (Active Directory, Kerberos, GPOs), Linux/Unix (SSH, PAM modules, sudoers), and networking fundamentals (firewall ports, DNS, RDP, SSH).
* **Scripting:** 
 Basic PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting skills to assist with automated onboarding, discovery parsing, and API calls.
* **Security Principles:** 
 Solid understanding of Least Privilege, Zero Trust, MFA, Session Isolation, and Break\-Glass procedures.



**Preferred Certifications** 



* CyberArk Defender (PAM\-DEF) or Sentry (PAM\-SEN)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* CompTIA Security\+ or SSCP

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
**Company Description**  

Take a seat on the Xplor rocketship and join us as a Database Administrator to help people succeed across the world.  

We’re a global team of builders, listeners and problem\-solvers who are relentlessly focused on making life simple, so our customers can get back to growing their business, engaging consumers and doing what they love.

 **Job Description** **The Opportunity**


Embedded Payments runs a group of payments platforms serving customers in the UK, Japan, Australia and New Zealand. Our platforms process continuously, and the businesses on them depend on transactional databases that stay fast as volumes grow, and on overnight data warehouse loads landing on time. The estate is Microsoft SQL Server throughout, across a range of hosting models: Microsoft AVS, Azure elastic pool and managed instance, and AWS.


The team is three DBAs, one in the UK and two in Pune, working a rostered pattern that extends live database coverage across the UK, Japan and ANZ business days. A team of that size against an estate of that reach means genuine ownership — the work is visible, and the people doing it shape the technical direction.


The appointment is senior. The role contributes to the maintenance and health standard for the estate and delivers it across platforms and hosting models, holds database escalation for live payments systems, and brings depth of experience to the team. For part of every shift it operates independently. It is a hands\-on operate\-and\-improve position, technical throughout, without people\-management responsibility.

**What You'll Do**


Production database administration

* Administering the SQL Server estate across the four in\-scope platforms and their hosting models.
* Running backup and restore against defined recovery objectives, including regular restore testing rather than assumed recoverability.
* Operating availability and replication configurations, and monitoring their health daily.
* Managing database security to a least\-privilege model: access provisioning and review, permissions, auditing on production systems.

**Proactive maintenance and health**

* Running and extending scheduled maintenance across the estate — index and statistics upkeep, integrity checks, health baselines — automated and measured rather than run by hand.
* Building the baseline picture of what normal looks like for each platform, so degradation is visible before it becomes an incident.
* Maintaining monitoring and alerting coverage, and tuning alert thresholds so what fires is worth acting on.
* Tracking database growth and capacity, and raising where headroom is running out ahead of it biting.

**Performance**

* Investigating and resolving performance problems: execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, statistics, blocking and deadlocks, wait statistics.
* Tuning problem queries, and taking the ones needing a code change back to the development teams with the evidence.
* Supporting the overnight data warehouse loads the reporting estate depends on, including diagnosis when a load runs long or fails.

**Incident response, escalation and handover**

* Acting as database escalation for production incidents raised by the 24/7 application support team.
* Owning incidents through to root cause and closing them out with a fix, rather than restoring service and moving on.
* Running the daily handover with the other Pune resource, so work in progress, open incidents and overnight events carry across the shift boundary without loss.

**Standards, documentation and automation**

* Writing and maintaining runbooks, to the standard where another team member can follow them unaided during cover.
* Automating recurring work with T\-SQL and PowerShell so it runs to schedule and reports on itself.
* Using AI tooling in daily work for diagnostics, scripting and documentation, with output held to the same standard as anything written by hand.

  

**Qualifications** **What You'll Bring**

**Essential**

* Extensive production experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in business\-critical environments, at a level where a production estate has been held as an owner rather than worked on under supervision.
* Backup, restore and recovery against defined recovery objectives, including a record of tested restores rather than only configured backups.
* Deep performance troubleshooting: execution plans, indexing strategy, statistics, blocking, deadlocks, wait statistics, and knowing which of those a given symptom points to.
* High availability in production — Always On availability groups, clustering, log shipping or replication — configured and operated, not merely inherited.
* Maintenance at estate scale: index and statistics upkeep and integrity checking, automated across many instances rather than server by server.
* Strong T\-SQL, and scripting for automation in PowerShell or equivalent.
* SQL Server across more than one hosting model — Azure, AWS, or virtualised on\-premises — and an understanding of what changes between them.
* Ownership of production incidents under time pressure, with the discipline to follow through to root cause and to say what happened afterwards.
* Database security to a least\-privilege model: access design and review, permissions, auditing on production systems.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the written communication distributed shift work depends on: handovers, incident notes, runbooks.
* Willingness to work the rostered shift pattern, the four\-weekly rotation and the on\-call commitment described above.

**Desirable**

* Payments, fintech or another regulated, high\-volume transactional environment.
* Exposure to, or previous working experience in, a PCI\-DSS environment.
* SSIS or comparable ETL, and experience troubleshooting data warehouse load failures.
* Database monitoring tooling such as Redgate SQL Monitor, or a comparable estate\-wide product.
* Prior experience of shift\-based or follow\-the\-sun operational support.
* Migration and upgrade work — cross\-version, or on\-premises to cloud.
* Experience improving database practice in teams that do not report to you.

**Core Competencies**

**Production Discipline**


Treats production with appropriate care — changes are planned, tested and reversible, and the risky ones are raised before they are made.

**Diagnostic Depth**


Works a problem to its cause rather than stopping at the symptom that restored service.

**Preventive Mindset**


Sees unrun maintenance and missing baselines as work to be done, not background noise.

**Escalation Judgement**


Knows what warrants a call\-out, what waits for the next shift, and who to pull in.

**Independent Operation**


Works effectively with no one else from the team online for part of every shift.

**AI Fluency**


Uses AI tooling routinely for diagnostics, scripting and documentation.

 **Additional Information** **Shift, On\-Call and Working Pattern**


This is a shift\-based role. The core pattern is set out below so it can be assessed before applying.

* Shifts — two nine\-hour Pune shifts, Early 07:00–16:00 IST and Late 14:00–23:00 IST.
* Rotation — the two shifts rotate on a four\-weekly cycle.
* On\-call — the role takes part in an on\-call rotation that rotates with the shift, including a share of weekend cover and a monthly Sunday patching window.
* Working arrangements — the Early shift is standard hybrid, a mixture of in\-office and remote working; the Late shift is worked remotely.

description:
Job Title: Major Incident Manager Specialist
   

  

 Req ID: 61090
   

  

 Job Function: Engineering

 Posting End Date: 17/09/2026

**Hiring Manager: Shahnawaz Salam**
**Level:D**
**Major Incident Manager Specialist: 61090**
**About the role:**
 The Major Incident Manager plays a pivotal role within International Managed Services (IMS), acting as a critical safeguard for the organization’s most important customer contracts and services. Operating as part of a highly experienced team, this role ensures that major incidents are responded to swiftly, effectively, and with the right level of control to minimize business disruption.
   

  

 Incidents within the IMS estate can have global impact, attracting attention not only internally but also externally—from the media, public sector bodies, and major corporate customers. In such high\-profile situations, the Major Incident Manager serves as the central point of coordination, ensuring that technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders are aligned and focused on rapid service restoration.
   

  

 This role is essential in maintaining trust at the highest levels, requiring direct engagement with senior stakeholders both within the organization and across customer leadership teams. Through clear communication, decisive leadership, and expert knowledge of processes and services, the Major Incident Manager helps protect the organization’s reputation during critical moments.
   

  

 As the final line of defence for International Managed Services, the role carries significant commercial responsibility. It directly influences customer satisfaction, contract retention, and key performance metrics such as Net Promoter Score (NPS). By ensuring effective incident resolution and driving continuous improvement, the Major Incident Manager not only mitigates immediate risks but also strengthens long\-term service resilience and customer confidence.
   

  

**Role Accountabilities**
* Take full accountability for managing Major Incidents on a 24x7 basis, lead bridge calls and provide command
* Lead and deliver clear, timely communication to stakeholders, including senior leadership up to executive/CEO level.
* Act as the central point of contact between business stakeholders and technical resolver groups.
* Ensure effective collaboration across different business units to maintain service continuity and protect organizational reputation.
* Manage crisis situations including security incidents, large\-scale outages, and other emergency events.
* Engage all necessary technical specialists and vendors to restore mission critical services.
* Responsible to create and deliver legally cleared commercially sensitive Post Incident Reviews ensuring the protection of the BT Brand and avoiding eventual financial implications following court proceedings initiated by customers.
* Represents BT Global during pan\-BT, security, civil, TARG, NEAT, customer and industrial action emergencies, serving as an interface between executive stakeholders and resolver teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in incident management processes and service resilience.


**Skills and experiences needed:**
* Stakeholder management: Strong ability to collaborate with senior internal stakeholders and engage effectively with customer executives (e.g., CIO/CEO level) during major incidents, ensuring clear, confident, and business\-focused communication..
* Leadership capability: able to manage an operation during a crisis situation with high profile mission critical customers.
* ITIL Expertise: Good to expert\-level understanding of ITIL frameworks, particularly Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, with the ability to apply best practices in real\-time scenarios
* Problem management: Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex incidents, understand root causes, and apply structured methodologies to drive effective resolution and prevention.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to identify trends and improvement opportunities following major incidents, driving process simplification, service resilience, and prevention of recurring issues.
* IT processes \& procedures: specialist knowledge and understanding required


**Technical skills:** 
 Solid understanding of BT IT infrastructure, products, and platforms, including how systems interact, enabling effective coordination with technical teams and informed decision\-making during incidents.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Network Engineering Specialist undertakes engineering activities that contributes towards the delivery of client technical requirements, deploying optimal networking and connectivity solutions that enable clients and the enterprise to achieve their operational and business goals.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Undertakes routine daily activities and is accountable for system design, build, testing, validation, maintenance, and ongoing support of all network infrastructure components.
* Undertakes the implementation of new and enhanced network technology that aligns to customers' strategic direction for enterprise and remote site connectivity.
* Maintains standards for global network infrastructure, including wireless, LAN and SD\-WAN networks and connectivity.
* Manages the installation, testing, and setup of new network hardware both physical and virtual (firewalls, routers, switching, monitoring) hardware and software.
* Executes engineering efforts to ensue currency and supportability of networking technology.
* Participates in technology lifecycle planning, including contributing to the development of the technology roadmaps and Network Health Assessments.
* Delivers the required documentation, knowledge transfer and training to successfully land new solutions into the support organisation.
* Delivers support for clients with data protection and overarching cloud capabilities.
* Drives the implementation of core and cloud infrastructure security to manage risks and exposure.
* Provides support for problem escalations from the global network support organisation.
* Drives impact with a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within the Network Engineering team and other related teams.
* Mentors other Engineering professionals, helping to improve the team's abilities by acting as a technical resource.
* Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in Network Engineering.


**Essential Skills / Experience**
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
**Our Package**
 At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: Site GSI Leader
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Site GSI Leader in Sabarmati we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your industrial data expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward\-thinking teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless implementation and upkeep of industrial Master Data across various systems, directly impacting the efficiency and accuracy of our operations. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as Process/Manufacturing Engineers, the Industrial team, and Sourcing and Supply Chain departments), coordinate data migration efforts, and support system updates and training for users.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of defining and maintaining critical data, such as Bills of Materials (BoMs), Process Routings, and Configuration Management data, but also ensure the consistency of these data across multiple systems.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Acting as the Key User for Industrial Information System Tools (e.g., ERP, SES)
* Performing system tests before implementation or updates
* Leading data migration and rework efforts
* Training and supporting users on system functionalities
* Defining data work plans and interfacing with project industrialization for BoM requirements
* Managing and updating the implementation of data such as M\-BoM, P\-BoM, Routings, Work Centers, and Tooling
* Ensuring the accuracy and consistency of data across systems through audits and continuous improvement
* Handling the impacts of engineering and process changes in the systems
* Building and maintaining up\-to\-date Industrial ERP data, including maintenance strategies and task lists


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* A technical education background
* Proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Experience in manufacturing engineering, ideally with 6\+ years in railway services
* Basic knowledge of engineering design and supply chain processes
* Strong experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP), particularly for managing Bills of Materials, Routings, and Configuration Management
* Familiarity with IS common tools
* Excellent organizational and logical thinking skills
* Strong communication abilities and a team\-oriented mindset
* Self\-motivation and a commitment to delivering results


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with cutting\-edge industrial information systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of sustainable mobility
* Utilise our inclusive and dynamic working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership or specialized roles within Alstom
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.
