We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


**The Team**
============


Public Cloud (Prisma) \- As the leader of the Public Cloud Security team, you will be responsible for building products that protect data, workloads, and infrastructure for some of the largest enterprise customers in the world. We help the customers in their transitional journey to the cloud by ensuring they have the best\-in\-class protection. The cloud market has been growing at a rapid rate for the last few years. As more and more enterprises use public cloud, there is an insatiable demand for securing workloads in the public cloud. With our recent acquisition of Prisma Public Cloud, formerly RedLock™, and Evident.io, Palo Alto Networks is the reigning market leader.


**Job Summary**
===============


Join our team building a cutting\-edge multi\-tenanted GenAI Security Platform that helps organizations validate and secure their AI systems against adversarial attacks.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


* Design and implement high\-performance REST APIs with enterprise\-grade multi\-tenant isolation and strict security boundaries.
* Work on distributed systems architecture handling high\-throughput workloads with mission\-critical uptime requirements.
* Build responsive dashboards and administrative interfaces for platform management, data visualisation, and system configuration.
* Integrate multiple LLM providers, implement semantic search capabilities, and build intelligent agent workflows.
* Architect complex, multi\-step AI evaluation pipelines for asynchronous job execution and large\-scale data processing.
* Design and implement database schemas with proper indexing, query optimisation, and data isolation strategies.
* Build and maintain scalable micro\-services with async/await patterns and type\-safe code.
* Develop data\-intensive UIs with real\-time updates, complex state management, and intuitive user experiences.
* Deploy and manage containerised applications on Kubernetes with comprehensive observability.
* Write thorough tests (frontend and backend) and maintain high code quality standards with automated tooling.
* Collaborate on architecture decisions and mentor team members on best practices.
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* Proven experience building and scaling multi\-tenant SaaS platforms with strict data isolation.
* Strong knowledge of API design, RESTful principles, and OpenAPI specifications.
* Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Svelte) with TypeScript.
* Experience building data\-intensive dashboards with complex visualisations and real\-time data.
* Strong CSS/styling skills and responsive design principles.
* Demonstrated experience working with production AI/ML systems at scale.
* Practical experience integrating LLM APIs and managing inference at scale.
* Understanding of LLM operational challenges: rate limiting, cost optimisation, latency management, fallback strategies.
* Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, MCP, or similar).
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, semantic search, and vector databases.
* Hands\-on experience with one of the major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
* Strong Kubernetes and Docker skills with production deployment experience at scale.
* Experience with workflow orchestration engines (Airflow, Prefect, Temporal, Dagster, or similar).
* Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of distributed systems, networking, load balancing, and service mesh architectures.
**Preferred Qualifications**
============================


* Familiarity with AI safety, red teaming, or adversarial ML concepts.
* Prior experience in cybersecurity, AppSec, or security research.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, API security best practices, RBAC, and IAM.
* Background in observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, DataDog, or similar).
* Experience with distributed task queues, message brokers, and resilience patterns.
**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.


Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

As a **Senior Engineer** within our Infrastructure Team, you will play a key role in delivering complex **Stormwater and Drainage Infrastructure projects** and maintaining high standards of quality. title: Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway
description:
**Who We Are**



Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all\-in\-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross\-border, and business management tools each month.



As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point\-of\-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.


**Why India**



Powering that scale takes engineering talent well beyond our home markets \- which is where India comes in. India is our second\-largest team by headcount, with close to 150 people, and it continues to grow. The team here is one of our strongest, and it has become central to how we build and run our platform globally, with world class team members joining us from Tide, Uber, Flipkat, Amazon, GoTo/Gojek, Paytm, Airtel Payments, Visa, BharatPe, MoneyView, and many others.



So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in India.


**About The Role**



Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it \- APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi\-currency, multi\-market support.



The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non\-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer\-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:


* Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
* Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
* Own the developer experience end\-to\-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
* Drive platform evolution towards multi\-currency and international scalability.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
* Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
* Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.


**Who You Are**


* Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on, production\-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
* At least 5 years of experience managing managers \- leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
* Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
* Deep knowledge of API\-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
* Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
* Strong backend engineering skills in high\-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
* Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi\-currency payment platform is a strong plus.


**Cultural Alignment**



As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.


* Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
* Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade\-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
* Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
* Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
* Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
* No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
* Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
* Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.


**What To Expect In The Hiring Process**


* A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
* A Panel interview session with two of our VPs of Engineering
* A Technical Assessment with our Group CTO / Co\-founder
* A Behavioral and technical interview with our Group CEO / Founder
* Technical Workshop with our Group CTO / Co\-founder


**Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with**


* Java (latest versions)
* Spring and Spring Boot
* Docker and Kubernetes
* PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elastic search
* Microservices architecture on AWS


**What we can offer you**


* Own the payments infrastructure that thousands of businesses and developers build on, at a company processing hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually.
* Work in a fast\-paced, technically demanding environment at the core of how money moves in high\-growth markets.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Security Engineer I, AWS Security Incident Response
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Security Incident Response is looking for technical Security Engineers that are passionate about learning new concepts and work well within a team environment to keep customers secure. We value engineers that can work through ambiguity to identify suspicious activity, lead security response, and can explain technical security concepts to non\-technical audiences.  

  

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  

  

AWS Services provides developers and small to large businesses access to the horizontally scalable state of the art cloud infrastructure like S3, EC2, AMI, Cloud Front and Simple DB, that powers Amazon.com. Developers can build any type of business on AWS Platform and scale their application with growing business needs. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to threat findings that indicate unauthorized activity has occurred
* Identify, evaluate and communicate security threats, risks and vulnerabilities, and propose recommended remediation for security issues.
* Contribute to the development of security automation and security posture improvements.
* Track and report on the effectiveness of AWS detective controls such as Amazon GuardDuty and partner products such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Wiz Defend
* Develop processes and policies to increase security response effectiveness.
* On\-call support: This role requires periodic on\-call responsibilities including weekends.

  

A day in the life  

As a Security Engineer in AWS Security Incident Response, your responsibilities include monitoring networks and systems for potential threats, performing triage for security alerts, documenting suspicious activity, and reporting issues so they can be adequately handled. You will work alongside our security engineers and partner teams to perform daily threat detection and incident response, using the full capability of AWS technologies and services to detect and mitigate cyber threats at a massive scale and help protect AWS Customers. You should also enjoy learning about the most up\-to\-date new technologies and procedures to protect information systems and data.  

  

About the team  

AWS Security Incident Response provides 24/7 threat monitoring, investigation, and response across for customer’s AWS environments. The service enhances existing security capabilities by providing security monitoring for all native AWS services and supports vendor agnostic detective and protective controls to provide holistic security controls for customers. This is done by leveraging data on common attack techniques to enhance detective controls and incident response, then building auto\-remediation capabilities to minimize disruption to customer workloads. title: Network Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you bring experience and autonomy to own end\-to\-end capacity restoration for assigned network segments. You drive complex troubleshooting across multiple failure domains, mentor engineers, define and improve operational processes, and partner with engineering teams to address systemic resilience gaps. You apply correct technologies and best practices to complex problems, and your scope of influence spans the full team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Execution**
* Own capacity restoration outcomes for assigned network segments, driving TTR reduction and backlog elimination.
* Lead complex, multi\-party troubleshooting for link and device failures spanning carriers, colocations, and internal teams.
* Participate in war rooms for critical events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


**Process And Operations Improvement**
* Define and improve operational processes and runbooks for restoration workflows.
* Analyze restoration metrics (TTR, backlog depth, network health score impact) to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Drive vendor accountability for carrier and colocation\-related restoration delays.


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Partner with Topology Engineering, Capacity Engineering, and fabric engineering teams to address systemic issues.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.


**Mentorship And Development**
* Mentor and develop Network Engineers, providing technical guidance and review.
* Contribute to hiring loops and technical assessments.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Lead complex capacity restoration events involving multiple network layers and cross\-region links.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and develop remediation plans for recurring failures.
* Improve operational processes, runbooks, and escalation procedures based on observed patterns.
* Mentor engineers and conduct knowledge transfer sessions.
* Coordinate with engineering teams on platform readiness and design validation.
* Drive vendor and carrier accountability for restoration delays.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.
* Participate in war rooms for major events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amaze Con (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience driving improvement programs in the operations, engineering and support fields
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
* 5\+ years of computer networking experience
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience with BGP, OSPF, or IS\-IS in large\-scale network environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in managing critical operational processes, with SLA responsibility
* Experience mentoring or training the engineering community on complex technical issues
* 1\+ years of fiber handling and fiber installation processes experience, or experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment \& troubleshooting methodologies
* CCNA or equivalent level networking certification, or Bachelor's degree
* Experience with network performance analysis (TCP tuning, ECMP, traffic engineering).
* Experience with carrier coordination and maintenance management.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are searching for an accomplished NOC (Network Operations Center) Team Lead and Technical Expert with over 10 years of hands\-on experience in leading NOC teams and managing complex IT environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in network, server, cloud, and application monitoring, combined with a proven track record in people management, team development, and operational excellence. This role requires a leader who can drive both strategic initiatives and day\-to\-day operations, ensuring optimal network performance and security while fostering a high\-performing team culture.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities
+ Lead and mentor the NOC team, leveraging extensive people management experience to develop talent, drive accountability, and promote continuous improvement.

+ Ensure that network issues are resolved within established SLAs.
+ Collaborate with other NOC Shift Leads and teams to address cross\-functional issues.
+ Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions as needed.
+ Ready to work in 24/7 operational model.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure management, cloud environment management, and network monitoring.
* Leadership: Proven experience in leading and mentoring a team of IT professionals.
* Technical Skills: In\-depth knowledge of IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, and network systems.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**

title: Senior IT Support Engineer
description:

We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top\-15 private equity firms.


Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.


Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.


We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

 **Job Description** **This Role**


Provides Level 2 IT support and technical administration across Microsoft 365, Intune, Cisco Meraki, and managed services environments, ensuring timely resolution of support requests, proactive system management, client satisfaction, operational efficiency, and adherence to service delivery standards.

**What You Will Do**

* You'll manage assigned support tickets, escalations, and project tasks through a dispatcher\-driven service model, providing timely issue resolution, remote support, root\-cause analysis, accurate documentation, knowledge base contributions, and detailed time recording to support service delivery and client billing requirements.
* You'll administer and support Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, SSPR, and Intune, while assisting with tenant migrations, environment buildouts, device management, application deployment, and automation using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
* You'll configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki networking solutions, including MX, MS, and MR devices, VLANs, firewall rules, DNS, NAT, VPN connectivity, domain management, and network remediation activities, escalating complex issues when appropriate.
* You'll support client onboarding, infrastructure deployments, and technology projects by providing remote, phone, email, and onsite technical support, clearly communicating complex technical information to non\-technical stakeholders, and contributing to the implementation and optimisation of the organisation's technology stack.
* You'll maintain strong operational discipline by proactively communicating workload status, collaborating with internal teams, monitoring alerts and system health, supporting security and compliance initiatives, and ensuring high\-quality service delivery across endpoint management, networking, cloud platforms, and managed services operations.

  

**Qualifications** **About You**

title: VMware / Infrastructure Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** VMware / Infrastructure Operations Engineer

**Experience:** 1\+ Year

We are looking for a **VMware / Infrastructure Operations Engineer** with hands\-on experience in virtualization, infrastructure monitoring, incident management, hardware troubleshooting, and operational support.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of VMware infrastructure and be comfortable performing initial troubleshooting, monitoring infrastructure health, following operational runbooks, and coordinating with senior infrastructure teams when required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**VMware Virtualization**

* Administer and support VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi hosts, clusters, and virtual machines.
* Perform infrastructure health checks.
* Manage datastores and virtual networking.
* Validate provisioned infrastructure resources.
* Assist with VM availability and infrastructure\-related troubleshooting.

**Provisioning \& Automation**

* Provision virtual machines through management consoles, CLI tools, scripts, and Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Configure CPU, memory, disk, and networking requirements.
* Validate VM builds after provisioning.
* Follow standardized provisioning procedures to reduce configuration errors.

**Monitoring \& Observability**

* Monitor infrastructure using tools such as **New Relic and PagerDuty**.
* Review alerts, infrastructure health signals, capacity thresholds, and service\-impact indicators.
* Perform initial analysis of infrastructure alerts and determine required actions.

**Incident Management \& ITSM**

* Perform initial incident diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Categorize incidents and determine severity based on business and service impact.
* Create and maintain high\-quality incident tickets.
* Execute predefined SOPs and runbooks.
* Maintain accurate incident timelines, troubleshooting actions, and resolution details.

**Hardware Troubleshooting**

* Perform initial troubleshooting for CPU, memory, NIC, HBA, storage\-device, and power\-supply issues.
* Interpret hardware health events and alerts.
* Coordinate hardware remediation with relevant infrastructure or datacenter teams.

**Out\-of\-Band Management**

* Work with remote management technologies including:
* IPMI
* KVM
* HPE iLO
* Dell iDRAC
* Perform remote health checks, log collection, and basic recovery activities.

**Storage Operations**

* Understand and support **VMFS and NFS datastores**.
* Monitor storage capacity utilization.
* Review performance indicators and threshold alerts.
* Identify storage risks and escalate issues to appropriate storage teams.

**Security Operations**

* Monitor SSL/TLS certificate expiration.
* Understand basic PKI and certificate\-renewal processes.
* Perform initial vulnerability triage using **CVE and CVSS** information.
* Review security and audit logs for initial investigation.
* Escalate security findings based on established procedures.

**Escalation \& Communication**

* Collect relevant logs, diagnostics, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
* Assess infrastructure and service impact.
* Document troubleshooting findings clearly.
* Provide structured handoffs to T2, SRE, Storage, Network, Security, and Datacenter teams.
* Maintain clear communication throughout incidents and escalations.

**Operational Documentation**

* Follow established SOPs and runbooks.
* Maintain accurate tickets and operational records.
* Document actions performed, evidence collected, outcomes, and handover notes.
* Support continuous improvement of operational documentation.

**Required Skills**

* 1\+ year of experience in Infrastructure / VMware Operations.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **VMware vSphere, vCenter and ESXi**.
* Understanding of VMs, clusters, datastores, and virtual networking.
* Familiarity with **VMFS and NFS storage**.
* Experience or understanding of monitoring tools such as **New Relic and PagerDuty**.
* Basic knowledge of incident management and ITSM processes.
* Understanding of server hardware troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of **iLO, iDRAC, IPMI, or KVM**.
* Basic understanding of SSL/TLS certificates and PKI.
* Awareness of CVE/CVSS and vulnerability management.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to follow SOPs, runbooks, and defined escalation procedures.

**Good to Have**

* Basic scripting or automation knowledge.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience working in 24x7 infrastructure operations or NOC environments.
* Understanding of Network, Storage, Security, and Datacenter operations.
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM tools.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at **hr@spasnik.com**.

title: Senior Civil Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

The **Senior** **Civil Engineer** will be based in **Hyderabad** . In this position, you will report to the Manager, Civil \& Automation. Watch “ Culture is our Passion ” to learn more about us


**We are looking for someone who demonstrates:**

* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Integrity to the core
* Enthusiastic customer focus
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement and top performance.

**Here is a glimpse of what you will do:**

* Terrain \& Grading Design: Perform desktop assessments and design cost\-effective land grading, levelling, and terracing strategies tailored specifically to solar tracker slope tolerances.
* Civil 3D Modelling: Build intelligent existing and proposed ground surfaces, alignments, and corridors using AutoCAD Civil 3D to align tracker rows with optimal tilt constraints.
* Earthwork Optimization: Analyses and calculate precise cut\-and\-fill volumes, minimizing soil disturbance and balancing earthwork to curb construction costs.
* Drainage \& Stormwater Planning: Design site\-specific stormwater management systems, erosion control measures, and access road networks running parallel or perpendicular to tracker arrays.
* Tracker Layout Integration: Collaborate with electrical and structural teams to verify pile/foundation placement, ensuring tracker rotational clearance over varied topography without inter\-row shading.
* Cross\-functional Coordination: Review geotechnical, hydrological, and topographical survey reports to refine constructability and issue Request for Information (RFI) responses during construction.
* Tasks to be perform on day\-to\-day activity – Grading Analysis, Slope Analysis, Detailed Slope analysis with contour study for the site.

**Here is some of what you will need (required):**

* B.E/B.Tech in Civil/Mechanical with (5\-8\) years of experience in Civil 3D Software Handling.
* Through knowledge of Civil 3D commands or any other equivalent CAD environment.
* Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good knowledge on drafting and detailing standards
* Very good communication skills

**Here are a few of our preferred experiences:**

* Experience in solar industry is preferred but not compulsory
* VBA (Optional)
* Auto Lisp (Optional)
* Python (Optional)
* C\# (Optional)

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title** 
 : Senior Consultant – Active Directory with Entra ID (AD, Entra ID, Migrations)
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 4–7 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), OR Microsoft 365 workloads. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in assessments, transitions, transformations, and migrations across hybrid and cloud identity environments, and will play a key role in advising clients while also executing technical delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and execute assessments of existing Active Directory, Entra ID, and M365 environments to identify gaps, risks, and modernization opportunities.
* Design and drive transition and transformation roadmaps for identity infrastructure (on\-prem AD to Entra ID, hybrid identity models).
* Plan and execute migrations of AD, Entra ID, and M365 workloads (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams) — including tenant\-to\-tenant migrations, domain consolidations, and hybrid setups.
* Provide hands\-on configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of AD DS, Azure AD Connect/Entra Connect, Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and hybrid identity synchronization.
* Work closely with client stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration strategy, and manage risk/rollback plans.
* Prepare technical documentation: assessment reports, architecture diagrams, migration runbooks, and transformation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (security, infrastructure, cloud) to ensure smooth delivery of projects.
* Stay current with Microsoft’s evolving identity and M365 ecosystem, and recommend best practices.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4–7 years of overall IT experience, with strong focus on Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), OR M365 workloads.
* Proven, in\-depth hands\-on experience (not just theoretical) in:
* AD DS design, administration, and troubleshooting
* Entra ID / Azure AD (Connect/Entra Connect, Conditional Access, Identity Protection, RBAC)
* M365 workloads: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams
* Strong experience in assessment methodologies for identity and M365 environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading transition \& transformation projects (on\-prem to cloud, hybrid identity).
* Solid experience in migration projects — tenant\-to\-tenant, cross\-forest, domain consolidation, mailbox/data migrations.
* Good understanding of security and compliance considerations in identity/M365 environments.
* Strong client\-facing consulting skills — able to present findings, roadmaps, and recommendations confidently.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.


**Good to Have**
* Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS\-100/101, SC\-300, AZ\-800/801\).
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation of AD/Entra ID/M365 tasks.
* Exposure to third\-party migration tools (Quest, BitTitan, ShareGate, etc.)

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

This position within Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) requires broad Data Center knowledge with Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in as many specific fields as possible. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 This position serves as the primary operational resource to support ADSIPL within its owned and operated Data Centers in India. This position will provide a central point of ownership and accountability for the overall ‘hands\-on’ management of the Mechanical, Electrical (M\&E) and across ADSIPL’s portfolio of Data Centers in India. This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on\-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Operations And Maintenance**
* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of investigation, root cause analysis and follow\-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of a Data Center (Electrical/Mechanical/Fire Suppression Systems) are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best\-in\-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
* Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans.


**Incident And Emergency Response**
* Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.


**About The Team**
 You'll be working with highly technical Data Center teams including cross\-functional ones looking after various aspects of a data center, in order to maintain 100% uptime for the customers.

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.  We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
* Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

AECOM India is seeking talented **Engineers** for Civil Engineering practice. Candidates for the **Senior Civil Engineer** position should have experience in medium to large size projects such as cultural buildings, high rises, office buildings, airports, transit, health care and research facility design preferably in a consulting engineering firm environment. The Engineer will have to be self\-starters and are required to work with only high\-level direction and guidance from seniors on projects.

* Project experience in datacentre, commercial, residential, retail, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, aviation sectors will be helpful.
* Undergraduate degree (master’s preferred) in Civil engineering/Hydraulics or related field.
* Knowledge on Site Grading Layouts, site development work, Design of Storm water drainage layouts, sanitary sewer system, Underground gravity drainages, chemical sewer system, tankage area layout, Asphalt and Concrete Road \& RC Pavement and preparation of Road layouts.
* Knowledge on design of Electrical substation related structure and foundation.
* Knowledge of Indian codes is mandatory. Familiarity with US, BS, Eurocodes is a plus.
* Working knowledge of current industry software, including Sewer Gem, Water GEM, Civil 3D, Arc GIS and Hec RAS/ HEC\-HMS
* Willingness for programming, macros \& Excel design sheets is desirable, though not mandatory.
* Interest in working with Rhino, Grasshopper, Dynamo, Python coding will be a big plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Client communication and interaction skills will be preferred.
* Time management and people management skills will be valuable.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

title: Data Center Engineering Operations, Data Center Engineering Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:  

  

Operations and Maintenance:  

  

* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post\-mortems, root cause analysis and follow\-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site\-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best\-in\-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
* Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
* Health \& Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
* Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
* Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
* Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.

  

Incident and Emergency Response:  

o Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.  

o Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.  

o Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.
  

  

About the team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

title: Drives Engineer- ACS 550 and 580
description:
Sr. Engineer\- Electrical–Drives\- Customer Services



Location: Jagdalpur, Chhattisgarh



Key Requirements


* Proven experience in maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical drive systems in Caster, Tunnel Furnace, Rolling Mill, and other continuous process plants.
* Strong knowledge of industrial drive technology, electrical power distribution, motor control centers (MCCs), control systems, and automation interfaces.
* Hands\-on expertise in ABB drives including ACS580, ACS800, ACS850, drive commissioning, parameterization, diagnostics, backup restoration, and firmware management.
* Working knowledge of Siemens drive systems including SINAMICS S120, G120, and associated engineering tools such as Starter and Startdrive/TIA Portal.
* Expertise in drive fault analysis, breakdown troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Ability to diagnose and rectify issues related to:


o Drive power modules and control units



o Encoder and feedback systems



o Communication networks (Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP)



o Motor and drive interlocks



o Harmonics, power quality, and electrical protection systems


* Experience in predictive, preventive, and condition\-based maintenance of VFDs and DC/AC drive systems to improve equipment reliability and availability.
* Strong understanding of drive system integration with PLC, HMI, SCADA, and field instrumentation.


Roles \& Responsibilities


* Plan, organize, and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for ABB and Siemens drive systems.
* Develop maintenance strategies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and troubleshooting guidelines for drive systems.
* Perform detailed fault diagnostics and analysis to minimize downtime and improve system reliability.
* Create and implement preventive maintenance plans for VFDs, drive panels, motors, cooling systems, and associated equipment.
* Monitor critical drive parameters, analyze trends, and recommend reliability improvement initiatives.
* Carry out drive commissioning, parameter backup/restoration, software upgrades, and performance optimization activities.
* Schedule maintenance shutdown activities, arrange required manpower, tools, and spare parts for timely execution.
* Review ongoing maintenance work and ensure compliance with technical specifications and quality standards.
* Maintain comprehensive records of drive faults, corrective actions, maintenance history, and reliability KPIs.
* Develop and manage critical spare parts inventory for ABB and Siemens drives to reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
* Coordinate with OEMs, vendors, and internal operations teams for complex troubleshooting and system upgrades.
* Support modernization, retrofit, and drive migration projects.
* Ensure strict compliance with electrical safety standards, LOTO procedures, arc\-flash protection requirements, and plant safety regulations.
* Prepare technical reports, maintenance analyses, presentations, and MIS reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

### **Preferred Skills**


* Advanced troubleshooting of ABB ACS800/ACS850 and Siemens SINAMICS S120 multi\-axis systems.
* Knowledge of drive networks, fieldbus diagnostics, and industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with thermography, power quality analysis, and condition monitoring techniques.
* Good leadership, communication, team coordination, and shift maintenance management skills.
* Exposure to steel manufacturing processes and critical rolling mill drive applications will be highly preferred.


Qualification Requirements


* You should have minimum 5 years’ experience preferably in Caster, Tunnel Furnace, Rolling mill with bachelor’s degree in electrical/ Electronic engineering or Diploma in electrical with 6\-8 years of experience

title: Java Gen AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Architect Java (with AI / GenAI) with 8\-12 years of experience in designing and leading enterprise\-scale application architectures. This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role focused on building scalable, cloud\-native, distributed systems using Java, Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, and modern cloud technologies. * Design cloud\-native architectures on AWS, Azure, and GCP platforms.
* Lead containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.

* Collaborate with DevOps and Platform Engineering teams to establish CI/CD and Infrastructure Automation practices.
* Drive observability, monitoring, security, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, delivery teams, QA, and DevOps organizations.

* Support solutioning activities, technical proposals, and strategic technology initiatives.
* Ensure successful delivery of high\-quality enterprise solutions.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8\-12 years of software engineering experience with at least 4\+ years in Architecture or Technical Leadership roles.
* Deep expertise in Java 11/17\+, multithreading, concurrency, collections, and functional programming.
* Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Integration, and Spring Batch.
* Strong knowledge of Microservices Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), and Clean Architecture.

 : Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: VL)
   

  

**(\*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client \- VL)
   

  

**What do you need for this opportunity?
   

  

**Must have skills required:**
 VHDL, MATLAB, modulation, Python, Digital signal processing, physical layer, Simulation Exposure, Lifi, RTL
   

  

**VL is Looking for:******
**Role: PHY Layer Engineer**
 Wireless \& Optical Wireless Communications
   

  

* Signal Processing
* FPGA


**Function: Research \& Development — Optical Wireless PHY**
**Education: M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. — ECE, EE, Signal Processing**
 Experience: 5–8 years
   

  

* PhD counts as experience


**Location: Delhi, On\-site**
**Velmenni is a leading Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) company developing LiFi and Free\-Space Optical (FSO) technologies for next\-generation high\-speed wireless networks.** 
 We combine communication theory, signal processing, FPGA acceleration, and photonics to build real\-world optical communication systems. Our team works across the full innovation cycle—from research and simulation to hardware prototyping and deployment—creating technologies that complement and extend traditional RF\-based wireless networks.
   

  

**This is an R\&D position. You will own the design, development, and experimental validation of physical layer algorithms for LiFi and Free Space Optical (FSO) communication systems — from theoretical formulation and simulation through to FPGA prototyping. Publishing and prototyping are both expected.**
**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop PHY algorithms for LiFi and FSO — modulation (OOK, PPM, DCO\-OFDM, ACO\-OFDM), channel coding (LDPC, Polar, RS), and synchronisation
* Model and simulate optical wireless channels: atmospheric turbulence, pointing errors, IM/DD receiver noise, ambient light interference, and LED/laser non\-linearities
* Build end\-to\-end link\-level simulation chains in MATLAB or Python and evaluate BER, throughput, and spectral efficiency under realistic conditions
* Implement validated algorithms on FPGA — translate fixed\-point models into RTL or HLS; own algorithm correctness through hardware validation
* Write bit\-exact C/C\+\+ reference models to support hardware verification
* Track and engage with relevant standards: IEEE 802\.11bb (LiFi), ITU\-T FSO, and adjacent wireless standards


**Required**
* M.Tech, M.S., or Ph.D. in ECE, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field — thesis or research in optical wireless, VLC, or wireless communications is a strong indicator
* Strong fundamentals in digital communications: modulation, channel coding, detection, estimation, and synchronisation
* Hands\-on experience building PHY simulations from scratch in MATLAB or Python — not just toolboxes
* Solid understanding of OFDM: multipath channels, cyclic prefix, pilot design, and channel estimation
* Fixed\-point thinking — ability to design algorithms aware of hardware quantisation and implementation cost
* FPGA awareness: understand LUT/DSP/BRAM trade\-offs, pipelining, and timing well enough to make
* hardware\-friendly algorithm decisions
* Familiarity with VHDL or Verilog to write or review RTL for PHY blocks
* Exposure to AMD/Xilinx Vivado — simulation, synthesis, and reading timing and resource reports
* Working knowledge of at least one wireless or optical wireless standard; ability to read and implement from spec documents


**Preferred**
* Experience with 3Gpp, IEEE 802\.11bb (LiFi), or ITU FSO link specifications
* Optical channel modelling: log\-normal turbulence, Gamma\-Gamma distribution, pointing error statistics
* LED non\-linearity, predistortion, and flicker mitigation for VLC systems
* Optical MIMO, spatial diversity techniques, and APD / PIN photodetector front\-end modelling
* Cellular or 5G NR PHY background — OFDM, LDPC, channel coding chain
* SDR platforms: Ettus USRP and GNU Radio for over\-the\-air prototyping
* Linux environment and Python / Bash scripting for toolchain automation
* Vitis HLS or OpenCL\-based FPGA acceleration flows
* Publications in IEEE Photonics, IEEE Communications Letters, JOCN, or equivalent venues


**Research Profile**
**We are open to two archetypes:**
* M.Tech or PhD with thesis in VLC, OWC, optical OFDM, or wireless channel modelling — research output matters more than years of industry experience
* Wireless PHY engineer from industry looking to move into R\&D — trainable on the optical wireless domain if the PHY and FPGA fundamentals are strong


**Interview Process :**
* First round: Head of Product Development, R\&D
* Final round: Deepak (CEO)
* If possible, a third round might happen


**How to apply for this opportunity?**
* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form \& Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted \& meet the client for the Interview!


**About Uplers:**
 Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
   

  

 (Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
   

  

 So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

title: Product Engineer (Field Tools)
description:
**Starting Date:** December 2026

**Contract type:** Full\-time and open\-ended

**Salary:** From 2,716,737 INR

**Location:** India, Delhi (Hybrid)

**Application closing date:** 8th October 2026

 *If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

 **About the Job**

  

The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.

 **The Challenge**

  

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

 **Responsibilities**


In this role, you will be responsible for :

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.

 **Experience**

  

the following skills, knowledge, and experience:

 **Essential:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.

  

Desirable:

* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.

 **What we offer**

* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.

 **Working arrangements**

  

The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.

 **Apply now**

  

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before **08\.10\.2026** via the application link.

  

In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

  

Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.

 **Our hiring process**

 **Initial Screening:**


Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

 **Interviews:**


If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.

 **Assessment and Testing:**


Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.

 **Reference Checks:**


Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.

 **Offer stage:**


After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.

 **About Better Cotton** **Initiative**


Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

 **About our Values**


The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:

* **Trustworthy** (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having **Integrity** (including responsible, authentic)
* **Positive** (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* **Engaging** (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* **Daring** (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)

 **Being you @ Better Cotton** **Initiative**

  

Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.

  

We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Troubleshooting Engineer
description:
The Troubleshooting Engineer will be responsible for providing advanced technical support for Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), and HVAC automation solutions across multiple customer sites. The role focuses on diagnosing complex system issues, ensuring high system availability, managing customer escalations, conducting root cause analysis, and delivering timely resolutions in compliance with service level commitments.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Advanced BMS \& EMS Troubleshooting
 


* Diagnose and resolve complex faults in BMS and EMS platforms.
* Analyze system alarms, trends, controller behavior, and field device performance.
* Restore system functionality through effective troubleshooting and corrective actions.
* Provide technical expertise for critical and recurring issues.



 HVAC Controls \& Building Automation Expertise
 


* Troubleshoot HVAC control systems including Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, VAVs, Pumps, and Ventilation Systems.
* Verify control logic, sequences of operation, and system integration.
* Recommend performance improvements and optimization opportunities.



 BACnet, Modbus \& Communication Protocol Management
 


* Diagnose and resolve communication issues related to BACnet, Modbus, TCP/IP, and other building automation protocols.
* Validate controller communications and network architecture.
* Support integration between BMS, EMS, third\-party equipment, and supervisory systems.



 Network Diagnostics \& Connectivity Management
 


* Troubleshoot network issues involving TCP/IP, routers, switches, gateways, and remote access infrastructure.
* Coordinate with customer IT teams for network\-related problem resolution.
* Ensure stable and secure communication between field devices and central systems.



 Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Problem Solving
 


* Conduct detailed RCA for major incidents and recurring failures.
* Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of findings and resolutions.



 Customer Escalation Management \& SLA Compliance
 


* Manage critical customer escalations and ensure timely closure.
* Prioritize service requests based on business impact and urgency.
* Monitor and achieve service performance metrics and SLA requirements.
* Maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication.



 Multi\-Site Operations \& Remote Technical Support
 


* Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting support across multiple customer locations.
* Support service teams in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project, commissioning, and service teams to ensure seamless customer support.



 Key Skills Required
 


* Advanced BMS \& EMS Troubleshooting
* HVAC Controls \& Building Automation Systems
* BACnet, Modbus \& Communication Protocols
* Network Diagnostics (TCP/IP, Routers, Switches \& Connectivity)
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Problem Solving
* Customer Escalation Management
* SLA Monitoring \& Compliance
* Multi\-Site Technical Support
* Remote System Monitoring
* Technical Documentation \& Reporting



 Educational Qualification
 


* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline.



 Preferred Experience
 


* Hands\-on experience with Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Building Operation (EBO), Continuum, or similar BMS platforms.
* Experience in troubleshooting mission\-critical facilities such as Data Centers, Commercial Buildings, Healthcare, Industrial, and Infrastructure projects.
* Understanding of HVAC systems, building automation architecture, and energy management solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and customer\-facing skills.



 Desired Candidate Profile
 


* 4 \- 9 Years of experience
* Self\-driven troubleshooting professional with strong diagnostic capabilities.
* Able to independently handle customer issues and drive resolutions.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced service environment with multiple stakeholders.
* Willing to travel for critical site support when required.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:

We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to design, install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support computer hardware, IFPD, networking equipment, and related IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in hardware diagnostics, system configuration, and end\-user support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and peripheral issues.
* Assemble, upgrade, and repair computer systems and replace faulty components.

Required Qualifications:

description:
**Scope**
 The Global Technical Support Engineer serves as the highest level of technical escalation for endpoint computing services, providing advanced support for desktops, laptops, operating systems, applications, conference room technologies, and enterprise endpoint management. The role is responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex hardware, software, operating system, and infrastructure\-related issues while ensuring optimal endpoint performance, security compliance, and business continuity.
   

  

 The engineer collaborates with Infrastructure, Security, Network, and Application teams, manages enterprise endpoint platforms, supports executive users, drives process improvements, and ensures timely resolution of incidents within agreed SLAs. * Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve advanced desktop, laptop, peripheral, and operating system issues.

* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring technical issues.
* Coordinate hardware diagnostics, warranty support, and replacement activities with OEM vendors.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications, collaboration tools, and enterprise endpoint technologies.
* Manage and support conference room Audio/Video systems and executive meeting environments.

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Mentor L1/L2 support engineers by providing technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in endpoint security initiatives, vulnerability remediation, compliance activities, and process improvements.
* Provide support after\-hours support during critical incidents or business requirements.


**Our Technical Environment**
* Windows 10/11, macOS
* SCCM/MECM, MDT, WDS

* Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Office)

* Data Center Infrastructure (MDF/IDF)
* PowerShell \& Automation Tools

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

* Strong knowledge in Windows administration, SCCM/MECM, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting macOS devices and enterprise mobility solutions is preferred.
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Experience in IT asset management and hardware lifecycle management.
* Strong customer service, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work effectively under pressure.
* Experience working in an ITIL\-based support environment.
