title: QA Engineer – Smart TV & Set-Top Box IRC304216
description:
**Description**
 Media \& Entertainment –
   

  

 This project involves the engineering and quality assurance for a Tier\-1 Global Streaming Platform. The team is responsible for ensuring the reliability of the Operating System across a diverse fleet of devices (TVs and Players) already in the market. The environment is fast\-paced and requires close collaboration with the client’s core engineering unit to troubleshoot live issues, validate firmware maintenance releases, and ensure a seamless viewer experience worldwide.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Core Experience: 4 to 6 years of hands\-on experience in validation and testing of Smart TVs, Set\-Top Boxes (STBs), or embedded multimedia devices.
   

  

 OS \& Platform Knowledge: Deep familiarity with testing proprietary TV Operating Systems, including firmware updates, sideloading builds, and navigating developer modes.
   

  

 Technical Debugging: Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA); must be able to capture and analyse system logs (via Serial, Telnet, SSH) to identify failure points rather than just reporting bugs.
   

  

 Domain Knowledge (OTA/OTT):
   

  

 Strong understanding of OTT (Over\-the\-Top) streaming workflows, including video playback, buffering, and A/V sync analysis.
   

  

 Knowledge of OTA (Over\-the\-Air) broadcast standards (ATSC, DVB, ISDB) and tuner functionality.
   

  

 Networking: Solid knowledge of Router Configuration, Wi\-Fi stability (2\.4/5GHz),
   

  

 Good to have knowledge of DNS and packet analysis using tools like Wireshark.
   

  

 Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with specific experience interacting with clients or teams located in different geographical time zones.
   

  

 Automation: Basic proficiency in Python scripting for automating repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Tools: Hands\-on experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
   

  

 Education: B.E/B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, or equivalent.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 End\-to\-End Product Validation: Execute functional, regression, and sustaining test cycles on Smart TV and STB platforms to ensure OS stability and compliance with product specifications.
   

  

 Root Cause Analysis \& Logging: Go beyond standard test execution by capturing logs (Serial/System logs) and performing initial debugging to isolate the root cause of crashes or defects before escalating to development.
   

  

 Hybrid Testing (OTA \& OTT): Validate both live broadcast features (channel scanning, signal strength, EPG) and streaming application performance (video start time, adaptive bitrate switching) across various network conditions.
   

  

 Client Collaboration: Act as the primary technical interface for the client; attend triage meetings with global engineering teams, providing detailed status updates and clarifying technical queries across time zones.
   

  

 Defect Reporting: Create comprehensive bug reports including steps to reproduce, system logs, and network captures; verify fixes and manage the defect lifecycle in JIRA.
   

  

 Network \& Environment Setup: Configure and maintain complex test environments, including specific router settings and network simulations, to replicate customer issues.
   

  

 Automation Support: Identify automation opportunities and maintain and execute basic Python scripts to improve testing efficiency.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Senior IREG & Network Test Engineer
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**About The Role**
 Every MNO onboarding ends at a technical test gate. We are hiring an automation\-oriented IREG \& Network Test Engineer to own that gate—from attach and authentication through SGD, MAP, SMS, IP NIDD, and roaming sign\-off.
   

  

 You will replace manual, partner\-dependent execution with a repeatable test strategy, scalable lab, and automated regression pipeline.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Automation**
* Own the IREG Testing Strategy: Define the roadmap for MNO onboarding—including clear pass/fail criteria, evidence requirements, and sign\-off processes—so we can scale our roaming partnerships faster and more reliably.
* Drive Testing Innovation: Look beyond manual execution to build a long\-term automation strategy that makes our roaming validation smarter, faster, and eventually hands\-free.
* Adapt Standards for Space: Take standard GSMA roaming test suites and figure out what’s missing for Non\-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), designing new edge\-case tests that bridge the gap between terrestrial and satellite.
* Build the Testing Lab: Design, scale, and maintain an automation harness capable of reliably running both standard GSMA and custom NB\-IoT NTN scenarios.


**Technical Execution \& Troubleshooting**
* Ensure End\-to\-End Interoperability: Validate the entire roaming journey (Registration, S6a/S6d, SGd, IP, NIDD), ensuring smooth handoffs across satellite and cellular networks.
* Translate Complex Tech into Test Cases: Build comprehensive test scenarios by combining GSMA standards, partner network configurations, and our unique NB\-IoT NTN traffic profiles.
* Troubleshoot Across Borders: Dig into Diameter/SS7 traces and network logs to isolate and resolve complex routing or signaling issues happening anywhere between our network, the IPX, and the MNOs.
* Learn from Real\-World Friction: Turn production snags and onboarding hiccups into automated regression tests to ensure we continuously improve and never fix the same bug twice.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Act as the Subject Matter Expert: Use your deep knowledge of 3GPP protocols (LTE/5G/NB\-IoT NTN) and RAN/Core networks to guide engineering and product teams on technical decisions.
* Own the Defect Lifecycle: Don't just log bugs—track them down to the root cause, partner with engineering on the fix, and see them through to complete closure.
* Keep Leadership Informed: Build and share clear dashboards covering test cycle times, defect rates, and overall readiness so the business always knows where MNO onboarding stands.
* Collaborate Across Boundaries: Work hand\-in\-hand with internal teams (Signaling, Billing, NOC, Product) and external partners (IPX, MNOs) to get new networks launched smoothly.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in roaming, mobile core, interconnect, IREG, or telecommunications network testing.
* Hands\-on understanding of Diameter and relevant SS7/MAP concepts, including S6a/S6d, SGd, and roaming authentication and registration flows.
* Experience reading Wireshark or equivalent signalling traces and diagnosing network failures involving multiple parties.
* Experience designing automated telecommunications testing frameworks using Python or comparable languages and CI practices.
* Fluency with IR.21/RAEX, PLMN, IMSI, TADIG, and structured testing evidence.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* NB\-IoT, NTN, NIDD, IoT roaming, GSMA test\-suite, or device\-lab experience.
* Familiarity with IMSI Tracing, Diameter/SS7 testing tools, Jira, Confluence, and dashboarding.
* Experience integrating network testing with TAP and billing validation.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plans
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to be part of developing and running the world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to a world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO Statement**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

 We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

This role requires a hands\-on QA professional who can guide testing strategy, review execution quality, manage workload across the QA team, and personally contribute to testing where needed. The resource should bring strong practical experience in Veeva PromoMats, Salesforce/Veeva CRM, IVA/CLM workflows, RTE/approved email testing, and pharma digital compliance expectations. In addition, the role will support QA for DTC and HCP websites, ensuring that all deliverables are functionally accurate, compliant, user\-friendly, and aligned with client, brand, regulatory, and platform requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. QA Leadership and Team Management:** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a large QA team responsible for testing Veeva IVA/CLM presentations, RTE/approved emails, pharma websites, landing pages, and web banners across high\-volume delivery environments.
* Own test planning, effort estimation, task allocation, daily tracking, defect triage, and QA status reporting across multiple brands, markets, workstreams, high\-volume deliverables, and compressed timelines.
* Demonstrate proven ability to manage peak workloads, rapid turnarounds, shifting priorities, and parallel releases while maintaining quality, compliance, and team productivity.
* Provide hands\-on functional, platform, and compliance guidance to QA team members and ensure consistency in testing quality and documentation.
* Act as the QA point of contact for project managers, developers, content authors, creative teams, MLR/regulatory stakeholders, and client teams.



**2\. Veeva IVA/CLM Presentation Testing:** 



* Lead end\-to\-end testing of Interactive Visual Aids/CLM presentations developed for Veeva, including navigation, slide sequencing, branching logic, hyperlinks, pop\-ups, animations, references, mandatory flows, and user interactions.
* Validate IVA functionality across Veeva CRM and Salesforce/Veeva environments, ensuring assets behave as expected for field force usage.
* Review content accuracy, layout consistency, brand alignment, claims, annotations, references, ISI/safety information, and approved assets against supplied source files and regulatory\-approved materials.
* Identify platform\-specific issues, document defects clearly, support root\-cause discussions, and retest fixes until closure.



**3\. RTE/Approved Email Testing:** 



* Lead QA for Rep Triggered Emails/Approved Emails built for Veeva, including subject lines, preheaders, body copy, personalization tokens, dynamic content, links, CTAs, footers, unsubscribe/legal text, and rendering behavior.
* Validate email functionality within Veeva Approved Email workflows, including template setup, CRM integration, content approval status, field force usability, and compliance with approved claims and references.
* Perform email rendering, compatibility, responsiveness, accessibility, and link validation using tools such as Litmus and Email on Acid, across approved email clients, devices, and browsers where applicable.
* Track defects, coordinate with development/content teams, support regression testing, and ensure final assets are deployment\-ready.



**4\. Veeva PromoMats and Platform Compliance:** 



* Work hands\-on in Veeva PromoMats to validate assets, references, annotations, claims, document relationships, versioning, approval status, and readiness for deployment.
* Ensure QA activities align with pharma review and approval processes, including MLR/regulatory expectations, audit readiness, and documentation standards.
* Understand and test dependencies between Veeva PromoMats, Veeva CRM, Salesforce, CLM content, and approved email workflows.
* Support troubleshooting of platform, configuration, content package, and deployment\-related issues.



**5\. Pharma Website QA – DTC and HCP:** 



* Lead or support testing of pharma websites, including Direct\-to\-Consumer websites, Healthcare Professional websites, landing pages, and web banners.
* Validate functionality, content accuracy, navigation, forms, links, downloads, tracking tags where applicable, responsive behavior, browser compatibility, accessibility basics, and compliance\-related content, using BrowserStack for cross\-browser and cross\-device validation where required.
* Ensure website testing covers approved copy, references, safety information, privacy/legal requirements, and market\-specific variations.
* Test static and animated web banners for content accuracy, click\-through behavior, dimensions/spec compliance, rendering consistency, tracking implementation where applicable, and alignment with approved brand and regulatory materials.
* Partner with development, content, UX, and project teams to resolve issues and support timely release.



**6\. Test Planning, Documentation and Reporting:** 



* Create and maintain test plans, test scenarios, checklists, test cases, defect logs, regression packs, and QA sign\-off documentation.
* Ensure test coverage includes functional accuracy, creative/content fidelity, platform behavior, compliance checks, usability, regression, and release readiness.
* Provide clear QA dashboards, daily status updates, risk/issue escalations, and quality metrics to project stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in QA processes, reusable checklists, defect prevention, and knowledge management for Veeva and pharma digital deliverables.



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 



* Strong QA experience in pharma digital production, with demonstrated exposure to IVA/CLM presentations and RTE/approved email testing.
* Hands\-on working knowledge of Veeva PromoMats, Salesforce/Veeva CRM, Veeva CLM, and Veeva Approved Email workflows.
* Mandatory hands\-on experience using Litmus and/or Email on Acid for approved email rendering, compatibility, responsiveness, and quality validation.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for auxiliary systems supporting gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators, you will be responsible for supplier qualification, development, and quality assurance activities across the supply chain. You will work closely with global suppliers and cross\-functional teams to ensure product and process compliance while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.
   

  

 In this role, you will leverage quality and digitalization tools, manage supplier performance, resolve quality issues, and implement preventive actions to enhance supplier capability and reliability.
   

  

****How You’ll Make An Impact****
* Conduct supplier qualification, capability assessments, and quality audits to ensure compliance with Siemens Energy requirements.
* Drive Product and Process Qualification (PPQ) activities and approve supplier manufacturing processes through Manufacturing Quality Control Plans.
* Perform source, virtual, and desk inspections while supporting quality assurance activities for components and systems within your scope.
* Manage supplier nonconformances, coordinate root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor supplier KPIs, support supplier development initiatives, and drive continuous improvement through structured reviews and risk mitigation plans.


****What You Bring****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in Supplier Quality, Quality Management, Supply Chain Management, or similar technical functions.
* Experience with industrial process technologies and/or auxiliary systems used in energy generation plants is preferred.
* Proven experience conducting supplier audits and strong knowledge of quality systems, including ISO 9001; familiarity with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of root cause analysis, quality methodologies, risk management, and supplier development processes.
* Experience working with quality management tools, supplier databases, and digital quality systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to work effectively in a global environment.
* Willingness to travel up to 30% based on business requirements.


****About The Team****
 You will be part of a global Supplier Quality organization focused on ensuring a high\-performing, reliable, and quality\-driven supply chain for Siemens Energy products. The team collaborates closely with suppliers, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing functions to drive quality excellence and supplier development.
   

  

 The environment promotes collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, providing opportunities to influence supplier performance and contribute to the successful delivery of critical energy solutions worldwide.
   

  

****About The Team****
 You will be part of the Supply Chain Management team supporting Siemens Energy. The team works closely with suppliers, procurement, manufacturing, and planning functions to ensure the reliable flow of materials and services required to meet customer and production commitments.
   

  

 The environment encourages collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation, providing opportunities to contribute to strategic supplier partnerships and the successful delivery of world\-class energy solutions.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

description:

**Job Description:**
**Role Objectives :**
 As one of the first Quality \& Compliance Leads to join the Bengaluru GCM, this role will establish and operationalize quality control execution and maintenance capabilities for Evidence Generation, including execution of QC processes, following checklists, risk register standards, and archival workflows before scaling to full steady\-state delivery .
   

  

 Execute independent quality control reviews of evidence deliverables, maintain the enterprise evidence generation risk register, and maintain QC evidence and audit records, enabling the Global Evidence Generation and Quality teams to focus on scientific judgment, exception decisions, and non\-standard quality determinations .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities :**
**Initial Capability Build:**
* In the early build phase, contribute to the adaption of the QC checklist standards, risk register taxonomy, exception triage criteria, escalation thresholds, repository metadata requirements, and archival naming conventions incoordination with the Global Evidence Generation and Quality teams
* Identify and flag process gaps, scope boundary ambiguities between GCM and the US organization, and repository readiness issues before they affect audit traceability or compliance


**QC Execution on Evidence Deliverables:**
* Run automated first\-pass QC on evidence deliverables using appropriate QC checklists where rules, templates, and escalation thresholds are defined; perform manual QC checks for completeness, formatting, references, and required fields
* Log all QC findings, exceptions, and rework items consistently and follow up on deliverables for correction or clarification as needed
* Confirm QC completion and file QC evidence in the appropriate library for audit readiness and traceability
* Escalate scientific, methodological, or compliance concerns to the Global Evidence Generation or Quality team per defined escalation protocols


**Risk Monitoring \& Exception Management:**
* Identify, receive, and log risks, exceptions, or issues arising from study, evidence, quality, or governance processes in the central risk register
* Assess and triage each risk or exception by type, impact, ownership, and escalation path; route quality, compliance, or governance exceptions to the US team through the appropriate channels
* Track mitigation actions, dependencies, and overdue items; follow up with relevant owners to ensure timely resolution
* Close risks or exceptions once mitigation evidence is confirmed as complete; report recurring themes and patterns to the Global Evidence Generation or Quality team for governance review


**QC Evidence \& Risk Register Maintenance:**
* Upload QC evidence and risk register artifacts to the designated repository, applying naming conventions, tagging, access controls, and version history in line with defined standards
* Link stored QC evidence to the relevant study, deliverable, CAPA, or risk record; flag missing or incomplete records for resolution


**Qualifications:**
**Experience  :** 
 \>2 years of related work experience; \>2 years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry; experience in quality control, evidence operations, regulatory submissions, or a related compliance or documentation role at a pharmaceutical company, CRO, or HEOR organization preferred .
   

  

**Technical skills :**
* Working knowledge of QC review processes for evidence deliverables
* Familiarity with risk register management, exception tracking, and mitigation documentation in a regulated pharmaceutical or evidence generation environment
* Experience managing document repositories including metadata tagging, naming conventions, access controls, etc.
* Familiarity with evidence or quality repository platforms and document lifecycle governance
* Attention to detail with the ability to apply structured QC checklists accurately and consistently across high volumes
* Comfort working with AI\-enabled or automated QC tools where rules and templates are defined


**Education  :** 
 A scientific, medical, life sciences, or health economics degree is required
   

  

**Languages  :** 
 Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous

 Competitive Salary \+ Performance Annual Bonus

title: QA Lead
description:
**Test Lead – Retail \& Enterprise Applications**
**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced and strategic
 **Test Lead** 
 to lead Quality Engineering and Testing within our Global Capability Center (GCC). This role will oversee testing across
 **6\+ Agile delivery pods** 
 , managing a team of approximately
 **15 QA professionals** 
 supporting Retail Operations, POS, Inventory, Merchandising, Supply Chain, and SAP\-integrated applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in test leadership, release management, stakeholder communication, and enterprise application integration testing. This individual will define testing strategy, drive release readiness, establish quality governance, and ensure successful delivery across a portfolio of business\-critical initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Leadership \& Delivery Management**
* 
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 15\+ QA professionals across multiple Agile pods.
+ Establish testing standards, governance processes, and quality metrics across the portfolio.
+ Manage QA resourcing, capacity planning, performance, and team growth.
+ Drive continuous improvement and promote a quality\-first culture.


**Test Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* 
+ Define and execute portfolio\-level test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, UAT, end\-to\-end, and non\-functional testing.
+ Oversee testing activities across multiple projects, releases, and delivery teams.
+ Manage test environments, dependencies, defects, risks, and issue resolution.
+ Provide visibility into testing progress, quality metrics, and key risks.


**Release Planning \& Governance**
* 
+ Lead release planning, test execution, release readiness reviews, and go\-live activities.
+ Define quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and release sign\-off recommendations.
+ Coordinate testing efforts across business, technology, and vendor teams.
+ Support production validation and post\-release verification.


**Retail \& Enterprise Application Testing**
 Lead testing across Retail and Store Operations platforms, including POS Systems, Inventory Management, Pricing \& Promotions, Loyalty Programs, Order Management, Payments, Omnichannel Retail Processes.
   

  

* 
+ Ensure successful end\-to\-end validation of business processes across retail and SAP ecosystems.
+ Oversee API, integration, batch, and middleware testing involving SAP and third\-party applications.


**Stakeholder Management**
* 
+ Act as the primary QA lead for business and technology stakeholders.
+ Provide regular updates on testing status, release readiness, risks, and mitigation plans.
+ Facilitate defect triage, quality reviews, and release governance meetings.
+ Deliver executive\-level reporting through quality dashboards and KPIs.


**Continuous Improvement**
* 
+ Drive adoption of automation, shift\-left testing, and quality engineering best practices.
+ Establish and monitor KPIs such as test coverage, defect leakage, release stability, automation coverage, and production defects.
+ Continuously improve testing efficiency, release predictability, and product quality.


**Required Qualifications**
* 
+ Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
+ 12\+ years of experience in Software Testing and Quality Assurance.
+ 5\+ years of experience leading QA teams and enterprise testing programs.
+ Proven experience managing testing across multiple Agile teams, products, or delivery pods.
+ Experience leading teams of 10\-15\+ QA resources.
+ Strong experience with Retail Operations, POS, or enterprise business applications.
+ Experience with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, or SAP\-integrated environments.
+ Strong expertise in API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
+ Experience with Agile Scrum, SAFe, or similar delivery methodologies.
+ Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), or similar tools.
+ Strong understanding of release management, quality governance, and testing best practices.
+ Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 
+ Experience operating within a Global Capability Center (GCC) model.
+ Retail industry experience supporting store operations and POS platforms.
+ Experience defining test automation strategies and implementing automation frameworks.
+ Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
+ Familiarity with SAP Retail, SAP CAR, SAP CPI, and related SAP technologies.
+ ISTQB Advanced, Test Manager, or equivalent certification.

title: Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise\-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non\-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.
   

  

 You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long\-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi\-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure\-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative\-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic\-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role where we establish the production\-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign\-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent\-a\-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI engineers, platform engineers, and the evaluation team, embedding quality from the design stage rather than inspecting for it at the end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent\-developer experience as the SDK evolves
* Build automated tests for long\-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable\-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
* Automate multi\-tenant isolation verification cross\-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost\-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
* Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations
* AI\-Specific \& Non\-Deterministic Testing
* Design test strategies for LLM\-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic\-similarity scoring, confidence\-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
* Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document\-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool\-call hijack, and data\-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red\-team taxonomies
* Verify Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
* Partner with the evaluation function on golden\-dataset\-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic\-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable
* Performance, Reliability \& NFR Verification
* Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95\), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
* Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first\-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost\-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
* Process, Evidence \& Collaboration
* Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per\-metric regression flagging on pull requests
* Produce auditable, reproducible test\-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign\-off
* Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
* Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
* Mentor mid\-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
* Hands\-on experience testing LLM\-powered or other non\-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual\-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
* Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
* Solid SQL and data\-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test\-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
* A security\-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt\-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
* Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non\-engineering stakeholders
* Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
* QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript\-based) and integrating them into high\-security CI/CD pipelines
* AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems
* Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning


**Desirable**
* Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
* Prior testing of multi\-tenant SaaS isolation
* Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
* Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
* Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document\-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
* Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
* Performance Testing: Experience testing high\-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
* Experience with qTest for test management


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
   

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

description:

 •     Error Analysis: When the AI makes a mistake, investigate why. Was the hospital note messy? Did the AI misunderstand a medical abbreviation?
 



 •     Prompt Writing: Work with our team to rewrite the AI’s instructions (prompts) in plain, logical English to prevent the same mistakes from happening again.
 



 •     Continuous Improvement: Curate examples of highly complex medical records to continuously test the AI’s performance as it evolves.
 



**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 •     Act as the bridge between the clinical/underwriting world and the software engineering team.
 



 •     Translate complex clinical concepts into simple rules that developers and machine learning models can follow.

 •     Experience: 3\+ years in clinical data abstraction, medical coding, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), nursing, or health informatics.
 



 •     Domain Expertise: Deep, native understanding of medical terminology, pharmacology, disease pathways, and how to navigate messy Electronic Health Records (EHR) or unstructured clinical notes.
 



 •     Meticulous Attention to Detail: A zero\-tolerance policy for medical inaccuracies and a passion for spotting inconsistencies that others miss.
 



 •     Tech\-Forward Mindset: Highly computer literate, adaptable to new software, and eager to learn how Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT work behind the scenes.

title: Software QA Engineer - Physics AI
description:
**We are Siemens**
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
   

  

 Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting\-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains \- from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.
   

  

 We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer \- Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI\-enabled engineering simulation capabilities.
   

  

 In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics\-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results.
   

  

 This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem\-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI\-enabled physics and simulation software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results.
* Own end\-to\-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI\-enabled simulation capabilities.
* Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end\-to\-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases.
* Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high\-performance systems where appropriate.
* Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.
* Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.


**Qualifications**
* 4–6\+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands\-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation.
* 1–3\+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products.
* Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI\-driven predictions against physics\-based, simulation, or solver\-generated reference results.
* Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post\-processing tools is highly valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands\-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI\-enabled engineering applications.
* Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross\-platform desktop software testing.
* Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system\-level testing.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self\-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies.


**Why Us**
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work \- hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
 Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high\-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
   

  

 As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high\-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
   

  

 Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team \- we’d love to have you apply!
   

  

**About The Role**
 This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare\-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post\-silicon environments.
   

  

 The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first\-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional\-safety and high\-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL\-D, where applicable
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare\-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault\-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post\-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first\-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262\-aligned requirements\-based testing, safety\-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL\-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring\-up


**About You**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8\+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C\+\+ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.
* Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with test planning, requirements\-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety\-critical standards; ASIL\-D validation experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety\-quality processes.
* Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with bare\-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex\-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power.
* Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results.
* Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post\-silicon bring\-up, or lab automation is a plus.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with bare\-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post\-silicon bring\-up.
* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test\-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.
* Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.


 At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long\-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
   

  

**Benefits Highlights Include**
* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work\-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.


 And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud\-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

**Experience**

**Other Requirements**
* Excellent communications skills.
* Working knowledge of current WCAG standards is required.
* Basic knowledge of EU EN 301 549 is preferred.
* Working knowledge and experience working with a variety of assistive technologies is required.
* Working knowledge and experience with evaluating web applications (HTML/Javascript/CSS) and using accessibility inspection tools is required.

 **Senior Software Test Engineer**

Your role will have a significant impact on enhancing the efficiency, scalability and reliability of our products, ensuring an exceptional user experience.
   

  

 This position is ideal for a seasoned professional with a strong technical foundation, excellent problem\-solving skills and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high\-quality software products.

* The Sr Software Test Engineer will be responsible for end\-to\-end testing activities.
* Develop and execute test plans consisting of both manual and automated test cases to validate software functionality against requirements and specifications.
* Identify, troubleshoot, report, and track software defects and issues.
* Perform functional, performance, and regression testing of software products.

* Provide suggestions and feedback to improve the quality of the software development process across teams.
* Stay updated with industry trends in software testing methodologies and tools.
* Active participation in planning, analysis, and estimation of backlog requirements.
* Configure test environments with different platform combinations for testing.
* Ability to work in a close team environment and engage with other departments.
* Able to work with minimal supervision and still meet job requirements and tight deadlines.
* Learn an automation tool (if new to automation) and automate the test cases.
* Learn a performance testing tool (if new to performance testing) and run the performance test cases.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 4\-6 years of experience in software testing
* Extensive experience with manual and automated testing methodologies, including functional, regression and performance testing.
* Experience in test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium or playwright
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner or other related tools to validate scalability and system performance under load.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, isolate and troubleshoot issues, ensuring high\-quality test coverage.

* Previous experience with Reconciliation and/or month\-end close applications is preferred

* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Superior analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Desire to work in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment
* Detail\-oriented with excellent organization skills
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Creative and Innovative thinking
* Embraces change, growth, and evolution

title: RC FS-BT INS-Life and Annuity Conversion workstream-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life \& Annuity Manager position:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Lead Policy Administration System (PAS) conversion initiatives (legacy to modern platforms) across Life, Annuity, and Group business lines, ensuring alignment with defined scope, timelines, and business objectives.
* Drive data migration and conversion activities, including Defining and validating data quality rules, profiling, cleansing, mapping, and transformation logic, Establishing audit controls, tolerance thresholds, and validation metrics
* Work closely with source and target system experts to define Data architecture and conversion design decisions, mapping logic and transformation rules, data cleansing and standardization criteria.
* Communicate complex conversion trade\-offs effectively to senior stakeholders, actuarial/finance teams, and technical audiences, enabling informed decision\-making in large transformation programs.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 10 to 15 years of experience working in Life \& Annuity insurance domain.


**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**
* Hands\-on expertise in policy administration data migration, including Conversion strategy and execution planning, Data quality frameworks, audit controls, and governance practices
* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.


**Ideally, good to have**
* Good understanding of SQL, stored procedures, and ETL frameworks, with the ability to support data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting in large\-scale migration programs.
* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Embedded & Flight Software QA Engineer
description:
**Role:** 
 Embedded \& Flight Software QA Engineer
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Space Technology
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–4 Years
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an Embedded and Flight Software QA Engineer with 3–4 years of experience to support verification and validation of embedded controllers, flight software, hardware interfaces, and software delivery pipelines. The role requires strong hands\-on skills in test planning, requirements analysis, test case design, test execution, defect reporting, and automation across hardware and software environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze system, software, and hardware requirements and derive detailed verification objectives.
* Create, review, and maintain test plans, test procedures, test cases, test scripts, and test reports.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, interface, and system\-level tests for embedded and flight software.
* Perform testing using both hardware\-in\-the\-loop and software\-based simulation environments.
* Verify controller behavior, communication interfaces, device drivers, sensor/actuator integration, and fault handling logic.
* Support DevOps and CI/CD workflows for automated build, test, quality checks, and release validation.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and utilities using Python, C, and C\+\+ where applicable.
* Log, track, debug, and verify defects in collaboration with embedded software, firmware, systems, and hardware teams.
* Ensure compliance with defined test processes, documentation standards, review practices, and quality gates.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, test coverage, automation strategy, and verification efficiency.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 3–4 years of experience in embedded software QA, flight software QA, firmware testing, or related verification roles.
* Strong understanding of embedded systems, microcontrollers, processors, peripherals, and board\-level interfaces.
* Hands\-on knowledge of communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, or similar protocols.
* Experience in requirement\-based testing, test case writing, test execution, traceability, and verification documentation.
* Exposure to hardware test setups, lab equipment, debugging tools, emulators, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, or equivalent environments.
* Programming and scripting experience in C, C\+\+, and Python.
* Working knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control, build systems, and automated test execution.
* Ability to understand software architecture, interface control documents, state machines, timing behavior, and failure modes.
* Good analytical, debugging, communication, and documentation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with aerospace, satellite, avionics, robotics, automotive, defense, or mission\-critical embedded systems.
* Familiarity with software verification life cycles, quality standards, configuration management, and release processes.
* Knowledge of test automation frameworks, static analysis tools, code coverage, continuous integration dashboards, and issue tracking tools.
* Exposure to hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, simulation environments, telemetry validation, command handling, or real\-time embedded systems.


**Tools And Technologies**
* Languages: C, C\+\+, Python
* DevOps and CI/CD: Git, build pipelines, automated test execution, code quality checks, and release validation workflows
* Testing: Requirement\-based testing, regression testing, integration testing, interface testing, hardware/software environment testing
* Hardware: Controllers, peripherals, communication interfaces, lab equipment, and embedded debugging environments


 What we are looking for: a detail\-oriented QA professional who can work closely with embedded software, hardware, systems, and mission teams to ensure reliable, testable, and high\-quality flight software. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in lab environments, debugging complex issues, improving test automation, and maintaining strong verification discipline throughout the development life cycle.

title: Software Tester / QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Software Tester / QA Engineer** to join our software development team. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, functionality, and performance of our software products.

Our primary focus is **ERP software**, along with **CRM, HRMS, web applications, and mobile applications**. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **Manual Testing, Automation Testing, and UAT**, with hands\-on knowledge of **Java and Selenium**.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **Manual, Automation, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**.
* Test ERP, CRM, HRMS, web\-based applications, and mobile applications.
* Understand business requirements, functional specifications, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Prepare and execute **test cases, test scenarios, test plans, and test scripts**.
* Perform **Functional, Regression, Integration, System, UAT, UI, and Exploratory Testing**.
* Develop and maintain automation test scripts using **Java and Selenium**.
* Conduct **UAT based on real\-world business scenarios and user workflows**.
* Validate that developed features meet business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with business users/stakeholders during UAT and document their feedback.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects.
* Perform end\-to\-end testing of complex business workflows.
* Test different user roles, permissions, approvals, and workflow processes.
* Verify data flow and integration between different modules and applications.
* Validate reports, calculations, business rules, transactions, and data accuracy.
* Perform regression testing after new features, changes, and bug fixes.
* Perform API testing and integration testing where required.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, project managers, and end users to resolve issues.
* Participate in requirement analysis and provide QA inputs during the development process.
* Ensure software releases meet defined quality standards before deployment.

**ERP \& Business Application Knowledge**

Good understanding of ERP modules and business workflows is preferred, including:

* Accounting \& Finance
* General Ledger
* Accounts Payable \& Receivable
* Inventory Management
* Purchase Management
* Sales \& Order Management
* HR \& Payroll
* Production / Manufacturing
* CRM
* Reporting \& Analytics
* Approval \& Workflow Management
* User Roles \& Permissions
* Inter\-module transactions and data flow

Experience in testing **ERP or other enterprise/business applications** will be highly preferred.

Technical Skills

**Mandatory:**

* Minimum **2 years of experience in Software Testing / QA**
* Strong experience in **Manual Testing**
* Hands\-on experience in **Automation Testing**
* Good knowledge of **Java**
* Hands\-on experience with **Selenium WebDriver**
* Experience with **TestNG / JUnit** or similar frameworks
* Good understanding of **SDLC and STLC**
* Experience in **Functional, Regression, Integration, and UAT Testing**

**Good to Have:**

* API Testing – Postman or similar tools
* SQL and Database Testing
* Git / Version Control
* Mobile Application Testing
* Cross\-browser and responsive testing
* CI/CD and automation integration
* Performance testing knowledge

**UAT \& Business Process Skills**

The candidate should be able to:

* Understand real\-world business processes and convert them into test scenarios.
* Prepare UAT scenarios based on business requirements.
* Validate complete **end\-to\-end workflows** across multiple modules.
* Identify gaps between business requirements and system functionality.
* Work with users/stakeholders to collect and document UAT feedback.
* Verify that issues identified during UAT are properly resolved.
* Support final validation and release readiness.
