title: SDET 2
description:
**Who we are :** 




 Money. A subject that’s always on our mind. We go through a rollercoaster of emotions when it comes to money. That’s why at Jupiter, our mission is to enable people to improve their relationship with money.
 



 We are a financial services platform that leverages technology to offer our customers seamless and user\-friendly products related to banking, loans, and investments. So whether it’s a savings account, credit cards, investment and payments, it's all on Jupiter. We also help users cut through the banking jargons, offer smart insights based on spending and provide users with a range of new age features to enable and make sense of their finances.
 



**Our journey so far:** 




 Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer\-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea : to create a modern, customer\-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.
 



 From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter \- and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2\.8 million \+ happy users on Jupiter.
 



 Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head\-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No\-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/\- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.
 



 We've embraced cutting\-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like\-minded folks to join the crew.
 



**Role Overview** 




 As an SDET at Jupiter, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless performance and reliability of our products. You will design and develop scalable automation frameworks, enhance test coverage, and proactively identify potential issues to maintain top\-notch quality standards.
 



 A milestone\-focused approach will be key, ensuring continuous improvements in test efficiency and reliability. This role requires a perfect blend of technical expertise, problem\-solving skills, and a passion for building robust systems that support Jupiter’s mission of redefining banking.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks for web, mobile, and APIs, ensuring scalability and reusability.
* Test Planning \& Execution: Define and implement test strategies, create detailed test plans, and perform functional, regression, and integration testing.
* CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitor builds, and troubleshoot test failures to ensure smooth deployments.
* Defect Identification \& Root Cause Analysis: Identify, document, and analyze defects with detailed root cause analysis to facilitate quick resolution.
* Collaboration with Cross\-Functional Teams: Work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to align quality processes with business goals.
* Performance \& Security Testing: Conduct performance, load, and security testing to identify bottlenecks and vulnerabilities, ensuring system stability.
* Process Improvement \& Mentorship: Continuously enhance testing processes, tools, and methodologies while mentoring junior team members to build a strong quality culture.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* 3\-6 years of experience as an SDET with a strong focus on backend testing and automation.
* Mobile app testing exposure is an added advantage.
* Proficiency in Python is highly preferred, though extensive backend automation experience with any language is acceptable.
* Hands\-on experience in microservices environments with knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, along with Kubernetes expertise.
* Strong debugging skills across large tech stacks, with the ability to perform root cause analysis (RCA) effectively.
* Familiarity with Linux OS and the ability to work efficiently in a Linux\-based environment.
* Mentoring experience and guiding junior engineers is a desirable plus.



**Why you should work with us:** 



* We like people who behave like owners, and we place a high regard on those who take ownership and see projects through to completion.
* We take pleasure in tackling meaningful problems by understanding pain points and developing intuitive experiences that delight customers.
* We appreciate those who can participate in healthy conflict and can commit to every decision as if it were their own. We value consent over consensus.
* In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we consistently set higher standards. If you crave continuous learning, growth, and improvement in a dynamic environment, choosing Jupiter is the right move.

title: Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and test frameworks using C\# and .NET.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable automation components following coding best practices.
* Create automated test cases covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Debug automation failures and collaborate with developers to identify and resolve software defects.
* Create automated test cases covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and delivery.
* Monitor automation execution results and continuously improve test stability, execution time, and reliability.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the automation framework, tools, processes, and testing practices.
* Create automated test cases covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Ensure automated testing aligns with project quality standards, coding guidelines, and security requirements.


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
   

  

**Work Experience**
* Strong programming experience in C\#.
* Good knowledge of .NET / .NET Core.
* Experience developing automated tests using C\#.
* Good understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
* Experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium.
* Experience with API testing and REST services.
* Good understanding of unit testing frameworks such as NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest.

The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare\-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post\-silicon environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test\-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth** 




 In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long\-term life goals \- retirement, education, and financial freedom.
 



  





**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia** 
 . However, we are not a one\-trick robo\-advisor. We are a full\-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short\-term cash management to long\-term retirement planning).
 



 Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (\~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter\-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.
 



**This is not an 'offshore' support role.** 
 Our India team is a
 **core product hub** 
 , operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end\-to\-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.
 



  





**The Role: Engineering Confidence** 




 Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.
 



 Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."
 



 Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.
 


* **Engineer the Safety Net** 
 : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack \- from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left** 
 : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality** 
 : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity** 
 : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience** 
 : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real\-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.



  





**Our Tech Stack** 



* **Web Automation** 
 : We use
 **Playwright** 
 for high\-speed, reliable end\-to\-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation** 
 : We use
 **Cucumber\-Scala** 
 to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation** 
 : We leverage
 **Maestro E2E** 
 and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops** 
 : We are 100% cloud\-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
 **CI/CD** 
 to run your tests on every commit.



**Want to look under the hood?** 
 Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
 
 tech.endowus.com
 




  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* **First 30 Days (Immersion)** 
 : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)** 
 : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)** 
 : You now own the test planning \& execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.



  





**What You Bring (Requirements)** 




 We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:
 



**Must\-Haves** 
 :
 


* **4\+ Years of Test Engineering** 
 : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals** 
 : You are proficient in at least one major language (
 **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python** 
 ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence** 
 : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
 **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium** 
 . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA** 
 : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset** 
 : You don't wait for a "hand\-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better



**Nice\-to\-Haves** 
 :
 


* **Mobile Automation** 
 : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing** 
 : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain** 
 : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high\-security environments



  





**Why Endowus?** 



* **Modern Stack, Serious Business** 
 : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission\-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top\-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World\-Class Engineering Talent** 
 : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside** 
 : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high\-talent team (\~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree** 
 : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.



  





**Why NOT Endowus?** 




 We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.
 


* **You prefer 100% Automation** 
 : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside\-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure** 
 : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand\-offs from developers, you might find our cross\-functional team structure (Backend \+ Frontend \+ QA \+ PM \+ Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning** 
 : If you do your best work when given a pre\-written test plan to execute step\-by\-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote** 
 : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in\-person collaboration



  





**The Interview Process** 




 We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.
 


* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands\-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture \& Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

**Summary**
 Under limited supervision designs, develops and maintains test procedures, tester hardware and software for electronic circuit board production.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**
* Review circuit board designs for testability requirements.
* Support manufacturing with failure analysis, tester debugging, reduction of intermittent failures and downtime of test equipment.
* Prepare recommendations for testing and documentation of procedures to be used from the product design phase through to initial production.
* Generate reports and analysis of test data, prepares documentation and recommendations.
* Review test equipment designs, data and RMA issues with customers regularly.
* Design, and direct engineering and technical personnel in fabrication of testing and test control apparatus and equipment.
* Direct and coordinate engineering activities concerned with development, procurement, installation, and calibration of instruments, equipment, and control devices required to test, record, and reduce test data.
* Determine conditions under which tests are to be conducted and sequences and phases of test operations.
* Direct and exercise control over operational, functional, and performance phases of tests.
* Perform moderately complex assignments of the engineering test function for standard and/or custom devices.
* Analyze and interpret test data and prepares technical reports for use by test engineering and management personnel.
* Develop or use computer software and hardware to conduct tests on machinery and equipment.
* Perform semi\-routine technique development and maintenance, subject to established Jabil standards, including ISO and QS development standards.
* May provide training in new procedures to production testing staff.
* Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
* Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Bachelors of Science in Electronics or Electrical Engineering from four\-year college or university preferred; or related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

**Language Skills**
 Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
   

  

**Mathematical Skills**
 Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
   

  

 REASONING ABILITY
   

  

 Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
   

  

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS
   

  

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is frequently required to walk, and to lift and carry PC’s and test equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and use of computer monitor screens a great deal of time.
   

  

 WORK ENVIRONMENT
   

  

 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Individual’s primary workstation is located in the office area, with some time spent each day on the manufacturing floor. The noise level in this environment ranges from low to moderate.

description:

For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.

With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Performance / Load Testing Domain Lead provides leadership for the performance testing capability within the SQA organization, supporting enterprise applications through performance, load, stress, and scalability testing. This role defines and maintains performance testing practices, standards, and execution approaches to ensure systems meet expected levels of responsiveness, stability, and reliability.
   

  

 The Domain Lead serves as a hands?on technical leader, guiding a small team of performance testing specialists while remaining directly involved in complex or high?risk initiatives. The role mentors team members, reviews work products, and establishes best practices for workload design, test execution, results analysis, and performance risk reporting.
   

  

 Working closely with application development teams, architecture, infrastructure/cloud partners, and internal performance engineering resources, the Domain Lead helps identify and address performance risks early in the delivery lifecycle. The role supports a diverse application portfolio, including modern cloud?native and AI?driven solutions, applying data?driven and intelligent techniques to improve testing efficiency, insight, and consistency.
   

  

 Success in this role is demonstrated by improved performance readiness, reduced performance?related production issues, consistent application of performance testing standards, and the ongoing development of a skilled and effective performance testing team.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead the SQA performance testing discipline across the enterprise, covering performance, load, stress, scalability, and stability testing.
* Define and maintain standardized performance testing practices, workload modeling approaches, and execution guidelines used across supported application teams.
* Serve as a hands?on technical leader for complex or high?risk initiatives, providing direct contribution and guidance in test design, execution strategy, and results interpretation.
* Mentor and coach a small team of performance testing specialists, reviewing work products and building team capability through lead?by?example practices.

* Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks and systemic constraints, and drive remediation and verification activities with stakeholders.

* Strong understanding of test environment planning, readiness criteria, access models, and dependency management across multiple SDLC phases.
* Broad knowledge of software quality assurance practices spanning functional, integration, end?to?end, automation, performance, security, and accessibility testing.
* Working knowledge of cloud and hybrid application environments and their impact on test data provisioning and environment stability.
* Understanding of data privacy, security, and regulatory considerations as they apply to test data and non?production environments.
* Ability to apply AI?enabled approaches to improve test data generation, readiness validation, risk detection, and execution efficiency.
* Experience integrating test data and environment readiness checks into CI/CD pipelines and automated quality workflows.
* Strong analytical skills to identify systemic risks, trends, and execution blockers related to data or environment constraints.
* Proven ability to define standards, frameworks, and playbooks and drive adoption across distributed SQA teams.
* Effective cross?functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering, platform, security, and data stakeholders without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for documenting standards, readiness criteria, and risk assessments.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in performance testing and performance engineering roles.
* Demonstrated hands?on experience conducting performance, load, stress, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring a small team of technical specialists through direct contribution and coaching.
* Experience supporting multiple application teams across complex, distributed environments.
* Strong collaboration experience with application development, architecture, infrastructure/cloud, and performance engineering stakeholders.

title: Senior Technical Lead - Software Quality Assurance
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a forward\-thinking Senior Technical Lead QA to lead, scale, and transform our Quality Engineering practice.
   

  

 In this role, you will oversee end\-to\-end quality across our consumer\-facing e\-commerce applications (Web \& Mobile) and our core backend systems, including Odoo ERP integrations (inventory, OMS, Sale/Purchase, and retail POS).
   

  

 You will lead a high\-performing team of QA Engineers, building a high\-velocity, low\-defect delivery ecosystem.
   

  

 Additionally, you will pioneer the adoption of AI\-assisted testing tools and workflows to automate test case generation, optimize regression runs, and elevate overall developer and QA productivity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* E2E Quality Architecture: Design and maintain scalable, robust automation frameworks for Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), and REST APIs across high\-traffic e\-commerce systems.
* Odoo ERP \& Backend Validation: Lead integration testing between front\-end storefronts and Odoo ERP modules (order state transitions, inventory sync, warehouse flows, and payment reconciliations etc.).
* AI\-Augmented QA: Integrate AI/LLM tools (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, automated test generators, visual regression) into daily workflows to cut regression overhead and boost QA/dev productivity.
* CI/CD \& Shift\-Left Testing: Embed automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins) to enable fast, reliable daily deployments with zero\-manual\-regression overhead.
* Performance \& Scalability: Plan and execute load/stress testing (JMeter, Locust) for flash sales, campaign spikes, and peak seasonal traffic.
* Technical Mentorship: Guide, mentor, and review code for a team of 4 \- 6 SDETs/QA engineers while remaining hands\-on with framework architecture.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 8 \- 10 years in Software Quality Engineering with strong hands\-on automation expertise and proven technical leadership.
* E\-Commerce \& ERP Domain: Strong background testing B2C e\-commerce platforms and backend integrations with Odoo ERP (or similar enterprise OMS/WMS platforms).
* Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python or Java/JavaScript, along with solid SQL skills (PostgreSQL) for complex data verification.
* Automation Frameworks: Deep hands\-on experience with Appium, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or RestAssured.
* AI\-Assisted Engineering: Working familiarity with using AI coding assistants and LLM workflows to automate edge\-case discovery, script authoring, and test triage.
* Performance \& API Testing: Strong grasp of Postman, Newman, JMeter/Locust, and microservices architecture.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Odoo module architectures, PostgreSQL datastores, and Python\-based custom modules.
* Experience in omnichannel retail setups bridging online platforms with physical store/POS operations.


**Key Mindset \& Competencies**
* Obsession with End\-User Experience: Zero tolerance for checkout friction, order dropping, or data mismatch between store and warehouse.
* Pragmatic AI Champion: Passionate about leveraging new technology to eliminate boilerplate QA work and let engineers focus on complex system risks.
* Cross\-Functional Influence: Ability to effectively communicate quality risks to business leads, product directors, and dev teams.


**Why Join Us? :**
* Scale \& Impact: Drive tech and quality strategy for a beloved brand serving millions of customers across online and retail channels.
* Innovation Focus: Direct sponsorship to experiment with AI tooling, test automation, and cutting\-edge DevOps workflows.
* Growth \& Culture: Competitive pay, comprehensive health coverage, and a fast\-paced product culture.

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
****Senior Manager, Quality Engineering — AI\-Native \& Hands\-On****
**Company:** 
 Practice by Numbers
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon In\-Office \| Full\-Time
   

  

**About Practice By Numbers**
 Practice by Numbers builds an integrated business management platform for dental practices. Our products span business analytics, patient communication, VoIP, payments, and AI\-powered call intelligence — from PracticeIQ for intelligent analytics to PbN VOICE, PbN Payments, and Call AI.
   

  

 We're a profitable SaaS company approaching eight figures in revenue, grown mostly organically through product excellence, inbound\-driven sales, and an obsession with customer outcomes. Our software runs the daily operations of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs. When we ship a defect, a front desk can't collect a payment, a patient doesn't get a reminder, or a practice owner makes a decision on a number that's wrong. Reliability, accuracy, and privacy are not abstractions here.
   

  

****Our Culture****
 We're curious, collaborative, and customer\-obsessed. QA at Practice by Numbers is not about finding bugs — it's about building confidence in every release. Quality Engineering partners closely with product managers and developers so that quality is designed in rather than inspected in at the end.
   

  

****Our values****
* Transparency: We communicate honestly with our teams and our customers.
* Accountability: We own quality outcomes and never compromise on reliability.
* Innovation: We champion smarter, scalable QA practices and automation.
* Empathy: We test from the user’s perspective, ensuring real\-world value.


 We prefer evidence over ceremony, shared ownership over functional silos, and durable engineering over manual heroics.
   

  

****The Role****
 We are looking for a highly technical Senior Manager of Quality Engineering to lead a team of 6 to 10 QA and Quality Engineers and modernize how quality is built into our products.
   

  

**This is not a traditional QA management role.** 
 We do not believe quality scales by maintaining a fixed developer\-to\-QA ratio. We expect this leader to increase quality and release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through engineering, AI, observability, and shared ownership. If our engineering team goes from 20 developers to 35, the plan is not five more testers; the plan is a quality organization that got better at leverage.
   

  

 We are not looking for someone to build a larger manual regression organization or to measure success by test\-case counts. We're looking for someone who raises release confidence through better engineering: reliable automation, AI\-assisted workflows, production observability, sharp risk judgment, tests placed at the right layer, and quality that developers and product managers share ownership of rather than outsource.
   

  

**You will stay meaningfully hands\-on.** 
 You will personally write and review automation code, design testing architecture, investigate difficult production issues, analyze failures, and improve CI/CD quality systems. This is not a coordination\-only position, and the technical work will not be delegated to an automation team while you run the process.
   

  

**You will not be the last gate before release.** 
 Your responsibility is not to become the department that owns quality on behalf of everyone else. It is to build the automated gates, risk signals, and observability that let Engineering and Product make informed release decisions together — and to challenge a release, clearly and with evidence, when the risk isn't worth it.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Establish a modern quality\-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering, and define risk\-based testing strategies for our critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Determine where specialized quality engineers add the greatest leverage, and where developer\-owned tests, architecture, observability, automation, or product\-design changes should carry the load instead.
* Improve requirements, acceptance criteria, technical designs, testability, error handling, and observability before implementation begins.
* Own the architecture and evolution of our web, API, integration, and end\-to\-end automation, and personally build and maintain production\-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test\-data systems, environment configuration, reporting, and parallel execution.
* Review pull requests, debug framework and pipeline failures, and establish engineering standards for the team.
* Partner with developers to place tests at the correct layer, including unit, component, contract, API, and integration, rather than over\-relying on slow or brittle UI automation.
* Integrate high\-signal suites into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar pipelines and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability. Treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects, not weather.
* Use exploratory and manual testing deliberately for discovery, usability, and unknown failure modes, not as the default mechanism for repeated regression validation.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in your own daily engineering workflow across requirements analysis, test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and log and incident analysis. Establish practical AI\-assisted workflows for the team and measure whether they actually improve development time, maintenance effort, diagnosis time, or release\-validation speed.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated code, tests, and analysis for correctness, maintainability, security, and privacy, and coach the team on detecting plausible but incorrect output.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for our AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversations. Build repeatable evaluations using representative datasets, scoring rubrics, adversarial scenarios, and human review, covering accuracy, context retention, fallback logic, hallucination risk, unsafe output, privacy, and latency, and catch regressions caused by model, prompt, retrieval, or data changes.
* Investigate production and pre\-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, monitoring platforms, and error tracking. Lead root\-cause analysis that addresses the architectural, testing, observability, or ownership gap that allowed the defect to escape.
* Strengthen post\-release validation, synthetic monitoring, and production feedback loops so customer\-impacting failures are found by us, not by a practice manager on the phone. Partner with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Support to reduce repeat incidents.
* Maintain a small set of quality signals that mean something, including escaped severe defects, repeat incidents, flaky\-test rate, time to trustworthy feedback, release\-validation time, and coverage of key risks. Provide clear release\-risk recommendations backed by automated quality gates rather than manual approval.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6 to 10 QA and Quality Engineers through clear goals, one\-on\-ones, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, onboarding, and career growth. Raise the technical bar and help people move from test execution toward higher\-leverage quality engineering.
* Represent quality in sprint planning, estimation, refinement, and retrospectives so risk is part of delivery planning rather than a downstream surprise. Create accountability without unnecessary process, and scale quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.


**Required Experience**
* Substantial experience in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including meaningful experience leading and developing engineers. Candidates will typically have 8 or more years of relevant experience and roughly 3 or more years of people leadership, but demonstrated impact matters more than tenure alone.
* Recent hands\-on coding. You have personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last year, and you can talk through it in detail.
* Strong software\-engineering ability in TypeScript, JavaScript, or a comparable programming language.
* Strong experience with modern browser and API automation. Playwright and TypeScript are preferred. Candidates coming from Selenium, Cypress, or another ecosystem must demonstrate strong current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience designing automation systems, not only adding scripts to an existing framework.
* Strong understanding of test layering, API and integration testing, asynchronous systems, distributed SaaS architectures, databases, third\-party integrations, and failure handling.
* Experience integrating automated validation into CI/CD pipelines and improving execution reliability and speed.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents. You can describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, the limits you hit, and a concrete case where the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
* Strong production\-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, network requests, and application behavior.
* A track record of improving quality without a proportional increase in manual QA headcount.
* Strong judgment about when to automate, when to fix the underlying design, when developers should own the test, and when exploratory human testing adds the most value.
* Strong communication skills, experience with distributed teams, and the willingness to challenge unclear requirements, fragile designs, or high\-risk releases using evidence rather than hierarchy.


**Preferred Experience**
* Testing AI assistants, LLM\-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, analytics, or other business\-critical platforms.
* Mobile automation, cloud systems, distributed architectures, third\-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, and observability testing.
* Experience transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.
* Experience supporting enterprise or multi\-location customers.


****Candidate Mindset****
 The right candidate is hands\-on, AI\-native, and focused on the quality of work. They balance release speed with customer trust, make decisions based on risk and evidence, build accountability without unnecessary process, and set a high technical bar for the team.
   

  

**This Role Is Probably Not The Right Fit If**
* Your primary model for improving quality is adding more manual testers as the development organization grows.
* You believe QA should be solely responsible for testing and approving everything developers build.
* You measure QA productivity mainly through test\-case counts, defect counts, or automation\-script counts.
* You have moved away from writing and reviewing technical work and expect an automation team to handle it for you.
* Your use of AI is limited to generating unchecked test cases or documentation.
* You prefer extensive process and approvals over engineering leverage, risk\-based judgment, and fast feedback.


 ﻿None of these make someone a poor QA leader. They make someone a poor fit for this particular role.
   

  

****Success Measures****
* Faster releases with no deterioration in reliability or customer trust.
* Fewer severe escaped defects and fewer repeat production incidents.
* Shorter time from code change to quality feedback the team can trust.
* Faster, more predictable release validation.
* A stable, maintainable, high\-signal automation portfolio and a falling flaky\-test rate.
* Reduced dependence on repeated manual regression testing.
* More coverage at the API, integration, contract, and component layers rather than excessive UI\-only automation.
* Faster production diagnosis and stronger incident\-prevention practices.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI\-assisted quality engineering without compromising correctness, privacy, or maintainability.
* A technically stronger team that can code, investigate, reason about risk, and contribute as engineering partners.


 We will not measure this role by the number of test cases, the number of automated tests, defects logged, headcount added, or automation coverage quoted without context — so please don't optimize for those.

title: Software Product Manager - CTI MD India
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

*At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.*
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital products within CTI\-MD. This role is ideal for a product professional who combines strong product management fundamentals with hands\-on technical expertise and can effectively bridge business, engineering, data, and operations teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will own products from discovery through delivery and adoption, partnering closely with scientists, business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data teams, and quality teams to solve complex business challenges within the pharmaceutical and life sciences domain.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role. While the primary responsibility is product leadership, the individual should be comfortable reading code, writing prototypes, analysing data, developing proof\-of\-concepts, and contributing technically when necessary.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Product Strategy \& Ownership**
* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a small to medium product, or for a major component of a larger CTI\-MD product.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, opportunities, and unmet needs.
* Translate business objectives into clear product strategies, measurable outcomes, and prioritized roadmaps.
* Define and track product success metrics and business value realized, demonstrating measurable improvement in key departmental KPIs.
* Identify market and industry opportunities that inform product direction and business unit goals.


**Product Discovery**
* Lead discovery activities including user research, workflow analysis, process mapping, and solution evaluation.
* Develop deep understanding of business processes and operational workflows.
* Validate assumptions through experimentation, data analysis, prototypes, and user feedback.


**Technical Product Leadership**
* Work closely with engineering teams to shape technical solutions and architecture decisions.
* Translate business requirements into detailed product and technical requirements.
* Evaluate technology options, architectural trade\-offs, integrations, scalability, and technical risks.
* Drive data\-driven, and platform\-thinking approaches.


**Delivery \& Execution**
* Partner with engineering teams through design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage product backlogs and prioritization decisions.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, compliance requirements, and technical constraints.
* Ensure products are delivered with quality, security, and operational excellence.


**AI \& Digital Innovation**
* Identify opportunities for AI, automation, analytics, and digital technologies within CTI\-MD products.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering and AI\-enabled product development practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential application to business challenges.


**Team First Mentality**
* Bring a no\-ego, team\-first mindset to all interactions, prioritizing shared success over individual recognition.
* Represent the product team with humility and integrity when engaging with stakeholders and partners.


**Knowledge Sharing \& Coaching**
* Share specialized product management practices and domain\-specific insights to help team members grow.
* Coach peers and engineering partners on discovery, prioritization, and outcome\-based product practices.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong relationships across business, scientific, regulatory, quality, and technology functions.
* Present product strategy, roadmap updates, and outcome metrics to leadership.
* Influence stakeholders across departments without formal authority, in global and cross\-functional settings.
* Make informed product decisions that balance business needs, technical constraints, and user value.


**Your Minimum Required Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 6\+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles.
* Experience leading software products through the full product lifecycle.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile environments.
* Demonstrated success delivering business outcomes through digital products.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong technical depth, with the ability to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions and to contribute hands\-on when required.
* Working knowledge of software engineering and system design fundamentals, including APIs, integrations, and scalability trade\-offs.
* Experience with cloud and data platforms.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts and how they apply to enterprise products.
* Familiarity with modern SDLC and DevOps practices, and with security, privacy, and compliance considerations in regulated environments.
* Read and reason about production code well enough to partner effectively with engineers on technical issues.
* Build prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept, scripts, or automations to test ideas and de\-risk decisions.


**What You Should Bring**
* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Clinical Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, or R\&D domains.
* Understanding of GxP, validation, data integrity, and regulated environments.
* Experience working with scientific, clinical, manufacturing, or laboratory systems.
* Experience with AI\-enabled products, data products, or enterprise platforms.
* MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.

title: Product Manager, AI & Data Products
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aleph\-Labs is a creative engineering company founded in 2006, strategically headquartered in Singapore and operating across the Asia Pacific region. The team of nearly 300 professionals collaborates across borders to design and deliver financial, internet, mobile, and desktop solutions for diverse clients. By combining deep expertise in both technology and design, Aleph\-Labs effectively bridges the gap between user experience and technical implementation. The company is strongly user\-centric, focusing on building applications that people love to use and that clients are proud to own. Team members are encouraged to apply their unique talents to solve complex challenges and create functional, flexible, and innovative products.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Product Manager, AI \& Data Products role based in Bengaluru South, with a hybrid work arrangement that allows some work from home. The Product Manager will define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI\-driven and data\-centric products, ensuring they align with client needs and Aleph\-Labs’ user\-centric approach. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include gathering and prioritizing requirements, collaborating with engineering, data science, design, and business stakeholders, and translating customer and market insights into clear product specifications and user stories. The role involves overseeing the product lifecycle from discovery and experimentation through development, launch, and iterative improvements, using data to validate hypotheses and guide decision\-making. The Product Manager will also monitor product performance, manage backlogs, coordinate releases, and communicate progress and risks to stakeholders, while ensuring compliance with relevant data governance and security standards.
 



  






 We are assembling a compact, high\-velocity AI product squad to turn complex workflows and data into useful, production\-grade products. We are looking for a hands\-on product leader who can move from an ambiguous problem to a tested product, then stay with it through deployment, adoption and measurable impact.
 





 This is not a coordination\-only product role. You will work directly with users, senior stakeholders, AI and data architects, engineers and design\-minded builders. You will bring a forward\-deployed mindset: close to real workflows, technically credible and accountable for whether the product succeeds in practice.
 




**Qualifications** 



* Discover and prioritize high\-value user problems through interviews, workflow observation, data analysis and rapid experimentation.
* Own the full 0\-to\-1 product lifecycle: opportunity framing, product strategy, requirements, prototyping, validation, launch, adoption and iteration.
* Translate messy business needs into crisp product decisions, user journeys, technical requirements, evaluation plans and delivery milestones.
* Partner closely with AI, data and software engineers to shape data foundations, model behavior, agent workflows, interfaces and production architecture.
* Decide when to use agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, conventional machine learning, deterministic software or a simpler operational change.
* Define product and AI quality measures, including adoption, task completion, output quality, groundedness, latency, cost, reliability and user trust.
* Design feedback loops, human\-in\-the\-loop controls and operating processes that make AI products safer and better over time.
* Use AI\-native tools such as Cursor, Codex and Claude Code to explore ideas, create lightweight prototypes and communicate more precisely with engineers.
* Build a focused roadmap, make explicit trade\-offs and maintain momentum without adding unnecessary process.
* Stay close to users after launch, identify where the product breaks down and convert real usage into the next product decision.
* 5\+ years of experience in product management or an adjacent product\-building role, with increasing ownership and scope.
* Evidence of having shipped at least two or three AI\- or data\-powered products from discovery through real\-world use.
* A strong technical foundation. You can engage credibly on APIs, data models, system trade\-offs, model limitations and deployment constraints.
* Working knowledge of modern AI product patterns, including LLMs, agents, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, guardrails and human oversight.
* Strong product judgment: the ability to distinguish a compelling demo from a product that solves a repeatable user problem.
* Comfort operating in a small, fast\-moving team where priorities evolve and individuals own outcomes rather than narrow functions.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder management and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.
* A record of using evidence and product metrics to make decisions, not simply tracking feature delivery.
* Experience in an AI, robotics, developer\-tools or data\-intensive startup.
* A software engineering, data engineering or technical solutions background; comfort with SQL or lightweight coding is a plus.
* Experience with enterprise workflows, sensitive data, security, governance or regulated environments.
* Experience in forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting or customer\-facing product roles.
* Being based in or within practical travelling distance of Bangalore is helpful, but not required.
* The squad works from a small set of well\-understood user problems and explicit outcome measures.
* Promising ideas become working prototypes quickly, and weak ideas are stopped before significant engineering effort is spent.
* At least one meaningful AI or data product moves from discovery to real user adoption, with quality and business impact measured.
* Product, engineering, data and design decisions happen together, without slow hand\-offs or unclear ownership.
* Users trust the products because limitations, evidence, failure states and human controls have been designed intentionally.

title: Staff Product Manager (International)
description:
**Job Summary** 
 : As a Staff Product Manager for JioHotstar’s Search, you'll work closely with senior product and engineering peers to shape a product strategy that drives measurable improvements in query understanding, ranking, search personalisation, cold start and content discovery across JioHotstar's 500M\+ user base. You will own the core search experience end\-to\-end \- from the search zero page, query understanding, ranking to results presentation and query\-assist surfaces (pills, suggestions, spell\-correct). Drawing on data, experimentation, and deep NLP/ML product instincts, you will identify gaps in query coverage and relevance, translate them into clear product requirements, and work with ML and engineering to ship improvements that move search success and engagement metrics at scale.
 



**About the Team:** 




 At JioHotstar, we're on a mission to deliver delightful experiences to our 500\+ million customers across the globe. Our technology spans multiple countries. The Search team sits within the Viewer Experience org and is responsible for helping every user find exactly what they're looking for through a state\-of\-the\-art search experience.
 



 We blend world\-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a fast, relevant search experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building intelligent search and query\-understanding systems that measurably improve how hundreds of millions of users discover content, join us in shaping the future of content discovery.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct thorough research and analysis on query logs, search relevance, and content discovery gaps to generate actionable insights and determine ROI of search investments.
* Translate abstract problem statements into clear requirements by assessing query intent, retrieval \& ranking model performance, and catalog coverage.
* Own and evolve the query understanding, search ranking \& relevance roadmap, and influence roadmaps within and outside the Search team to enhance the broader discovery ecosystem, including integrating Search insights with Recommendations. .
* Collaborate effectively with ML Engineering, Data Science, and Platform teams, contributing to roadmaps and prioritisation decisions beyond in the search domain.
* Show agility in responding to external signals like content launches, live sports events, and seasonal shifts, enabling swift roadmap adjustments and ensuring transparent communication of downstream impacts on search quality.
* Take ownership of key KPIs that directly aligns with Organisation Objectives and Key Results.
* Develop deep expertise \& drive strategic advancements through innovation and transformation.



**Skills and attributes for success:** 



* Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas, equally comfortable writing ML\-facing product requirements and presenting search strategy to senior leadership.
* Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex query\-understanding problems, asking the right questions to determine whether an issue is rooted in data quality, model behaviour, or product definition.
* Demonstrate the ability to bridge business problems and ML solutions, translating user and product goals into well\-scoped problem formulations, and conversely, grounding algorithmic improvements in measurable business or user outcomes.
* Demonstrate sufficient understanding of ML and NLP fundamentals, including how ranking and query\-understanding models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, to have substantive technical conversations with Data Scientists and ML Engineers, challenge assumptions, and make informed prioritisation decisions.
* Leverage a data\-driven mindset to derive insights from query logs and metrics and make well\-informed product decisions.
* Show strong user empathy, using structured problem\-solving to address pain points across various user cohorts through hypothesis\-building and solution development.
* Have a strong customer experience understanding to build and shape what the Search experience looks like for users across Mobile and Large Screen devices.
* Benchmark competitors and validate findings through experimentation, maintaining high standards for product roadmap inclusion.
* Confidently tackle ambiguous problems with minimal supervision, taking decisive action across the organization.
* Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas, equally comfortable writing ML\-facing product requirements and presenting recommendation strategy to senior leadership
* Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex personalisation problems, asking the right questions to determine whether an issue is rooted in data quality, model behaviour, or product definition
* Demonstrate the ability to bridge business problems and ML solutions, translating user and product goals into well\-scoped ML problem formulations, and conversely, grounding algorithmic improvements in measurable business or user outcomes
* Demonstrate sufficient understanding of ML fundamentals, including how recommendation models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, to have substantive technical conversations with Data Scientists and ML Engineers, challenge assumptions, and make informed prioritisation decisions



**Preferred education and experience:** 



* Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent preferred. Minimum 7\+ years of experience with at least 5 years of experience in product management
* At least 2 years owning ML / search / recommendation products at consumer scale, with a demonstrable track record of shipping measurable metric improvements, not just features.
* Fluency in the ML product lifecycle: feature engineering, A/B experiment design, metric interpretation, and launch readiness is a bonus.



**About JioStar**

If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Directs a comprehensive product strategy from product conception and definition through end of life. Functions as a central resource with design, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing and distribution as the product(s) move through their lifecycle. Directs those involved in the design, modification and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products. Formulates and executes long\-term plans for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry\-leading trends. Selects, develops and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Job Title: Senior Product Manager**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (India GCC) / Hybrid
   

  

*(Works closely with global product, engineering, design, and commercial teams)*
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own and drive the
 **end‑to‑end strategy, discovery, delivery, and outcomes** 
 for a defined product area. This role goes beyond backlog management—it requires strong
 **customer and market insight, strategic thinking, data‑driven decision making, and cross‑functional leadership** 
 .
   

  

 The Senior Product Manager will play a key role in shaping multi‑quarter roadmaps, identifying high‑impact opportunities, and delivering measurable business outcomes for providers, payers, and partners in the US healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

**Required Qualifications (must Have)**
* 12\+ years of experience in Product Management, with ownership of complex, customer‑facing products.
* Proven experience owning product strategy, discovery, and delivery end‑to‑end.
* Strong ability to work in ambiguous, cross‑functional environments and drive clarity.
* Excellent communication skills—able to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.
* Experience working with Agile / Lean product development teams.
* Experience in US healthcare, healthcare IT, SaaS platforms, or regulated domains.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong data literacy and comfort using metrics to drive decisions.
* Experience in building AI native products.
* Product innovation experience (0\-1\)
* Experience working with global or distributed teams.
* Familiarity with Clinical data analysis, provider, payer, clearinghouse, or API‑driven ecosystems.


**Eligibility**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Own the product vision and multi‑quarter roadmap for a defined product or portfolio area, balancing near‑term delivery with long‑term strategic bets.
* Identify and articulate customer problems, market opportunities, and strategic trade‑offs to senior stakeholders.
* Anticipate industry, regulatory, and market shifts in US healthcare and translate them into product direction and investment choices.


**Customer \& Market Discovery**
* Lead product discovery by synthesizing customer research, usage data, support insights, and market signals.
* Translate insights into clear problem statements, opportunity areas, and value hypotheses—not just feature requests.
* Partner with UX and research teams to validate problems and solutions early and continuously.


**End‑to‑End Product Ownership**
* Own initiatives from discovery through launch and post‑launch optimization, treating outcomes—not launch—as the measure of success.
* Define success metrics, constraints, and acceptance criteria before development begins to enable fast, confident execution.
* Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and sequencing across teams.


**Execution \& Cross‑Functional Leadership**
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, QA, Data, Sales, and Operations to deliver high‑quality outcomes.
* Manage, mentor product management team.
* Act as the single‑threaded owner for product decisions within the area of responsibility.
* Communicate product initiatives clearly using structured frameworks (e.g., Problem → Impact → Solution → Benefit → Value).


**Data, Metrics \& Outcomes**
* Define and track product success metrics tied to business goals such as adoption, efficiency, cost reduction, revenue, and customer satisfaction.
* Use data to evaluate performance, generate insights, and influence future roadmap decisions.
* Hold yourself and the team accountable for measurable outcomes, not just outputs.


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* Clear, outcome‑based product direction that aligns teams and stakeholders.
* Roadmaps that reflect customer value, business impact, and strategic intent.
* Products that demonstrate measurable improvements in adoption, efficiency, cost, or customer satisfaction.
* Trusted partnership with engineering, design, and business teams.


**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera\-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non\-participants.*

title: Delivery and Release Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





 We're a profitable, product\-led startup that has spent over 9 years helping creators, entrepreneurs and businesses automate how they publish and distribute content across social platforms. We serve tens of thousands of active users and are scaling toward hundreds of thousands as we move beyond MVP 1\.0 in rapid iteration and accelerated feature velocity.
 



  





 Our structure is flat and politics\-free, with founders directly engaged and collaborating with the team. give people high autonomy and agency, shape our ways of working around agile and lean principles, and iterate, assess and pivot on everything. Our team spans multiple time zones, including India, the America Europe and Australia.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 As "Agile" Delivery \& Release Manager, you'll be part of our journey to b product platform. A build the next generation of our
 



  





 Your scope covers agile delivery facilitation, cross\-team dependency management, timeline forecasting, and release planning and execution.
 



  





 This is a delivery role, not a people\-management role: you own the "when" \- working alongside Product (the "what"), Engineering (the "how") and Business (the "why") to keep delivery predictable, dependencies unblocked, and releases well planned.
 



  





 You'll report to the founders, and your stakeholders will span product, engineering, QA and business teams.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Agile Team \& Project Management** 




  





 Drive facilitation of agile ceremonies such as standups, retros and team activities.
 



 Own the kanban walls, ensuring they're always up to date and prioritised by the product team. Act as agile project manager, following a Scrum or Kanban flavour shaped by the team.
 



  





**Delivery** 




  




* Drive estimation of duration based on engineering's complexity estimates.
* Compile a timeline of milestones aligned with product prioritisation and engineering estimates.
* Keep the timeline and forecasted delivery dates always up to date.
* Initiate review or re\-estimation of the timeline when scope changes.
* Update the timeline when priorities change.
* Report timeline status to business: immediately on change, and via bi\-weekly summaries.
* Keep business timeline expectations and team estimates aligned, driving consolidation where they diverge.
* Track and drive resolution of cross\-team dependencies to minimise stall time.
* Identify blockers and drive their resolution.
* Highlight blockers, resource shortages and bottlenecks to all other teams.



  





**Releases** 




  




* Plan releases as deliverables of product increments to the business.
* Manage all intersections of release planning with business, marketing, engineering, QA and support.
* Ensure necessary stakeholders are available during deployment activities.
* Document release history.
* Conduct release retros and liaise with support on incidents.



  





**What You Bring** 




  





 You've spent 5\+ years in delivery, release and agile project management roles, ideally in a multi\-team product engineering environment, with startup experience and the pace that comes with it. You genuinely enjoy the multitude of responsibilities a role like this carries in a startup, rather than seeing it as scope creep. You're grounded in Scrum and Kanban, but you adapt ceremonies to what a team actually needs rather than following a playbook rigidly, and you bring pragmatic estimation and prioritisation rather than theoretical rigour.
 



  





 You've built and maintained delivery timelines from engineering estimates, and you re\-forecast confidently when scope or priorities shift. You have a track record of surfacing and resolving cross\-team dependencies and blockers before they cause delay, and of planning and running releases end\-to\-end, including coordination with support and stakeholders outside engineering.
 



  





 Your communication is factual and direct you report status, including bad news, to business stakeholders early and plainly, without spin. You work easily across multiple teams and time zones, know how to bring focus and structure to a fast\-paced environment, and have a vast set of tools in your toolbox, acquired from experience, to shape the success of your activities. You're strong with Jira and Confluence.
 



  





**Is This You?** 




  





 High\-ownership\- energised by keeping delivery predictable end\-to\-end Pragmatic facilitator \- you adapt process to the team, not the other way around Clear communicator \- you'd rather raise a risk early than smooth it over

title: Relationship Manager — Relationship Marketing (KoinBX)
description:
**KoinBX**  
**India's Most Trusted Crypto Exchange**

JOB DESCRIPTIONRelationship Manager — Relationship Marketing

**Department:** Product Marketing  
**Reports To:** Compliance / Product Marketing  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid / On\-site)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and empathetic Relationship Manager to join our Relationship Marketing team at KoinBX. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our users throughout their lifecycle — from their very first sign\-up and KYC verification to becoming confident, active traders on the platform.

You will own the end\-to\-end user onboarding experience, conduct user interviews to uncover pain points and feature needs, and serve as the voice of the customer to internal product and leadership teams. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a genuine curiosity about user behaviour and a passion for crypto and Web3\.

Key Responsibilities

**Onboarding \& User Support**

* Guide new users through the complete onboarding journey — account creation, KYC verification, first deposit, and first trade — ensuring a smooth, friction\-free experience.
* Proactively identify and resolve onboarding drop\-offs by reaching out to stalled users via calls, emails, or in\-app messages.
* Maintain a structured onboarding playbook and continuously update it based on user feedback and product changes.
* Track and report onboarding completion rates, time\-to\-first\-trade, and other funnel metrics weekly.

**User Research \& Interviews**

* Plan, schedule, and conduct structured user interviews (1\-on\-1 calls, surveys, feedback sessions) to deeply understand user pain points, motivations, and trading behaviour.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative user insights into actionable reports for the Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
* Build and maintain a user research repository — tagging insights by theme (e.g., UX friction, feature requests, trust concerns, pricing feedback).
* Recruit and manage a panel of power users and early adopters for ongoing beta testing and feedback loops.

**Relationship Marketing \& Retention**

* Design and execute lifecycle campaigns (welcome sequences, re\-engagement, milestone celebrations) in coordination with the Marketing team.
* Segment the user base by activity level, trading volume, and engagement score to personalise outreach and retention strategies.
* Own NPS, CSAT, and user health score tracking; flag at\-risk cohorts and implement targeted win\-back initiatives.
* Drive referral program adoption and community engagement by nurturing relationships with high\-value and high\-influence users.

**Internal Communication \& Advocacy**

* Act as the "Voice of the Customer" — regularly present user insights, recurring complaints, and feature requests to the Product Manager, Design Lead, and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with the Customer Support team to escalate systemic issues and close the loop on user\-reported bugs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly user sentiment reports with clear, data\-backed recommendations for cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing on user testimonials, case studies, and community content by identifying and nurturing brand advocates.

Required Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in Relationship Management, Customer Success, Account Management, or User Research — preferably in a fintech, crypto, or high\-growth product company.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting user interviews, surveys, and qualitative research.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi is must and other regional languages is a plus.
* Empathetic, patient, and user\-first mindset — you genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems.
* Analytical thinking: comfort with data, funnels, and metrics (onboarding rates, NPS, CSAT, retention cohorts).
* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment with minimal hand\-holding.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in the cryptocurrency, blockchain, or Web3 industry.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Freshdesk, Intercom, or similar) and engagement platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar).
* Background in UX research methodologies (jobs\-to\-be\-done, usability testing, journey mapping).
* Experience with lifecycle marketing tools and campaign design.
* Familiarity with Indian regulatory context for crypto — KYC/AML flows, FIU\-IND compliance, VDA taxation basics.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or a related field.

Key Competencies

* **Empathy \& Active Listening** — Ability to make users feel heard and translate emotions into structured insights.
* **Ownership \& Accountability** — Takes full ownership of user outcomes from first touch to resolution.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** — Works seamlessly with Product, Design, Engineering, Support, and Marketing.
* **Data\-Informed Storytelling** — Turns raw feedback and numbers into compelling narratives that drive action.
* **Adaptability** — Comfortable navigating shifting priorities in a fast\-moving crypto startup.
* **Problem Solving** — Identifies root causes rather than surface symptoms; proposes solutions, not just escalations.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Front\-row seat in one of India's fastest\-growing crypto exchanges.
* Direct impact on user experience and product roadmap — your insights shape what we build.
* A collaborative, transparent, and low\-ego team culture.

Toni\&Guy (company\-owned outlets in Bengaluru) is hiring a hands\-on Marketing Manager to own local and digital marketing for multiple stores. You will plan and execute performance and brand marketing, manage mall \& partner relationships, run WhatsApp and CRM campaigns, control local advertising budgets, and convert marketing activity into measurable store visits and revenue.

Key responsibilities

* Work with mall marketing teams and on\-site mall managers: secure joint promotions, participate in mall events, ensure visibility and placement.

* Field coordination: train receptionists on lead handling, ensure 3\-ring SLA and WhatsApp response SLAs; run A/B tests for offers and booking flow.
* Compliance \& brand: ensure all marketing materials follow Toni\&Guy brand guidelines and relevant advertising policies.

Outcomes / KPIs (first 6 months)

* CPA / CPL targets achieved for each store (set per\-store baseline within 30 days).
* Increase store visits attributed to Ads / GMB by X% (baseline \& target to be agreed).
* WhatsApp conversion rate (click → booking) ≥ target (example 8–12% depending on traffic).
* Reduce marketing % of spend to revenue (OGP) by improving conversion \& upsells.
