* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads (Search, PMax), Meta Ads, Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business API / third\-party WhatsApp platforms, CRM/automation tools.
* Solid analytic skills — able to build and maintain dashboards, interpret performance and optimise campaigns to ROI. Excel / Google Sheets advanced.
* Demonstrable experience managing budgets and delivering measurable store ROI.
* Experience working with mall marketing teams and local partnership / activation.
* Excellent written \& verbal communication; ability to write compelling short ad copy and WhatsApp templates.
* Proactive, process\-oriented, able to operate with minimal supervision and manage multiple outlets.
* Education: Graduate; MBA / Postgrad in marketing or equivalent is desirable.

Nice\-to\-have

* Experience with appointment\-based businesses, salon or beauty retail.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business API integrations, marketing automation (e.g., Zoho, HubSpot, Freshworks) and Google Data Studio.

title: People Technology Staff Product Manager
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **The Enterprise Technology Team**



The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire\-to\-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data\-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.


### **The Opportunity**



Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as the Product Manager for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on Employee Growth \& Talent. You will act as the strategic bridge between global People leaders and delivery teams. You will translate strategic product visions into high\-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning \& Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI\-driven automation.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap Leadership:** Define the multi\-year product vision and strategy for the Growth \& Talent domain in close collaboration with functional and technical leadership. Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome\-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience.
* **Talent Ecosystem Modernization:** Build data\-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences.
* **Delivery Lead Partnership:** Partner closely with the Growth \& Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well\-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade\-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.
* **Functional \& Technical Alignment:** Act as the voice of the business and end users within technical discussions, translating complex functional requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade\-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long\-term scalability.
* **AI \& Talent Automation Strategy:** Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise\-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.
* **Global Stakeholder Management:** Drive cross\-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US\-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.

### **What You Bring to Okta**


* 8\+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.
* **Deep Talent Tech Domain Expertise:** In\-depth understanding of core Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and Performance/Talent Management processes, with hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Greenhouse, Cornerstone, and Workday Talent (or equivalent ATS/LMS/HCM ecosystems).
* **Strategic Business Case \& ROI Sizing:** Proven ability to translate long\-term business goals into multi\-year product strategies, build data\-backed investment cases, and measure the tangible ROI and operational impact of platform initiatives.
* **Technical Fluency \& Cross\-Functional Translation:** Demonstrated track record partnering with delivery teams on system integrations, data flows, and technical trade\-offs—translating complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and PRDs.
* **AI \& Automation Acumen:** Functional understanding of enterprise AI applications, generative AI capabilities, and automated workflows, with an appreciation for human\-in\-the\-loop design, ethical AI, and data privacy safeguards.
* **Autonomous Global Leadership:** Proven success operating with high autonomy across distributed time zones (US / APAC / EMEA), driving alignment and influencing senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams asynchronously.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience scoping and delivering solutions on enterprise platform extensibility frameworks (e.g., Workday Extend, orchestration engines, or custom application ecosystems).
* Direct experience conceptualizing, testing, or deploying agentic AI workflows, conversational interfaces, or autonomous task automation in an enterprise HR context.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance, compliance standards (SOX, SOC2, GDPR), and sensitive employee data handling.

title: Sr. Product Manager, FBA Inventory Management, WW FBA
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The WW FBA team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.  

We are looking for a Product Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain Tech, Retail, and Operations teams in IES stores to drive key FBA inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, placement sufficiency and low inventory reduction. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive a product and program roadmap informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. There is a clear path for this role to evolve into full product ownership — including end\-to\-end responsibility for a defined FBA capability area — as the team and its scope grow.  

This role sits at the intersection of business operations and product development. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain Tech, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country XBR forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence\-based product and program roadmap.
* Work with engineering, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW product roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA Product teams and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for Annual Planning, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* • 8\+ years of experience in product management, supply chain analytics, business operations, or a closely related field
* • Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* • Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* • Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* • Experience designing and running structured experiments or A/B tests to test hypotheses and inform roadmap decisions
* • Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or equivalent in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science, or Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* • Experience in 3P Business, Supply Chain technologies, inventory planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* • Familiarity with inventory systems — including placement logic, restock recommendations, capacity management, or seller\-facing tools
* • Experience working with engineering and science teams to translate operational needs into product requirements and evaluate technical tradeoffs
* • Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN, AU, MENA, LATAM)
* • Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks

 The Data Marketplace Product Lead will lead the product strategy, roadmap, delivery alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement of US Bank Internal Data Marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy, digital product management, user experience, governance, architecture, and enterprise data platform enablement.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
 Valor PayTech is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own the internal software development lifecycle for our
 **Valor Gateway and Portal** 
 — the system of record that powers the entire Credit card processing, Payment Gateway, POS Terminals, SWITCH processing, ECOM Channel, Virtual terminal including ACH capability, and ISVs support. This is a hands\-on, in\-the\-weeds role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, process, and engineering execution.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Senior Technical Product Manager and act as the operational and technical backbone of the Gateway’s roadmap — translating business priorities into clear,
 **complete** 
 engineering requirements, managing sprint execution, and ensuring releases are delivered with quality and on schedule. Above all, this role owns the discipline of
 **getting analysis right the first time** 
 : before a change reaches engineering, you are accountable for enumerating its full impact across the platform, so that what we build is consistent, complete, and free of the gaps that surface late in production.
   

  

 This role does not require coding ability, but candidates with hands\-on technical fluency (SQL, scripting, API / data literacy) will be considered a strong asset given the complexity of the systems involved.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 Four qualities define success in this role:
   

  

* A Self\-Starter and Owner — You take end\-to\-end ownership of your platform’s SDLC without waiting to be directed. You drive backlog, analysis, and releases forward, chase down open questions across teams, and treat every gap between intent and delivery as yours to close.
* Technically Fluent — You are comfortable in the details of a complex payments platform — transaction flows, data models, integrations, and configuration — and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers and QA. You reason about systems, not just features.
* Rigorous and Complete — You do not stop at the happy path. Before a change is committed, you systematically map its full impact surface — every transaction type, user persona, device population, credential form, processing feature, integration rail, and configuration state it could touch — so nothing is silently left behind. Completeness of analysis is the single most important thing this role protects.
* A Strong Executor and Communicator — You run disciplined agile ceremonies, write specifications engineering can build against without guessing, and communicate clearly with a US\-based team — turning business and compliance needs into precise, unambiguous requirements.


**What You’ll Own**
**SDLC Ownership and Delivery**
* End\-to\-end SDLC management for Valor Gateway and Portal — backlog grooming, sprint planning, release coordination, and go\-live sign\-off, working closely with engineering leads and QA.
* Project estimation and resource planning, partnering with the Senior Technical Product Manager on scoping, prioritization, and developer\-day forecasting.
* Release documentation, including change logs, workflow enhancement specs, and cross\-processor integration notes.
* Own phase one of the SDLC — analysis and requirements gathering — as the point where quality is decided. For every change, enumerate the complete impact surface before engineering commits. Facilitate pre\-commitment reviews with engineering and QA — a shared walkthrough of scope and impact before build begins.
* Translate business and compliance requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can execute against without ambiguity.


**Platform Domain: Valor Payment Gateway and ISV Project**
* Understanding Valor Payment Gateway capabilities and work towards offering them for the ISVs
* Handling ISVs requirements, lining up for work
* Prioritize based on the feasibility and the market value


**What You’ll Bring**
* 7\+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, or a closely related role, ideally within fintech, payments, banking, or merchant services.
* Proven experience managing a software development lifecycle: writing requirements, grooming backlogs, running agile ceremonies, and coordinating releases with engineering teams.
* Demonstrated rigor in requirements analysis — a track record of thinking through the full scope of a change and its edge cases up front, rather than discovering them after release.
* Strong analytical and process\-design skills, with comfort interpreting data to monitor transactional and non\-transactional activity.
* High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with a US\-based team and accurately translate their business requirements into clear PRDs and project plans.
* Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., for documentation, analysis, or workflow automation) as part of regular product management practice.
* A collaborative work style and willingness to work a hybrid schedule from Valor PayTech’s Chennai office.
* Experience reporting to or partnering closely with a Product Owner in a structured product organization.


**Qualifications**
**Nice to Have (Strong Bonus)**
* US Payment Knowledge, credit card processing and working on ISV products
* POS machines development, APP building, API integration
* Web Apps development and payment integration
* Familiarity with payments infrastructure and terminology — processors (such as TSYS, Fiserv), ACH / NACHA, ISO 8583, PCI DSS — gained through hands\-on product or technical work. Big plus – but not required.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying transaction, settlement, or merchant data.
* Scripting ability (e.g., Python) to support data analysis, automation, or reporting tasks.
* Exposure to REST APIs, JSON / XML data structures, or systems integration concepts.
* Prior experience with risk / fraud monitoring tools or chargeback and dispute workflows.
* Certifications such as CSPO, PMI\-ACP, or processor\-specific training (e.g., TSYS University).


**Why Join Valor PayTech**
 You’ll take ownership of a mission\-critical platform that touches every stage of the Valor payment gateway and ISV relationship, working alongside a focused product and engineering team in our Chennai office. This is an opportunity to shape how a fast\-growing Payment gateway integrating with ISVs to utilize our feature — and to set the standard for how analysis and requirements are done — with direct visibility into the Product and broader leadership team.

This role does not require coding ability, but candidates with hands\-on technical fluency (SQL, scripting, API / data literacy) will be considered a strong asset given the complexity of the systems involved.

**What We’re Looking For**


Four qualities define success in this role:

* **A Self\-Starter and Owner —** You take end\-to\-end ownership of your platform’s SDLC without waiting to be directed. You drive backlog, analysis, and releases forward, chase down open questions across teams, and treat every gap between intent and delivery as yours to close.
* **Technically Fluent —** You are comfortable in the details of a complex payments platform — transaction flows, data models, integrations, and configuration — and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers and QA. You reason about systems, not just features.
* **Rigorous and Complete —** You do not stop at the happy path. Before a change is committed, you systematically map its full impact surface — every transaction type, user persona, device population, credential form, processing feature, integration rail, and configuration state it could touch — so nothing is silently left behind. Completeness of analysis is the single most important thing this role protects.
* **A Strong Executor and Communicator —** You run disciplined agile ceremonies, write specifications engineering can build against without guessing, and communicate clearly with a US\-based team — turning business and compliance needs into precise, unambiguous requirements.

**What You’ll Own**

**SDLC Ownership and Delivery**

* End\-to\-end SDLC management for Valor Gateway and Portal — backlog grooming, sprint planning, release coordination, and go\-live sign\-off, working closely with engineering leads and QA.
* Project estimation and resource planning, partnering with the Senior Technical Product Manager on scoping, prioritization, and developer\-day forecasting.
* Release documentation, including change logs, workflow enhancement specs, and cross\-processor integration notes.
* Own phase one of the SDLC — analysis and requirements gathering — as the point where quality is decided. For every change, enumerate the complete impact surface before engineering commits. Facilitate pre\-commitment reviews with engineering and QA — a shared walkthrough of scope and impact before build begins.
* Translate business and compliance requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can execute against without ambiguity.

**Platform Domain: Valor Payment Gateway and ISV Project**

* Understanding Valor Payment Gateway capabilities and work towards offering them for the ISVs
* Handling ISVs requirements, lining up for work
* Prioritize based on the feasibility and the market value

**What You’ll Bring**

* 7\+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, or a closely related role, ideally within fintech, payments, banking, or merchant services.
* Proven experience managing a software development lifecycle: writing requirements, grooming backlogs, running agile ceremonies, and coordinating releases with engineering teams.
* Demonstrated rigor in requirements analysis — a track record of thinking through the full scope of a change and its edge cases up front, rather than discovering them after release.
* Strong analytical and process\-design skills, with comfort interpreting data to monitor transactional and non\-transactional activity.
* High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with a US\-based team and accurately translate their business requirements into clear PRDs and project plans.
* Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., for documentation, analysis, or workflow automation) as part of regular product management practice.
* A collaborative work style and willingness to work a hybrid schedule from Valor PayTech’s Chennai office.
* Experience reporting to or partnering closely with a Product Owner in a structured product organization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Nice to Have (Strong Bonus)**

* US Payment Knowledge, credit card processing and working on ISV products
* POS machines development, APP building, API integration
* Web Apps development and payment integration
* Familiarity with payments infrastructure and terminology — processors (such as TSYS, Fiserv), ACH / NACHA, ISO 8583, PCI DSS — gained through hands\-on product or technical work. Big plus – but not required.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying transaction, settlement, or merchant data.
* Scripting ability (e.g., Python) to support data analysis, automation, or reporting tasks.
* Exposure to REST APIs, JSON / XML data structures, or systems integration concepts.
* Prior experience with risk / fraud monitoring tools or chargeback and dispute workflows.
* Certifications such as CSPO, PMI\-ACP, or processor\-specific training (e.g., TSYS University).

**Why Join Valor PayTech**


You’ll take ownership of a mission\-critical platform that touches every stage of the Valor payment gateway and ISV relationship, working alongside a focused product and engineering team in our Chennai office. This is an opportunity to shape how a fast\-growing Payment gateway integrating with ISVs to utilize our feature — and to set the standard for how analysis and requirements are done — with direct visibility into the Product and broader leadership team.

title: (Agentic) Product Manager
description:
**About This Role**
 We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
   

  

 You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 Strategic ownership
   

  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities


 Execution leadership
   

  

* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively


 Partnership with platform PMs
   

  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success


**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
 AI\-native products or features that users love
   

  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.


 Core capabilities
   

  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

title: Product Manager, AI Data & Insight Products
description:
Overview:
**About JAGGAER:**
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.JAGGAER is the leader in autonomous commerce, delivering AI\-powered Source\-to\-Pay solutions that connect buyers, suppliers, and partners across the globe. JAI, our intelligence and execution layer, is the centrepiece of JAGGAER's AI strategy: enabling procurement teams to work smarter, move faster, and drive measurable outcomes.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Job Title:** Product Manager

**Location:** Hyderabad, India


**Reports To:** Director of Product Management, JAI
**Type:** Full\-Time


**About the Role**
==================


This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue\-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.


The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI\-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.


You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.


This is a strategy and delivery role in a single seat. You will set the direction, and you will be measured on what ships against it.


Principal Responsibilities:
* **Product ownership:** Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the data products built on them.
* **AI\-native insight capabilities:** Define and deliver new AI capabilities in this space, including generated insight and anomaly detection across customer spend, taking them from concept through early access to general availability.
* **Product direction:** Define what analytics and data products become as AI absorbs them, including how customers consume data when their own systems and agents are the consumer rather than a person, and where the boundary sits between surfacing an insight and acting on it. Establish the product direction for agent\-ready data delivery.
* **Data trust and accuracy:** Own the quality bar for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over: the definitions of core procurement measures, the evaluation approach that proves accuracy, and the standard a model must meet before it is used with a customer.
* **Committed delivery:** Meet the existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments already sold to customers, including those carried in active RFPs and renewals, and keep the install base on a clear roadmap.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration:** Work closely with engineering, applied AI, UX, and the Experience, AgentOS and Deep Research product managers, so the data and intelligence layer serves the whole JAI portfolio rather than one surface.
* **Market and customer insight:** Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings.
* **Agile execution:** Translate product requirements into clear, well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery.
* **Metrics and performance:** Define and report the KPIs for this scope, including adoption of the AI insight surfaces, accuracy against the evaluation set, and delivery against customer commitments.


Position Requirements:
**What You Will Bring**
=======================

* 3\+ years of product management experience in SaaS or enterprise software, including ownership of a product area end to end.
* Hands\-on experience with AI products, including LLM\-powered applications, prompt engineering, retrieval architectures, or applying AI to structured enterprise data.
* Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage.
* A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure.
* Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests.
* Experience with procurement, source\-to\-pay, supply chain or finance data is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and working closely with distributed engineering teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.

**Success in This Position**
============================

* An outcome focus, with customer value always in mind.
* Comfortable saying no to a capability that has not met the accuracy bar, and able to explain that decision commercially to sales and to customers.
* Able to hold both a multi\-year product direction and a current\-quarter delivery commitment without losing either.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership.
* Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go\-to\-market teams.
* Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones.

**Goals for the First 12 Months**
=================================

* An agreed product direction for analytics and data products in an AI\-first platform, signed off with Product and Engineering leadership and reflected in the roadmap.
* Generated insight and anomaly detection delivered to early access customers, with adoption and accuracy reported as the primary measures of success.
* A published quality and evaluation standard for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over, with accuracy tracked and reported.
* All existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments met, with a clear and communicated roadmap for the install base.

Customer validation of the new AI capabilities in this space, with quantified outcomes suitable for use in renewals and new business.  
* 

**What We Offer:**
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M****:**
At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.* Transparency \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth

title: New Product Development And Purchase Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Insight Cosmetics is a one\-stop cosmetic brand offering a wide range of beauty products designed for diverse skin types and skin tones. Recognized as India’s first toxic\-free brand by Bureau Veritas, Insight is committed to safe and high\-quality formulations. All products are vegan, cruelty\-free, and dermatologically tested, reflecting a strong focus on ethical and skin\-friendly beauty solutions. The brand is growing rapidly and offers opportunities for professionals who are passionate about innovative, responsible cosmetics.
   

**Role Description** 
 The New Product Development and Purchase Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end development and procurement of cosmetic products. Day\-to\-day tasks include identifying market trends and gaps, collaborating with R\&D and marketing teams to define product concepts, and coordinating with suppliers and manufacturers for raw materials and packaging. The role involves managing purchase orders, negotiating pricing and contracts, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining quality standards in line with toxic\-free, vegan, and cruelty\-free guidelines. The manager will also monitor project timelines, maintain documentation, track costs, and support continuous improvement of product performance and supply chain efficiency.
   

**Qualifications**
* Experience in new product development within cosmetics, personal care, or FMCG, including concept development, formulation coordination, and product lifecycle management.
* Strong purchasing and procurement skills, including vendor sourcing, negotiation, contract management, and cost optimization.
* Knowledge of cosmetic industry standards and regulations, including toxic\-free, vegan, cruelty\-free, and dermatological testing requirements.
* Proficiency in project management, with the ability to manage multiple product development timelines, budgets, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Analytical and research skills for market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with R\&D, marketing, operations, and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in cosmetics technology, chemistry, pharmacy, business, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in a similar role in the beauty or consumer goods sector and familiarity with Mumbai\-based supply chains is preferred.

description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Marketplace Manager** with proven experience in managing and growing **skincare, haircare, beauty or personal care brands** across major e\-commerce marketplaces.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for the **overall marketplace business**, including sales growth, marketplace visibility, product listings, promotions, inventory coordination, advertising, ratings \& reviews, and marketplace performance.

You should have a strong understanding of how beauty brands win on platforms such as **Amazon, Nykaa, Flipkart, Myntra, and other relevant marketplaces**, and be comfortable working with marketplace dashboards, data and performance metrics.

Key Responsibilities1\. Marketplace Business Management

* Manage day\-to\-day operations and performance across all key marketplaces.
* Develop and execute marketplace growth strategies to achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
* Identify opportunities to increase revenue, product visibility, conversion and average order value.
* Track marketplace trends, competitor activity, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Identify new marketplace opportunities and expansion channels.

2\. Amazon \& Marketplace Management

* Manage Amazon Seller/Vendor Central and other marketplace platforms.
* Manage product catalogues, listings, SKUs, variations, attributes and backend content.
* Ensure products are correctly categorised and marketplace\-ready.
* Improve product detail pages to maximise **visibility, CTR and conversion**.
* Manage A\+ Content, brand stores, enhanced content and other marketplace merchandising opportunities.

3\. Marketplace Marketing \& Advertising

* Plan, execute and optimise marketplace advertising campaigns.
* Manage Amazon Ads and relevant advertising platforms.
* Work with internal/agency performance marketing teams to align marketplace advertising with overall brand strategy.
* Monitor **ROAS, ACOS/TACOS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate and sales contribution**.
* Develop promotional strategies around launches, seasonal events and marketplace sale periods.

4\. Promotions \& Visibility

* Plan marketplace promotions, discounts, coupons, deals and offers.
* Participate in major marketplace events and sale campaigns.
* Work towards improving organic rankings and product discoverability.
* Identify opportunities for banners, brand stores, category placements and other marketplace visibility initiatives.

5\. Inventory \& Operations

* Coordinate closely with supply chain, warehouse and finance teams to maintain optimum marketplace inventory.
* Monitor stock levels, sell\-through, ageing inventory and replenishment requirements.
* Prevent stock\-outs and minimise excess inventory.
* Coordinate marketplace orders, cancellations, returns and operational issues.
* Ensure products remain active and available across marketplaces.

6\. Ratings, Reviews \& Customer Experience

* Monitor product ratings, reviews, customer feedback and marketplace complaints.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and communicate insights to the relevant teams.
* Develop strategies to improve ratings, reviews and overall product perception.
* Ensure marketplace content accurately communicates product benefits and usage.

7\. Analytics \& Reporting

* Track marketplace KPIs on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
* Prepare marketplace performance reports and actionable insights.
* Analyse:
* Revenue \& GMV
* Units sold
* Conversion rate
* Product rankings
* Traffic \& sessions
* ROAS / ACOS / TACOS
* Average order value
* Returns \& cancellations
* Ratings \& reviews
* Inventory and stock cover
* Identify underperforming SKUs and recommend corrective actions.

8\. Competitor \& Market Analysis

* Regularly monitor competing skincare and haircare brands.
* Analyse competitor pricing, offers, product launches, ratings, reviews, content and visibility.
* Identify market gaps and opportunities for new products, bundles and marketplace strategies.
* Stay updated on marketplace trends, beauty consumer behaviour and platform developments.

9\. Cross\-functional Coordination

* Work closely with **Brand, Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Supply Chain, Finance and Product teams**.
* Coordinate with marketplace account managers and external agencies.
* Ensure marketplace execution is aligned with overall brand positioning and communication.
* Support new product launches across marketplaces from catalogue creation to go\-live and performance optimisation.

Requirements

* **3–6 years of experience in marketplace/e\-commerce management.**
* **Mandatory experience with skincare, haircare, beauty, cosmetics or personal care brands.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Amazon**.
* Experience managing marketplaces such as **Nykaa, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata CLiQ, Meesho or other relevant platforms** is preferred.
* Strong understanding of marketplace advertising and promotions.
* Experience managing product catalogues, A\+ content, Brand Stores and marketplace merchandising.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and marketplace analytics dashboards.
* Ability to manage multiple SKUs and marketplaces simultaneously.
* Strong commercial understanding with a focus on **revenue, profitability and growth**.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on and accountable for marketplace growth**, not someone who only manages listings or coordinates with agencies.

The ideal candidate should be able to look at marketplace data and answer:

**What is selling?**  
**Why is it selling?**  
**Why isn't a product selling?**  
**What should we change?**  
**And how do we grow marketplace revenue profitably?**

Experience working with **D2C beauty brands** and taking products from launch to scale will be a strong advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Marketplace revenue growth
* Sales and profitability
* Organic product ranking and visibility
* Conversion rate improvement
* Advertising efficiency / ROAS
* New product launch performance
* Inventory availability
* Reduction in stock\-outs
* Product ratings and reviews
* Marketplace market share and category growth

title: Product Manager, Business Systems
description:
Product Manager, Business Systems
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India · Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 4–6 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager, Business Systems, to own the intake\-to\-decision process for internal business and technology requirements, while also serving as the administrator for our core finance systems.
 



 When a team brings a requirement, you will scope the problem, validate feasibility, and recommend the best path forward, whether that means configuring an existing system, automating a process, building a solution, or evaluating a new tool.
 



 You will also work closely with the Finance team to support core finance systems and the activities required to keep period\- and quarter\-end processes running smoothly.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is a unique opportunity for someone who combines a strong finance background and systems expertise with a product mindset.
 



  





 The role has two equally important aspects:
 



**The Product \& Business Systems side:** 
 You will own intake and prioritization across business functions. You will run discovery with stakeholders, assess requirements against the existing technology landscape, validate solutions through hands\-on proofs of concept, and make clear build\-versus\-buy recommendations.
 



 When the right solution is to build, you will define the requirements and partner with engineering teams to deliver it. When the right solution is to buy, you will lead the evaluation and selection process.
 



 You will be accountable not just for delivery, but also for adoption and the value realised from the solutions implemented.
 



**The Finance Systems side:** 
 You will own the administration and ongoing management of our core finance platform, including configuration, workflows, roles and permissions, reporting, and other system capabilities. You will also support recurring finance processes, including period\- and quarter\-end activities.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




**Product \& Business Systems** 



* Run structured discovery with stakeholders across Finance, Go\-to\-Market, People, Talent, Legal, IT and other business functions.
* Translate business needs into clear problem statements and well\-defined requirements.
* Assess whether requirements can be addressed through existing system configuration, automation, custom development, or a new tool.
* Run lightweight proofs\-of\-concept to validate feasibility before committing significant time or investment.
* Make build\-vs\-buy recommendations based on cost, time, risk, scalability and maintainability.
* Write clear specifications and partner with technical teams to deliver solutions end to end.
* Lead vendor and tool evaluations when a new solution is required.
* Own a prioritised roadmap and backlog across business systems initiatives.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate decisions and trade\-offs clearly.
* Drive adoption, enablement and post\-launch improvements by measuring outcomes and iterating.
* Maintain clear documentation for requirements, decisions, systems and key processes.



**Finance Systems** 



* Own administration of the core finance platform, including configuration, roles and permissions, workflows, saved searches, reports and forms.
* Support Finance teams through recurring period\- and quarter\-end processes.
* Document key finance processes, system configurations and dependencies to ensure continuity and resilience.
* Support audit requirements through accurate documentation and evidence.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual finance and operational processes and partner with technical teams to implement solutions.



**What We're Looking For** 



* **CA or an equivalent finance qualification** 
 , such as an MBA in Finance.
* **4–6 years of relevant experience** 
 , including hands\-on experience with finance systems and administration.
* Strong understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including financial close, AP/AR and reporting.
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS applications and business systems.
* Strong product thinking and the ability to evaluate multiple solution approaches.
* Ability to assess whether a requirement should be solved through configuration, automation, custom development or a new tool.
* Familiarity with common business SaaS ecosystems, such as CRM, finance, HR, support and collaboration platforms, and how they integrate.
* Comfortable being hands\-on and running proofs\-of\-concept to validate ideas and solutions.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools and modern approaches to improving business and technical workflows.
* Excellent discovery, written communication, specification and stakeholder\-management skills.
* A bias for action and the ability to take requirements from discovery to decision quickly.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of recurring business\-critical processes.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience administering enterprise finance or ERP systems.
* Formal training or certification in enterprise business systems or ERP platforms.
* Exposure to systems supporting People, Talent, Legal or other business functions.
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations and automation concepts.
* Experience supporting financial audits and compliance processes.
* Exposure to procurement, vendor management or software renewal cycles.

title: Senior API Product Engineer
description:
**About the job** 




**We’re hiring a Senior API Product Engineer in Pune!** 




 Be part of our growing international tech team building innovative telecom platforms for European market.
 



  





**About Peoplefone:** 




 Founded in Zurich in 2005, peoplefone started as a bold idea to transform telecommunications — and we’ve been growing ever since. Now active in
 **seven European countries** 
 and licensed telecom providers in five others, we’re a dynamic and forward\-thinking organization committed to innovation in VoIP and telecom services.
 



**🌐 Learn more:
 
 www.peoplefone.com**




  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




 We are looking for a Senior API Product Engineer to design and develop customer\-facing APIs as reliable, secure and easy\-to\-use products. This is not only a backend development position. You will work with product teams, internal developers, customers, and integration partners to understand their use cases, determine which capabilities and data should be exposed, and translate those requirements into clear and evolvable API contracts.
 



 You will own API design from the initial use case through contract definition, implementation, documentation, testing, publication and lifecycle management.
 



  





**Your impact:** 



* **Understand real usage** 
 – Gather and challenge API requirements together with customers, partners, product owners and internal teams, and understand how their developers will consume what we expose.
* **Design contract\-first** 
 – Design every API using a contract\-first approach with OpenAPI: agree resources, operations, schemas, error models, pagination, filtering, idempotency and async patterns before implementation starts, and use the contract as the source of truth for docs, mocks and tests.
* **Decide what's exposed** 
 – Work with product, architecture and security to decide what data and operations may be exposed, and translate business capabilities into intuitive, consistent API resources and workflows.
* **Build production\-grade APIs** 
 – Implement and maintain the REST APIs you design, with clean versioning, deprecation and backward\-compatibility strategies so partner integrations never break unexpectedly.
* **Secure by design** 
 – Define authentication and authorization, scopes and roles appropriate to customer\- and partner\-facing use cases.
* **Enable integrators** 
 – Create accurate documentation, examples and reference integrations, and support customers and partners directly during their integration work.
* **Close the loop** 
 – Establish automated contract, integration, security and performance testing, and feed real API\-consumer feedback back into the design.
* **Raise the bar platform\-wide** 
 – Define API design guidelines and reusable standards that other development teams adopt.
* **Work as one team** 
 – Participate in daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, with code reviews, pair programming and CI/CD as standard practice.



  





**What You Bring** 




***The Must\-Haves:***



* 8\+ years of backend software engineering experience, including significant time designing and building REST APIs in production
* Hands\-on experience defining API contracts with OpenAPI/Swagger, and comfort treating the spec as a first\-class deliverable, not an afterthought
* Proven ability to design resources, schemas, versioning and backward\-compatibility strategies for APIs consumed by external customers or partners — not only internal services
* Solid understanding of API security fundamentals: OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, scopes, roles and data\-exposure controls
* Confident handling of relational databases and writing clean, maintainable, well\-tested code (automated unit/integration tests as standard practice)
* Experience working directly with customers, partners or third\-party integrators to gather requirements and support their integration work
* Self\-organized, a strong communicator, and comfortable owning a feature or capability from initial use case through go\-live
* Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear developer\-facing documentation



  





***Nice\-to\-Haves:***



* Telecom/VoIP domain experience.
* Experience with PHP 8\.x, Laravel \& OOP
* Frontend experience (Vue 2/3, CSS, React)
* Familiarity with contract/schema testing tools (e.g. OpenAPI diffing, Spectral, contract test frameworks)
* Experience with containers and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI)
* Monitoring stack exposure: Grafana, Prometheus, OpenSearch
* Atlassian tooling: Jira, Confluence.
* Agile mindset and experience with Scrum methodologies



  





**Why Join peoplefone?** 



* Young, international team \- short communication paths, direct decisions
* Daily challenges in an open, innovative environment with a team that supports and inspires each other
* Training time and budget allocated for your growth
* Career Growth opportunities into an evolving team

title: Product Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
 This entry level/early career professional, product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub\-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates product problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Main focus will include working in business processes of Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI) or Current Product Support (CPS) and executing technical processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) while using tools such as 7\-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Applies Principles of Statistical Methods \- Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data\-based decisions.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Design Integration \- Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross\-functional design review.
   

  

 Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls \- Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
   

  

 Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems \- Acquires and applies an in\-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.
   

  

 Mechanical Design Specification \- Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross\-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.
   

  

 Product Configuration and Change Management \- Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.
   

  

 Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control \- Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.
   

  

 Product Failure Mode Avoidance \- Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Interface Management and Integration \- Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.
   

  

 Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Technical Documentation \- Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Self\-development \- Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

title: Senior Manager - Technical Program Management
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 We're seeking an experienced
 **Senior Manager of Technical Program Management** 
 (TPM) to lead a team of TPMs and drive execution across our most critical, cross\-functional engineering initiatives. This role blends people leadership, program strategy, and hands\-on execution — you'll build and mentor a high\-performing TPM team while personally driving alignment across engineering, product, and business stakeholders on our highest\-priority programs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has deep technical fluency, a track record of managing complex programs from concept to launch, and the leadership skills to grow a team while raising the bar on program management practices across the organization.
   

  

**HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**
* Lead and grow a team of TPMs, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of major, cross\-organizational technical programs — from scoping and planning through execution, risk management, and launch.
* Partner with engineering leadership, product management, and design to align on roadmaps, priorities, and tradeoffs across multiple teams.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, surfacing dependencies, blockers, and resourcing gaps before they impact timelines.
* Establish and evolve program management practices — tooling, rituals, reporting, and processes that scale with the organization.
* Drive clear, concise communication of program status, risks, and decisions to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Facilitate technical planning processes such as quarterly roadmap planning, sprint/PI planning, and post\-mortems.
* Champion a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, using data and retrospectives to refine how the team plans and executes.
* Represent the TPM function in cross\-functional leadership forums and influence organizational strategy.


**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a related discipline, including 2\+ years directly managing a team of TPMs or program managers.
* Strong technical background — CS degree or equivalent experience, with enough fluency in software architecture, APIs, and infrastructure to engage credibly with engineers and make informed tradeoff decisions.
* Demonstrated success leading large, complex, cross\-functional programs (multiple teams, competing priorities, ambiguous scope) to successful completion.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience communicating effectively to both engineers and senior executives.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to drive decisions.
* Experience with program/project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence Smartsheet) and methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
* A track record of building or scaling program management processes within a growing engineering organization.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clear, actionable narratives.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support high\-quality decision\-making.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in data security, data management, backup/recovery, or infrastructure/cloud software.
* Familiarity with hybrid and multicloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and enterprise IT workloads.
* Background as a software engineer, engineering manager, or in a related technical role prior to moving into program management.
* Experience operating through a large\-scale product integration or M\&A (e.g., platform consolidation efforts).
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent certification.

 We are hiring an experienced Ecommerce Manager to lead our ecommerce team and take ownership of marketplace performance across Amazon and Flipkart.

 Lead the team and own results

 Essential experience

 Experience with home appliances or consumer durables; Unicommerce or a similar order and inventory system; and additional marketplaces or a brand's own ecommerce website.

 Team delivery against agreed KPIs, staff development, profitable sales growth, advertising efficiency, stock availability, account health, and fewer avoidable operational errors. Numerical targets will be agreed after reviewing the current business baseline.

title: Project Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE TEAM** 




 The Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the Quality Council of India (QCI) is a team of young professionals working to augment the capacity of government bodies in policy making and to formulate high\-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. We function as a high\-impact consulting group within QCI: a fast\-paced, mission\-driven unit whose work sits at the intersection of policy, research and project management.
 



 Our work spans strategic transformation of service lines across QCI's boards and divisions, conceptualisation and launch of new projects and proposals aligned to national priorities, strategic research and advisory on current and emerging policies, quality assurance, and technology\-led transformations, and comprehensive research and assessment studies for central and state government bodies.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




 As Project Manager within the Project Management Unit, you own day\-to\-day execution of the engagement. You manage deliverables control, coordinate across headquarters and field, consolidate inputs from a panel of subject\-matter experts, and ensure adherence to timelines, quality standards and reporting requirements. You direct workstreams against defined stage gates, own methodology and sampling where required, and consolidate findings into decision\-ready reports for the client's acceptance. You act as a day\-to\-day point of contact for senior government counterparts and translate their objectives into rigorous, well\-sequenced delivery.
 



 The role blends delivery leadership, people management, and client management on a high\-visibility national programme, and is a blend of a strategist, a project management professional, and a public\-sector adviser.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE IS A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY** 




 You will be at the epicentre of policy and execution, translating the Viksit Bharat @ 2047 vision into actionable, on\-the\-ground projects that affect millions of lives, rather than producing reports and opinion pieces alone.
 



 We are looking for individuals who want to look back at their careers and point to a specific national programme and say, 'I helped build that.' If you have intellectual rigour, a strong commitment to public service, and the resilience to navigate complex challenges, this is the place for you.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 The role carries clearly defined ownership across the following areas, applied to the engagements to which you are assigned:
 


* **Day\-to\-Day Execution \& Deliverables Control:** 
 Manage day\-to\-day execution of the engagement, control deliverables end\-to\-end, and ensure scope, timelines and quality are met across assigned workstreams.
* **Coordination \& Input Consolidation:** 
 Coordinate with client headquarters and field, and consolidate inputs from all subject\-matter experts into coherent, integrated deliverables.
* **Methodology \& Baseline Ownership:** 
 Where directing diagnostic work, own the baseline methodology, sampling plan and stakeholder engagement, and consolidate findings into diagnostic and baseline reports for acceptance.
* **Stage\-Gate \& Quality Discipline:** 
 Sequence design work against stage gates, review outputs for quality, and ensure adherence to timelines, quality standards and reporting requirements.
* **Team Management \& Capability Building:** 
 Supervise, mentor and review the work of Associate Managers, Analysts and Coordinators; allocate tasks, manage workloads, and build the team's research and analytical capability.
* **Client \& Stakeholder Management:** 
 Manage day\-to\-day engagement with government counterparts and stakeholders; lead interviews, drive decisions in meetings, and present findings clearly and with calibrated confidence.
* **Reporting \& Storytelling:** 
 Structure the storyline and own the analytical report, scorecard and presentation for leadership audiences.
* **Quality Assurance \& Delivery Governance:** 
 Own milestone and SLA tracking and compliance with confidentiality, data\-ownership and Government of India data\-governance requirements.
* **Business Development:** 
 Identify opportunities for scaling the team's impact, contributing to organisational growth and business development objectives.



  





**REQUIRED CAPABILITIES** 




 We expect an ideal candidate to demonstrate the following capabilities. Technical capabilities are transferable across SPD engagements; behavioural capabilities are common to all SPD roles.
 



  





**Technical Capabilities**

 \&
 
**Behavioural Capabilities**






**Project \& Programme Management** 




 A strategic, highly organised approach to planning, tracking and delivering multi\-workstream engagements to milestones and SLAs, managing risks, dependencies, field operations and delivery governance.
 



**Leadership \& Ownership** 




 You lead from the front, set the standard for your team, and stay calm and decisive under pressure and ambiguity.
 



**Research Design \& Methodology** 




 Architect mixed\-method studies and diagnostic assessments, including sampling strategy, instrument design and analytical frameworks, for large\-scale, geographically distributed engagements.
 



**High Degree of Curiosity** 




 A genuine interest in how India's public services, policy and governance systems work; someone who naturally follows trends and asks 'why'.
 



**Structured Thinking \& Writing** 




 Frame ambiguous problems, structure a compelling top\-down storyline, and communicate logically and persuasively in writing and on slides.
 



**Integrity \& Accountability** 




 Taking ownership of tasks, delivering on commitments, and upholding the highest ethical standards in all work and interactions.
 



**Data Analysis \& Interpretation** 




 Command of data cleaning and analytics using tools such as MS Excel, STATA, R, Python and Power BI or Tableau, with the judgement to interpret results soundly.
 



**Meticulous Attention to Detail** 




 The person who catches the typo, the formatting error or the mismatched number that others miss; in this work, details are critical.
 



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 Executive presence to manage senior government stakeholders, drive decisions in meetings, and build trusted client relationships.
 



**Reliability \& Time Management** 




 Trusted to manage multiple competing priorities and deliver high\-quality work to tight deadlines.
 



**Visualisation, Presentation \& AI Efficiency** 




 Strong data\-visualisation and presentation skills using the MS suite, and effective use of generative\-AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis across the team.
 



**Coachability \& Humility** 




 A strong desire to learn and to teach, with a positive, resilient attitude toward receiving and implementing detailed, critical feedback.
 



  





**ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA \& REQUIREMENTS** 



* **Education:** 
 Postgraduate Degree/ Diploma in Management/Operations/Finance/Marketing/Supply Chain/General Admin/Economics/Statistics/Public Policy/Business, or a related field is required. A background in Engineering, Technology, Data Science or IT Management is also relevant for technology\-led engagements.
* **Experience:** 
 10 or more years of professional experience in public\-sector or strategy consulting, project management, market research, or organisational and digital transformation initiatives, with a track record of leading multi\-workstream engagements and teams, and acting as primary client liaison.
* **Preferred:** 
 Prior experience managing government and public\-sector engagements, client relationships and pan\-India field operations, and an in\-depth understanding of public\-sector processes, capacity\-building frameworks and digital transformation.
* **Location:** 
 Based at the
 **PMU in Delhi, with pan\-India travel as required for client engagement and field oversight. Specific location will be confirmed at the time of offer, based on active engagement needs.**
