description:
AEDEN FRUITS INTERNATIONAL PVT LTD

**Digital Marketing \& Content Creator Intern**

Kochi HQ, Kerala

POSITION DETAILS

**Position Title**

**Digital Marketing \& Content Creator Intern**

**Department**

Digital Marketing \& Communications

**Reports To**

Digital Marketing Manager / Communications Head

**Location**

Aeden HQ, Kochi, Kerala

**Employment Type**

Internship (Full\-Time)

3–6 months (extendable based on performance)

**Monthly Stipend**

₹5,000–₹7,000 (based on experience and performance)

ABOUT AEDEN FRUITS INTERNATIONAL

Aeden Fruits International Pvt Ltd is a leading fruit and vegetable supplier operating across India. We are scaling our digital presence to reach modern retail, food service, and e\-commerce customers. Our Digital Marketing team is building content strategy around video, podcasts, social media, and thought leadership to establish Aeden as a trusted voice in the fresh produce industry.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Marketing \& Content Creator Intern is a unique opportunity for someone passionate about content creation, storytelling, and the digital landscape — but unsure where to start professionally. You will work as the on\-camera talent and content contributor for Aeden's digital initiatives, including podcast hosting, video acting, product demonstrations, testimonials, and social media presence. This is a hands\-on learning role designed to build your portfolio while contributing to Aeden's brand growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESPodcast \& Audio Content

· Host Aeden's podcast series on agribusiness, supply chain, and fresh produce trends

· Conduct interviews with industry experts, farmers, and thought leaders

· Prepare talking points and research topics before recording

· Assist in podcast planning, scheduling, and distribution

· Participate in podcast editing and post\-production feedback

· Engage with listeners and build podcast community

Video Content \& On\-Camera Presence

· Act as on\-camera talent for Aeden marketing videos

· Host product demonstration videos (fruit varieties, quality, freshness)

· Create testimonial and educational videos for customers and stakeholders

· Participate in behind\-the\-scenes content and warehouse/farm tours

· Perform in social media videos, reels, and short\-form content

· Assist with video planning, scripting, and content ideation

Digital Content Production

· Support video shooting, recording, and production setup

· Collaborate with videographers and content producers

· Provide feedback on scripting, messaging, and creative direction

· Assist with content editing and post\-production reviews

· Participate in brainstorming sessions for content strategy

Social Media \& Community Engagement

· Feature in social media content (Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook)

· Engage with audience comments and community feedback

· Assist with social media content planning and scheduling

· Help build brand personality across digital channels

· Support live streaming and interactive digital events

Learning \& Skill Development

· Learn podcast production, editing, and distribution best practices

· Develop on\-camera presence, public speaking, and communication skills

· Understand digital marketing strategy and content planning

· Gain exposure to video production workflow and post\-production

· Build a personal portfolio of content work

· Receive mentorship from Digital Marketing team

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONSEducation

· Currently pursuing or recently completed Bachelor's degree (any stream); Communications, Media, Marketing, Journalism, or Entrepreneurship preferred but not mandatory

Skills \& Competencies

· Comfortable on camera and with public speaking (no prior acting/hosting experience required)

· Good communication skills with clear diction and articulation

· Basic understanding of social media and digital platforms

· Willingness to learn podcast production and video creation

· Proficiency in basic MS Office and Google Workspace

· Adaptability and comfort with trying new things

· Enthusiasm for content creation and storytelling

Personal Attributes

· Genuine interest in content creation and digital marketing (entry\-level okay)

· Open\-minded and eager to learn from experienced team members

· Reliable, punctual, and committed to assignments

· Collaborative and team\-oriented approach

· Willingness to be the "face" of Aeden's digital initiatives

· Comfortable with constructive feedback and iteration

· Passion for fresh produce, agriculture, or food industry (helpful but not required)

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

· Prior experience in content creation, blogging, or social media management

· Experience in public speaking, theater, debate, or media clubs

· Basic knowledge of video editing software (Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut)

· Familiarity with podcast platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, RSS feeds)

· Personal blog, YouTube channel, or social media presence (even if small)

· Graphic design or visual communication skills

· Interest in agribusiness, supply chain, or sustainability topics

WHAT YOU'LL GAIN FROM THIS INTERNSHIP

· Hands\-on experience in podcast hosting and production

· Real\-world video production and on\-camera talent experience

· Mentorship from experienced digital marketing and content professionals

· Portfolio pieces (podcast episodes, videos, social content) to showcase to future employers

· Understanding of content strategy, audience engagement, and digital marketing

· Exposure to agribusiness and supply chain communications

· Networking opportunities in the content creation and marketing space

· Potential for performance\-based extension to part\-time or full\-time role

· Certificate of completion and strong reference letter

· Foundational skills to launch a career in content creation, marketing, or media

INTERNSHIP TERMS \& CONDITIONSDuration \& Schedule

· Initial Duration: 3–6 months (flexible based on learning progression)

· Work days: Monday to Friday (6 hours per day) \+ occasional Saturday shoots/events

· Working hours: 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM (flexible for content production schedules)

· Production days may have flexible hours for shooting, podcasting, or events

Compensation \& Benefits

· Monthly stipend: ₹5,000–₹7,000 (disbursed monthly via bank transfer)

· Higher stipend offered based on prior experience or exceptional performance

· No health insurance, PF, or statutory benefits during internship

· Reimbursement: Local transportation costs covered for shoots/events

· Portfolio materials (videos, podcast episodes) provided at internship end

Expectations \& Conduct

· Interns are bound by Aeden's Code of Conduct, confidentiality policy, and brand guidelines

· Attendance and punctuality at scheduled shoots, podcasts, and meetings are mandatory

· Professional behavior on and off\-camera is expected (brand representative)

· Creative input and feedback are welcomed; willingness to take direction is essential

· Confidentiality: Do not share unreleased content or internal discussions publicly

· Use of Aeden's name/logo only with explicit approval from marketing team

· Any breach of conduct or guidelines may result in internship termination

Post\-Internship

· Performance evaluation at end of internship period

· Strong performers may be offered part\-time or full\-time role in marketing/content

· Certificate of completion, reference letter, and portfolio compilation provided

· Opportunity to remain as freelance content contributor (optional)

· No contractual obligation for either party beyond the internship period

WORKING CONDITIONS \& ENVIRONMENT

· Primary location: Aeden HQ, Kochi, with occasional on\-site shoots at warehouse/operations

· Work environment: Office\-based, studio/podcast recording space, and field shoots

· Content production: May involve early morning or evening shoots for specific campaigns

· On\-camera presence: Professional grooming and appearance expected during shoots

· Collaboration: Frequent interaction with videographers, editors, and marketing team

· Flexibility: Willingness to adapt to production schedules and creative direction

· Travel: Occasional local travel for on\-location shoots (within Kochi/Kerala region)

LEARNING ROADMAP

This internship is designed as a learning experience with structured progression:

· Month 1: Onboarding, podcast basics, on\-camera training, brand messaging

· Month 2–3: Lead podcast episodes, feature in multiple videos, build portfolio

· Month 4–6: Mentor junior content contributors, lead content strategy ideas, independent projects

APPLICATION PROCESS

1\. To apply:

1\. Submit a resume highlighting relevant background (education, prior content work, media club participation, etc.)

2\. Provide a brief cover letter (200–300 words) explaining why you're interested in content creation and why Aeden appeals to you

3\. Share links to your portfolio (personal blog, YouTube channel, Instagram, podcast, or any content work — even if small)

4\. Submit a 1–2 minute video introduction (casual, smartphone video is fine) talking about yourself and why you want this role

5\. Be prepared for a casual conversation about digital marketing, content creation, and your learning goals

Send applications to: Sam, HR Manager, Aeden Fruits International Pvt Ltd

title: Project Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru and Hyderabad
 



 Experience \- 6\-7 Years
 



  





 Roles and Responsibilities:
 



 To lead and manage end\-to\-end delivery of workplace interior projects under the Shyftworks vertical, ensuring timely execution, cost efficiency, quality compliance, and seamless coordination between design, vendors, and clients. The Project Manager is responsible for converting approved designs into high\-quality built environments while upholding Shyftworks’s standards of execution and service excellence.
 



**1\. Project Planning \& Scheduling** 



* Develop comprehensive project execution plans, timelines, and resource allocation schedules.
* Conduct site feasibility checks and validate the scope of work before project commencement.
* Coordinate with design and estimation teams to finalise BOQs, project budgets, and execution plans.
* Prepare weekly and monthly work schedules aligned with overall project timelines.



**2\. Site Execution \& Quality Control** 



* Oversee daily site operations and ensure overall execution aligns with approved drawings and specifications.
* Monitor workmanship, finishing quality, materials usage, and adherence to safety standards.
* Conduct regular site reviews and quality audits; resolve deviations or technical issues proactively.
* Maintain updated site records, MIS reports, and daily progress logs.



**3\. Vendor, Contractor \& Material Coordination** 



* Manage subcontractors, labor teams, and vendor partners to ensure timely delivery of tasks.
* Coordinate material procurement, delivery schedules, and site storage planning.
* Review contractor bills, work orders, and reconciliation documentation.
* Ensure all vendors follow Shyftworks’s quality, compliance, and safety guidelines.



**4\. Client Communication \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the single point of contact for the client throughout the project duration.
* Provide regular updates, progress reports, and issue escalations to ensure transparency.
* Conduct weekly project review meetings with clients and internal teams.
* Manage change requests and ensure documentation of variations or additional work.



**5\. Design Coordination \& Technical Validation** 



* Review design intent drawings, GFC sets, and technical details with the design team.
* Ensure on\-site execution aligns with the approved design and brand standards.
* Coordinate with MEP consultants and vendors for execution of electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and network infrastructure.
* Flag and resolve technical conflicts between architectural and MEP services.



**6\. Cost, Time \& Risk Management** 



* Track project costs, material usage, and labour productivity to maintain budget discipline.
* Identify risks and delays early; prepare mitigation plans and corrective actions.
* Ensure strict adherence to project timelines and milestone commitments.
* Support project closure process including snagging, rectification, and handover.



**7\. Handover, Documentation \& Closure** 



* Prepare final snag lists, checklists, testing reports, and compliance documents.
* Ensure smooth handover of the completed project to the client.
* Prepare a final project report with timelines, quality checks, vendor performance, and cost summary.
* Conduct post\-handover review to identify improvement areas for future projects.



**Behavioural \& Functional Competencies** 



* Strong leadership, ownership, and team coordination abilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong understanding of interior materials, MEP services, and execution processes.
* Detail\-oriented approach with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced environments with tight deadlines.

* Establish project objectives, execution plans, governance, roles, reporting lines, communication protocols, milestones and working procedures.
* Lead project meetings, track decisions and actions, manage priorities across multiple initiatives, and provide direction and coaching to project team members.
* Client and Stakeholder Management
* Act as the single point of contact for the client and understand business objectives, requirements, constraints and expectations.
* Build effective relationships with senior leaders, consultants, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors and internal teams.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, communicate project status clearly, and escalate critical issues with practical recommendations and resolution plans.
* Planning, Design and Procurement
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestone plans, procurement programmes and resource plans; monitor critical paths, approvals, long\-lead items and material deliveries.
* Coordinate and review drawings, specifications and technical submissions for completeness, coordination, constructability and compliance; resolve design gaps and support value engineering.
* Manage pre\-construction activities, tender documentation, bid evaluation, vendor selection, statutory approvals, permits and inspections.
* Contract, Change and Commercial Management
* Administer consultant, contractor and vendor contracts, including obligations, notices, claims, variations, extensions of time, change orders and performance reviews.
* Manage budgets, cost plans, commitments, expenditures, accruals, invoices, forecasts, cash flows, payment cycles and revenue tracking in JLL and client systems.
* Prepare cost and variance reports, identify potential overruns, certify bills against verified progress, resolve financial discrepancies, and complete final reconciliation at closeout.
* Construction, Quality and Safety
* Monitor construction through site visits, inspections, progress reviews and coordination meetings; verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications and contractual requirements.
* Coordinate site activities across design, procurement, construction and commissioning teams while monitoring workmanship, material quality, productivity and resource deployment.
* Implement QA/QC and health, safety, environmental and statutory controls; track observations, non\-conformances, defects and corrective actions through closure.
* Risk, Reporting and Information Control
* Maintain risk and issue registers, assign owners, develop mitigation and recovery plans, monitor residual exposure and escalate high\-impact matters promptly.
* Prepare accurate daily, weekly and monthly reports covering progress, milestones, cost, cash flow, procurement, quality, safety, risks, issues and upcoming priorities.
* Maintain reliable project data in AdaptiveWork and other systems, including workplans, budgets, risks, actions, decisions, changes, approvals and meeting minutes.
* Maintain complete and auditable project records, including contracts, drawings, specifications, permits, correspondence, reports, checklists and approvals.
* Commissioning, Handover and Closeout
* Plan and coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, final acceptance and closure of all outstanding works.
* Manage submission and approval of as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, warranties, test certificates, training records, completion certificates and statutory documentation.
* Support final account settlement, financial reconciliation, contract closure, lessons learned and a structured transition to the client or operations team.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Graduate degree in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Architecture (B.Arch.), or a related discipline.
* 9\-12 years of relevant experience in project management or project management consultancy, with strong end\-to\-end delivery experience.
* Experience in corporate interior fit\-outs, commercial buildings or capital works; MEP experience is preferred, with the ability to manage C\&I projects.
* Demonstrated capability in planning, design coordination, procurement, tendering, contract administration, construction monitoring, cost control, risk management and closeout.
* Experience managing multiple projects, budgets, cash flows, invoices, commitments, consultants, contractors, subcontractors and vendors.
* Working knowledge of AdaptiveWork or comparable project management platforms, project reporting portals and Microsoft Office.


 Core Competencies
   

  

**Client Focus and Ownership**
 Prioritises client outcomes while protecting commercial and organisational interests.
   

  

**Communication and Influence**
 Communicates complex matters clearly and engages confidently with senior stakeholders.
   

  

**Planning and Organisation**
 Applies a structured, detail\-oriented approach and manages competing priorities effectively.
   

  

**Leadership and Collaboration**
 Builds trust, promotes accountability, and mentors team members to achieve shared goals.
   

  

**Judgement and Problem Solving**
 Makes sound decisions, anticipates risks, and develops practical solutions under pressure.
   

  

**Adaptability and Initiative**
 Learns quickly and performs effectively in dynamic, ambiguous and deadline\-driven environments.

* Proven experience managing contractors, consultants, vendors, and multiple project stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of project budgets, BOQs, billing, variations, and change management.
* Experience managing contractual obligations, deviations, and project risks.
* Strong proficiency in MS Project / Primavera, Excel trackers, and project dashboards.
* Excellent client management, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong attention to detail with a structured, outcome\-oriented approach.
* Ability to independently lead projects from mobilization through handover.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience working with major IPCs / global real estate consultancies
 
**(Must have)**

* Experience working with enterprise and multinational clients.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a Diploma in Civil Engineering or B.Arch, M.Arch, MBA in Project Management, or an equivalent educational qualification
* PMP, PRINCE2, LEED, IGBC, or equivalent certification.

* Exposure to NBC, NFPA, IGBC, and other relevant building and safety standards.



  





 About Altre Build Tech
 



  





 Altre Build Tech is a tech\-enabled design, build, and project management platform delivering high\-quality corporate fit\-outs, workspaces, and real estate solutions across India. Our mission is to bring transparency, predictability, and performance excellence to every project through integrated design, construction, and technology.

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to lead a complex enterprise data\-retention and regulatory program within a highly regulated financial\-services environment.
 



 This is a
 **pure\-play Project Management role**

 The ideal candidate will bring strong ownership, planning discipline, stakeholder management, governance, risk management, and the ability to independently drive teams toward committed outcomes.

 **Credit Cards business**

 The Project Manager will coordinate across Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Product, Data teams, and external vendors to ensure the program is delivered successfully.

 .

 .

title: Program Manager (PMO & IT Delivery)
description:

 **Whitefield, Bangalore\-KA , India**
****What You Will Do:****
 The
 **Finance Transformation Lead** 
 plays a senior role within the
 **Analytics Center of Excellence (COE) – Continuous Improvement (CI)** 
 , accountable for
 **shaping, leading, and delivering complex finance transformation initiatives** 
 across global finance operations.
   

  

 This role is designed for a
 **high\-performing, tech‑savvy finance transformation professional** 
 with
 **8–12 years of experience** 
 , typically gained through
 **management consulting, advanced analytics, finance systems, or large‑scale finance transformation programs** 
 .
   

  

 The position requires strong
 **strategic thinking, solution design capability, and stakeholder influence** 
 , acting as a
 **trusted advisor to senior finance leaders** 
 while ensuring measurable business value delivery.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Finance Transformation Leadership**
* Lead end‑to‑end finance transformation and CI initiatives across global finance processes, from opportunity identification through solution design, execution, and value realization.
* Own the design of standardized, scalable, future‑state finance processes, emphasizing simplification, controls, and exception elimination rather than exception automation.

**Analytics COE \& Digital Enablement**

* Guide the use of analytics, automation, and emerging digital/AI capabilities to improve insight quality, operational efficiency, and scalability.
* Ensure strong data governance, metric consistency, and reporting integrity across initiatives.


**Stakeholder Management \& Strategic Influence**
* Partner closely with GBS, Finance Leadership, Continuous Improvement Leads, Tower SMEs, Analytics teams, and IT to align transformation priorities and execution.
* Facilitate executive‑level discussions, workshops, and decision forums using a structured, consulting‑style approach.
* Prepare and present clear, data‑driven executive communications, including roadmaps, business cases, progress updates, and impact reporting.
* Influence outcomes in complex, matrixed environments, often without direct authority.


**Delivery Oversight \& Capability Building**
* Provide direction, coaching, and informal leadership to project resources, analysts, or junior transformation roles supporting initiatives.
* Ensure disciplined execution, risk management, and benefit tracking across the transformation portfolio.
* Contribute to the maturation of Continuous Improvement and Analytics COE ways of working, methodologies, and playbooks.


****What You Will Have:****
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
+ Finance transformation or continuous improvement leadership
+ Management / finance transformation consulting
+ Advanced analytics or data‑driven finance roles
+ Finance systems, ERP, or digital transformation programs

* Strong understanding of end‑to‑end finance processes, performance drivers, and operating models.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders.
* This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week schedule in the office.


****Preferred Profile \& Skills (Strongly Desired)****
* Senior tech‑savvy finance transformation profile, such as:
+ Former management or finance transformation consultant
+ Analytics‑led finance leader
+ Finance systems / digital transformation specialist

* Deep data and analytics mindset: KPI design, data lineage, quality controls, and insight generation.
* High technology literacy: strong understanding of modern finance platforms, analytics, automation, and AI enablement (hands‑on coding not required).
* Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and change‑leadership skills.
* Strong ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution.


****Skills Desired:****
**Accuracy and Attention to Detail:** 
 Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
* Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
* Productively balances speed and accuracy.
* Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
* Implements a variety of cross\-checking approaches and mechanisms.
* Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.


**Analytical Thinking:** 
 Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
* Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.

* Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.

**Effective Communications** 
 : Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non\-verbal cues from individuals and groups.


**Managing Multiple Priorities:** 
 Knowledge of effective self\-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Clarifies and handles multiple concurrent and diverse activities.

* Works with or leads others to re\-prioritize work and reschedule commitments as necessary.
* Responds to shifting priorities while maintaining progress of regularly scheduled work.
* Demonstrates an expectation that there will be ongoing shifts in demands and priorities.


**Problem Solving** 
 : Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

title: Academic Program & Innovation Manager
description:
In the role of the
 
**Program Manager, FORT.Academy** 

 the person shall report to the CEO, Forge and engage in a scope of work spanning techno\-managerial, financial, operational and administrative aspects relating to the broad
 
***Key Result Areas (KRAs)* 
 covering
 *program management \& operations of various offerings, Training services, Innovation Project Management services for MSMEs \& Startups, Partner/Client Stakeholder Management \& Ecosystem Connect, and General Administration.***





  






 FORT.Academy shall partner with various knowledge/capability partners, higher technical institutions and Industry partners (MSMEs and Startups) to implement the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum as an adjunct process to the academic curriculum, and as the consolidated process for all innovation centered initiatives, policies and programs at a national scale. The Program Manager is the operational lead for the MTP(Manufacturing Technology Practicum), requiring a high degree of organisational skill, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of the program's practical components. The role is a blend of administration, coordination, and participant\-facing support, ensuring that all program activities run smoothly and effectively.
 




  





**Introduction: FORT.Academy within Forge Innovation \& Ventures** 





 Forge Innovation \& Ventures operates as a vertically integrated enterprise, fundamentally committed to establishing and managing a national\-scale Open Innovation Value Network. The core objective of this network is to catalyse talent, technology, and ventures, thereby powering India's innovation economy in the Industrial Intelligence Age. The strategic framework of the organisation is meticulously structured around six Strategic Program Verticals (SPVs), each aligned with one of three core thrust areas: Talent, Technology, and Ventures.
 





 Forge.Academy is positioned as a core Strategic Program Vertical (SPV) under Forge's overarching "Talent" thrust area. Its primary function is to cultivate an innovation\-capable industrial workforce and entrepreneurial talent pool achieved through a comprehensive portfolio of university\-accredited/affiliated graduate education programs and professional development courses focused on innovation and entrepreneurship.
 




  






 FORT.Academy accelerates the convergence of industrial manufacturing with cutting\-edge technology, serving as the framework under which the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum for Industrial Workforce are implemented. Innovation Practicum for Technical Education is a unique program designed to redefine the role of an engineer by equipping students with a potent blend of technology, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit necessary to tackle contemporary industry challenges. Manufacturing Technology Practicum operationalises the Manufacturing Technology Practicum as the cornerstone of the Career Advancement \& Capability Development (CACD) program, providing a structured pathway for the industrial workforce to evolve from being passive technology users to becoming active innovators, strategists, and leaders.
 




  





**Position \& Designation** 




**Grade \- Manager or Sr. Manager** 





 The
 
**Program Manager** 

 to be designated in Forge at the grade of Manager or Sr.Manager shall be considered for a promotion to the role of Business Manager after having delivered a commendable performance in the stated role for a minimum tenure of 24 months.
 




  





**Compensation** 





 Forge compensation is at par with the top end of the social enterprises sector in India and continuously benchmarked to be above the average compensation offered in the social (non\-commercial or development) sector in general but significantly above the average compensation offered by TBIs. The Total CTC will include 3 major components namely,
 
**Fixed Monthly Gross** 

 ,
 
**Fixed Quarterly Payout, and Annual Development Bonus** 

 (linked to demonstration of progress on developing and strengthening capabilities in alignment with the Career Advancement and Capabilities Development framework of Forge).
 




  





**Role \& Responsibilities \- Key Result Areas** 




  





**1\.Program Delivery \& Operational Excellence** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of the MTP and all innovation programs, encompassing comprehensive logistical orchestration from inception to completion.
* Create and manage detailed course schedules while coordinating seamlessly with faculty, coaches, and external partners to guarantee timely availability of all facilities and resources.
* Ensure robust support for hands\-on lab sessions, practical exercises, and innovation projects, thereby elevating the quality of participant learning experiences and driving operational excellence
* Maintaining a high degree of operational excellence directly correlates with participant satisfaction and successful learning outcomes.



**2\.Commercialisation, Revenue Scaling \& Innovation Leadership** 



* Support CEO and CPO Fort.Academy is actively prospecting, seeding, and nurturing opportunities for commercializing various knowledge products developed, standardized, and monetized under innovation programs.
* Support the CEO and CPO Fort.Academy, Fort.Academy to manage execution of initiatives or lead certain ones for scaling revenue generation from beneficiaries including industrial companies (corporates \& MSMEs), academia, industry professionals, and startups.
* Lead innovation skills training and competencies development programs, managing design, delivery, admissions, curriculum alignment, and operational aspects for future\-ready talent.
* Lead innovation projects and services, overseeing product innovations, structured processes, stakeholder management, trainee coaching, and outcome monitoring.



**3\.Participant Success \& Support** 



* Drive participant journeys from initial enrollment through career advancement, serving as the primary conduit for academic guidance while meticulously tracking progress against defined learning outcomes.
* Oversee comprehensive onboarding processes, infuse the human touch into addressing career goals, and nurture future\-ready talent in harmony with industrial digital transformation imperatives.innovation practicum got industrial innovation
* Act as a career advancement coach and innovation mentor for diverse trainees \- including students and professionals delivering personalized support on seamless program transitions, such as from GEC Level III to PGDTM, informed by individual performance and aspirations.
* Play a deeply personal role in guiding trainees through innovation lifecycles from challenge curation and solution exploration to product concept development and MUP design ensuring the tiered program structure empowers strategic missions with vital support.



**4\.Educational Infrastructure \& Resource Management** 



* Manage the  allocation, maintenance, and optimal utilization of all educational resources essential for the MTP and innovation programs.
* Ensure availability of lab equipment, software licenses for tools like CAD/CAM or PLC programming, classroom spaces, and inventory of consumables for uninterrupted hands\-on learning.
* Develop and manage necessary systems, processes, and tools to facilitate seamless knowledge sharing, program facilitation, and resource efficiency across physical, digital, and hybrid formats.
* Maintain all resources in prime working condition while working across Forge centers to support practice\-based, innovation\-centric learning models.



**5\.Team Staffing, Training \& Stakeholder Representation** 



* Staff, train, and manage a team of competent program leads and program associates apart from playing the role of the authorised representative of the company’s CEO to all external stakeholders in the respective program ecosystem.
* Foster internal and external stakeholder communication for streamlined project completion and ecosystem engagement.



**6\.Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Diligently collect, analyse, and report on a broad set of key performance indicators (KPIs) spanning program effectiveness, participant enrollment, completion rates, satisfaction scores, and innovation outcomes.
* Gather feedback on courses, faculty performance, and specific initiatives, consolidating data for the Program Director to fuel strategic decisions and continuous improvements.
* Monitor and report product innovation impacts, ensuring timely deployment of projects while demonstrating program value through meticulous metrics.



**7\.Program Operations, MarComm \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Lead/support the effective planning and implementation of events, conferences, visits, startup demos, ecosystem meetups, and other forms of physical, digital or hybrid events required towards creating a strong pipeline of talent and industry partners for the various innovation programs implemented by Fort.Academy
* Anchor the implementation of various activities and deliverables coming under the purview of Marketing Communications relating to outreach campaigns, event collateral, social media promotions etc.

The role focuses on driving program adoption, behavior change, and business impact by enabling sales and technical teams with clear execution plans, operating rhythms, and actionable insights.
   

  

 This role acts as a bridge between the field, APAC leadership, and global stakeholders, ensuring programs are localized, practical, and effectively implemented. Success is measured by conversion of strategy → execution → adoption → revenue outcomes.

* Develop and maintain a structured feedback mechanism to assess program adoption, critical success factors, business impact, and areas requiring course correction.
* Provide regular updates and recommendations to the Global CCO team to support ongoing optimization and scalability of initiatives.
* Drive continuous program improvement by identifying enhancements to processes, tools, communication strategies, and execution frameworks.
* Enable agile decision\-making by monitoring program performance and recommending adjustments when results differ from expected outcomes.
* Ensure alignment and coordination across multiple concurrent initiatives, including product launches, professional services programs, renewals, customer success initiatives, and learning services.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership

* Serve as a central point of coordination, governance, and support, ensuring consistent execution, communication, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.
* Promote best practices, operational rigor, and a culture of continuous improvement to maximize business impact and sales productivity.

Program Execution \& Domain Governance

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 The D. E. Shaw group seeks a motivated and detail\-oriented professional to join its growing Middle Office function in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India. This team supports the lifecycle of the firm's global trading strategies and serves as a key link between the front office and operational teams. This project\-focused role offers the opportunity to lead middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies, while retaining hands\-on operational ownership. This position will initially be an individual contributor role, with the potential to assume people management responsibilities in the future based on business needs and the candidate's interest.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will lead and deliver middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies. You will act as a project manager across internal and external teams—scoping requirements, driving solutioning, coordinating testing, and owning sign\-off on product roadmaps. You will partner with trading desks, technology, operations, and vendors to convert operational pain points into durable solutions that reduce risk and manual effort. You will manually handle exceptions and edge cases that fall outside automated workflows, resolving them accurately and feeding insights back into process improvements. You will work across the full trade lifecycle and a range of hedge fund asset classes, designing corner cases and defining exception handling for post\-automation workflows. You will also build workflows, dashboards, and tooling that give the desk and management clear visibility into trading activity, operational health, and risk.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* A postgraduate degree and 5\+ years of relevant experience across the trade lifecycle, including time in or alongside middle office functions
* A robust understanding of trade lifecycle operations—trade capture, P\&L, security master, settlements, and corporate actions—and of how various hedge fund asset classes behave across their lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience managing projects end\-to\-end as a project manager across internal and external teams, including scoping, testing, sign\-off, and stakeholder coordination
* A risk\-first mindset, with the judgment to anticipate corner cases and design exception handling for post\-automation workflows
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to senior management, stakeholders, front office, and vendors
* The ability to design or contribute to dashboards, workflows, and analytics that surface operational insight


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with automation and hands\-on familiarity with emerging GenAI and LLM tooling, with the ability to identify and apply these pragmatically within middle office workflows
* Program management–related academic qualifications (e.g., MBA, PMP)

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**
* Hands\-on expertise in policy administration data migration, including Conversion strategy and execution planning, Data quality frameworks, audit controls, and governance practices

* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.


**Ideally, good to have**

* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Senior Program Manager - FinOps, FinOps PMO
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalise new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines. In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure\-to\-pay, order\- to\-cash and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon's businesses, from Retail, Digital and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance.  

  

  

  

As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Senior Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the APAC region. This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross\-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast\-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement.  

  

  

  

As a Senior Program Manager, you will lead cross\-functional teams to deliver large\-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make
  

smart trade\-offs between competing priorities. You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle, not as a peripheral tool, but as an integral part of how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress\-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, to producing launch readiness assessments and synthesising post\-launch operational data into actionable improvements, you will set the standard for AI\-augmented program delivery.  

  

  

  

You will bring high judgment to distinguish between one\-way and two\-way door decisions, driving rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring rigour for irreversible choices. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results, understanding that significant progress on a bold objective often creates more value than perfectly delivering incremental improvements. Are you ready to redefine what's possible in Program Management? Apply now and join the Amazon team driving the future of global technology and innovation.  

  

  

  

  

Who Are We Looking For?
  

The successful candidate will bring a demonstrated ability to manage the lifecycle of complex, cross\-functional programs with considerable business impact. You will have a proven track record of delivering large\-scale, highly complex business program implementations in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven and virtual environments, ideally involving systems development and integration.  

  

  

  

  

You will demonstrate:
  

  

* Active, demonstrable use of AI across the program delivery lifecycle: from planning and dependency mapping through to launch coordination, status synthesis, risk identification, and post\-launch analysis. We do not want someone who knows about AI; we want someone who delivers programs differently because of it.

  

  

* The ability to work backwards from the problem: challenging assumptions about how things have been done, questioning whether existing approaches are still the right ones, and designing solutions from the core problem rather than defaulting to precedent.

  

  

* High\-judgment decision\-making: distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, applying appropriate rigour to each, and driving decisions confidently when data is incomplete.

  

  

* A metrics\-driven approach that goes beyond tracking numbers to designing measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics (delivery completion) from outcome metrics (business impact, stakeholder satisfaction), while knowing when to trust judgment over data.

  

  

* The ability to distil complex scenarios into clear, compelling narratives and communicate persuasively at all levels — from technical engineering teams to VPs.

  

  

* A track record of force multiplication: creating mechanisms, frameworks, and reusable approaches that deliver value beyond a single program.

  

  

* Superior influencing and interpersonal skills to resolve conflicts, build consensus across organizations with different priorities, and drive cross\-functional decision making without authority.

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Your responsibilities will span seven core dimensions:  

  

* Stakeholder \& Customer Understanding: Engage systematically with stakeholders across FinOps and partner organisations to understand business problems, constraints, and scaling factors. Gather requirements from diverse personas, distinguish representative signal from isolated requests, and drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions and aligned outcomes.

  

  

Systems \& Technical Awareness: Understand the systems landscape deeply — automation limitations, integration dependencies, and scaling factors. Leverage AI across the full program lifecycle: generating and stress\-testing program plans, mapping dependency chains, automating status aggregation, accelerating testing coordination, producing launch readiness assessments, and synthesising post\-launch data into actionable recommendations.  

  

  

  

* Strategic Thinking \& Decision\-Making: Work backwards from the problem — questioning proposals and testing assumptions rather than perpetuating approaches because "that is how it has always been done."

  

Distinguish between one\-way and two\-way door decisions, develop clear program tenets that guide prioritisation, and make smart trade\-offs between time, effort, and deliverables with measurable success criteria.  

  

  

  

* Solution Design \& Process Architecture: Design scalable program mechanisms that create predictable process paths and ensure long\-term success. Streamline or eliminate excess process, steer teams away from classic failure modes, and continually strengthen FinOps PMO effectiveness by delivering innovative, think\-big improvement opportunities.

  

  

  

* Metrics \& Judgment: Design measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics from outcome metrics. Identify the highest\-leverage input metrics, use AI to synthesise cross\-team status inputs and identify leading indicators of delivery risk, and drive decisions confidently when data is incomplete — using judgment calibrated by experience.

  

  

* Execution \& Results Delivery: Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver highly complex, large\-scale programs from initiation through to delivery, on time and with quality. Take calculated risks where bold programmatic moves could deliver disproportionate impact, use AI to amplify personal capacity across the delivery lifecycle, and learn systematically from outcomes.

  

  

* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Effectively communicate with and influence senior, VP\-level stakeholders across multiple parts of the organisation. Write effective narratives, influence without authority across organisations with different priorities, and actively mentor and develop others.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of program or project management experience
* 6\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 6\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Demonstrated, active use of AI tools across the program delivery lifecycle, not just awareness, but proven application in planning, tracking, communication, risk identification, or launch coordination

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 6\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience managing programs in finance operations, procure\-to\-pay, order\-to\-cash, or payroll domains
* Experience designing and embedding AI\-augmented workflows into program delivery (e.g., automated status synthesis, AI\-generated launch readiness assessments, predictive risk models)
* Track record of creating reusable mechanisms and frameworks adopted beyond a single program

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 M.Tech/MBA/MS/PGDM; PMP/PgMP; digital transformation, CISSP/CISM, Smart City, or Digital Twin certifications; maritime, port technology, GIS/LiDAR, or ICCC experience.

title: Production & Post-Production Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Production \& Post\-Production Manager who can take a locked script from
 



 the Creative Director and be the CD’s right hand in throughout the production and post
 



 production process\- from planning and budgeting, to crew and vendor negotiations, to
 



 being on set, to final delivery of the edited video. This role sits at the intersection of
 



 production management, vendor negotiation, and creative coordination. You'll be the person
 



 who makes sure the creative vision survives contact with real\-world budgets, timelines, and
 



 logistics \- without ever using budget as an excuse for a lesser video.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Pre\-Production \& Planning
 



 ● Take locked scripts from the CD and translate the creative requirements/direction into
 



 a concrete production plan.
 



 ● Break down each script into crew, equipment, location, cast, and budget
 



 requirements.
 



 ● Lock crew members and negotiate their pay/terms.
 



 ● Scout, shortlist, and negotiate shoot locations.
 



 ● If shooting in\-office, identify and arrange all production requirements (space,
 



 equipment, permissions, setup, etc.).
 



 ● Handle relevant casting coordination for shoots as needed.
 



 ● Make budget sheets
 



 Budgeting \& Vendor Management
 



 ● Own and control the production budget for each shoot/project.
 



 ● Find creative, practical hacks to keep video quality high even under budget
 



 constraints \- the budget should never visibly compromise the output.
 



 ● Negotiate with vendors (crew, locations, equipment, editors, etc.) to get the best
 



 quality within the budget sanctioned by the company.
 



 ● Coordinate with the finance team to lock vendor registrations/onboarding.
 



 ● Coordinate release of advances and ensure all vendors are paid on time.
 



 On Shoot
 



  





 ● Be present on shoot days to coordinate all production elements — crew, schedule,
 



 logistics, vendor issues \- in real time.
 



 ● Troubleshoot on\-ground issues quickly, keeping the shoot on schedule and on
 



 budget.
 



 Post\-Production
 



 ● Coordinate the post\-production process once shoot is wrapped.
 



 ● Take creative feedback from the CD/creative team and ensure edits are executed
 



 exactly as per that feedback.
 



 ● Track edit timelines and ensure final deliverables are completed and delivered on
 



 schedule.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 ● Prior experience in production planning/coordination for video/ad shoots (agency,
 



 production house, or in\-house brand team background all welcome).
 



 ● Existing industry contacts across crew, vendors, locations, and production houses.
 



 ● Strong negotiation skills \- proven ability to get quality output at feasible costs.
 



 ● Solid budgeting and cost\-control skills, with a knack for creative problem\-solving
 



 when budgets are tight.
 



 ● Comfort coordinating with finance teams on vendor registration, advances, and
 



 payments.
 



 ● Experience with post\-production coordination \- working with editors, tracking
 



 feedback loops, and managing delivery timelines.
 



 ● A go\-getter attitude \- someone who solves problems on the spot rather than
 



 escalating everything.
 



 ● Strong organizational skills to juggle multiple shoots/projects and their respective
 



 timelines simultaneously.
 



 ● Willingness to be hands\-on and present on shoot days as required.
 



 Good to Have
 



 ● Experience working on performance marketing/ad creative shoots (vs. only brand
 



 films).
 



 ● Basic understanding of the creative process so you can bridge conversations
 



 between the CD and vendors/editors effectively.
 



 ● Prior casting coordination experience.

title: Executive - API Technical
description:
**About Apotex Inc.**
 Apotex is a Canadian\-based global health company. We improve everyday access to affordable, innovative medicines and health products for millions of people worldwide, with a broad portfolio of generic, biosimilar, innovative branded pharmaceuticals and consumer health products. Headquartered in Toronto, with regional offices globally, including in the United States, Mexico and India, we are the largest Canadian\-based pharmaceutical company and a health partner of choice for the Americas for pharmaceutical licensing and product acquisitions.
   

  

 For more information visit: www.apotex.com .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 In this role, the incumbent will liaise and work directly with the appropriate functional groups within the Apotex group of companies and external raw material manufacturers on technical, quality, and regulatory matters for New Product Development (NPD), Product Life\-Cycle Management (PLCM), and Commercial Projects related to active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and excipients. Responsible to provide a high level of expertise with regards to drug master file (DMF) review, DMF deficiencies, DMF changes, also known as supplier driven changes, raw material out\-of\-specification (OOS)/out\-of\-trend (OOT) events resolution between Apotex and its suppliers.
   

  

**This Involves**
* Driving the technical aspects of raw material sourcing projects in the region or problem\-event resolution by defining, planning, monitoring and reporting project progress/performance against timelines and deliverables.
* Updating the Sourcing Hub Leader, Global API Technical Managers and other stakeholders on project progress.
* Focusing on the end goals of delivering API technical assessments and problem resolutions with suppliers in the sourcing region.


**Job Responsibilities**
* Ensure that Apotex achieves the most rapid approval on drug product submission dossiers, the incumbent with be the lead reviewer for sourcing region originated DMFs (open\-part and closed\-part, when available)
* Ensure that the supplier DMFs conform to the most current requirements of the filing jurisdiction, for example, ICH guidelines (Q3, Q11, M7 etc.), with special attention to the most recent regulator mandated filing requirements
* DMF review must extract and disseminate relevant information needed to assist formulation development, setting of appropriate drug substance specification, and shipping and storage of materials
* Contribute to and manage response plans with manufacturers and Apotex internal groups for DMF deficiency responses, so as to not disrupt application approval timelines or the material supply chain.
* Manage the coordination of NPD and PLCM projects and process/manufacturing site changes between the sourcing region suppliers and GAPI Site Technical teams (and when required, directly with Apotex Analytical Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Formulation Development) to ensure a seamless submission process
* Coordinate the data (OOS investigation, rejection, OOT investigation, CAPA, etc) and information flow between suppliers and GAPI Site Technical teams and/or quality assurance teams for all quality and technical initiatives (Nitrosamine, Allergen, Forced degradation, Stability data, etc) quality related investigations surrounding active ingredients and excipients from the regional hub’s portfolio.
* Working with suppliers, investigate and resolve technical, quality, and regulatory issues related to active ingredients and excipients for NPD, PLCM and Commercial drug products with regard to OOS events, Certificate of Analysis (CofA) discrepancies, documentation for impurities and active standards, manufacturing process changes or site relocations, DMF deficiencies, DMF changes, and specification changes, method alignment
* Coordinate specifications revisions (monograph updates or new project status), as well as industry initiatives, between Apotex and raw material suppliers
* Assist the Global API manufacturer selection process for NPD and PLCM projects through cross\-functional communication with the technical teams at the GAPI regional hubs and GAPI site teams
* Contribute information content to GAPI supply databases as required. Maintain the Apotex SharePoint database for DMF and DMF annual updates for the regional hub portfolio
* Perform all other tasks and duties as may, from time to time, be assigned (for example, Confidentiality Disclosure Agreements with suppliers)
* All other duties as assigned.


**Job Requirements** 
  

  

* Education:
+ Graduate/ Post Graduate in Science/ Commerce, Economist (Business Administration) or Scientist (Chemistry, Chemical engineering, Pharmacology etc.)

* Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
+ Must possess knowledge of the technical, quality compliance, and regulatory requirements related to the sourcing of APIs.
+ Must possess the ability to provide solutions to a variety of problems of moderate scope and complexity.
+ Ability to read and interpret complex technical documents. Ability to write detailed business correspondence.
+ Ability to work with managers or directors and communicate ambiguous concepts.
+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
+ Strong organizational skills; ability to work independently and manage priorities.
+ Demonstrated knowledge of the generic API new product development process
+ Ability to travel to supplier sites or industry trade conventions when required.
+ Knowledge of and experience with the MS\-Office suite of products; with particular emphasis on MS\-Word, MS Outlook and MS\-Excel. Willingness to learn and become proficient with new business software applications as they are introduced to the organization.

* Experience:
+ 8 \- 10 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.


 At Apotex, we are committed to fostering a welcoming andaccessible work environment, where all everyone feels valued, respected, and supported to succeed.
   

  

 We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities as part of its recruitment process. If you are contacted to arrange for an interview or testing, please advise us if you require an accommodation.

title: Lead - MEPF (E&M)
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- MEPF is responsible for overseeing operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire safety systems across the airport facility. This role ensures that all MEPF activities adhere to quality, safety, and regulatory standards while aligning with project timelines and budgets. The Lead provides strategic direction to the MEPF team, fosters cross\-functional collaboration, and maintains alignment with stakeholders. Ultimately, the Lead \- MEPF is dedicated to delivering high\-performance, compliant MEPF systems ensuring that all MEPF systems are maintained in optimal working conditions, minimizing downtime, and ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Maintenance Scheduling \& Planning:
   

  

 Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules for MEPF systems to ensure minimal disruption to airport operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with other departments to prioritize maintenance activities, ensuring that critical systems receive immediate attention when necessary.
   

  

 Plan for shutdowns or system upgrades while minimizing downtime during peak airport operations.
   

  

 Troubleshooting \& Diagnostics
   

  

 Take a hands\-on approach to troubleshooting and resolving complex MEPF system malfunctions or failures, ensuring rapid response to minimize system downtime.
   

  

 Use diagnostic tools and equipment to pinpoint issues, developing long\-term solutions to prevent recurrence of common problems.
   

  

**Budgeting And Cost Control**
 Prepare and manage budgets for MEPF maintenance operations, ensuring that all activities are conducted within allocated budgets while maintaining high standards.
   

  

 Identify cost\-saving opportunities through efficient maintenance practices, vendor negotiations, and resource optimization.
   

  

**Safety Management**
 Establish, communicate, and enforce stringent safety protocols and procedures to maintain a safe working environment and ensure that all team members and contractors adhere to industry safety standards and regulatory requirements throughout the project.
   

  

 Conduct regular safety meetings, training sessions, and site inspections to identify and mitigate potential hazards, and respond promptly to safety incidents, implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence and maintaining a strong safety culture within the team.
   

  

 Ensure all MEPF systems comply with local, regional, and international regulations, including fire safety codes, electrical safety standards, and environmental guidelines.
   

  

**Quality Control**
 Develop and implement comprehensive quality control processes to maintain high standards across all phases of MEPF maintenance in accordance with relevant codes, project specifications, and best practices.
   

  

 Perform regular site inspections, reviewing installed systems to verify compliance with quality standards and document findings and communicate any discrepancies to the team, ensuring prompt corrective actions to maintain the integrity of MEPF systems.
   

  

**Vendor And Contractor Management**
 Manage relationships with external contractors and suppliers for specialized MEPF work, ensuring they meet quality, cost, and safety standards.
   

  

 Review and assess vendor performance, ensuring they adhere to the terms of their contracts and deliver work in a timely manner.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and manage a team of MEPF engineers and technicians, ensuring they are clear on responsibilities for each project and facilitate effective communication, setting clear expectations and encouraging collaboration to achieve project milestones.
   

  

 Develop, implement, and continuously improve team policies, procedures, and performance standards, and regularly evaluate team members, provide constructive feedback, and support their professional growth through training and mentorship.
   

  

**Energy Conservation Initiatives**
 Lead energy conservation initiatives by identifying areas of inefficiency within the HVAC systems and implementing industry best practices for energy saving and collaborate with the team to set and meet energy reduction goals, such as optimizing chiller setpoints and monitoring energy performance metrics.
   

  

 Conduct periodic energy audits and assessments to identify patterns of excessive energy usage and implement improvements that promote more sustainable operation, such as advanced controls, automation, or use of alternative energy sources where feasible.
   

  

**Purchasing And Inventory Control**
 Manage the inventory levels for HVAC parts, tools, and equipment to balance availability and cost\-effectiveness.
   

  

 Work closely with procurement to ensure that critical parts are stocked without overloading inventory, reducing holding costs while maintaining availability for emergency repairs.
   

  

 Establish strong vendor relationships by coordinating regular purchase order follow\-ups to ensure timely delivery of supplies and regularly evaluate vendor performance and negotiate terms to secure cost\-effective, high\-quality parts for HVAC system maintenance.
   

  

**Stakeholder Coordination**
 Coordinate closely with contractors, engineers, architects, and project managers to ensure that MEPF installations align with overall project timelines and milestones and facilitate open communication to resolve any conflicts or issues that may arise during construction.
   

  

 Engage with stakeholders to address design or construction\-related issues, ensuring technical queries are resolved promptly. Maintain alignment between MEPF systems and broader project requirements, enabling seamless integration and a successful project outcome.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Head \- Engineering Services
   

  

 Project Managers
   

  

 MEPF Engineers and Technicians
   

  

 Design Management Team
   

  

 Quality Assurance Team
   

  

 Health \& Safety Officers
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Architects
   

  

 Construction Contractors
   

  

 Subcontractors (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection)
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Client Representatives
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Educational Qualifications:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering discipline
   

  

**Work Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in maintaining MEPF systems, with hands\-on experience in troubleshooting and repairs. Previous experience in an airport, large commercial facilities, or industrial buildings is preferred. Understanding of MEPF systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety) and their importance in large\-scale facilities.

title: Civil Project Manager
description:
**Company:** Atlantaa Limited  
**Project:** Atlantaa Exotica  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Borivali East, Mumbai, Maharashtra

About the Role

Atlantaa Limited is seeking an experienced and result\-oriented **Project Manager** to lead and manage the execution of its **Borivali East Project in Mumbai**.

The Project Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, monitoring, and successful completion of the project within the approved **timeline, budget, quality standards, and safety requirements**. The role requires strong leadership, technical knowledge, project management capabilities, and the ability to coordinate effectively with consultants, contractors, vendors, statutory authorities, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take overall responsibility for the day\-to\-day management and execution of the project.
* Develop and monitor detailed project execution plans, schedules, milestones, and targets.
* Ensure project activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contracts, and project requirements.
* Monitor progress against the baseline schedule and implement corrective measures wherever required.
* Identify potential delays, constraints, and project risks and take proactive action to mitigate them.

2\. Construction \& Technical Coordination

* Supervise and coordinate construction activities across all disciplines.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, PMC, contractors, subcontractors, and vendors.
* Review drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, work programs, method statements, and material requirements.
* Ensure proper sequencing and coordination of civil, structural, architectural, MEP, finishing, and external development works.
* Resolve technical and site\-related issues in coordination with the relevant consultants and stakeholders.

3\. Contractor \& Vendor Management

* Manage and coordinate contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and service providers.
* Monitor contractor performance, productivity, manpower deployment, and resource utilization.
* Ensure contractors adhere to agreed timelines, quality standards, specifications, and contractual obligations.
* Review work progress, measurements, bills, variations, and claims in coordination with the commercial team.
* Drive timely mobilization and deployment of manpower, machinery, materials, and other resources.

4\. Cost \& Commercial Management

* Monitor project expenditure against the approved budget.
* Work closely with the commercial and procurement teams to control project costs.
* Review and control variations, additional works, and potential cost implications.
* Ensure effective utilization of resources and minimize wastage.
* Support procurement planning and ensure timely availability of critical materials and services.

5\. Quality Management

* Ensure construction work complies with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
* Establish and monitor quality control procedures at the project site.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, approvals, and rectification of defects.
* Ensure proper documentation of quality records, inspection reports, test reports, and approvals.
* Drive a quality\-focused culture across contractors and project teams.

6\. Health, Safety \& Environment

* Ensure strict compliance with project HSE policies and applicable statutory requirements.
* Monitor site safety practices and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly.
* Coordinate with the safety team to conduct regular inspections, toolbox meetings, and safety audits.
* Ensure appropriate permits, PPE, safe work practices, and emergency procedures are followed.

7\. Stakeholder \& Authority Coordination

* Coordinate effectively with internal management, consultants, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Liaise with relevant government/statutory authorities wherever required.
* Ensure necessary approvals, permissions, inspections, and compliances are obtained in a timely manner.
* Represent the company in project review meetings and coordination meetings.

8\. Project Monitoring \& Reporting

* Conduct regular project review meetings and site progress meetings.
* Prepare and submit periodic project status reports to senior management.
* Track key project KPIs including schedule, cost, quality, safety, procurement, and construction progress.
* Maintain updated project schedules, risk registers, action trackers, and project documentation.
* Escalate critical issues and delays to senior management with recommended solutions.

9\. Team Leadership

* Lead and manage the project execution team effectively.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish clear performance expectations.
* Monitor team performance and promote accountability.
* Coordinate across departments to ensure smooth project execution.
* Mentor and develop project team members.

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Strong knowledge of **construction project management and site execution**.
* Excellent planning, scheduling, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong understanding of civil, structural, architectural, and MEP works.
* Ability to manage multiple contractors and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Good understanding of project contracts, BOQs, billing, variations, and cost control.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet strict project deadlines.
* Strong knowledge of quality, safety, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in **MS Project / Primavera P6, MS Excel, AutoCAD**, and other relevant project management tools is preferred.

Qualification

* **Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering** or a related engineering discipline.
* A **Postgraduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management** will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **10–15\+ years of relevant experience** in construction/project management, preferably in large\-scale real estate, residential, commercial, infrastructure, or mixed\-use projects.
* Candidates with strong experience in managing projects from **planning through execution, finishing, testing, commissioning, and handover** will be preferred.
* Experience managing multiple contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders is essential.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within approved schedule.
* Adherence to approved project budget and cost targets.
* Construction quality and reduction of defects/rework.
* Timely procurement and resource mobilization.
* Compliance with safety and statutory requirements.
* Effective contractor and consultant performance.
* Timely completion of project milestones.
* Successful project completion and handover.

Employment Details

The ideal candidate will be a **hands\-on project leader** with strong construction management experience, capable of taking ownership of project execution, managing multidisciplinary teams, resolving site challenges, and delivering the project safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

**About ACCESS:**  

ACCESS Development Services is a national livelihoods promotion organization that incubates innovations and builds sustainable models of livelihood promotion for the poor — implementing programmes on the ground (Tier I); partnering civil society, government, the corporate sector and multilateral agencies (Tier II); and shaping national policy and the enabling environment (Tier III). **.ld\_spacer\_6aa1486f446f7{height:** 10px;}

Annapurna – Catalysing Women Entrepreneurship in Food Processing is a 36\+3\-month initiative supported by Bajaj Holdings \& Investment Limited, administered by the Bajaj Finserv CSR team, running from 1 August 2026 to 31 October 2029\. It works with 12,000 women from 1,200 Self Help Groups across 15 blocks of Thane, Pune and Raigad districts of Maharashtra — 4,000 women, 400 SHGs and 5 Annapurna Resource Centres (ARCs) per district, each ARC serving about 80 SHGs through centralised (at\-ARC) and decentralised (home\-based) support. Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (UMED) is proposed as a facilitation partner.
  
  

**.ld\_spacer\_6aa1486f447ca{height:** 10px;}

Day\-to\-day operational command of Annapurna across three districts and fifteen blocks — delivery calendar, field team, ARC rollout, budget burn and HQ reporting — under the Programme Lead. This is a field\-anchored role, not a desk role. ACCESS wants someone who has built a multi\-district women’s enterprise programme from inception, can hold a CSR donor’s compliance calendar without slippage, and will say early and plainly when something is not going to plan.
  
  

**.ld\_spacer\_6aa1486f4486c{height:** 10px;}
