Lead a ground team member; set work plans, review performance and hold the weekly, fortnightly, monthly and quarterly review rhythm
  
Own mobilisation of 12,000 women from 1,200 SHGs, the centralised/decentralised delivery split, and ARC premises identification, right\-to\-use, fit\-out and commissioning
  
  

2\. Partnership, Compliance and Convergence
  
  

Manage the UMED/MSRLM relationship at state, district and block level and service the Steering Committee
  
Ensure every ARC food business runs on an FSSAI registration or licence held by the community institution or enterprise group that operates the premises
  
Ensure sales revenue is transacted by community institutions and individual entrepreneurs
  
Drive convergence with PMFME, MUDRA, Udyam, MSME registration and social security entitlements
  
  

3\. Budget, Risk and Reporting
  
  

Manage a budget; track burn against the instalment schedule and flag drawdown, refund and interest exposure early
  
Deliver donor and internal reports on time, with every figure traceable to an approved source, and maintain the risk register, clarification tracker and decision log.
  
**.ld\_spacer\_6aa1486f44aa9{height:** 10px;}

Postgraduate in Rural Management, Agribusiness, Development Studies, Social Work or Management (IRMA / TISS / XISS / IIFM or equivalent)
  
8–10 years in the sector, including 5\+ years managing multi\-district livelihoods or women’s enterprise programmes with line responsibility for teams of 10 or more

Judgement under pressure, and honesty to escalate bad news early.

Project Owner Engineer – Solar EPC
 
  





**Company:** 
  Swid Renewables Limited
 



**Department:** 
  Engineering
 



**Location:** 
  Pune, Maharashtra, with frequent travel to project sites
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-time
 



  




 About the Role
 
 Swid Renewables Limited is looking for a technically competent and highly accountable 
 **Project Owner Engineer** 
  to take end\-to\-end ownership of Industrial Solar EPC projects—from receipt of the Customer Purchase Order until successful commissioning and final handover.
 



 The Project Owner Engineer will be the single point of coordination between the customer and Swid’s Design, Engineering, Procurement, Stores, Finance, Projects, Quality, Safety and Service teams.
 



 While the Projects Team will execute the installation, the Project Owner Engineer will remain responsible for ensuring that the project is engineered correctly, adequately resourced, safely executed, completed on time, delivered within budget and handed over to the customer with the highest quality standards.
 



 Although employed by Swid, the person will act as an 
 **Owner’s Engineer from the customer’s perspective** 
 , safeguarding the customer’s technical and quality expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Take complete ownership of assigned projects immediately after receipt of the Purchase Order.
* Review the project scope, technical specifications, commercial terms, payment milestones and completion schedule.
* Conduct technical site visits along with the Design Engineer.
* Collect and verify all technical inputs required for detailed engineering.
* Coordinate the preparation of layouts, SLDs, structural drawings, cable\-routing plans and other project drawings.
* Submit drawings to the customer and coordinate until final approval.
* Ensure that execution is carried out according to the latest approved drawings.
* Coordinate with the Design Team for preparation and verification of the Bill of Materials.
* Share the final BOM with the Procurement and Stores teams and track material availability.
* Visit the stores to verify material segregation, packing, loading and dispatch.
* Coordinate pending procurement and direct\-to\-site material deliveries.
* Ensure that the correct material, quantity, make and specifications reach the project site on time.
* Coordinate with the customer for material\-storage space, site access, permits, shutdowns, unloading and other site\-readiness requirements.
* Assess suitable lodging and basic facilities for engineers and project workers.
* Coordinate with the customer and Finance Department for timely release of payments as per agreed terms.
* Formally hand over the approved drawings, BOM, materials, schedule, site risks and complete project scope to the Project Engineer.
* Monitor the Projects Team’s work as an independent Quality Control and Project Assurance representative.
* Conduct periodic site inspections and identify quality deviations, safety concerns, delays, wastage and rework.
* Coordinate corrective actions and ensure timely closure of all observations.
* Ensure successful testing, commissioning, documentation and closure of punch points.
* Obtain the customer’s completion acknowledgement and formally hand over the completed project.
* Coordinate final project handover to the Service/O\&M Department.



  




 Key Success Parameters
 * Timely approval of drawings and engineering documents
* Accurate and complete Bill of Materials
* On\-time procurement and material delivery
* Adherence to project timelines and budgets
* Minimum material wastage and emergency procurement
* Zero compromise on safety and quality
* Minimum rework and execution deviations
* Timely achievement of payment milestones
* Successful commissioning and documentation
* High customer satisfaction



  




 Candidate Profile
 * Bachelor’s or Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil or Renewable Energy Engineering
* Relevant experience in Solar EPC, preferably Industrial and Commercial Rooftop Solar projects
* Practical understanding of solar design, SLDs, layouts, BOMs, procurement, project execution and quality control
* Ability to read and review technical drawings and project specifications

**Role: Senior Transition Manager** 




 The Senior Transition Manager is a strategic leadership role responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of complex client transitions, service takeovers, and transformation initiatives. The role ensures seamless service continuity, effective knowledge transfer, operational stabilization, and successful handover to steady\-state delivery, while providing executive\-level governance and stakeholder assurance.

* Define and drive the transition strategy, approach, timelines, governance model, and success criteria in alignment with client expectations and contractual commitments.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for transition outcomes, including service continuity, knowledge transfer, risk management, and operational readiness.
* Establish and lead robust transition governance, including executive steering, reporting cadence, decision forums, and escalation management.
* Develop and manage integrated transition plans covering people, process, technology, security, compliance, and financials
* Engage with senior client \& vendor stakeholders, internal leadership, and delivery partners to provide transparency, build confidence, and manage expectations throughout the transition lifecycle.

**Mandatory Skills:** 



* Extensive experience (15\+ years) in leading complex IT service transitions, outsourcing takeovers, or large\-scale transformation programs.
* Strong leadership and governance skills with the ability to influence and engage CxO\-level stakeholders.

* Experience configuring OneSource Indirect Tax Determination or Vertex O Series for indirect tax calculation
* Experience supporting indirect tax requirements for value\-added tax, sales tax, or use tax
* Experience developing SAP forms, reports, or customizations

* Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA with OneSource Indirect Tax Determination using Global Next or with Vertex O Series using Vertex Indirect Tax Accelerator

* Experience with testing tools, content updates, and configuration migration within OneSource or Vertex

description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Senior Lead, Service Delivery \- IT Service Desk**
 Work Location – Pune, India
   

  

 Job: Information Technology
   

  

 The Sr Lead, Service Delivery \- IT Service Desk is responsible for managing global IT Service Desk operations and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality support services to Northern Trust employees and contractors. This role combines operational leadership, service governance, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement, with a focus on enhancing user experience, improving service performance, and driving efficiencies through process optimization, self\-service, knowledge management, and automation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery \& Operations**
* Lead day\-to\-day IT Service Desk operations, ensuring high\-quality support, service reliability, and positive user experiences.
* Manage and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, and experience‑based metrics to drive service quality and accountability.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for critical operational issues, major incidents, and executive‑level support needs.
* Lead and participate, as required, in Incident, Problem, Change and Critical Incident Management processes related to IT Service Desk operations.
* Provide operational insights and reporting to leadership, highlighting trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure operational readiness for new services and products by partnering with technology teams on support models, communications, knowledge management, and training.


**Automation, Self\-Service \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proven experience with driving automation, self\-service, AI\-enabled support, and service improvement initiatives that enhance user experience and reduce support demand.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive work, reduce contact volumes, improve first\-contact resolution, and simplify support processes.
* Identify opportunities for workflow optimization, intelligent routing, knowledge improvements, and proactive support.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, process maturity, tooling optimization, and operational resilience.
* Partner with technology teams to deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business value through automation and operational improvements.


**User Experience \& Enablement**
* Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and support end users.
* Act as a trusted advisor on service delivery, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective communication.
* Champion a customer\-first culture focused on service excellence and continuous improvement.


**Technical Skills \& Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in technology operations, including leadership of IT Service Desk, End User Services, or Help Desk functions.
* Willingness and ability to work a flexible schedule covering part of North America business hours, including regular overlap with U.S. teams and stakeholders.
* Expected to collaborate with other SDMs and stakeholders to provide adequate coverage for operations across time zone as necessary.
* Strong knowledge of ITSM practices including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Major Incident Management.
* Demonstrated experience identifying and driving automation, self\-service, or service improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable reductions in contact volume, manual effort, or support costs.
* Experience utilizing operational data and service insights to identify opportunities for automation, contact reduction, and improved user experience.
* Experience with call center management tools such as Cisco CUIC, Verint, and/or Avaya.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft enterprise technologies including Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, ServiceNow, Copilot, VDI/Citrix, and Windows 365\.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Data‑driven mindset with the ability to leverage ITSM reporting and service metrics to drive decisions and outcomes.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 31000\), SOX 404, DORA, GDPR, PCI DSS.

 ticketing (ServiceNow/Jira).

 narratives.

**Job Profile:** Project Manager \- Corporate Interior Fit\-Out Works
  
Profile Overview
  
The Project Manager for Corporate Interior Fitout Works at JLL serves as the central point of leadership for the successful delivery of interior construction projects for our corporate clients. This role is instrumental in translating client vision into practical, efficient, and high\-quality workspace environments while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and safety. The position represents a critical client\-facing function that directly impacts JLL's reputation for excellence in project management services.
  
This position sits within JLL's Project \& Development Services (PDS) division, specializing in interior buildouts and workspace transformations for corporate clients across various industry sectors. The Project Manager reports directly to the Senior Project Manager or Regional Director of Project Management, while providing guidance and direction to Assistant Project Managers, Project Coordinators, and managing relationships with external consultants, contractors, and vendors engaged on assigned projects.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
**Project Planning \& Execution:** Develop and implement comprehensive project execution plans covering scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management for corporate interior fitout projects ranging from 10,000 to 100,000\+ square feet.
  
**Client Relationship Management:** Serve as the primary day\-to\-day client contact, understanding business objectives, managing expectations, and ensuring continuous alignment between project execution and client goals throughout the project lifecycle.
  
**Financial Oversight:** Develop, monitor and manage detailed project budgets, including cost estimation, tracking expenditures, approving payment applications, managing change orders, and forecasting costs to completion while identifying opportunities for value engineering.
  
**Schedule Management:** Create, maintain and monitor detailed project schedules using industry\-standard tools, identifying critical path activities, mitigating potential delays, and implementing recovery strategies when necessary.
  
**Procurement \& Vendor Management:** Manage the selection and performance of general contractors, specialty consultants, and vendors; negotiate contracts, review bids, and oversee the procurement process for furniture, fixtures, and equipment.
  
**Technical Oversight:** Review and coordinate design documentation, provide constructability feedback, ensure code compliance, and oversee quality control processes throughout the construction phase.
  
**Risk Management:** Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution to minimize impacts on schedule, budget, and client satisfaction.
  
**Project Closeout \& Transition:** Oversee project closeout activities including punch list completion, systems commissioning, documentation handover, warranty management, and transition to facilities management teams.
  
Required Qualifications
  
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field
  
Minimum 7\-8 years of progressive experience in project management, with at least 5 years specifically managing commercial interior construction or corporate fitout projects
  
Demonstrated experience managing projects with budgets exceeding $1 million
  
Strong technical understanding of interior construction methodologies, building systems, and local building codes
  
Proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural and engineering drawings
  
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
  
LEED Accredited Professional credential desirable
  
Knowledge of workplace design trends and corporate real estate strategies
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

**Technical Skills:**  

Proficiency with project management software (e.g., Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project)
  
Strong capabilities with Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel for budget tracking and PowerPoint for client presentations
  
Working knowledge of CAD/BIM concepts and ability to review technical drawings
  
Familiarity with construction documentation systems and processes
  
Understanding of sustainable design principles and WELL building standards
  
Knowledge of local building codes, permitting requirements, and ADA compliance
  
  

**Soft Skills:**  

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for effective client interaction
  
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
  
Team leadership and ability to influence across organizational boundaries
  
Strategic thinking and problem\-solving orientation
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
  
Client\-centric mindset with strong service orientation
  
Meticulous attention to detail while maintaining big\-picture perspective
  
Performance Metrics
  
The Project Manager will be evaluated based on the following key performance indicators:
  
**Project Delivery Performance:** On\-time and on\-budget delivery of projects against established baselines (target: 90% of projects delivered within 5% of approved budget and schedule)
  
**Client Satisfaction:** Measured through post\-project client surveys and retention/repeat business metrics (target: minimum 85% client satisfaction rating)
  
**Financial Management:** Accuracy of cost forecasting, change order management, and overall project profitability (target: maintain average project profit margins within 2% of targets)
  
**Safety Performance:** Maintaining zero recordable incidents on project sites and ensuring contractor compliance with safety protocols
  
**Quality Management:** Minimizing defects and rework as measured by punch list items and warranty claims
  
**Team Development:** Mentoring junior staff and contributing to department knowledge sharing
  
This role requires a versatile professional who can balance technical expertise with strong client relationship skills while embodying JLL's values of teamwork, ethics, excellence, and client focus in delivering exceptional project outcomes.
